-- Botanical page labels. Stroke design adapted from K1o0n/florilegium (MIT),
-- commit 72ebc0f; layout, Roman support and upright mirroring added here.
local ink, numeral = require("ink"), require("numeral")
local flora = require("flora")
local M = {}
local min, max, sqrt, atan, sin, abs = math.min, math.max, math.sqrt, math.atan, math.sin, math.abs
local rad = math.pi / 180
local function lerp(a,b,t) return a+(b-a)*t end
local function norm(x,y) local d=sqrt(x*x+y*y);return d>0 and x/d or 0,d>0 and y/d or 1 end
local function deg(x,y) return atan(y,x)/rad end

function M.layout(g, options, root, foot)
  if not options.page_number then return nil end
  local label = numeral.normalize(g.number)
  local W = label and numeral.width(label)
  if not W then return nil end
  local xmin, xr = max(root[1]+1.4,2.6), g.colright-0.25
  local H = min(3*options.number_scale,0.46*g.colright,(xr-xmin)/W)
  if H <= 0.9 then return nil end
  local baseline=(foot[2]+foot[4])/2-0.05
  if baseline<0.5 then return nil end
  local n = {H=H,label=label,x0=xmin+(xr-xmin-W*H)/2,ytop=baseline+H}
  if g.ph and n.ytop+0.6>g.ph then return nil end
  n.x1=n.x0+W*H
  for _,r in ipairs(g.reserves or {}) do
    if n.x1+0.5>=r[1] and n.x0-0.5<=r[3] and n.ytop+0.6>=r[2] and foot[2]-0.3<=r[4] then return nil end
  end
  return n
end

function M.draw(num, g, api)
  local stem, place, event = api.stem, api.place, api.event
  local add_stem_points, disc, footpts, L_LEAF = api.add_stem_points, api.disc, api.footpts, api.leaf_layer
    local nrng = ink.rng(g.seed * 7919 + 307)
    local function fy(x)
      if x <= footpts[1][1] then return footpts[1][2] end
      for i = 2, #footpts do
        local a, b = footpts[i - 1], footpts[i]
        if x <= b[1] then return lerp(a[2], b[2], (x - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])) end
      end
      return footpts[#footpts][2]
    end
    local H, x, ylo = num.H, num.x0, math.huge
    local function leaflet(ev, at, px, py, a, ls, bend)
      local sd = nrng.int(1, 0x3fffffff)
      event({ kind = "bloom", parent = ev, at = at, size = ls })
      place(L_LEAF, px, py, a, function() ink.scale(ls) flora.leaflet(ink.rng(sd), { bend = bend }) end)
    end
    for i = 1, #num.label do
      local gl = numeral.glyphs[num.label:sub(i, i)]
      local function map(p)
        local px = x + (p[1] + numeral.SLANT * p[2]) * H
        if g.mirror then px = num.x0 + num.x1 - px end
        local y0 = fy(px)
        ylo = min(ylo, y0)
        return { px, lerp(y0, num.ytop, p[2]) }
      end
      local c = map({ gl.w / 2, 0.5 })
      local ls0 = min(0.6, max(0.32, 0.19 * H))
      for k, st in ipairs(gl.strokes) do
        local ctrl = {}
        for j, p in ipairs(st) do ctrl[j] = map(j == 1 and p or { p[1] + nrng.sym(0.012), p[2] + nrng.sym(0.012) }) end
        local pts = ink.catmull(ctrl, 8)
        local nbody = #pts
        if st.curl then numeral.curl(pts, st.curl, (k == 1 and 0.075 or 0.06) * H, nrng.range(1.1, 1.4)) end
        local s, L = ink.arclen(pts)
        -- a broad nib: the taper of a stem, thicker where the stroke runs across
        -- the nib's angle and a hairline along it, so the digit reads as lettering
        local w0, w1 = k == 1 and 0.12 or 0.09, 0.045
        local wpt = {}
        for j = 1, #pts do
          local a, b = pts[max(1, j - 1)], pts[min(#pts, j + 1)]
          local th = atan(b[2] - a[2], (g.mirror and -1 or 1) * (b[1] - a[1])) - numeral.NIB * rad
          wpt[j] = lerp(w0, w1, (s[j] / L) ^ 1.6) * (0.32 + 0.68 * abs(sin(th)))
        end
        local function width(u)
          local at, lo, hi = u * L, 1, #s
          while hi - lo > 1 do local mid = (lo + hi) // 2 if s[mid] <= at then lo = mid else hi = mid end end
          return lerp(wpt[lo], wpt[hi], s[hi] > s[lo] and min(1, max(0, (at - s[lo]) / (s[hi] - s[lo]))) or 0)
        end
        local ev = event({ kind = "stem", phase = "stems", off = 0.45 + 0.12 * (i - 1) })
        stem(pts, width, nil, 0.16)
        -- the upper part of the digit can carry branches: what grows just above
        -- the number grows out of it (the box below keeps its inside clear)
        local run = {}
        for j = 1, nbody + 1 do
          local p = pts[j]
          if j <= nbody and p[2] > c[2] + 0.3 * H then run[#run + 1] = p
          elseif #run > 2 then add_stem_points(run, 0.05, 0.03, 2) run = {} else run = {} end
        end
        local function frame(at)
          local j = 2
          while j < #pts - 1 and s[j] < at do j = j + 1 end
          local tx, ty = norm(pts[j + 1][1] - pts[j - 1][1], pts[j + 1][2] - pts[j - 1][2])
          return j, tx, ty
        end
        if k == 1 then
          local nl = nrng.int(1, 2)
          for m = 1, nl do
            local u = nl == 1 and nrng.range(0.38, 0.6) or (m == 1 and nrng.range(0.22, 0.36) or nrng.range(0.55, 0.7))
            local j, tx, ty = frame(u * L)
            local p = pts[j]
            local side = (p[1] - c[1]) * -ty + (p[2] - c[2]) * tx >= 0 and 1 or -1
            leaflet(ev, s[j] / L, p[1], p[2], deg(tx, ty) + side * nrng.range(35, 50), ls0 * nrng.range(0.85, 1.05), -side * nrng.range(0.1, 0.25))
          end
        end
        if st.leaf then
          local p, q = pts[#pts], pts[#pts - 1]
          local tx, ty = norm(p[1] - q[1], p[2] - q[2])
          leaflet(ev, 1, p[1], p[2], deg(tx, ty), ls0 * 1.1, nrng.sym(0.15))
        end
      end
      x = x + (gl.w + numeral.GAP) * H
    end
    -- keep the digits legible: proxies over their box
    for bx = num.x0 - 0.1, num.x1 + 0.1, 0.25 do
      for by = ylo, num.ytop + 0.1, 0.25 do disc(bx, by, 0.2, 1) end
    end
  return {num.x0,ylo,num.x1,num.ytop}
end
return M

-- Optional plain-texlua fontloader bootstrap. Adapted from wilsybubs 6f1d846
-- (MIT). A missing installation remains a supported plain-initial fallback.
local M = {sources={}}
local function record_sources()
  for name in pairs(package.loaded)do
    if type(name)=='string' and (name:match('^fontloader') or name:match('^lualibs'))then
      local path=kpse.find_file(name,'lua') or kpse.find_file(name..'.lua','lua')
      if path then M.sources[path]=true end
    end
  end
end
function M.load()
  if fonts and fonts.handlers and fonts.handlers.otf and fonts.handlers.otf.readers
    and fonts.handlers.otf.readers.loadshapes then record_sources();return true end
  local write,write_nl=texio.write,texio.write_nl
  local search=package.path
  local ok,err=pcall(function()
    kpse.set_program_name("luatex")
    config=config or {}
    config.lualibs={verbose=false,prefer_merged=true,load_extended=true}
    require("lualibs")
    local u=utilities
    texio.write,texio.write_nl=function() end,function() end
    require("fontloader-basics-gen.lua")
    utilities=u
    pdf=pdf or {}
    for _,name in ipairs({"data-con","font-ini","font-con","fonts-enc","font-cid","font-map",
      "font-oti","font-otr","font-ott","font-cff","font-ttf","font-dsp","font-oup","font-onr","font-def"}) do
      require("fontloader-"..name)
    end
  end)
  texio.write,texio.write_nl=write,write_nl
  package.path=search
  record_sources()
  return ok,err
end
return M
source.grow.lua:
-- grow.lua -- the grown composition of florilegium (LuaLaTeX only).
--
-- A plant, not a packing. Everything grows from one root in the bottom-left
-- corner of the page:
--   1. stems: two or three long stems sway up the margin column (their x is a
--      smooth noise of their height, so they cross now and then); the first
--      ends in the largest flower at the top. A footer stem runs from the root
--      along the bottom of the page. On the last page, extra stems wave into
--      the space under the text.
--   2. leaves are hung at the nodes of the stems, alternating sides.
--   3. a greedy loop in the spirit of Wong, Zongker & Salesin, "Computer-
--      Generated Floral Ornament" (SIGGRAPH 1998): take the largest free disc
--      within reach of a stem, choose a motif that fits it, and grow a branch
--      to it from the nearest stem point. The branch leaves its parent along
--      the parent's direction and arrives along the motif's axis, so every
--      flower can be traced back to the root. Branches become stems for later
--      branches. Repeat until only small holes are left.
--   4. small holes get florets, buds and leaflets on short stalks; a few
--      copper accents go along the outer edge; pale ghost flowers sit behind.
-- Proxies (discs) may overlap a little, so leaves tuck under flowers.
-- Everything is deterministic for a given seed.

local ink = require("ink")
local flora = require("flora")
local settings = require("layout")
local space = require("space")
local folio = require("folio")
local M = {}

local sqrt, cos, sin, atan, pi, floor, max, min, abs = math.sqrt, math.cos, math.sin, math.atan, math.pi, math.floor, math.max, math.min, math.abs
local rad = pi / 180
local tone = ink.tone
local function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) local dx, dy = ax - bx, ay - by return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) end
local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
local function smoothstep(a, b, x) local t = math.min(1, math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))) return t * t * (3 - 2 * t) end
local function norm(x, y) local L = sqrt(x * x + y * y) if L < 1e-9 then return 0, 1 end return x / L, y / L end
local function deg(x, y) return atan(y, x) / rad end

-- layers, back to front (the overlay only in the growth animation)
local L_GHOST, L_STEM, L_LEAF, L_AIRY, L_BLOOM, L_ACCENT, L_OVERLAY = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7

local GRID     = 0.2    -- candidate spacing (cm)
local REACH    = 3.0    -- a motif must be within this distance of a stem
local SMALLEST = 0.36   -- the branch loop stops below this free radius
local FILLMIN  = 0.17   -- the filler stops below this

-- the growth animation: a stem is recorded as prefixes GROWSTEP cm apart, a
-- motif at the scales in BLOOM before its full size (eased: quick, then settling)
local GROWSTEP = 0.3
local BLOOM    = { 0.25, 0.45, 0.62, 0.76, 0.87, 0.95 }
local FLYSTEPS = 14     -- positions of a visitor flying in

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- motifs
-- r(s): proxy radius; off(s): distance from the disc center back to the
-- primitive's origin, along the motif's axis; upright: the axis leans upward
-- (sprays reach for the light); draw(rng, s, p): the primitive in a frame whose
-- +y is the axis (p: progress of its flight in the animation, nil on the page).
-- Visitors fly: no branch, and only on pages that the visitor stream allows.
-- spring/summer/autumn multiply w as the garden ages (default 1; see `season`).
local motifs = {
  { name = "flower",  w = 3,   smin = 0.75, smax = 1.3, max = 3, hard = true, layer = L_BLOOM, spring = 0.12, autumn = 0.45,
    r = function(s) return 1.0 * s end, off = function(s) return 0 end,
    draw = function(rng, s) flora.flower(rng, s) end },
  { name = "lily",    w = 2,   smin = 0.8,  smax = 1.25, max = 2, hard = true, layer = L_BLOOM, upright = 0.4, spring = 0.1, autumn = 0.4,
    r = function(s) return 0.9 * s end, off = function(s) return 0.15 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s) flora.lily(rng, s) end },
  { name = "blossoms", w = 3,  smin = 0.55, smax = 0.85, max = 5, layer = L_BLOOM, upright = 0.5, spring = 0.5, autumn = 0.5,
    r = function(s) return s end, off = function(s) return 0.6 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s)
      local n = rng.int(2, 4)
      for k = 1, n do
        local a = (k - (n + 1) / 2) * 38 + rng.sym(10)
        local d = s * rng.range(0.45, 0.8) * (k == 1 and 1 or rng.range(0.85, 1.1))
        local x, y = d * sin(a * rad), d * cos(a * rad)
        ink.moveto(0, 0) ink.curveto(0, d * 0.4, x * 0.6, y * 0.7, x, y) ink.stroke(tone(0.1), 0.35)
        ink.push() ink.translate(x, y) flora.blossom(rng, s * rng.range(0.38, 0.5)) ink.pop()
      end
      if rng.chance(0.6) then ink.push() ink.rotate(rng.sym(50)) ink.scale(0.5 * s) flora.bud(rng, 1) ink.pop() end
    end },
  { name = "cyme",    w = 3,   smin = 1.0,  smax = 2.4, max = 6, layer = L_AIRY, upright = 0.6, spring = 1.3, autumn = 0.7,
    r = function(s) return 0.45 * s end, off = function(s) return 0.5 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s) flora.cyme(rng, s) end },
  { name = "sprig",   w = 2,   smin = 1.2,  smax = 2.8, max = 4, layer = L_AIRY, upright = 0.8, spring = 1.2,
    r = function(s) return 0.42 * s end, off = function(s) return 0.5 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s) flora.sprig(rng, s) end },
  { name = "umbel",   w = 1.5, smin = 0.8,  smax = 1.5, max = 3, hard = true, layer = L_AIRY, upright = 1.0, spring = 0.8, autumn = 0.8,
    r = function(s) return 0.75 * s end, off = function(s) return 0.6 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s) flora.umbel(rng, s) end },
  { name = "leaf",    w = 2,   smin = 0.9,  smax = 2.0, max = 8, layer = L_LEAF, upright = 0.2, spring = 1.3, autumn = 1.2,
    r = function(s) return 0.32 * s end, off = function(s) return 0.5 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s) ink.scale(s) flora.leaf(rng, { w = rng.range(0.22, 0.3), depth = rng.chance(0.6) and rng.range(0.4, 0.8) or 0 }) end },
  { name = "bud",     w = 1,   smin = 0.45, smax = 0.75, max = 5, layer = L_BLOOM, upright = 0.5, spring = 3.5, autumn = 0.3,
    r = function(s) return 0.45 * s end, off = function(s) return 0.5 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s) flora.bud(rng, s) end },
  { name = "bells",   w = 0.7, smin = 0.6,  smax = 0.95, max = 1, hard = true, layer = L_BLOOM, hang = true, spring = 0.5, autumn = 0.6,
    r = function(s) return 0.62 * s end, off = function(s) return 0 end,
    draw = function(rng, s)
      flora.bell(rng, s)
      ink.moveto(0, 0) ink.curveto(0.15 * s, 0.25 * s, 0.4 * s, 0.25 * s, 0.5 * s, 0.1 * s) ink.stroke(tone(0.1), 0.35)
      ink.push() ink.translate(0.5 * s, 0.1 * s) flora.bell(rng, 0.75 * s) ink.pop()
    end },
  { name = "tendril", w = 0.6, smin = 0.3,  smax = 0.5, max = 4, layer = L_AIRY, spring = 2, autumn = 1.3,
    r = function(s) return 1.0 * s end, off = function(s) return 1.0 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s) ink.rotate(90) flora.tendril(rng, s) end },
  { name = "budding", w = 3,   smin = 0.55, smax = 0.9, max = 6, layer = L_BLOOM, upright = 0.6,
    spring = 1, summer = 0, autumn = 0,
    r = function(s) return 0.9 * s end, off = function(s) return 0.6 * s end,
    draw = function(rng, s)                    -- a spray of closed buds on stalks
      local n = rng.int(2, 4)
      for k = 1, n do
        local a = (k - (n + 1) / 2) * 34 + rng.sym(10)
        local d = s * rng.range(0.5, 0.85)
        local x, y = d * sin(a * rad), d * cos(a * rad)
        ink.moveto(0, 0) ink.curveto(0, d * 0.4, x * 0.6, y * 0.7, x, y) ink.stroke(tone(0.1), 0.35)
        ink.push() ink.translate(x, y) ink.rotate(-a * 0.6) flora.bud(rng, s * rng.range(0.45, 0.6)) ink.pop()
      end
    end },
  { name = "seedhead", w = 2,  smin = 0.45, smax = 0.75, max = 3, hard = true, layer = L_AIRY, upright = 0.6,
    spring = 0, summer = 0, autumn = 1,
    r = function(s) return 1.05 * s end, off = function(s) return 0 end,
    draw = function(rng, s) flora.seedhead(rng, s) end },
  { name = "butterfly", w = 0.8, smin = 1.1, smax = 1.5, max = 2, hard = true, layer = L_ACCENT, fly = true,
    r = function(s) return 0.5 * s end, off = function(s) return 0 end,
    draw = function(rng, s, p) flora.butterfly(rng, s, p and { open = 0.3 + 0.7 * abs(cos(p * 5 * pi)) }) end },
  { name = "bee",     w = 0.8, smin = 0.7,  smax = 0.85, max = 2, hard = true, layer = L_ACCENT, fly = true,
    r = function(s) return 0.6 * s end, off = function(s) return 0 end,
    draw = function(rng, s, p) flora.bee(rng, s, { trail = p == nil }) end },
}

M.motifs = {}
for _, m in ipairs(motifs) do M.motifs[m.name] = m end
M.layers = { ghost = L_GHOST, stem = L_STEM, leaf = L_LEAF, airy = L_AIRY, bloom = L_BLOOM, accent = L_ACCENT }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- region
-- rects = { {x0,y0,x1,y1}, ... }, a union; shared edges count as open
local function inside(r, x, y) return x > r[1] and x < r[3] and y > r[2] and y < r[4] end
local function border(rects, x, y)
  local best = -1
  for _, r in ipairs(rects) do
    if inside(r, x, y) then
      local d = math.huge
      local edges = { { x - r[1], r[1] - 0.05, y }, { r[3] - x, r[3] + 0.05, y }, { y - r[2], x, r[2] - 0.05 }, { r[4] - y, x, r[4] + 0.05 } }
      for _, e in ipairs(edges) do
        local open = false
        for _, o in ipairs(rects) do if o ~= r and inside(o, e[2], e[3]) then open = true end end
        if not open and e[1] < d then d = e[1] end
      end
      if d > best then best = d end
    end
  end
  return best
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- animation timing
-- Every step of the growth is an event: a stem that grows at a constant
-- speed, or a motif that opens. An event either belongs to a phase (stems,
-- ghost, branch, fill, accent, tail) or starts at a fraction `at` of its
-- parent's growth, e.g. a leaf when the stem tip passes its node. Times are
-- seconds of a nominal timeline; florilegium.lua spreads the frames over it.
local T_START, T_STEMS = 0.4, 3.6           -- an empty margin, then the tallest stem takes 3.6 s
local T_BRANCHES, T_EASE = 6.0, 0.55        -- branch i of n starts at (i/n)^0.55: big holes slowly
local T_FILL, T_ACCENT = 1.2, 0.5

local function schedule(events)
  local Lmax, n = 0, { branch = 0, fill = 0, accent = 0, fall = 0 }
  for _, e in ipairs(events) do
    if e.phase == "stems" then Lmax = max(Lmax, e.len or 0) end
    if n[e.phase] then n[e.phase] = n[e.phase] + 1 end
  end
  local speed = Lmax / T_STEMS
  local function start(i, N) return T_BRANCHES * ((i - 1) / max(1, N)) ^ T_EASE end
  for _, e in ipairs(events) do
    if e.span then e.dur = e.span
    elseif e.kind == "stem" then e.dur = (e.len or 0) / speed
    elseif e.kind == "bloom" then e.dur = e.root.phase == "ghost" and 1.2 or 0.2 + 0.25 * min(1, e.size or 0.5)
    elseif e.kind == "overlay" then
      -- the dashed disc shows a little before its branch starts, longer while the loop is slow
      local i = e.parent.i
      e.lead = max(0.08, min(0.4, 1.5 * (start(i + 1, n.branch) - start(i, n.branch))))
    end
    e.dur = max(e.dur or 0, 1e-3)
  end
  -- resolve start times in creation order (a parent is always created before its children)
  local function resolve(root_t0)
    local last = 0
    for _, e in ipairs(events) do
      if not e.t0 then
        local p = e.parent
        if not p then e.t0 = root_t0(e)
        elseif p.t0 and e.kind == "overlay" then e.t0, e.dur = p.t0 - e.lead, e.lead + p.dur
        elseif p.t0 then e.t0 = p.t0 + (e.at or 0) * p.dur end
      end
      if e.t0 and not e.till_end then last = max(last, e.t0 + e.dur) end
    end
    return last
  end
  local t1 = resolve(function(e)
    if e.phase == "stems" then return T_START + (e.off or 0) end
    if e.phase == "ghost" then return T_START + 0.8 * e.i end
  end)
  local t2 = resolve(function(e)
    if e.phase == "marks" then return t1 + 0.1 + 0.3 * (e.i - 1) end
    if e.phase == "branch" then return t1 + 0.2 + start(e.i, n.branch) end
  end)
  local t3 = resolve(function(e)
    if e.phase == "fall" then return t2 - 0.4 + T_FILL * (e.i - 1) / max(1, n.fall) end
    if e.phase == "fill" then return t2 + 0.1 + T_FILL * (e.i - 1) / max(1, n.fill) end
  end)
  local t4 = resolve(function(e)
    if e.phase == "tail" then return t3 end
    if e.phase == "accent" then return t3 + T_ACCENT * (e.i - 1) / max(1, n.accent) end
  end)
  for _, e in ipairs(events) do
    assert(e.t0, "florilegium: an animation event without a start")
    if e.till_end then e.dur = max(0.5, t4 - e.t0) end       -- e.g. the snail crawls until the end
  end
  return t4
end

-- the part [0,t] of a cubic Bézier, by de Casteljau
local function bezier_head(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, t)
  local ax, ay = lerp(x0, x1, t), lerp(y0, y1, t)
  local bx, by = lerp(x1, x2, t), lerp(y1, y2, t)
  local cx, cy = lerp(x2, x3, t), lerp(y2, y3, t)
  local dx, dy = lerp(ax, bx, t), lerp(ay, by, t)
  local ex, ey = lerp(bx, cx, t), lerp(by, cy, t)
  return ax, ay, dx, dy, lerp(dx, ex, t), lerp(dy, ey, t)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- page
-- With g.anim set, the page is recorded instead of written, and the
-- recording is returned with its events timed: { rec, total }.
function M.page(g)
  local options = settings.resolve(g.layout)
  ink.set_color_mode(options.color_mode)
  local density = options.density
  local exclusions=g.reserves or {}
  local skipped,route_failures=0,0
  local rng = ink.rng(g.seed * 7919 + 13)
  local layout = rng.fork()                 -- decisions; primitives get their own forks
  ink.set_transform({ ink.CM, 0, 0, ink.CM, 0, 0 })

  -- animation: each event's output is tagged { event, from, to }, visible
  -- while the event's progress is in [from, to)
  local anim = g.anim
  local events, now = {}, nil
  local function event(e)
    if not anim then return nil end
    e.root = e.parent and e.parent.root or e
    events[#events + 1] = e
    now = e
    ink.tag({ e, 0 })
    return e
  end
  if anim then ink.record(true) end
  -- visitors come from their own stream, so a page without them is unchanged
  local vis = ink.rng(g.seed * 7919 + 101)
  local visiting = g.visitors == false and {} or
    { butterfly = vis.chance(0.75), bee = vis.chance(0.6), snail = vis.chance(0.4), bird = vis.chance(0.22) }
  -- the season (g.age: 0 spring, 0.5 summer, 1 autumn; nil is summer as it always
  -- was): a value for each season, blended; its own stream for what it adds
  local age = g.age
  local function season(sp, su, au)
    if not age then return su end
    if age < 0.5 then return lerp(sp, su, smoothstep(0.1, 0.5, age)) end
    return lerp(su, au, smoothstep(0.5, 0.9, age))
  end
  local spring, autumn = season(1, 0, 0), season(0, 0, 1)
  local sea = ink.rng(g.seed * 7919 + 211)
  local blooms = {}                         -- the flowers, for the petals that fall in autumn

  -- regions: margin column, footer band, and the space under the text on the last page
  local col = { 0.3, 0.45, g.colright, g.ph - 0.5 }
  local fx1 = g.textleft + (g.textright - g.textleft) * layout.range(0.42, 0.52)
  local foot = { g.colright - 0.01, 0.4, fx1, min(1.75, g.footy - 0.45) }
  local rects = { col }
  if options.footer then rects[#rects + 1] = foot end
  local spill
  if options.spill and g.spill == 1 and (g.spilly - 0.8) - (g.ybot + 0.6) > 2.5 then
    spill = { g.colright - 0.01, g.ybot + 0.6, g.textright - 0.2, g.spilly - 0.8 }
    rects[#rects + 1] = spill
  end
  local function route(pts)
    local routed,ok=space.route(pts,rects,exclusions)
    if not ok then route_failures=route_failures+1 end
    return routed
  end

  -- grid on a global lattice, so a disc only has to visit nearby cells
  local gx, gy, free, sdist, lat = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  local function key(ix, iy) return ix * 100000 + iy end
  for _, r in ipairs(rects) do
    for ix = floor(r[1] / GRID), floor(r[3] / GRID) do
      for iy = floor(r[2] / GRID), floor(r[4] / GRID) do
        local x, y = (ix + 0.5) * GRID, (iy + 0.5) * GRID
        local k = key(ix, iy)
        if not lat[k] then
          local b = border(rects, x, y)
          if #exclusions>0 then b=min(b,space.clearance(exclusions,x,y)) end
          if b > 0 then
            local i = #gx + 1
            gx[i], gy[i], free[i], sdist[i] = x, y, b, math.huge
            lat[k] = i
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local maxfree = 0
  for i = 1, #free do if free[i] > maxfree then maxfree = free[i] end end
  local function each_near(x, y, R, fn)
    for ix = floor((x - R) / GRID), floor((x + R) / GRID) do
      for iy = floor((y - R) / GRID), floor((y + R) / GRID) do
        local i = lat[key(ix, iy)]
        if i then fn(i) end
      end
    end
  end
  -- a proxy disc: cells count it at k of its radius (k < 1 lets things overlap)
  local function disc(x, y, r, k)
    k = k or 0.85
    each_near(x, y, r * k + maxfree, function(i)
      local d = dist(gx[i], gy[i], x, y) - k * r
      if d < free[i] then free[i] = d end
    end)
  end
  local function free_at(x, y)
    local i = lat[key(floor(x / GRID), floor(y / GRID))]
    return i and free[i] or -1
  end

  -- stem points: {x, y, tx, ty, w}; a branch may start at any of them
  local spts = {}
  local function add_stem_points(pts, w0, w1, every)
    every = every or 1
    local n = #pts
    for i = 1, n, every do
      local a, b = pts[max(1, i - 1)], pts[min(n, i + 1)]
      local tx, ty = norm(b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2])
      local p = pts[i]
      spts[#spts + 1] = { p[1], p[2], tx, ty, lerp(w0, w1, (i - 1) / max(1, n - 1)) }
      each_near(p[1], p[2], REACH, function(j)
        local d = dist(gx[j], gy[j], p[1], p[2])
        if d < sdist[j] then sdist[j] = d end
      end)
    end
  end
  local function nearest_stem(x, y)
    local best, bp = math.huge, nil
    for _, p in ipairs(spts) do
      local d = dist(x, y, p[1], p[2])
      if d < best then best, bp = d, p end
    end
    return bp, best
  end
  local function stem(pts, w0, w1, proxy)
    ink.layer(L_STEM)
    if anim then
      -- growing: the first k/n of its length, for progress in [k/n, (k+1)/n)
      local s, L = ink.arclen(pts)
      local n, j = max(1, floor(L / GROWSTEP)), 1
      now.len = L
      for k = 1, n - 1 do
        local at = L * k / n
        while s[j + 1] < at do j = j + 1 end
        local d = s[j + 1] - s[j]
        local u = d > 1e-9 and (at - s[j]) / d or 0
        local head = {}
        for i = 1, j do head[i] = pts[i] end
        head[j + 1] = { lerp(pts[j][1], pts[j + 1][1], u), lerp(pts[j][2], pts[j + 1][2], u) }
        ink.tag({ now, k / n, (k + 1) / n })
        if type(w0)=="function" then
          flora.stem(head, function(t) return w0(t*k/n) end, nil, nil, nil, 0.4)
        else
          flora.stem(head, w0, lerp(w0, w1, k / n), nil, nil, 0.4)
        end
      end
      ink.tag({ now, 1 })
    end
    flora.stem(pts, w0, w1)
    if anim then ink.tag({ now, 0 }) end
    for i = 1, #pts, 2 do disc(pts[i][1], pts[i][2], proxy or 0.1, 1) end
  end
  -- draw a primitive at (x,y) with its +y axis at angle `a` (degrees from +x).
  -- In the animation it opens, or with path(e) -> x, y, a it travels to its place
  -- in `steps` positions and fn gets the progress e.
  local function place(layer, x, y, a, fn, path, steps)
    local transaction=#exclusions>0 and ink.begin_element() or nil
    ink.layer(layer)
    if anim then
      -- a few earlier copies with the same random draws, then the real one
      local r0, l0 = rng.save(), layout.save()
      local n = path and (steps or FLYSTEPS) or #BLOOM
      for k = 1, n do
        ink.tag({ now, (k - 1) / n, k / n })
        ink.push()
        if path then
          local px, py, pa = path((k - 1) / n)
          ink.translate(px, py) ink.rotate(pa - 90) fn((k - 1) / n)
        else
          ink.translate(x, y) ink.rotate(a - 90) ink.scale(BLOOM[k]) fn()
        end
        ink.pop()
        rng.load(r0) layout.load(l0)
      end
      ink.tag({ now, 1 })
    end
    if transaction then ink.track_element(transaction) end
    ink.push() ink.translate(x, y) ink.rotate(a - 90) fn() ink.pop()
    if transaction and not ink.end_element(transaction,exclusions) then skipped=skipped+1 end
    if anim then ink.tag({ now, 0 }) end
  end
  -- a flight path for the animation: from distance d in direction `from` (degrees),
  -- easing out, swinging sideways by `swing`, wobbling about the final heading
  local function arrive(x, y, a, d, from, swing)
    local ux, uy = cos(from * rad), sin(from * rad)
    return function(e)
      local q = 1 - (1 - e) ^ 2
      local w = swing * sin(pi * q)
      return x + d * ux * (1 - q) - uy * w, y + d * uy * (1 - q) + ux * w, a + 25 * sin(3 * pi * e) * (1 - q)
    end
  end
  -- the explained animation marks the free disc a branch grows to, and its stem point
  local function overlay(parent, x, y, r, S)
    if not anim then return end
    local e = { kind = "overlay", parent = parent, root = parent.root }
    events[#events + 1] = e
    local old = ink.tag({ e, 0, 1, overlay = true })
    ink.layer(L_OVERLAY)
    ink.circle(x, y, r) ink.stroke(ink.accent(0), 0.7, 0.9, false, "[2.5 2] 0")
    ink.circle(x, y, 0.035) ink.fill(ink.accent(0))
    ink.circle(S[1], S[2], 0.05) ink.fill(ink.accent(0))
    ink.tag(old)
  end

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------- 1. stems
  local root = { layout.range(1.0, 1.6), 0.75 }
  local num = folio.layout(g,options,root,foot)
  local custom_focals=options.focal_scale~=1 or options.asymmetry~=1
  local function focal_size(s)
    local size=s*options.focal_scale
    -- Keep enlarged/custom flowers whole inside the available side column.
    -- The classic path remains unchanged for upstream reproducibility.
    return custom_focals and min(size,(g.colright-0.8)/2.5) or size
  end
  local hero_size=focal_size(min(1.75,g.colright*0.27))
  local focal_radius={1.25*hero_size,1.25*focal_size(1.2),1.25*focal_size(1)}
  local cx = g.colright * 0.47
  local amp = g.colright * 0.2 * options.asymmetry
  local mains, mainev = {}, {}
  local tops = { g.ph - 2.6, g.ph * layout.range(0.6, 0.72), g.ph * layout.range(0.36, 0.48) }
  tops[1] = min(tops[1], g.ph - 0.8 - min(1.75, g.colright * 0.27) * options.focal_scale)
  if custom_focals then tops[1]=min(tops[1],g.ph-focal_radius[1]-0.7) end
  for k = 1, 3 do
    local f = ink.fbm1(layout, 2)
    local ph, lam = layout.range(0, 10), layout.range(6, 9)
    local x0 = root[1] + (k - 2) * 0.25 * options.asymmetry
    local pts = {}
    local y = root[2]
    while y <= tops[k] do
      local x = cx + amp * f(y / lam + ph) + (k - 2) * 0.35 * options.asymmetry
      x = lerp(x0, x, smoothstep(0, 4, y - root[2]))
      x = max(0.9, min(g.colright - 0.9, x))
      if custom_focals and k<=options.focal_count then
        local r=focal_radius[k]
        local target=max(r+0.35,min(g.colright-r-0.35,x))
        x=lerp(x,target,smoothstep(tops[k]-3,tops[k],y))
      end
      if num and x>num.x0-0.45 then
        x=lerp(x,num.x0-0.45,1-smoothstep(num.ytop,num.ytop+1.6,y))
      end
      pts[#pts + 1] = { x, y }
      y = y + 0.25
    end
    pts=route(pts)
    mains[k] = pts
    mainev[k] = event({ kind = "stem", phase = "stems" })
    local w0 = k == 1 and 0.085 or 0.065
    stem(pts, w0, 0.028)
    add_stem_points(pts, w0, 0.028)
  end
  -- the scroll: the root curls into a spiral at the corner
  do
    local pts = {}
    local turns = layout.range(1.2, 1.6)
    for i = 0, 40 do
      local t = i / 40
      local a = pi * 0.5 + t * turns * 2 * pi
      local r = 0.55 * (1 - 0.85 * t) ^ 1.3
      pts[#pts + 1] = { root[1] - 0.55 + r * cos(a) * -1, root[2] + 0.05 + r * sin(a) }
    end
    event({ kind = "stem", phase = "stems", off = 0.3 })
    stem(pts, 0.06, 0.012)
  end
  -- the footer stem: from the root along the bottom, tapering out to a hairline
  local footpts, footev = {}, nil
  do
    local f = ink.fbm1(layout, 2)
    local ybase = (foot[2] + foot[4]) / 2 - 0.05
    local x = root[1]
    while x <= fx1 - 0.3 do
      local u = smoothstep(root[1], root[1] + 1.5, x)
      local y = lerp(root[2] + 0.1, ybase + 0.22 * f(x / 3.5), u)
      footpts[#footpts + 1] = { x, y }
      x = x + 0.2
    end
    if options.footer then
      footpts=route(footpts)
      footev = event({ kind = "stem", phase = "stems", off = 0.5 })
      stem(footpts, 0.065, 0.01, 0.06)
      add_stem_points(footpts, 0.065, 0.012)
    end
  end
  local number_box
  if num then
    if not options.footer then
      -- A compact label keeps its own baseline inside the side column; the
      -- optional under-text footer remains absent in quiet compositions.
      local base={}
      for _,p in ipairs(footpts) do if p[1]<=num.x1+0.15 then base[#base+1]=p end end
      event({kind="stem",phase="stems",off=0.4})
      stem(route(base),0.055,0.012,0.05)
    end
    number_box=folio.draw(num,g,{stem=stem,place=place,event=event,disc=disc,
      add_stem_points=add_stem_points,footpts=footpts,leaf_layer=L_LEAF})
  end
  -- on the last page, branches arch out of the main stems into the space under
  -- the text, each ending in a flower
  local leafy = {}
  for k = 1, 3 do leafy[k] = { pts = mains[k], big = true, ev = mainev[k] } end
  local arcs, arcev = {}, {}
  if spill then
    local sh = spill[4] - spill[2]
    local nb = max(1, floor(sh / 7))
    for b = 1, nb do
      local y0 = spill[2] + sh * (b - 0.75) / nb
      local si = layout.int(1, 3)
      local src = mains[si]
      local best, bi = math.huge, 1
      for i, p in ipairs(src) do local d = abs(p[2] - y0) if d < best then best, bi = d, i end end
      local s0 = src[bi]
      local w = spill[3] - s0[1]
      local x3 = s0[1] + w * layout.range(0.7, 0.88)
      local y3 = min(spill[4] - 1.4, y0 + sh / nb * layout.range(0.35, 0.6))
      local pts = ink.sample(ink.bezier3(s0[1], s0[2], s0[1] + w * 0.25, s0[2] + layout.range(-0.4, 0.8),
        x3 - w * 0.3, y3 + layout.range(-1.2, -0.3), x3, y3), floor(w / 0.2))
      local f = ink.fbm1(layout, 2)
      for i, p in ipairs(pts) do local u = (i - 1) / (#pts - 1) p[2] = p[2] + 0.35 * f(p[1] / 3) * sin(pi * u) end
      pts=route(pts)
      local sa, La = ink.arclen(src)
      local e = event({ kind = "stem", parent = mainev[si], at = sa[bi] / La })
      stem(pts, 0.06, 0.025)
      add_stem_points(pts, 0.06, 0.025)
      leafy[#leafy + 1] = { pts = pts, big = true, ev = e }
      arcs[#arcs + 1] = pts
      arcev[#arcs] = e
    end
  end

  -- the header fleuron keeps its spot free
  disc(g.colright - 0.5, g.headrule + 0.1, 0.7, 1)

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------- 2. terminal flowers and ghosts
  local counts = {}
  for _, m in ipairs(motifs) do counts[m.name] = 0 end
  if options.focal_count > 0 then
    local p, q = mains[1][#mains[1]], mains[1][#mains[1] - 2]
    local hx, hy = norm(p[1] - q[1], p[2] - q[2])
    local s = hero_size
    local fx, fy = p[1] + hx * 0.2, p[2] + hy * 0.2
    event({ kind = "bloom", parent = mainev[1], at = 1, size = s })
    place(L_BLOOM, fx, fy, 90, function() flora.flower(rng.fork(), s) end)
    disc(fx, fy, 1.05 * s, 0.85)
    blooms[#blooms + 1] = { fx, fy, s }
    for k = 2, options.focal_count do
      local pts = mains[k]
      local p2, q2 = pts[#pts], pts[#pts - 2]
      local ax, ay = norm(p2[1] - q2[1], p2[2] - q2[2])
      -- the shorter stems end in a lily and a flower; in spring in buds, in autumn gone to seed
      local tip = spring > 0.5 and "bud" or autumn > 0.5 and "seedhead" or nil
      if k == 2 then
        local s2 = focal_size(layout.range(1.0, 1.2))
        event({ kind = "bloom", parent = mainev[2], at = 1, size = s2 })
        if tip == "bud" then
          place(L_BLOOM, p2[1], p2[2], deg(ax, ay), function() flora.bud(rng.fork(), 0.95 * s2) end)
        elseif tip == "seedhead" then
          place(L_AIRY, p2[1] + ax * 0.15, p2[2] + ay * 0.15, 90, function() flora.seedhead(rng.fork(), 0.75 * s2) end)
        else
          place(L_BLOOM, p2[1] + ax * 0.25 * s2, p2[2] + ay * 0.25 * s2, deg(ax, ay), function() flora.lily(rng.fork(), s2) end)
        end
        disc(p2[1] + ax * 0.3 * s2, p2[2] + ay * 0.3 * s2, 0.95 * s2, 0.85)
        counts.lily = counts.lily + 1
      else
        local s3 = focal_size(layout.range(0.85, 1.0))
        event({ kind = "bloom", parent = mainev[3], at = 1, size = s3 })
        if tip == "bud" then
          place(L_BLOOM, p2[1], p2[2], deg(ax, ay), function() flora.bud(rng.fork(), 0.9 * s3) end)
        elseif tip == "seedhead" then
          place(L_AIRY, p2[1], p2[2], 90, function() flora.seedhead(rng.fork(), 0.75 * s3) end)
        else
          place(L_BLOOM, p2[1], p2[2], 90, function() flora.flower(rng.fork(), s3) end)
          blooms[#blooms + 1] = { p2[1], p2[2], s3 }
        end
        disc(p2[1], p2[2], s3, 0.85)
        counts.flower = counts.flower + 1
      end
    end
  end
  for b, pts in ipairs(arcs) do
    local p = pts[#pts]
    local s = layout.range(1.0, 1.25)
    event({ kind = "bloom", parent = arcev[b], at = 1, size = s })
    place(L_BLOOM, p[1], p[2], 90, function() flora.flower(rng.fork(), s) end)
    disc(p[1], p[2], s, 0.85)
    counts.flower = counts.flower + 1
    blooms[#blooms + 1] = { p[1], p[2], s }
  end
  -- ghosts: large pale flowers behind, given a little room so they show
  do
    local ng = layout.int(1, 2)
    if density < 1 then ng = min(ng, floor(2 * density)) end
    for k = 1, ng do
      local gxp = g.colright * layout.range(0.35, 0.65)
      local gyp = g.ph * (k == 1 and layout.range(0.15, 0.3) or layout.range(0.45, 0.6))
      local s = layout.range(1.3, 1.6)
      event({ kind = "bloom", phase = "ghost", i = k })
      place(L_GHOST, gxp, gyp, 90, function() flora.ghost(0.62, function() flora.flower(rng.fork(), s) end) end)
      disc(gxp, gyp, 0.8 * s, 0.6)
    end
  end

  -- a branch from stem point S to a motif at (bx,by) whose axis is (ax,ay)
  local function branch_to(S, bx, by, ax, ay, w0, ev)
    local pts = flora.branch_path(layout, S[1], S[2], S[3], S[4], bx, by, ax, ay)
    pts=route(pts)
    local d = dist(S[1], S[2], bx, by)
    local w = min(S[5] * 0.7, w0)
    stem(pts, w, max(0.012, w * 0.45), 0.07)
    add_stem_points(pts, w, max(0.012, w * 0.45), 2)
    -- a leaflet or two on a longer branch
    if d > 1.0 then
      local nl = d > 2 and 2 or 1
      for j = 1, nl do
        local i = floor(#pts * (0.25 + 0.3 * j / nl))
        local p, q = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
        local a = deg(q[1] - p[1], q[2] - p[2]) + (j % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * layout.range(40, 60)
        local ls = layout.range(0.45, 0.75)
        event({ kind = "bloom", parent = ev, at = i / #pts, size = ls })
        place(L_LEAF, p[1], p[2], a, function() ink.scale(ls) flora.leaflet(rng.fork()) end)
        disc(p[1] + cos(a * rad) * ls * 0.5, p[2] + sin(a * rad) * ls * 0.5, 0.25 * ls, 0.7)
      end
    end
    return pts
  end

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------- marks: flowers the text asks for
  -- beside a heading (option sections) or wherever \florilegiumbloom[motif] stands:
  -- the motif sits at the column's edge at the height of that line, on a branch
  -- from the nearest stem; where there is no room (the hero flower) it is left out
  local nmarks = 0
  for _, mk in ipairs(g.marks or {}) do
    local m, s
    if mk.kind == "heading" then
      local large=mk.arg<=1 and options.style~="quiet"
      m, s = M.motifs[large and "flower" or "blossoms"], (large and 0.95 or 0.7)*options.focal_scale
    else
      m = M.motifs[mk.arg ~= "" and mk.arg or "flower"]
      s = m and (mk.arg == "" and 0.9 or (m.smin + m.smax) / 2)
    end
    if m then
      local r = m.r(s)
      local px, py = g.colright - r - 0.15, mk.y + 0.12
      local f = free_at(px, py)
      if f < 0.95 * r then
        local lo, hi = m.smin * 0.8, s
        for _ = 1, 20 do local mid = (lo + hi) / 2 if m.r(mid) > f * 0.95 then hi = mid else lo = mid end end
        s = lo r = m.r(s)
      end
      if r <= f * 1.15 and py > 0.6 + r and py < g.ph - 0.6 - r then
        local S = nearest_stem(px, py)
        local dx, dy = norm(px - S[1], py - S[2])
        local ax, ay = norm(dx, dy + (m.upright or 0))
        local ox, oy = px - ax * m.off(s), py - ay * m.off(s)
        nmarks = nmarks + 1
        local bev = event({ kind = "stem", phase = "marks", i = nmarks })
        if m.fly then
          event({ kind = "bloom", parent = bev, at = 1, span = 1.2 })
          place(m.layer, px, py, 90, function(p) m.draw(rng.fork(), s, p) end, arrive(px, py, 90, 3, 200, 0.5))
        else
          branch_to(S, ox, oy, ax, ay, 0.045, bev)
          event({ kind = "bloom", parent = bev, at = 1, size = r })
          -- a heading's flower is painted in the accent, as headings were rubricated
          local heading = mk.kind == "heading"
          place(m.layer, ox, oy, deg(ax, ay), function()
            if heading then ink.in_accent(function() m.draw(rng.fork(), s) end) else m.draw(rng.fork(), s) end
          end)
          if m.name == "flower" then blooms[#blooms + 1] = { ox, oy, s } end
        end
        counts[m.name] = counts[m.name] + 1
        disc(px, py, r, 0.85)
      end
    end
  end

  -- visitors on the stems: a snail crawling up a main stem, and now and then a
  -- bird on a twig of its own
  local function tangent(pts, i)
    local a, b = pts[max(1, i - 1)], pts[min(#pts, i + 1)]
    return norm(b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2])
  end
  if visiting.snail then
    local s, best, c = vis.range(0.75, 0.9), -1, nil
    for _ = 1, 12 do
      local k = vis.int(1, 3)
      local pts = mains[k]
      local i = vis.int(max(10, floor(#pts * 0.15)), max(11, floor(#pts * 0.45)))
      local side = vis.chance(0.5) and 1 or -1
      local tx, ty = tangent(pts, i)
      local nx, ny = ty * side, -tx * side             -- toward the shell
      local f = free_at(pts[i][1] + nx * 0.8 * s, pts[i][2] + ny * 0.8 * s)
      if f > best then best, c = f, { k = k, i = i, side = side, nx = nx, ny = ny } end
    end
    if c and best > 0.25 then
      local pts = mains[c.k]
      local sa, La = ink.arclen(pts)
      local i0 = max(1, c.i - 8)                       -- it crawls up the last 2 cm
      local function at(e)
        local j = lerp(i0, c.i, e)
        local j0 = floor(j)
        local j1 = min(#pts, j0 + 1)
        local p, q = pts[j0], pts[j1]
        local tx, ty = tangent(pts, j0)
        local u = j - j0
        return lerp(p[1], q[1], u) + c.nx * 0.03, lerp(p[2], q[2], u) + c.ny * 0.03, deg(tx, ty)
      end
      local x, y, a = at(1)
      event({ kind = "bloom", parent = mainev[c.k], at = sa[c.i] / La, till_end = true })
      place(L_ACCENT, x, y, a, function() ink.scale(c.side, 1) flora.snail(rng.fork(), s) end, at, 40)
      disc(pts[c.i][1] + c.nx * 0.36 * s, pts[c.i][2] + c.ny * 0.36 * s, 0.5 * s, 1)
      counts.snail = 1
    end
  end
  if visiting.bird then
    local s, best, c = vis.range(2.3, 2.7), -1, nil
    for _ = 1, 24 do
      local k = vis.int(1, 3)
      local pts = mains[k]
      local i = vis.int(floor(#pts * 0.25), floor(#pts * 0.75))
      local p = pts[i]
      local dir = vis.chance(0.5) and 1 or -1
      local L = vis.range(1.2, 1.7)
      local ex, ey = p[1] + dir * L, p[2] + vis.range(0.05, 0.4)
      local bx, by = ex - dir * 0.25, ey
      local facing = vis.chance(0.65) and dir or -dir
      local cx, cy = bx + facing * 0.03 * s, by + 0.4 * s
      local f = min(free_at(cx, cy) / (0.36 * s), free_at(bx - facing * 0.35 * s, by + 0.15 * s) / (0.2 * s))
      if f > best then best, c = f, { k = k, i = i, ex = ex, ey = ey, dir = dir, facing = facing, cx = cx, cy = cy } end
    end
    if c and best > 1 then
      local pts = mains[c.k]
      local p = pts[c.i]
      local tx, ty = tangent(pts, c.i)
      local sa, La = ink.arclen(pts)
      local twig = flora.branch_path(vis, p[1], p[2], tx, ty, c.ex, c.ey, c.dir, 0.1)
      twig=route(twig)
      local tev = event({ kind = "stem", parent = mainev[c.k], at = sa[c.i] / La })
      stem(twig, 0.05, 0.02, 0.07)
      add_stem_points(twig, 0.05, 0.02, 2)
      local perch = twig[max(1, floor(#twig * 0.85))]
      event({ kind = "bloom", parent = tev, at = 1, span = 1.4 })
      place(L_ACCENT, perch[1], perch[2], 90, function() flora.bird(rng.fork(), s, { facing = c.facing }) end,
        arrive(perch[1], perch[2], 90, 3.5, c.facing > 0 and 160 or 20, 0.6), FLYSTEPS)
      disc(c.cx, c.cy, 0.36 * s, 0.9)
      disc(perch[1] - c.facing * 0.35 * s, perch[2] + 0.15 * s, 0.2 * s, 0.9)
      counts.bird = 1
    end
  end

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------- 3. leaves at the nodes
  -- big stems get full leaves, alternating sides, smaller toward the top; the
  -- footer gets leaflets that thin out toward its end
  if options.footer then leafy[#leafy + 1] = { pts = footpts, big = false, ev = footev } end
  for _, st in ipairs(leafy) do
    local pts = st.pts
    local s, acc, side = 0, layout.range(0.6, 1.3) / density, layout.chance(0.5) and 1 or -1
    local total = 0
    for i = 2, #pts do total = total + dist(pts[i][1], pts[i][2], pts[i - 1][1], pts[i - 1][2]) end
    for i = 2, #pts - 4 do
      s = s + dist(pts[i][1], pts[i][2], pts[i - 1][1], pts[i - 1][2])
      if s >= acc then
        local u = s / total
        acc = acc + (st.big and layout.range(1.4, 2.2) or lerp(0.55, 1.4, u) * layout.range(0.8, 1.2)) / density
        side = -side
        local tx, ty = norm(pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i - 1][1], pts[i + 1][2] - pts[i - 1][2])
        local a = deg(tx, ty) + side * layout.range(35, 60)
        local ux, uy = cos(a * rad), sin(a * rad)
        local Lf = st.big and lerp(2.4, 1.3, pts[i][2] / g.ph) * layout.range(0.85, 1.1) or lerp(0.95, 0.45, u) * layout.range(0.85, 1.1)
        Lf = Lf * season(0.8, 1, 1)                     -- young leaves are small
        local ok = false
        for _ = 1, 3 do
          local mx, my = pts[i][1] + ux * Lf * 0.55, pts[i][2] + uy * Lf * 0.55
          if free_at(mx, my) >= 0.24 * Lf then ok = true break end
          Lf = Lf * 0.75
        end
        if ok and Lf > (st.big and 0.7 or 0.3) then
          event({ kind = "bloom", parent = st.ev, at = u, size = 0.4 * Lf })
          if st.big then
            local lobed = layout.chance(0.6)
            local bend = side * layout.range(0.05, 0.3)
            -- young leaves are pale; in autumn some turn copper
            local copper = autumn > 0 and sea.chance(0.35 * autumn)
            place(L_LEAF, pts[i][1], pts[i][2], a, function()
              local function leaf()
                ink.scale(Lf) flora.leaf(rng.fork(), { w = layout.range(0.22, 0.3), depth = lobed and layout.range(0.4, 0.8) or 0, bend = bend })
              end
              if copper then ink.in_accent(leaf) elseif spring > 0 then flora.ghost(0.3 * spring, leaf) else leaf() end
            end)
          else
            local bend = -side * layout.range(0.1, 0.3)
            place(L_LEAF, pts[i][1], pts[i][2], a, function() ink.scale(Lf) flora.leaflet(rng.fork(), { bend = bend }) end)
          end
          for _, f in ipairs({ 0.3, 0.55, 0.8 }) do disc(pts[i][1] + ux * Lf * f, pts[i][2] + uy * Lf * f, 0.24 * Lf, 0.85) end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------- 4. branches to the largest holes
  local area = 0
  for _, r in ipairs(rects) do area = area + (r[3] - r[1]) * (r[4] - r[2]) end
  local af = max(1, area / 175)
  local caps = {}
  for _, m in ipairs(motifs) do caps[m.name] = m.fly and m.max or floor(m.max * af * density + 0.5) end   -- visitors stay few
  local nbranch = 0
  -- Full density keeps the original stopping rule. Lower settings leave holes
  -- deliberately, with fewer leaves, branches and small finishing details.
  local branch_limit = density == 1 and 400 or floor(36 * af * density)
  for _ = 1, branch_limit do
    local best, bi = -1, nil
    for i = 1, #gx do
      if sdist[i] <= REACH then
        local v = free[i] * layout.range(0.85, 1.15)
        if v > best then best, bi = v, i end
      end
    end
    if not bi or free[bi] < SMALLEST / sqrt(density) then break end
    local f, px, py = free[bi], gx[bi], gy[bi]
    -- statement motifs have a hard cap; the others only lose weight as they repeat
    local elig, wts, wsum = {}, {}, 0
    for _, m in ipairs(motifs) do
      local wt = m.w * season(m.spring or 1, m.summer or 1, m.autumn or 1) / (1 + counts[m.name] / max(1, caps[m.name]))
      local ok = wt > 0 and not (options.style=="quiet" and m.hard) and m.r(m.smin) <= f * 1.05 and (not m.hard or counts[m.name] < caps[m.name]) and (not m.fly or visiting[m.name])
      if ok then elig[#elig + 1] = m wts[#elig] = wt wsum = wsum + wt end
    end
    if #elig == 0 then free[bi] = 0 else
      local pick, acc = elig[#elig], layout.u() * wsum
      for k, m in ipairs(elig) do acc = acc - wts[k] if acc <= 0 then pick = m break end end
      local s = pick.smax
      if pick.r(s) > f * 0.95 then
        local lo, hi = pick.smin, s
        for _ = 1, 20 do local mid = (lo + hi) / 2 if pick.r(mid) > f * 0.95 then hi = mid else lo = mid end end
        s = lo
      end
      local S, sd = nearest_stem(px, py)
      local dx, dy = norm(px - S[1], py - S[2])
      -- the motif's axis: away from the stem, leaning up for the upright kinds
      local ax, ay = norm(dx, dy + (pick.upright or 0))
      local ox, oy = px - ax * pick.off(s), py - ay * pick.off(s)
      if pick.hang then ox, oy = px - dx * 0.2 * s, py + 0.45 * s end
      nbranch = nbranch + 1
      local bev = event({ kind = "stem", phase = "branch", i = nbranch })
      overlay(bev, px, py, f, S)
      if pick.fly then
        -- a visitor: no branch, any heading, and in the animation it flies in
        local a = pick.name == "bee" and layout.range(0, 360) or 90 + layout.sym(50)
        event({ kind = "bloom", parent = bev, at = 1, span = 1.2 })
        place(pick.layer, px, py, a, function(p) pick.draw(rng.fork(), s, p) end,
          arrive(px, py, a, 3, layout.range(0, 360), layout.sym(0.8)))
      else
        if dist(ox, oy, S[1], S[2]) > 0.12 then
          branch_to(S, ox, oy, pick.hang and dx or ax, pick.hang and -0.3 or ay, 0.04, bev)
        end
        local a = pick.hang and 90 or deg(ax, ay)
        event({ kind = "bloom", parent = bev, at = 1, size = pick.r(s) })
        place(pick.layer, ox, oy, a, function() pick.draw(rng.fork(), s) end)
        if pick.name == "flower" then blooms[#blooms + 1] = { ox, oy, s } end
      end
      counts[pick.name] = counts[pick.name] + 1
      disc(px, py, pick.r(s), 0.85)
    end
  end

  -- autumn: loose petals fall from the flowers into the free space below them
  -- (in the animation they drift down from the flower)
  if autumn > 0 then
    local nfall = 0
    for _, b in ipairs(blooms) do
      for _ = 1, sea.int(0, floor(3 * autumn + 0.5)) do
        local best, bx, by = 0.16, nil, nil
        for _ = 1, 6 do
          local x, y = b[1] + sea.sym(1.1), b[2] - b[3] - sea.range(0.1, 2.2)
          local f = free_at(x, y)
          if f > best then best, bx, by = f, x, y end
        end
        if bx then
          local ps, pa, pt = sea.range(0.4, 0.6), sea.range(0, 360), sea.range(0.36, 0.5)
          local sway, x0, y0 = sea.sym(0.6), b[1] + sea.sym(0.3), b[2] - 0.3 * b[3]
          nfall = nfall + 1
          event({ kind = "bloom", phase = "fall", i = nfall, span = 1.6 })
          place(L_BLOOM, bx, by, pa, function() ink.scale(ps) flora.petal(rng.fork(), { tone = pt, heart = false }) end,
            function(e)
              return lerp(x0, bx, e) + sway * sin(2 * pi * e), lerp(y0, by, e * e * (3 - 2 * e)), pa - 140 * (1 - e)
            end, 16)
          disc(bx, by, 0.22, 1)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------- 5. small holes
  -- only right next to a stem, and not too many: a pair of leaflets at a node,
  -- a bud, or a few florets. Far from any stem, a copper accent or nothing.
  local accents, fills = 0, 0
  local maxfill = density < 0.5 and 0 or floor(28 * af * density * density)
  local maxaccent = floor(6 * density)
  for _ = 1, (maxfill > 0 or maxaccent > 0) and 600 or 0 do
    local best, bi = -1, nil
    for i = 1, #gx do
      local v = free[i] * layout.range(0.85, 1.15)
      if v > best then best, bi = v, i end
    end
    if not bi or free[bi] < FILLMIN / sqrt(density) then break end
    local f, px, py = free[bi], gx[bi], gy[bi]
    local S, sd = nearest_stem(px, py)
    if sd < 0.75 and fills < maxfill then
      fills = fills + 1
      event({ kind = "bloom", phase = "fill", i = fills, size = f })
      local dx, dy = norm(px - S[1], py - S[2])
      local ax, ay = norm(dx, dy + 0.4)
      local kind = layout.u()
      if kind < 0.4 then
        -- two leaflets in a V at the stem point
        local base = deg(ax, ay)
        local ls = min(0.75, f * 1.6)
        for k = -1, 1, 2 do
          local a = base + k * layout.range(20, 35)
          place(L_LEAF, S[1], S[2], a, function() ink.scale(ls * layout.range(0.8, 1)) flora.leaflet(rng.fork(), { bend = -k * 0.15 }) end)
        end
      elseif kind < 0.65 then
        local ox, oy = px - ax * f * 0.5, py - ay * f * 0.5
        ink.layer(L_STEM)
        ink.moveto(S[1], S[2]) ink.curveto(S[1] + S[3] * 0.15, S[2] + S[4] * 0.15, ox - ax * 0.1, oy - ay * 0.1, ox, oy)
        ink.stroke(tone(0.1), 0.4)
        place(L_BLOOM, ox, oy, deg(ax, ay), function() flora.bud(rng.fork(), min(0.6, f * 1.7)) end)
      else
        -- a small cluster of florets on hairline stalks
        local n = layout.int(2, 4)
        for k = 1, n do
          local qx, qy = px + layout.sym(f * 0.5), py + layout.sym(f * 0.5)
          ink.layer(L_STEM)
          ink.moveto(S[1], S[2]) ink.curveto(S[1] + S[3] * 0.1, S[2] + S[4] * 0.1, (S[1] + qx) / 2, (S[2] + qy) / 2 + 0.05, qx, qy)
          ink.stroke(tone(0.12), 0.25, 0.9)
          place(L_BLOOM, qx, qy, 90, function() flora.floret(rng.fork(), min(0.11, f * 0.6) * layout.range(0.8, 1.1)) end)
        end
      end
    elseif sd >= 0.75 and accents < maxaccent and f > 0.22 and px < g.colright then
      accents = accents + 1
      event({ kind = "bloom", phase = "accent", i = accents, size = 0.3 })
      if layout.chance(0.6) then
        place(L_ACCENT, px, py, 90, function() flora.sparkle(rng.fork(), 0.13) end)
      else
        place(L_ACCENT, px, py, 90, function() flora.rosette(rng.fork(), 0.12) end)
      end
    end
    disc(px, py, max(f, 0.3), 1)
  end

  -- ---------------------------------------------------------- 6. the footer's tail
  if options.footer then
    local e = footpts[#footpts]
    local x2 = e[1] + layout.range(1.6, 2.2)
    ink.layer(L_ACCENT)
    local c = { e[1], e[2], e[1] + 0.6, e[2] + 0.05, x2 - 0.6, e[2] - 0.05, x2, e[2] }
    local tail = event({ kind = "stem", phase = "tail", len = x2 - e[1] })
    if anim then
      for k = 1, 7 do
        ink.tag({ tail, k / 8, (k + 1) / 8 })
        ink.moveto(c[1], c[2]) ink.curveto(bezier_head(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4], c[5], c[6], c[7], c[8], k / 8))
        ink.stroke(ink.accent(0), 0.3, 0.8)
      end
      ink.tag({ tail, 1 })
    end
    ink.moveto(c[1], c[2]) ink.curveto(c[3], c[4], c[5], c[6], c[7], c[8])
    ink.stroke(ink.accent(0), 0.3, 0.8)
    event({ kind = "bloom", parent = tail, at = 1, size = 0.3 })
    place(L_ACCENT, x2 + 0.18, e[2], 90, function() flora.sparkle(rng.fork(), 0.12, { rays = false }) end)
    ink.circle(x2 + 0.45, e[2], 0.025) ink.fill(ink.accent(0))
  end

  -- assemble: a safety clip a little outside the regions, then the layers
  ink.tag(nil)
  ink.layer(0)
  for _, r in ipairs(rects) do
    local overhang = r == col and settings.SIDE_OVERHANG or 0.3
    ink.poly({ { r[1] - 0.25, r[2] - 0.3 }, { r[3] + overhang, r[2] - 0.3 }, { r[3] + overhang, r[4] + 0.3 }, { r[1] - 0.25, r[4] + 0.3 } }, true)
  end
  ink.clip()
  ink.layer(99)
  ink.unclip()
  local n, seen = 0, {}
  for _, v in pairs(counts) do n = n + v end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "butterfly", "bee", "snail", "bird" }) do
    if (counts[name] or 0) > 0 then seen[#seen + 1] = counts[name] .. " " .. name end
  end
  local stats = { cells = #gx, motifs = n, branches = nbranch, fills = fills, accents = accents,
    skipped=skipped, route_failures=route_failures, number_box=number_box }
  if anim then
    local total = schedule(events)
    if texio then texio.write_nl(string.format("florilegium: recorded %d motifs, %d events, %.1f s of growth", n, #events, total)) end
    return { rec = ink.take_recording(), total = total, stats = stats }
  end
  local bytes = ink.flush()
  if texio then
    texio.write_nl(string.format("florilegium: grew %d cells, %d motifs, %d stem points, %.0f KB; visitors: %s",
      #gx, n, #spts, bytes / 1024, #seen > 0 and table.concat(seen, ", ") or "none"))
  end
  return stats
end

return M
source.initial.lua:
-- initial.lua -- a decorated initial for florilegium (LuaLaTeX only).
--
-- A square tile at the start of a paragraph: the letter, its outline read from
-- an OpenType font and painted like a petal; a vine that winds over and under
-- the letter's strokes, as in an interlaced manuscript initial; leaves where
-- they fit and small flowers in the largest gaps; a double frame, like a tile.
-- Drawn in a local frame of centimeters, [0,S] x [0,S], under the current ink
-- transform.

local ink = require("ink")
local flora = require("flora")
local M = {}

local sqrt, cos, sin, pi, floor, max, min, abs, atan = math.sqrt, math.cos, math.sin, math.pi, math.floor, math.max, math.min, math.abs, math.atan
local tone, white = ink.tone, ink.white
local rad = pi / 180
local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
local function dist(ax, ay, bx, by) local dx, dy = ax - bx, ay - by return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- outlines
-- luaotfload's reader returns each glyph as segments in font units:
-- {x, y, "m"}, {x, y, "l"}, {x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, "c"}, {x1, y1, x2, y2, "q"}
local cache = {}
local function font_glyphs(file)
  if cache[file] then return cache[file] end
  local path = kpse.find_file(file, "opentype fonts") or kpse.find_file(file, "truetype fonts")
  if not path then return nil, "initial font not found: " .. file end
  local reader = fonts and fonts.handlers and fonts.handlers.otf and fonts.handlers.otf.readers
  if not reader or type(reader.loadshapes) ~= "function" then
    return nil, "luaotfload's outline reader is unavailable (install texlive-luatex)"
  end
  local ok, shapes = pcall(reader.loadshapes, path)
  if not ok or type(shapes) ~= "table" then return nil, "cannot read initial font: " .. file end
  if type(shapes.glyphs)~="table" then return nil,"no glyph outlines in initial font: "..file end
  local byuni = {}
  for _, gl in pairs(shapes.glyphs or {}) do
    if type(gl.unicode) == "number" and not byuni[gl.unicode] then byuni[gl.unicode] = gl end
  end
  cache[file] = { units = shapes.units or 1000, byuni = byuni }
  return cache[file]
end

-- the contours of one character, as path commands and as flattened polygons,
-- scaled to fit a box of height h and width w (cm) centered at (cx, cy)
local function contours(file, char, cx, cy, h, w)
  local f, err = font_glyphs(file)
  if not f then return nil, err end
  local gl = f.byuni[utf8.codepoint(char)]
  if not gl or not gl.segments then return nil, "no outline for '" .. char .. "' in " .. file end
  local bb = gl.boundingbox
  if type(bb)~="table" or not (bb[3] and bb[4] and bb[1] and bb[2]) or bb[3]<=bb[1] or bb[4]<=bb[2] then
    return nil,"no usable outline bounds for '"..char.."' in "..file
  end
  local k = min(h / (bb[4] - bb[2]), w / (bb[3] - bb[1]))
  local ox, oy = cx - k * (bb[1] + bb[3]) / 2, cy - k * (bb[2] + bb[4]) / 2
  local function P(x, y) return ox + k * x, oy + k * y end
  local out, cur, lx, ly = {}, nil, 0, 0
  for _, sg in ipairs(gl.segments) do
    local op = sg[#sg]
    if op == "m" then
      cur = { ops = {}, poly = {} }
      out[#out + 1] = cur
      lx, ly = P(sg[1], sg[2])
      cur.ops[1] = { "m", lx, ly } cur.poly[1] = { lx, ly }
    elseif op == "l" and cur then
      lx, ly = P(sg[1], sg[2])
      cur.ops[#cur.ops + 1] = { "l", lx, ly } cur.poly[#cur.poly + 1] = { lx, ly }
    elseif (op == "c" or op == "q") and cur then
      local x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3
      if op == "c" then
        x1, y1 = P(sg[1], sg[2]) x2, y2 = P(sg[3], sg[4]) x3, y3 = P(sg[5], sg[6])
      else                                     -- quadratic as cubic
        local qx, qy = P(sg[1], sg[2])
        x3, y3 = P(sg[3], sg[4])
        x1, y1 = lx + 2 / 3 * (qx - lx), ly + 2 / 3 * (qy - ly)
        x2, y2 = x3 + 2 / 3 * (qx - x3), y3 + 2 / 3 * (qy - y3)
      end
      cur.ops[#cur.ops + 1] = { "c", x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 }
      local f3 = ink.bezier3(lx, ly, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3)
      for i = 1, 8 do local x, y = f3(i / 8) cur.poly[#cur.poly + 1] = { x, y } end
      lx, ly = x3, y3
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function trace(cs)
  for _, c in ipairs(cs) do
    for _, o in ipairs(c.ops) do
      if o[1] == "m" then ink.moveto(o[2], o[3])
      elseif o[1] == "l" then ink.lineto(o[2], o[3])
      else ink.curveto(o[2], o[3], o[4], o[5], o[6], o[7]) end
    end
    ink.close()
  end
end

-- even-odd point in the letter
local function inside(cs, x, y)
  local c = false
  for _, ct in ipairs(cs) do
    local p, n = ct.poly, #ct.poly
    local j = n
    for i = 1, n do
      local xi, yi, xj, yj = p[i][1], p[i][2], p[j][1], p[j][2]
      if (yi > y) ~= (yj > y) and x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi then c = not c end
      j = i
    end
  end
  return c
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- the tile
-- S: side (cm); letter: one character; o.font: an OpenType file (Latin Modern
-- Roman Bold by default, the OpenType twin of Computer Modern)
function M.draw(rng, S, letter, o)
  o = o or {}
  if utf8.len(letter) ~= 1 then return nil, "an initial must contain exactly one Unicode character" end
  local m = 0.07 * S                           -- the frame's inset
  local cs, err = contours(o.font or "lmroman10-bold.otf", letter, S * 0.5, S * 0.47, S * 0.66, S * 0.7)
  if not cs then return nil, err end
  -- free space: a grid of the distance to the letter and the frame
  local N = 36
  local cell = S / N
  local blocked, freecells = {}, {}
  for i = 0, N - 1 do
    for j = 0, N - 1 do
      local x, y = (i + 0.5) * cell, (j + 0.5) * cell
      if inside(cs, x, y) then blocked[#blocked + 1] = { x, y } else freecells[#freecells + 1] = { x, y } end
    end
  end
  local function clearance(x, y)
    local d = min(x - m, S - m - x, y - m, S - m - y)
    for _, b in ipairs(blocked) do
      local e = dist(x, y, b[1], b[2]) - cell * 0.7
      if e < d then d = e end
    end
    return d
  end

  -- the ground: a pale glaze and a double frame
  ink.layer(1)
  ink.poly({ { 0, 0 }, { S, 0 }, { S, S }, { 0, S } }, true) ink.clip()
    ink.flood(tone(0.975), 0, 0, S, S)
    flora.mottle(rng, 0, 0, S, S, 6, S * 0.2, 0.93, 1.0, 0)
  ink.unclip()
  ink.poly({ { 0, 0 }, { S, 0 }, { S, S }, { 0, S } }, true) ink.stroke(tone(0.1), 0.8)
  ink.poly({ { m * 0.5, m * 0.5 }, { S - m * 0.5, m * 0.5 }, { S - m * 0.5, S - m * 0.5 }, { m * 0.5, S - m * 0.5 } }, true)
  ink.stroke(tone(0.15), 0.3, 0.8)

  -- the vine: from the lower-left corner up across the letter to the upper right
  local f = ink.fbm1(rng, 2)
  local ctrl = {
    { m * 1.2, m * 1.2 }, { S * rng.range(0.14, 0.22), S * rng.range(0.3, 0.4) }, { S * rng.range(0.32, 0.42), S * rng.range(0.5, 0.58) },
    { S * rng.range(0.58, 0.68), S * rng.range(0.42, 0.52) }, { S * rng.range(0.74, 0.82), S * rng.range(0.62, 0.72) }, { S - m * 1.6, S - m * 1.4 } }
  local pts = ink.catmull(ctrl, 14)
  for i, p in ipairs(pts) do local u = (i - 1) / (#pts - 1) p[2] = p[2] + 0.03 * S * f(u * 6) end
  local w0, w1 = 0.026 * S, 0.01 * S
  local function width(i) return lerp(w0, w1, (i - 1) / (#pts - 1)) end
  ink.layer(2)
  flora.stem(pts, w0, w1)
  -- where it crosses the letter, it goes over and under in turn
  local runs, run = {}, nil
  for i, p in ipairs(pts) do
    if inside(cs, p[1], p[2]) then
      if not run then run = { i, i } runs[#runs + 1] = run else run[2] = i end
    else run = nil end
  end
  -- the strands that pass over: drawn again on top of the letter, inside its
  -- outline only, with a thin halo of paper that parts them from the letter
  local over = rng.chance(0.5)
  for _, r in ipairs(runs) do
    if over then
      local a, b = max(1, r[1] - 2), min(#pts, r[2] + 2)
      local seg = {}
      for i = a, b do seg[#seg + 1] = pts[i] end
      ink.layer(4)
      trace(cs) ink.clip()
        ink.smooth(seg, false) ink.stroke(ink.paper, (width(a) + width(b)) / 2 * ink.unit() * ink.CM + 1.0)
        flora.stem(seg, width(a), width(b))
      ink.unclip()
    end
    over = not over
  end
  -- a bud at its tip
  do
    local e, q = pts[#pts], pts[#pts - 3]
    ink.layer(5)
    ink.push() ink.translate(e[1], e[2]) ink.rotate(atan(e[2] - q[2], e[1] - q[1]) / rad - 90)
    flora.bud(rng, 0.13 * S)
    ink.pop()
  end

  -- the letter: wash, granulation, pooled edges, light lifted out
  local t0 = o.tone or rng.range(0.16, 0.22)
  ink.layer(3)
  trace(cs) ink.fill(tone(t0))
  trace(cs) ink.clip()
    flora.mottle(rng, 0, 0, S, S, 22, S * 0.06, t0 - 0.12, t0 + 0.2, 20)
    for k = 1, 9 do
      local x = S * (0.15 + 0.7 * (k - 0.5) / 9) + rng.sym(0.02 * S)
      local y0, y1 = S * rng.range(0.1, 0.25), S * rng.range(0.72, 0.9)
      flora.streak3(x, y0, x + 0.02 * S, lerp(y0, y1, 0.35), x - 0.02 * S, lerp(y0, y1, 0.7), x + rng.sym(0.03 * S), y1,
        0.018 * S, 0.003 * S, white, rng.range(0.25, 0.45))
    end
    trace(cs) ink.stroke(tone(0.04), 0.07 * S * ink.unit() * ink.CM, 0.45, true)
  ink.unclip()
  trace(cs) ink.stroke(tone(0.04), 0.35, 0.7)

  -- leaves along the vine where they fit, alternating sides
  ink.layer(4)
  local s, acc, side = 0, S * rng.range(0.08, 0.14), 1
  for i = 2, #pts - 3 do
    s = s + dist(pts[i][1], pts[i][2], pts[i - 1][1], pts[i - 1][2])
    if s >= acc then
      acc = acc + S * rng.range(0.11, 0.16)
      side = -side
      local tx, ty = pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i - 1][1], pts[i + 1][2] - pts[i - 1][2]
      local a = atan(ty, tx) / rad + side * rng.range(40, 60)
      local L = S * rng.range(0.16, 0.22)
      local ok = true
      for _, u in ipairs({ 0.35, 0.65, 0.95 }) do
        local x, y = pts[i][1] + L * u * cos(a * rad), pts[i][2] + L * u * sin(a * rad)
        if inside(cs, x, y) or clearance(x, y) < 0.03 * S then ok = false end
      end
      if ok then
        ink.push() ink.translate(pts[i][1], pts[i][2]) ink.rotate(a - 90) ink.scale(L)
        flora.leaflet(rng, { bend = -side * 0.2 })
        ink.pop()
      end
    end
  end

  -- flowers in the largest gaps: a blossom, and florets on hairlines from the vine
  ink.layer(5)
  local spots = {}
  for _, c in ipairs(freecells) do
    local cl = clearance(c[1], c[2])
    if cl > 0.06 * S then spots[#spots + 1] = { c[1], c[2], cl } end
  end
  table.sort(spots, function(a, b) return a[3] > b[3] end)
  local placed = {}
  local nb = 0
  for _, sp in ipairs(spots) do
    if nb >= 4 then break end
    local far = true
    for _, p in ipairs(placed) do if dist(sp[1], sp[2], p[1], p[2]) < p[3] + sp[3] + 0.04 * S then far = false end end
    if far then
      nb = nb + 1
      local r = min(sp[3] * 0.85, 0.12 * S)
      placed[#placed + 1] = { sp[1], sp[2], r }
      -- a hairline stalk back to the vine, if the vine is near
      local best, bp = math.huge, nil
      for _, p in ipairs(pts) do local d = dist(p[1], p[2], sp[1], sp[2]) if d < best then best, bp = d, p end end
      if bp and best < 0.3 * S then
        ink.layer(2)
        ink.moveto(bp[1], bp[2]) ink.curveto(lerp(bp[1], sp[1], 0.3), lerp(bp[2], sp[2], 0.1) + 0.03 * S, lerp(bp[1], sp[1], 0.7), sp[2] - 0.02 * S, sp[1], sp[2])
        ink.stroke(tone(0.12), 0.35)
        ink.layer(5)
      end
      ink.push() ink.translate(sp[1], sp[2])
      if r > 0.07 * S and nb <= 2 then flora.blossom(rng, r) else flora.floret(rng, r * 0.8, { star = rng.chance(0.5) }) end
      ink.pop()
    end
  end
  -- a copper sparkle in a corner
  ink.layer(6)
  ink.push() ink.translate(S - m * 2.2, m * 2.2) flora.sparkle(rng, 0.045 * S) ink.pop()
  return true
end

return M
source.ink.lua:
-- ink.lua -- the drawing core of florilegium: geometry in Lua, raw PDF out.
--
-- Everything is computed here and written as PDF path operators into a literal
-- node, so TeX does no arithmetic at all. A drawing is made in a local frame
-- (centimeters) under an affine transform that maps it to the page (big points);
-- strokes are absolute widths in bp, and anything that should scale with the
-- motif (stems, veins, streaks) is drawn as a filled ribbon instead of a stroke.
--
-- Color comes from a tone ramp derived from the document color `ink`:
-- tone(0) is the darkest navy, tone(1) the palest mist, all at the hue of `ink`,
-- computed in OKLCH so the light end stays blue instead of turning gray.

local M = {}

local fmt, floor, sqrt, sin, cos, atan, pi, abs = string.format, math.floor, math.sqrt, math.sin, math.cos, math.atan, math.pi, math.abs
local concat = table.concat
local rad = pi / 180
local CM = 72 / 2.54                       -- bp per cm

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- random
-- mulberry32: small, fast, identical on every platform (math.random is not)
function M.rng(seed)
  local s = floor(seed) & 0xffffffff
  local r = {}
  function r.u()
    s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) & 0xffffffff
    local t = s
    t = ((t ~ (t >> 15)) * (t | 1)) & 0xffffffff
    t = (t ~ (t + (((t ~ (t >> 7)) * (t | 61)) & 0xffffffff))) & 0xffffffff
    return ((t ~ (t >> 14)) & 0xffffffff) / 4294967296
  end
  function r.range(a, b) return a + (b - a) * r.u() end
  function r.sym(a) return a * (2 * r.u() - 1) end
  function r.int(a, b) return a + floor((b - a + 1) * r.u()) end
  function r.chance(p) return r.u() < p end
  function r.pick(t) return t[1 + floor(#t * r.u())] end
  function r.normal() local u1 = math.max(r.u(), 1e-12) return sqrt(-2 * math.log(u1)) * cos(2 * pi * r.u()) end
  function r.fork() return M.rng(floor(r.u() * 4294967295)) end   -- an independent stream
  function r.save() return s end                                  -- replay a draw (animation)
  function r.load(v) s = v end
  return r
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- noise
-- 1-D gradient noise with a seeded gradient table, smooth, roughly in [-1,1]
function M.noise1(rng)
  local g = {}
  for i = 0, 255 do g[i] = rng.sym(1) end
  return function(x)
    local i = floor(x); local f = x - i
    local a, b = g[i & 255] * f, g[(i + 1) & 255] * (f - 1)
    local u = f * f * (3 - 2 * f)
    return 2 * (a + (b - a) * u)
  end
end

-- fractal sum of 1-D noise: `oct` octaves, each double frequency, half amplitude
function M.fbm1(rng, oct)
  local ns = {}
  for k = 1, oct do ns[k] = M.noise1(rng) end
  return function(x)
    local v, a, f = 0, 1, 1
    for k = 1, oct do v = v + a * ns[k](x * f + 17 * k); a = a * 0.5; f = f * 2 end
    return v
  end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- color
local function srgb_dec(c) return c <= 0.04045 and c / 12.92 or ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4 end
local function srgb_enc(c) return c <= 0.0031308 and 12.92 * c or 1.055 * c ^ (1 / 2.4) - 0.055 end
local function cbrt(x) return x < 0 and -((-x) ^ (1 / 3)) or x ^ (1 / 3) end

local function rgb_to_oklch(r, g, b)
  r, g, b = srgb_dec(r), srgb_dec(g), srgb_dec(b)
  local l = cbrt(0.4122214708 * r + 0.5363325363 * g + 0.0514459929 * b)
  local m = cbrt(0.2119034982 * r + 0.6806995451 * g + 0.1073969566 * b)
  local s = cbrt(0.0883024619 * r + 0.2817188376 * g + 0.6299787005 * b)
  local L = 0.2104542553 * l + 0.7936177850 * m - 0.0040720468 * s
  local A = 1.9779984951 * l - 2.4285922050 * m + 0.4505937099 * s
  local B = 0.0259040371 * l + 0.7827717662 * m - 0.8086757660 * s
  return L, sqrt(A * A + B * B), atan(B, A) / rad
end

-- OKLCH -> sRGB; nil when out of gamut
local function oklch_to_rgb(L, C, h)
  local A, B = C * cos(h * rad), C * sin(h * rad)
  local l = (L + 0.3963377774 * A + 0.2158037573 * B) ^ 3
  local m = (L - 0.1055613458 * A - 0.0638541728 * B) ^ 3
  local s = (L - 0.0894841775 * A - 1.2914855480 * B) ^ 3
  local r = 4.0767416621 * l - 3.3077115913 * m + 0.2309699292 * s
  local g = -1.2684380046 * l + 2.6097574011 * m - 0.3413193965 * s
  local b = -0.0041960863 * l - 0.7034186147 * m + 1.7076147010 * s
  if r < -1e-4 or g < -1e-4 or b < -1e-4 or r > 1.0001 or g > 1.0001 or b > 1.0001 then return nil end
  local function c(x) return srgb_enc(math.min(1, math.max(0, x))) end
  return c(r), c(g), c(b)
end

-- largest in-gamut chroma at or below C
local function oklch_clamped(L, C, h)
  local r, g, b = oklch_to_rgb(L, C, h)
  if r then return r, g, b end
  local lo, hi = 0, C
  for _ = 1, 18 do local mid = (lo + hi) / 2 if oklch_to_rgb(L, mid, h) then lo = mid else hi = mid end end
  return oklch_to_rgb(L, lo, h)
end

-- the ramp: lightness and chroma per stop; chroma scales with the chroma of
-- `ink`, the hue follows `ink` and drifts slightly violet in the darks and
-- cyan in the lights, as ultramarine does when it is thinned with water
local STOPS = {   -- t, L, C, hue drift
  { 0.00, 0.25, 0.105,  6 },
  { 0.18, 0.35, 0.150,  3 },
  { 0.38, 0.47, 0.175,  0 },
  { 0.58, 0.60, 0.145, -3 },
  { 0.80, 0.77, 0.080, -6 },
  { 1.00, 0.92, 0.030, -8 },
}
local REF_C = 0.175                        -- the chroma of the default ink at the cobalt stop
local ramp = {}                            -- 101 precomputed "r g b" strings
local hue, chroma_k = 263, 1
local lift = 0                             -- ghost mode: tone t -> t + (1-t)*lift

local function build_ramp()
  for i = 0, 100 do
    local t = i / 100
    local k = 1
    while STOPS[k + 1][1] < t do k = k + 1 end
    local a, b = STOPS[k], STOPS[k + 1]
    local u = (t - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])
    local L = a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u
    local C = (a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * u) * chroma_k
    local h = hue + a[4] + (b[4] - a[4]) * u
    local r, g, bb = oklch_clamped(L, C, h)
    ramp[i] = { r, g, bb }
  end
end

-- set the hue from the document color `ink` (r,g,b in 0..1)
local ink_rgb
function M.set_ink(r, g, b)
  ink_rgb={r,g,b}
  local _, C, h = rgb_to_oklch(r, g, b)
  hue, chroma_k = h, math.max(0.15, math.min(1.3, C / REF_C))
  build_ramp()
end
M.set_ink(0x24 / 255, 0x56 / 255, 0xC4 / 255)

local accent = { 0.71, 0.40, 0.18 }
function M.set_accent(r, g, b) accent = { r, g, b } end

-- a color is a table {r,g,b}; tone(t) is a point on the ramp (ghost lift applied)
function M.tone(t)
  t = t + (1 - t) * lift
  local i = math.max(0, math.min(100, floor(t * 100 + 0.5)))
  return ramp[i]
end
function M.accent(k)                        -- k>0 lightens toward white, k<0 darkens
  k = k or 0
  if k >= 0 then return { accent[1] + (1 - accent[1]) * k, accent[2] + (1 - accent[2]) * k, accent[3] + (1 - accent[3]) * k } end
  k = 1 + k
  return { accent[1] * k, accent[2] * k, accent[3] * k }
end
-- paint fn() with a ramp at the hue of the accent instead (copper leaves in autumn)
local accent_ramp, accent_key
function M.in_accent(fn)
  local key = fmt("%.3f %.3f %.3f", accent[1], accent[2], accent[3])
  local main = ramp
  if accent_key ~= key then
    local h0, c0 = hue, chroma_k
    local _, C, h = rgb_to_oklch(accent[1], accent[2], accent[3])
    ramp, hue, chroma_k = {}, h, math.max(0.15, math.min(1.3, C / REF_C))
    build_ramp()
    accent_ramp, accent_key, hue, chroma_k = ramp, key, h0, c0
  end
  ramp = accent_ramp
  fn()
  ramp = main
end
M.white = { 1, 1, 1 }
M.paper = { 0.995, 0.993, 0.985 }
function M.set_lift(v) local old = lift lift = v return old end
function M.get_lift() return lift end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- transforms
-- an affine map {a,b,c,d,e,f}: x' = a x + c y + e,  y' = b x + d y + f
local T = { CM, 0, 0, CM, 0, 0 }           -- current transform: local cm -> page bp
local stack = {}

local function mul(A, B)                   -- A then B, i.e. B(A(p))
  return { B[1] * A[1] + B[3] * A[2], B[2] * A[1] + B[4] * A[2],
           B[1] * A[3] + B[3] * A[4], B[2] * A[3] + B[4] * A[4],
           B[1] * A[5] + B[3] * A[6] + B[5], B[2] * A[5] + B[4] * A[6] + B[6] }
end
function M.set_transform(t) T = t end
function M.get_transform() return T end
function M.push() stack[#stack + 1] = T end
function M.pop() T = table.remove(stack) end
function M.translate(x, y) T = { T[1], T[2], T[3], T[4], T[1] * x + T[3] * y + T[5], T[2] * x + T[4] * y + T[6] } end
function M.rotate(deg)
  local c, s = cos(deg * rad), sin(deg * rad)
  T = { T[1] * c + T[3] * s, T[2] * c + T[4] * s, -T[1] * s + T[3] * c, -T[2] * s + T[4] * c, T[5], T[6] }
end
function M.scale(sx, sy) sy = sy or sx T = { T[1] * sx, T[2] * sx, T[3] * sy, T[4] * sy, T[5], T[6] } end
-- size of one local unit on the page, in cm (for level-of-detail decisions)
function M.unit() return sqrt(abs(T[1] * T[4] - T[2] * T[3])) / CM end
-- local point -> page cm (for layout code that needs absolute positions)
function M.to_page(x, y) return (T[1] * x + T[3] * y + T[5]) / CM, (T[2] * x + T[4] * y + T[6]) / CM end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- output
-- Output goes into numbered layers; flush() writes them in order as one
-- literal. ExtGState resources for opacity/blend are registered with pgf.
-- While recording (the growth animation), every piece of output also keeps
-- the tag that was current when it was painted, so a frame can later write
-- only the pieces it wants, in their original order.
local layers, cur = {}, 5
local tags, tag, recording = {}, nil, false
-- Optional neutral capture. Disabled on all existing drawing paths by default.
local capture, vector_layers, vector_path, vector_points
local page_transform
function M.set_page_transform(t) page_transform = t end
local page_clip, element_bounds
function M.set_page_clip(pw,ph,rects) page_clip = rects and #rects>0 and {pw,ph,rects} or nil end
function M.begin_element()
  local tx={lengths={},previous=element_bounds}
  for k,v in pairs(layers) do tx.lengths[k]=#v end
  return tx
end
function M.track_element(tx) element_bounds={minx=math.huge,miny=math.huge,maxx=-math.huge,maxy=-math.huge,pad=0};tx.bounds=element_bounds end
function M.end_element(tx,rects)
  local b=tx.bounds
  element_bounds=tx.previous
  if b then for _,r in ipairs(rects) do
    if b.maxx+b.pad>=r[1]*CM and b.minx-b.pad<=r[3]*CM and b.maxy+b.pad>=r[2]*CM and b.miny-b.pad<=r[4]*CM then
      for k,v in pairs(layers) do
        local n=tx.lengths[k]
        if n==nil then layers[k],tags[k]=nil,nil else for i=#v,n+1,-1 do v[i]=nil;tags[k][i]=nil end end
        if capture and vector_layers[k] then
          if n==nil then vector_layers[k]=nil else for i=#vector_layers[k],n+1,-1 do vector_layers[k][i]=nil end end
        end
      end
      return false
    end
  end end
  return true
end
local function put(s, neutral)
  local b = layers[cur]
  if not b then b = {} layers[cur] = b tags[cur] = {} end
  b[#b + 1] = s
  if capture then
    assert(neutral~=nil,"unrepresented operation in neutral ink capture")
    if neutral.op=="path" and capture.semantic_ref then neutral.semantic_ref=capture.semantic_ref() end
    vector_layers[cur]=vector_layers[cur] or {};vector_layers[cur][#b]=neutral
  end
  if recording then tags[cur][#b] = tag end
end
function M.layer(n) local old = cur cur = n return old end
function M.tag(t) local old = tag tag = t return old end
function M.record(on)
  assert(not capture or not on,"legacy animation recording requires its own semantic migration")
  recording = on tag = nil
end

-- Default LuaTeX sink. Standalone PDF and XeTeX replace the sink, not the paths.
M.backend = {
  literal = function(s, mode)
    local n = node.new("whatsit", "pdf_literal")
    n.mode, n.data = mode or 0, s
    node.write(n)
  end,
  extgs = function(name, dict)
    tex.sprint(luatexbase.registernumber("catcodetable@atletter"),
      fmt("\\pgfutil@addpdfresource@extgs{/%s %s}", name, dict))
  end,
}
local gs_known = {}
function M.set_backend(backend)
  assert(type(backend.literal) == "function" and type(backend.extgs) == "function", "invalid drawing backend")
  M.backend, gs_known = backend, {}
end
local function gs(op, mult)
  op = floor(op * 100 + 0.5)
  if op >= 100 and not mult then return nil end
  local name = fmt("flo%s%d", mult and "m" or "a", op)
  if not gs_known[name] then
    gs_known[name] = true
