    M.backend.extgs(name, fmt("<< /ca %.2f /CA %.2f%s >>", op / 100, op / 100, mult and " /BM /Multiply" or ""))
  end
  return name
end

-- 0.1 bp (0.035 mm) is finer than any printer resolves
local function P(x, y)
  local px,py=T[1] * x + T[3] * y + T[5], T[2] * x + T[4] * y + T[6]
  if element_bounds then
    local b=element_bounds
    b.minx,b.maxx=math.min(b.minx,px),math.max(b.maxx,px)
    b.miny,b.maxy=math.min(b.miny,py),math.max(b.maxy,py)
  end
  if capture then
    local function rounded(n) return assert(tonumber((fmt("%.1f",n):gsub(",","."))))/CM end
    vector_points[#vector_points+1]={rounded(px),rounded(py)}
  end
  return fmt("%.1f %.1f", px, py)
end

local function vector_sequence(sequence)
  if not capture then return end
  local points=vector_points;vector_points={};local at=1
  for _,op in ipairs(sequence) do
    local n=op=="Z" and 0 or op=="C" and 3 or 1
    local command={op};for _=1,n do local p=assert(points[at],"neutral point arity");command[#command+1]=p[1];command[#command+1]=p[2];at=at+1 end
    vector_path[#vector_path+1]=command
  end
  assert(at==#points+1,"unexpected neutral control points")
end
local function vector_command(first,rest,arity,closed)
  if not capture then return end
  local sequence={first};local used=first=="C" and 3 or 1
  while used<#vector_points do assert(rest,"unexpected neutral path points");sequence[#sequence+1]=rest;used=used+arity end
  if closed then sequence[#sequence+1]="Z" end
  vector_sequence(sequence)
end
local function neutral_path(paint)
  if not capture then return nil end
  assert(#vector_points==0,"unconsumed neutral control points")
  local commands=vector_path;vector_path={}
  if #commands==0 then return false end -- a legacy no-op remains a no-op
  return {op="path",commands=commands,paint=paint}
end

-- path construction: polyline or smooth (Catmull-Rom as Béziers) through points {{x,y},...}
local path = {}
function M.moveto(x, y) path[#path + 1] = P(x, y) .. " m";vector_command("M") end
function M.lineto(x, y) path[#path + 1] = P(x, y) .. " l";vector_command("L") end
function M.curveto(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3) path[#path + 1] = P(x1, y1) .. " " .. P(x2, y2) .. " " .. P(x3, y3) .. " c";vector_command("C") end
function M.close() path[#path + 1] = "h";if capture then vector_path[#vector_path+1]={"Z"} end end
function M.poly(pts, closed)
  path[#path + 1] = P(pts[1][1], pts[1][2]) .. " m"
  for i = 2, #pts do path[#path + 1] = P(pts[i][1], pts[i][2]) .. " l" end
  if closed then path[#path + 1] = "h" end
  vector_command("M","L",1,closed)
end
function M.smooth(pts, closed, tension)
  local n = #pts
  if n < 3 then return M.poly(pts, closed) end
  local k = (tension or 1) / 6
  local function at(i)
    if closed then return pts[(i - 1) % n + 1] end
    return pts[math.max(1, math.min(n, i))]
  end
  path[#path + 1] = P(pts[1][1], pts[1][2]) .. " m"
  local last = closed and n or n - 1
  for i = 1, last do
    local p0, p1, p2, p3 = at(i - 1), at(i), at(i + 1), at(i + 2)
    path[#path + 1] = P(p1[1] + (p2[1] - p0[1]) * k, p1[2] + (p2[2] - p0[2]) * k) .. " " ..
      P(p2[1] - (p3[1] - p1[1]) * k, p2[2] - (p3[2] - p1[2]) * k) .. " " .. P(p2[1], p2[2]) .. " c"
  end
  if closed then path[#path + 1] = "h" end
  vector_command("M","C",3,closed)
end
function M.circle(x, y, r)
  local k = 0.5523 * r
  path[#path + 1] = P(x + r, y) .. " m " .. P(x + r, y + k) .. " " .. P(x + k, y + r) .. " " .. P(x, y + r) .. " c " ..
    P(x - k, y + r) .. " " .. P(x - r, y + k) .. " " .. P(x - r, y) .. " c " ..
    P(x - r, y - k) .. " " .. P(x - k, y - r) .. " " .. P(x, y - r) .. " c " ..
    P(x + k, y - r) .. " " .. P(x + r, y - k) .. " " .. P(x + r, y) .. " c h"
  vector_command("M","C",3,true)
end
local function take() local s = concat(path, " ") path = {} return s end

local color_mode = "color"
function M.set_color_mode(mode)
  assert(mode=="color" or mode=="mono", "invalid color mode")
  color_mode=mode
end
function M.palette_snapshot()
  return {ink={ink_rgb[1],ink_rgb[2],ink_rgb[3]},accent={accent[1],accent[2],accent[3]},lift=lift,color_mode=color_mode}
end
local function rgb(c, stroke)
  local r,g,b=c[1],c[2],c[3]
  if color_mode=="mono" then
    return fmt(stroke and "%.3f G" or "%.3f g",0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*b)
  end
  return fmt(stroke and "%.3f %.3f %.3f RG" or "%.3f %.3f %.3f rg", r,g,b)
end
local function neutral_paint(c,w,op,mult,dash)
  if not capture then return nil end
  local function rounded(n,d) return assert(tonumber((fmt("%."..d.."f",n):gsub(",",".")))) end
  local color
  if color_mode=="mono" then color={rounded(0.2126*c[1]+0.7152*c[2]+0.0722*c[3],3)}
  else color={rounded(c[1],3),rounded(c[2],3),rounded(c[3],3)} end
  local alpha=math.min(1,floor((op or 1)*100+0.5)/100)
  assert(alpha>=0,"negative captured opacity")
  local paint={color_space=color_mode=="mono" and "gray" or "rgb",opacity=alpha,blend=mult and "multiply" or "normal",fill_rule="nonzero"}
  if w then
    paint.stroke=color;paint.stroke_width=rounded(w,2)/CM;paint.cap="round";paint.join="round";paint.miter_limit=10
    if dash then
      local list,phase=dash:match("^%[([^%]]*)%]%s*([%d.+-]+)$");assert(list and tonumber(phase),"unsupported legacy dash spelling")
      local array={};for token in list:gmatch("%S+") do local n=assert(tonumber(token));assert(n>=0,"negative dash");array[#array+1]=n/CM end
      paint.dash={array=setmetatable(array,{__jsontype="array"}),phase=tonumber(phase)/CM}
    end
  else paint.fill=color end
  return paint
end

-- paint the current path. opacity < 1 or mult=true wraps it in its own graphics state
function M.fill(c, op, mult)
  local neutral=neutral_path(neutral_paint(c,nil,op,mult))
  local g = gs(op or 1, mult)
  if g then put("q /" .. g .. " gs " .. rgb(c) .. " " .. take() .. " f Q",neutral)
  else put(rgb(c) .. " " .. take() .. " f",neutral) end
end
-- dash: a PDF dash array, e.g. "[2 2] 0"
function M.stroke(c, w, op, mult, dash)
  local neutral=neutral_path(neutral_paint(c,w,op,mult,dash))
  if element_bounds then element_bounds.pad=math.max(element_bounds.pad,w/2+0.1) end
  local g = gs(op or 1, mult)
  local s = rgb(c, true) .. fmt(" %.2f w ", w) .. (dash and dash .. " d " or "") .. take() .. " S"
  if g then put("q /" .. g .. " gs " .. s .. " Q",neutral) else put("q " .. s .. " Q",neutral) end
end
-- clip to the current path until the matching unclip()
function M.clip()
  local neutral=neutral_path();if capture then assert(neutral,"empty legacy clip unsupported in primitive capture");neutral.op="push_clip";neutral.fill_rule="nonzero" end
  put("q " .. take() .. " W n",neutral)
end
function M.unclip() put("Q",capture and {op="pop_clip"} or nil) end
function M.discard() path = {};if capture then vector_path,vector_points={},{} end end
-- paint the whole of the current clip (inside a clip(), cheaper than repeating the path)
function M.flood(c, x0, y0, x1, y1)
  M.poly({ { x0, y0 }, { x1, y0 }, { x1, y1 }, { x0, y1 } }, true)
  M.fill(c)
end

-- write all layers (in order) as one literal node at the current position
local function literal(parts)
  if #parts == 0 then return 0 end
  local s = "q 1 J 1 j\n" .. concat(parts, "\n") .. "\nQ"
  if page_clip then
    local clips={"q"}
    for _,r in ipairs(page_clip[3]) do
      clips[#clips+1]=fmt("0 0 %.3f %.3f re %.3f %.3f %.3f %.3f re W* n",page_clip[1]*CM,page_clip[2]*CM,r[1]*CM,r[2]*CM,(r[3]-r[1])*CM,(r[4]-r[2])*CM)
    end
    s=concat(clips,"\n").."\n"..s.."\nQ"
  end
  if page_transform then s = "q " .. concat(page_transform, " ") .. " cm\n" .. s .. "\nQ" end
  M.backend.literal(s)
  return #s
end
local function sorted_keys()
  local keys = {}
  for k in pairs(layers) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
  table.sort(keys)
  return keys
end
function M.flush()
  local parts = {}
  if capture then
    assert(not page_transform and not page_clip,"legacy page transforms/clips require an explicit Document view")
    for _,k in ipairs(sorted_keys()) do for _,op in ipairs(vector_layers[k] or {}) do if op then capture.operations[#capture.operations+1]=op end end end
    vector_layers={}
  end
  for _, k in ipairs(sorted_keys()) do parts[#parts + 1] = concat(layers[k], "\n") end
  layers, tags = {}, {}
  return literal(parts)
end

-- hand over what was recorded instead of writing it: { keys, layers, tags }
function M.take_recording()
  assert(not capture,"legacy recording replay is outside primitive capture")
  local rec = { keys = sorted_keys(), layers = layers, tags = tags }
  layers, tags, recording, tag = {}, {}, false, nil
  return rec
end
-- write one frame of a recording: the untagged pieces and those keep(tag) accepts
function M.emit(rec, keep)
  assert(not capture,"legacy recording replay is outside primitive capture")
  local parts = {}
  for _, k in ipairs(rec.keys) do
    local L, T, out = rec.layers[k], rec.tags[k], {}
    for i = 1, #L do
      local t = T[i]
      if t == nil or keep(t) then out[#out + 1] = L[i] end
    end
    if #out > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = concat(out, "\n") end
  end
  return literal(parts)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
-- polyline helpers: points are {x,y}; `spine` functions return x,y for v in [0,1]

-- outward normals and cumulative length of a polyline
local function normals(pts)
  local n, out = #pts, {}
  for i = 1, n do
    local a, b = pts[math.max(1, i - 1)], pts[math.min(n, i + 1)]
    local dx, dy = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]
    local L = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    if L < 1e-9 then L = 1 end
    out[i] = { -dy / L, dx / L }
  end
  return out
end
M.normals = normals

function M.arclen(pts)
  local s, acc = { 0 }, 0
  for i = 2, #pts do acc = acc + sqrt((pts[i][1] - pts[i - 1][1]) ^ 2 + (pts[i][2] - pts[i - 1][2]) ^ 2) s[i] = acc end
  return s, acc
end

-- a ribbon along a centerline: width(u) is the full width at fraction u of the length.
-- Returns the closed outline (left side forward, right side back).
function M.ribbon(pts, width)
  local nrm = normals(pts)
  local s, L = M.arclen(pts)
  local left, right = {}, {}
  for i, p in ipairs(pts) do
    local w = width(L > 0 and s[i] / L or 0) / 2
    left[#left + 1] = { p[1] + nrm[i][1] * w, p[2] + nrm[i][2] * w }
    right[#right + 1] = { p[1] - nrm[i][1] * w, p[2] - nrm[i][2] * w }
  end
  local out = left
  for i = #right, 1, -1 do out[#out + 1] = right[i] end
  return out
end

-- a tapered stroke along one cubic Bézier, as a closed outline of two Béziers:
-- the control points are pushed out along the curve's normals by half the
-- width at their parameter (w0 at the start, w1 at the end). Five times
-- smaller than a sampled ribbon and indistinguishable for a gentle curve.
function M.taper(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, w0, w1)
  local function nrm(dx, dy) local L = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) if L < 1e-9 then return 0, 0 end return -dy / L, dx / L end
  local n0x, n0y = nrm(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
  local n1x, n1y = nrm(x2 - x0, y2 - y0)
  local n2x, n2y = nrm(x3 - x1, y3 - y1)
  local n3x, n3y = nrm(x3 - x2, y3 - y2)
  local h0, h1, h2, h3 = w0 / 2, (2 * w0 + w1) / 6, (w0 + 2 * w1) / 6, w1 / 2
  path[#path + 1] = P(x0 + n0x * h0, y0 + n0y * h0) .. " m " ..
    P(x1 + n1x * h1, y1 + n1y * h1) .. " " .. P(x2 + n2x * h2, y2 + n2y * h2) .. " " .. P(x3 + n3x * h3, y3 + n3y * h3) .. " c " ..
    P(x3 - n3x * h3, y3 - n3y * h3) .. " l " ..
    P(x2 - n2x * h2, y2 - n2y * h2) .. " " .. P(x1 - n1x * h1, y1 - n1y * h1) .. " " .. P(x0 - n0x * h0, y0 - n0y * h0) .. " c h"
  vector_sequence({"M","C","L","C","Z"})
end

-- Catmull-Rom samples through control points {{x,y},...}, `per` per segment
function M.catmull(pts, per)
  local out, n = {}, #pts
  for i = 1, n - 1 do
    local p0, p1, p2, p3 = pts[math.max(i - 1, 1)], pts[i], pts[i + 1], pts[math.min(i + 2, n)]
    for k = 0, per - 1 do
      local t = k / per local t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
      local function c(j) return 0.5 * (2 * p1[j] + (-p0[j] + p2[j]) * t + (2 * p0[j] - 5 * p1[j] + 4 * p2[j] - p3[j]) * t2 + (-p0[j] + 3 * p1[j] - 3 * p2[j] + p3[j]) * t3) end
      out[#out + 1] = { c(1), c(2) }
    end
  end
  out[#out + 1] = { pts[n][1], pts[n][2] }
  return out
end

-- sample a curve function f(v) -> x,y at n+1 points
function M.sample(f, n, v0, v1)
  v0, v1 = v0 or 0, v1 or 1
  local out = {}
  for i = 0, n do local x, y = f(v0 + (v1 - v0) * i / n) out[#out + 1] = { x, y } end
  return out
end

-- quadratic and cubic Bézier evaluators, returning functions of v
function M.bezier3(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3)
  return function(v)
    local u = 1 - v
    local a, b, c, d = u * u * u, 3 * u * u * v, 3 * u * v * v, v * v * v
    return a * x0 + b * x1 + c * x2 + d * x3, a * y0 + b * y1 + c * y2 + d * y3
  end
end

-- a blade: closed outline around a spine with half-widths wl(v), wr(v) on each side
-- and an optional edge perturbation e(v, side) added along the normal.
-- Used for petals, leaves, sepals, buds.
function M.blade(spine, n, wl, wr, edge)
  local c = M.sample(spine, n)
  local nrm = normals(c)
  local left, right = {}, {}
  for i = 1, n + 1 do
    local v = (i - 1) / n
    local el, er = 0, 0
    if edge then el, er = edge(v, 1), edge(v, -1) end
    local a, b = wl(v) + el, wr(v) + er
    if a < 0 then a = 0 end
    if b < 0 then b = 0 end
    left[i] = { c[i][1] + nrm[i][1] * a, c[i][2] + nrm[i][2] * a }
    right[i] = { c[i][1] - nrm[i][1] * b, c[i][2] - nrm[i][2] * b }
  end
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, n + 1 do out[#out + 1] = left[i] end
  for i = n, 2, -1 do out[#out + 1] = right[i] end
  return out, c, nrm
end

-- an irregular blob: a circle of radius r whose radius wobbles by `rough`
function M.blob(rng, x, y, rx, ry, rough, n)
  n = n or 9
  local ph, ph2, rot = rng.range(0, 2 * pi), rng.range(0, 2 * pi), rng.range(0, 2 * pi)
  local out = {}
  for i = 0, n - 1 do
    local a = 2 * pi * i / n
    local k = 1 + rough * (0.6 * sin(2 * a + ph) + 0.4 * sin(3 * a + ph2)) + rough * 0.5 * rng.sym(1)
    local px, py = rx * k * cos(a), ry * k * sin(a)
    out[#out + 1] = { x + px * cos(rot) - py * sin(rot), y + px * sin(rot) + py * cos(rot) }
  end
  return out
end

M.CM = CM
-- Capture the existing primitive mathematics as neutral cm operations. The
-- temporary sink/state is restored even when the callback fails. This is a
-- primitive bridge, not a migration of page growth or animation semantics.
function M.capture(fn, options)
  assert(type(fn)=="function" and not capture,"capture requires a callback and cannot nest")
  options=options or {};for key in pairs(options)do assert(key=="semantic_ref","unsupported capture option "..tostring(key))end
  assert(options.semantic_ref==nil or type(options.semantic_ref)=="function","capture semantic source must be a callback")
  local saved={T=T,stack=stack,layers=layers,cur=cur,tags=tags,tag=tag,recording=recording,
    page_transform=page_transform,page_clip=page_clip,element_bounds=element_bounds,
    path=path,backend=M.backend,gs_known=gs_known,color_mode=color_mode,ramp=ramp,
    hue=hue,chroma_k=chroma_k,lift=lift,accent=accent,accent_ramp=accent_ramp,accent_key=accent_key,ink_rgb=ink_rgb}
  capture={operations={},semantic_ref=options.semantic_ref};vector_layers,vector_path,vector_points={},{},{}
  T,stack,layers,cur,tags,tag,recording={CM,0,0,CM,0,0},{},{},5,{},nil,false
  page_transform,page_clip,element_bounds,path=nil,nil,nil,{}
  M.backend={literal=function()end,extgs=function()end};gs_known={}
  ramp={};build_ramp();accent={accent[1],accent[2],accent[3]};accent_ramp,accent_key=nil,nil
  local ok,err=pcall(function()
    fn();assert(#path==0,"capture ended with an unpainted path");M.flush()
    local depth=0
    for _,op in ipairs(capture.operations) do
      if op.op=="push_clip" then depth=depth+1 elseif op.op=="pop_clip" then depth=depth-1 end
      assert(depth>=0,"capture clipping crosses layer order")
    end
    assert(depth==0,"capture has an unbalanced clip stack")
  end)
  local operations=capture.operations
  T,stack,layers,cur,tags,tag,recording=saved.T,saved.stack,saved.layers,saved.cur,saved.tags,saved.tag,saved.recording
  page_transform,page_clip,element_bounds,path=saved.page_transform,saved.page_clip,saved.element_bounds,saved.path
  M.backend,gs_known,color_mode=saved.backend,saved.gs_known,saved.color_mode
  ramp,hue,chroma_k,lift,accent,accent_ramp,accent_key=saved.ramp,saved.hue,saved.chroma_k,saved.lift,saved.accent,saved.accent_ramp,saved.accent_key
  ink_rgb=saved.ink_rgb
  capture,vector_layers,vector_path,vector_points=nil,nil,nil,nil
  assert(ok,err)
  return operations,{operation="ink-neutral-capture-v1",unit="cm",coordinate_quantization_bp=0.1,color_digits=3,stroke_width_digits=2,count=#operations}
end
return M

-- Layout controls for the grown composition. Distances are in page cm.
local M = { SIDE_OVERHANG = 0.25 }
local presets = { full = 1, balanced = 0.6, airy = 0.3 }
local defaults = { density = 1, text_gap = 0.15, spill = true, footer = true, header = true,
  side = "left", style = "classic", focal_count = 3, focal_scale = 1, asymmetry = 1,
  page_number = false, number_scale = 1, variation = "page", seed = false, color_mode = "color" }
M.styles = {
  classic = { density = 1, spill = true, footer = true, header = true, focal_count = 3, focal_scale = 1, asymmetry = 1 },
  quiet = { density = 0.3, spill = false, footer = false, header = false, focal_count = 1, focal_scale = 0.75, asymmetry = 0.45 },
  chapter = { density = 0.6, spill = false, footer = true, header = true, focal_count = 2, focal_scale = 1.2, asymmetry = 1.35 },
}

function M.resolve(options)
  local out = {}
  for k, v in pairs(defaults) do out[k] = v end
  local preset=options and M.styles[options.style]
  if preset then for k,v in pairs(preset) do out[k]=v end end
  for k, v in pairs(options or {}) do
    if defaults[k] == nil then error("florilegium: unknown layout control '" .. tostring(k) .. "'", 2) end
    out[k] = v
  end
  local d = out.density
  d = presets[d] or (type(d) == "number" or type(d) == "string") and tonumber(d)
  if not d or d ~= d or d < 0.2 or d > 1 then
    error("florilegium: density must be full, balanced, airy, or a number from 0.2 to 1", 2)
  end
  out.density = d
  local gap = out.text_gap
  if type(gap) ~= "number" or gap ~= gap or gap < 0 or gap == math.huge then
    error("florilegium: text-gap must be a finite, nonnegative dimension", 2)
  end
  for _, k in ipairs({ "spill", "footer", "header", "page_number" }) do
    if out[k] == "true" then out[k] = true elseif out[k] == "false" then out[k] = false end
    if type(out[k]) ~= "boolean" then error("florilegium: " .. k .. " must be true or false", 2) end
  end
  if not ({left=true,right=true,outer=true,inner=true})[out.side] then
    error("florilegium: side must be left, right, outer, or inner", 2)
  end
  if not M.styles[out.style] then error("florilegium: style must be classic, quiet, or chapter", 2) end
  if not ({page=true,spread=true,fixed=true})[out.variation] then error("florilegium: variation must be page, spread or fixed",2) end
  if not ({color=true,mono=true})[out.color_mode] then error("florilegium: color-mode must be color or mono",2) end
  if out.seed=="auto" then out.seed=false end
  if out.seed~=false then
    local n=tonumber(out.seed)
    if not n or n%1~=0 or n<0 or n>=2^31 then error("florilegium: seed must be auto or an integer from 0 to 2^31-1",2) end
    out.seed=n
  end
  for k, limits in pairs({ focal_count = {0,3}, focal_scale = {0.5,1.5}, asymmetry = {0,2}, number_scale = {0.5,1.25} }) do
    local n = tonumber(out[k])
    if not n or n ~= n or n < limits[1] or n > limits[2] or (k == "focal_count" and n % 1 ~= 0) then
      error("florilegium: invalid " .. k .. " (expected " .. limits[1] .. " to " .. limits[2] .. ")", 2)
    end
    out[k] = n
  end
  return out
end

return M

-- Adapted from K1o0n/florilegium, commit 72ebc0f (MIT).
-- numeral.lua -- the page number as stems (option pagenumber, grown only).
--
-- Each digit is one or two strokes through a few control points in a unit box
-- (height 1, baseline 0), written the way a plant would grow them: every
-- stroke starts at its root and ends free. The first stroke's root sits on the
-- baseline, where the digit grows out of the footer stem; a second stroke
-- (the tails of 3, 5, 9, the bowl of 6) starts at that same root. A free end
-- curls into a small spiral (spin +1 turns left, -1 right) or carries a leaflet.
-- grow.lua maps the unit box onto the page so that y = 0 follows the footer
-- stem, draws the strokes as tapered stems and keeps the digits clear.

local M = {}

local sqrt, cos, sin, atan, pi, max, min = math.sqrt, math.cos, math.sin, math.atan, math.pi, math.max, math.min

local TAIL = { { 0, 0 }, { -0.14, 0.03 }, { -0.22, 0.12 } }    -- relative to the root

M.glyphs.D = {w=0.65,strokes={{{0.04,0},{0.04,0.5},{0.04,1},leaf=true},{{0.04,0},{0.4,0.03},{0.64,0.3},{0.64,0.7},{0.4,0.97},{0.04,1}}}}
M.glyphs.M = {w=0.85,strokes={{{0.02,0},{0.02,0.5},{0.02,1},{0.42,0.35},{0.83,1},leaf=true},{{0.83,0},{0.83,0.5},{0.83,1},curl=-1}}}

function M.normalize(label)
  if type(label)~="string" or #label==0 or #label>16 then return nil end
  if label:match("^%d+$") then return #label<=6 and label or nil end
  if label:match("^[ivxlcdmIVXLCDM]+$") then return label:upper() end
  return nil
end

-- the width of a label in units of the height, or nil if it is not a number
function M.width(label)
  label=M.normalize(label)
  if not label then return nil end
  local w = 0
  for i = 1, #label do w = w + M.glyphs[label:sub(i, i)].w end
  return w + M.GAP * (#label - 1) + M.SLANT
end

-- a spiral that continues a polyline from its last point, turning left
-- (spin = 1) or right (-1) with radius r and the given number of turns
function M.curl(pts, spin, r, turns)
  local n = #pts
  local p, q = pts[n], pts[n - 1]
  local dx, dy = p[1] - q[1], p[2] - q[2]
  local L = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
  dx, dy = dx / L, dy / L
  local cx, cy = p[1] - spin * dy * r, p[2] + spin * dx * r
  local a0 = atan(p[2] - cy, p[1] - cx)
  local steps = 28
  for i = 1, steps do
    local u = i / steps
    local a = a0 + spin * u * turns * 2 * pi
    local rr = r * (1 - 0.82 * u) ^ 1.25
    pts[#pts + 1] = { cx + rr * cos(a), cy + rr * sin(a) }
  end
  return pts
end

return M

-- Versioned data contracts. Generators retain their own semantic structures.
-- Geometry algorithms, canonical recipes and renderers are separate stages.
local json = require("pattern_json")
local M = { VERSION = 1, TOLERANCE = 1e-9 }
local stored = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function fail(path, message) error("pattern: "..path..": "..message, 0) end
local function need(ok, path, message) if not ok then fail(path,message) end end
local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge end
local function id(v,p) need(type(v)=="string" and #v>0 and #v<=256,p,"expected a nonempty stable ID") end
local function seq(t,p)
  need(type(t)=="table",p,"expected an array")
  local data=stored[t] or t;local mt=getmetatable(data)
  need(not mt or mt.__jsontype~="object",p,"expected an array; use array() for an empty array")
  local n=#t; for k in pairs(t) do need(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=n,p,"expected a dense array") end
  for i=1,n do need(t[i]~=nil,p,"expected a dense array") end
  return t
end
local function numbers(t,n,p)
  seq(t,p);need(#t==n,p,"wrong coordinate count")
  for _,v in ipairs(t) do need(finite(v),p,"nonfinite coordinate") end
end
local function coordinates(v,n,p)
  if v.exact then
    need(v.point==nil,p,"point and exact coordinates cannot both be authoritative")
    local ok,err=pcall(require("pattern_exact").validate_point,v.exact,n)
    need(ok,p,"invalid exact coordinate: "..tostring(err))
  else numbers(v.point,n,p) end
end
local function bounds(t,p)
  numbers(t,4,p);need(t[3]>t[1] and t[4]>t[2],p,"expected positive bounds")
end
local function clone(v,seen,depth,count)
  local ty=type(v)
  if ty=="number" then
    need(finite(v),"data","nonfinite number")
    need(not math.type or math.type(v)~="integer" or (v>=-9007199254740991 and v<=9007199254740991),"data","integer exceeds portable exact range; use a string identity")
    return v
  elseif ty=="string" then
    need(utf8.len(v)~=nil,"data","invalid UTF-8; binary resources require explicit encoding")
    for _,cp in utf8.codes(v) do need(cp<=0x10ffff and (cp<0xd800 or cp>0xdfff),"data","invalid Unicode scalar value") end
    return v
  elseif ty=="boolean" or ty=="nil" then return v end
  need(ty=="table" and v~=json.null,"data","expected JSON data, without null/functions/userdata")
  v=stored[v] or v;seen=seen or {};depth=depth or 0;count=count or {n=0}
  need(not seen[v] and depth<64,"data","cyclic or excessively nested data")
  count.n=count.n+1;need(count.n<=100000,"data","data object budget exceeded")
  seen[v]=true
  local mt=getmetatable(v)
  need(mt==nil or (type(mt)=="table" and (mt.__jsontype=="array" or mt.__jsontype=="object")),"data","unsupported data metatable")
  if mt then for k in pairs(mt) do need(k=="__jsontype","data","executable/unknown data metatable field") end end
  local array=(mt and mt.__jsontype=="array") or (not mt and #v>0)
  if array then for i=1,#v do need(rawget(v,i)~=nil,"data","sparse array") end end
  local out=setmetatable({},{__jsontype=array and "array" or "object"})
  for k,x in pairs(v) do
    if array then need(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=#v,"data","sparse or mixed array")
    else need(type(k)=="string","data","object keys must be strings");clone(k) end
    out[k]=clone(x,seen,depth+1,count)
  end
  seen[v]=nil;return out
end
local function freeze(v)
  if type(v)~="table" then return v end
  local data={};for k,x in pairs(v) do data[k]=freeze(x) end
  setmetatable(data,getmetatable(v))
  local proxy={};stored[proxy]=data
  return setmetatable(proxy,{__index=data,__newindex=function() fail("instance","immutable snapshot; construct a new record") end,
    __pairs=function() return next,data,nil end,__len=function() return #data end,__metatable=false})
end
function M.array(t) return setmetatable(t or {},{__jsontype="array"}) end
function M.plain(t) return clone(t) end
function M.snapshot(t) return freeze(clone(t)) end
local headers={kind=true,schema_version=true,id=true,extensions=true}
local function fields(t,allowed,p)
  local known={};for k in pairs(headers) do known[k]=true end
  for k in allowed:gmatch("%S+") do known[k]=true end
  for k in pairs(t) do need(known[k],p,"unknown key '"..tostring(k).."'") end
end
local function header(t,kind)
  need(type(t)=="table",kind,"expected record")
  need(t.kind==kind,kind,"wrong record kind")
  need(t.schema_version==1,kind,"unsupported schema version; explicit migration required")
  id(t.id,kind..".id")
end
local function ref(r,target,p)
  need(type(r)=="table",p,"expected versioned reference")
  need(r.id==target.id and r.version==target.version,p,"reference does not match definition")
end
local function list_ids(t,p)
  local found={};for _,s in ipairs(seq(t,p)) do id(s,p);need(not found[s],p,"duplicate ID "..s);found[s]=true end
  return found
end
local semantics={graph=true,strands=true,tiling=true,growth=true,field=true,text=true,curve3d=true}
local function definition(d)
  header(d,"definition")
  fields(d,"version family capabilities parameters units transforms assumptions validation", "definition")
  id(d.version,"definition.version");id(d.family,"definition.family")
  local tags=list_ids(d.capabilities,"definition.capabilities");need(next(tags),"definition","at least one semantic capability required")

-- Beenker (1982), §§2.2–2.3 and 5.1–5.3. Use integer lifts and exact
-- Q(sqrt(2)) line decisions before calculating any drawing coordinates.
local P,H,G=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash"),require("pattern_geometry")
local M={VERSION="beenker-tetragrid-v1"}
local sqrt2=math.sqrt(2)
local half=sqrt2/2
local directions={{1,0},{half,half},{0,1},{-half,half}}
local profiles={
  offset={numerators={1,2,3,4},denominator=17,center={0,0,0,0}},
  centered={numerators={1,1,1,1},denominator=2,center={1,1,1,1}},
  ["zero-plus"]={numerators={0,0,0,0},denominator=1,center={0,0,0,0},direction={1,2,3,4}},
  ["zero-minus"]={numerators={0,0,0,0},denominator=1,center={0,0,0,0},direction={-1,-2,-3,-4}},
}
local function finite(x) return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<math.huge end
local function sign(x) return x<0 and -1 or x>0 and 1 or 0 end
local function algebraic_sign(a,b)
  local sa,sb=sign(a),sign(b)
  if sa==0 then return sb end
  if sb==0 or sa==sb then return sa end
  assert(math.abs(a)<2^29 and math.abs(b)<2^29,"beenker-algebraic-sign-budget")
  return sa*sign(a*a-2*b*b)
end

-- Twice the sine ratio, represented as a+b*sqrt(2).
local function sine_ratio(n,d)
  if n==0 then return 0,0 end
  local side=sign(n)*sign(d)
  if (math.abs(n)==2)==(math.abs(d)==2) then return 2*side,0 end
  return 0,side*(math.abs(n)==2 and 2 or 1)
end
local function coefficients(i,j,k)
  local a,b=sine_ratio(j-k,j-i)
  local c,d=sine_ratio(k-i,j-i)
  return a,b,c,d
end
local function residual(i,j,k,values)
  local a,b,c,d=coefficients(i,j,k)
  return 2*values[k]-a*values[i]-c*values[j],-b*values[i]-d*values[j]
end
local function phase_record(name)
  local phase=P.plain(assert(profiles[name],"beenker-phase"))
  phase.name=name
  phase.tie_policy=phase.direction and "coherent-positive-infinitesimal" or "regular-no-ties"
  phase.regularity=P.array()
  -- Each relation has exactly one grid index on the irrational side.
  -- A rational phase at that index must be integral for a triple tie.
  for _,triple in ipairs{{1,2,3,2},{1,2,4,1},{1,3,4,4},{2,3,4,3}} do
    local i,j,k,l=table.unpack(triple)
    local witness={families={i,j,k},irrational_side=l}
    if phase.direction then
      local a,b=residual(i,j,k,phase.direction)
      assert(algebraic_sign(a,b)~=0,"beenker-degenerate-perturbation")
      witness.perturbation={a,b}
    else
      witness.residue=phase.numerators[l]%phase.denominator
      assert(witness.residue~=0,"beenker-phase-not-regular")
    end
    phase.regularity[#phase.regularity+1]=witness
  end
  return phase
end

local function ceiling(a,b,d,phase,i,j,k)
  -- The float estimate only starts the search. Exact comparisons make
  -- the decision, including equality at a singular line.
  local c=math.ceil((a+b*sqrt2)/d)
  while algebraic_sign(a-(c-1)*d,b)<=0 do c=c-1 end
  while algebraic_sign(a-c*d,b)>0 do c=c+1 end
  if algebraic_sign(a-c*d,b)~=0 then return c end
  assert(phase.direction,"beenker-unexpected-tie")
  local u,v=residual(i,j,k,phase.direction)
  local side=algebraic_sign(u,v)
  assert(side~=0,"beenker-unresolved-tie")
  return c+(side>0 and 1 or 0),{family=k,line=c,residual={u,v},side=side}
end
local function shift(k,i,j)
  local out={table.unpack(k)}
  if i then out[i]=out[i]+1 end
  if j then out[j]=out[j]+1 end
  return out
end
local function exact_points(k,center)
  local a,b,c,d=k[1]-center[1],k[2]-center[2],k[3]-center[3],k[4]-center[4]
  return {{2*a,b-d},{2*c,b+d}},{{2*a,d-b},{-2*c,b+d}}
end
local function point(exact)
  return {(exact[1][1]+exact[1][2]*sqrt2)/2,(exact[2][1]+exact[2][2]*sqrt2)/2}
end
local function bounds(points)
  local x0,y0,x1,y1=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
  for _,p in ipairs(points) do
    x0,y0,x1,y1=math.min(x0,p[1]),math.min(y0,p[2]),math.max(x1,p[1]),math.max(y1,p[2])
  end

end
local function crossing(i,j,m,n,phase)
  local d,g=phase.denominator,phase.numerators
  local u,v=m*d-g[i],n*d-g[j]
  local base={[i]=m,[j]=n}
  local ties=P.array()
  for k=1,4 do
    if k~=i and k~=j then
      local a,b,c,e=coefficients(i,j,k)
      local lift,tie=ceiling(a*u+c*v+2*g[k],b*u+e*v,2*d,phase,i,j,k)
      base[k]=lift
      if tie then ties[#ties+1]=tie end
    end
  end
  local corners={base,shift(base,i),shift(base,i,j),shift(base,j)}
  local points={}
  for a,k in ipairs(corners) do points[a]=point(exact_points(k,phase.center)) end
  return {address={i,j,m,n},corners=corners,points=points,box=bounds(points),ties=ties,
    prototype=j-i==2 and "square" or "rhombus"}
end
local function key(k) return table.concat(k,"/") end
local function sorted_keys(t)
  local list={}
  for k in pairs(t) do list[#list+1]=k end
  table.sort(list,P.byte_less)
  return list
end
local function grow(b,h) return {b[1]-h,b[2]-h,b[3]+h,b[4]+h} end
local function intersects(a,b,e)
  return a[1]<=b[3]+e and a[3]+e>=b[1] and a[2]<=b[4]+e and a[4]+e>=b[2]
end
local function ranges(box,phase)
  -- f(z)=2z+sum((gamma+error-center)*u). With these profiles, each
  -- summand has norm <=1.5, so half the displacement is <=3.
  -- One extra unit on each side covers the integer line end bounds.
  local primal={box[1]/2-3,box[2]/2-3,box[3]/2+3,box[4]/2+3}
  local out={}
  for i,u in ipairs(directions) do
    local a,b=u[1]*primal[1],u[1]*primal[3]
    local c,d=u[2]*primal[2],u[2]*primal[4]
    local g=phase.numerators[i]/phase.denominator
    out[i]={math.floor(math.min(a,b)+math.min(c,d)+g)-1,
      math.ceil(math.max(a,b)+math.max(c,d)+g)+1}
  end
  return out
end
local function construct(request,context)
  local frame,step=request.frame,request.step_cm
  assert(frame.unit=="cm" and frame.dimension==2 and frame.handedness=="right","beenker-frame")
  assert(finite(step) and step>=.2 and step<=2,"beenker-edge-length")
  local origin=G.point(frame.origin)
  local query={}
  for i,v in ipairs(request.world_query) do
    query[i]=(v-origin[(i-1)%2+1])/step
    assert(finite(query[i]) and math.abs(query[i])<=64,"beenker-query-horizon")
  end
  assert(#query==4 and query[1]<query[3] and query[2]<query[4],"beenker-empty-query")
  local phase=phase_record(request.phase)
  local selected_box=grow(query,2)
  local wide_box=grow(selected_box,2)
  local limits=ranges(wide_box,phase)
  local epsilon=1e-10
  local prefix="beenker/"..H.value("beenker/frame",{frame=frame,step_cm=step,phase=phase,method=M.VERSION})
  local function vertex_id(k) return prefix.."/v/"..k end
  local function edge_id(k) return prefix.."/e/"..k end
  local function world(p) return {origin[1]+step*p[1],origin[2]+step*p[2]} end
  local cells,edges,vertices=P.array(),P.array(),P.array()
  local used,all_edges,visible_edges,visible_vertices={},{},{},{}
  local examined,wide_count,tie_count,positive_ties,negative_ties=0,0,0,0,0
  local counts={square=0,rhombus=0}
  for i=1,3 do for j=i+1,4 do
    local a,b=limits[i],limits[j]
    local work=(a[2]-a[1]+1)*(b[2]-b[1]+1)
    if context then context:consume("operations",work) end
    examined=examined+work
    for m=a[1],a[2] do for n=b[1],b[2] do
      local c=crossing(i,j,m,n,phase)
      if intersects(c.box,wide_box,epsilon) then
        wide_count=wide_count+1
        local id=prefix.."/cell/"..key(c.address)
        local keep=intersects(c.box,selected_box,epsilon)
        local boundary=P.array()
        local keys={}
        for k,lift in ipairs(c.corners) do keys[k]=key(lift) end
        local signature={table.unpack(keys)}
        table.sort(signature,P.byte_less)
        local geometry=table.concat(signature,"+")
        assert(not used[geometry],"beenker-duplicate-tile")
        used[geometry]=true
        for k,from in ipairs(keys) do
          local to=keys[k%4+1]
          local reversed=P.byte_less(to,from)
          local v,w=from,to
          if reversed then v,w=to,from end
          local ekey=v.."+"..w
          local edge=all_edges[ekey]
          if not edge then edge={from=v,to=w,uses={}};all_edges[ekey]=edge end
          assert(#edge.uses<2 and (#edge.uses==0 or edge.uses[1].reversed~=reversed),"beenker-edge-incidence")
          edge.uses[#edge.uses+1]={cell=id,reversed=reversed,visible=keep}
          if keep then
            if not visible_vertices[from] then
              local physical,internal=exact_points(c.corners[k],phase.center)
              visible_vertices[from]={id=vertex_id(from),point=world(c.points[k]),lift=c.corners[k],
                physical=physical,internal=internal}
            end
            visible_edges[ekey]=true
            boundary[k]={edge=edge_id(ekey),reversed=reversed}
          end
        end
        if keep then
          assert(#cells<1000,"beenker-cell-budget")
          local first,angle=1,45*(i-1)
          if j-i==3 then first,angle=2,45*(j-1) end
          cells[#cells+1]={id=id,prototype=c.prototype,chirality=1,address=c.address,base_lift=c.corners[1],
            boundary=boundary,ties=c.ties,
            isometry={rotation_degrees=angle,reflection=false,translation=world(c.points[first])}}
          counts[c.prototype]=counts[c.prototype]+1
          for _,tie in ipairs(c.ties) do
            tie_count=tie_count+1
            if tie.side>0 then positive_ties=positive_ties+1 else negative_ties=negative_ties+1 end
          end
        end
      end
    end end
  end end
  local interior,cuts=0,0
  for _,k in ipairs(sorted_keys(visible_edges)) do
    local edge=all_edges[k]
    assert(#edge.uses==2,"beenker-insufficient-neighbor-halo")
    local global,selected={},{}
    for _,use in ipairs(edge.uses) do
      global[#global+1]=use.cell
      if use.visible then selected[#selected+1]=use.cell end
    end
    table.sort(global,P.byte_less);table.sort(selected,P.byte_less)
    local inside=#selected==2
    if inside then interior=interior+1 else cuts=cuts+1 end
    edges[#edges+1]={id=edge_id(k),from=vertex_id(edge.from),to=vertex_id(edge.to),owner=selected[1],
      role=inside and "interior" or "patch_boundary",boundary_reason=inside and "none" or "query_cut",
      global_owner=global[1],global_cells=global}
  end
  for _,k in ipairs(sorted_keys(visible_vertices)) do vertices[#vertices+1]=visible_vertices[k] end
  assert(#cells>0,"beenker-empty-patch")
  if context then context:consume("objects",#cells+#edges+#vertices) end
  local certificate={method=M.VERSION,source="Beenker 1982, §§2.2–2.3 and 5.1–5.3",phase=phase,
    step_cm=step,frame=P.plain(frame),normalized_query=query,normalized_selection_box=selected_box,
    line_ranges=limits,query_horizon_edge_units=64,physical_internal_denominator=2,
    neighbor_patch_tiles=wide_count,candidate_crossings=examined,counts=counts,
    interior_seams=interior,query_cuts=cuts,ties={count=tie_count,positive=positive_ties,negative=negative_ties},
    checks={"exact algebraic grid decisions and coherent singular-limit ties",
      "integer lifts and complementary physical/internal coordinates",
      "canonical tile incidence with globally owned opposite seams",
      "bounded finite query with a reconstructed neighbor halo"}}
  return {prefix=prefix,tiling={vertices=vertices,edges=edges,cells=cells},certificate=certificate}
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="tiling/ammann-beenker",version="1",family="beenker-tetragrid",
    units="cm",capabilities={"tiling"},parameters={edge_length={type="number",minimum=.2,maximum=2,required=true},
      phase={type="string",enum={"offset","centered","zero-plus","zero-minus"}}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Fixed rational phase and physical frame",
      "A square and 45-degree rhombus from the exact source tetragrid",
      "Explicit coherent limits for singular zero phase, with finite coverage distinct from nonperiodicity"}})
end
local function routes()
  local registry=require("pattern_aperiodic").route_registry()
  registry.register("projection_multigrid",{construct=construct,validate=function(p)
    return #p.tiling.cells==p.certificate.counts.square+p.certificate.counts.rhombus
      and #p.certificate.phase.regularity==4
  end})
  return registry
end
local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.beenker
  local registry=routes()
  assert(e.route=="projection_multigrid" and P.serialize(e.request.frame)==P.serialize(x.frame),"beenker-frame-record")
  assert(P.serialize(e.capabilities)==P.serialize(registry.capabilities()),"beenker-route-certificate")
  local actual=registry.construct(e.route,P.plain(e.request))
  assert(P.serialize(actual.tiling)==P.serialize(x.structures.tiling),"beenker-lift-and-incidence-reconstruction")
  assert(P.serialize(actual.certificate)==P.serialize(e.certificate),"beenker-certificate-reconstruction")
  return {ok=true,checks=P.plain(e.certificate.checks),construction=P.plain(e.certificate)}
end
function M.validate(x) return validate(P.instance(P.plain(x),M.definition())) end
local colors={clean={square={.21,.38,.49},rhombus={.78,.57,.32}},
  diagnostic={square={.78,.86,.88},rhombus={.92,.78,.56}}}
local function lower(x,v,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="display","beenker-style:"..k) end
  local display=style.display or "clean"
  local fill=assert(colors[display],"beenker-display")
  local request=x.extensions.beenker.request
  local transform=P.plain(v.transform)
  local inverse=G.inverse(transform,G.policy("cm",request.step_cm))
  local crop=v.crop
  local box=request.world_query
  for _,corner in ipairs{{crop[1],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[4]},{crop[1],crop[4]}} do
    local p=G.transform(corner,inverse)
    assert(p[1]>=box[1]-1e-10 and p[1]<=box[3]+1e-10 and p[2]>=box[2]-1e-10
      and p[2]<=box[4]+1e-10,"beenker-view-outside-certified-query")
  end
  local world,page,edges={},{},{}
  local ops=P.array()
  for _,vertex in ipairs(x.structures.tiling.vertices) do
    world[vertex.id]=vertex.point;page[vertex.id]=G.transform(vertex.point,transform)
  end
  for _,e in ipairs(x.structures.tiling.edges) do edges[e.id]=e end
  for _,c in ipairs(x.structures.tiling.cells) do
    local commands,points={},{}
    for i,use in ipairs(c.boundary) do
      local edge=edges[use.edge]
      local id=use.reversed and edge.to or edge.from
      local p=world[id]
      commands[i]={i==1 and "M" or "L",p[1],p[2]}
      points[i]=page[id]
    end
    if intersects(bounds(points),crop,0) then
      commands[5]={"Z"}
      local color=fill[c.prototype]
      if display=="diagnostic" and #c.ties>0 then
        if #c.ties==2 then color={.64,.55,.69}
        elseif c.ties[1].side>0 then color={.53,.70,.60}
        else color={.82,.55,.46} end
      end
      ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=c.id,commands=commands,transform=transform,
        paint={fill=color}}
    end
  end
  local width=.012
  local pad=width*math.sqrt(transform[1]^2+transform[2]^2+transform[3]^2+transform[4]^2)
  for _,e in ipairs(x.structures.tiling.edges) do
    if intersects(bounds{page[e.from],page[e.to]},crop,pad) then
      local p,q=world[e.from],world[e.to]
      local stroke=display=="diagnostic" and e.role=="patch_boundary" and {.63,.19,.22} or {.12,.21,.28}
      ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=e.id,commands={{"M",p[1],p[2]},{"L",q[1],q[2]}},
        transform=transform,paint={stroke=stroke,stroke_width=width}}
    end
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
    clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)},operations=ops,resources=P.array()}
end
function M.register(registry)
  local d,r=M.definition(),routes()
  registry:register(d,{generate=function(s,context)
    local request={phase=s.parameters.phase or "offset",step_cm=s.parameters.edge_length,
      frame=P.plain(context.frame),world_query=P.plain(s.document.bounds)}
    local built=r.construct("projection_multigrid",request,context)
    return {id=built.prefix.."/query/"..H.value("beenker/query",request),definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},
      frame=P.plain(context.frame),structures={tiling=built.tiling},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={beenker={route="projection_multigrid",request=request,certificate=built.certificate,
        capabilities=P.plain(r.capabilities())}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end
return M
source.pattern_aperiodic.lua:
-- Finite aperiodic construction routes with an exact integer substitution fixture.
local P=require("pattern")
local H=require("pattern_hash")
local M={VERSION="finite-construction-v1"}
local routes={
  hierarchical_substitution="fixed root, local dissection, hierarchical addresses",
  projection_multigrid="basis, window/phase, certified finite enumeration",
  bounded_constraint="finite domain, hypotheses, solver and verification",
}
function M.route_registry()
  local providers={}
  return {
    register=function(name,provider)
      assert(routes[name] and not providers[name],"aperiodic-route-registration")
      assert(type(provider)=="table" and type(provider.construct)=="function" and type(provider.validate)=="function",
        "aperiodic-route-provider")
      providers[name]=provider
    end,
    construct=function(name,request,context)
      assert(routes[name],"aperiodic-unknown-route:"..tostring(name))
      local provider=assert(providers[name],"aperiodic-route-unimplemented:"..name)
      local result=provider.construct(request,context)
      assert(provider.validate(result,request)==true,"aperiodic-route-validation")
      return result
    end,
    capabilities=function()
      local out={}
      for name,contract in pairs(routes) do out[name]={contract=contract,implemented=providers[name]~=nil} end
      return P.snapshot(out)
    end,
  }
end

local occupied={{0,0},{1,0},{0,1}}
local outline={{0,0},{1,0},{2,0},{2,1},{1,1},{1,2},{0,2},{0,1}}
local labels={"foot-first","foot-second","right","inward-west","inward-north","crown","left-upper","left-lower"}
local children={
  {id="a",turn=0,offset={0,0}},
  {id="b",turn=0,offset={1,1}},
  {id="c",turn=1,offset={4,0}},
  {id="d",turn=3,offset={0,4}},
}
local function rotate(p,n)
  local x,y=p[1],p[2]
  if n==0 then return {x,y} end
  if n==1 then return {-y,x} end
  if n==2 then return {-x,-y} end
  if n==3 then return {y,-x} end
  error("aperiodic-invalid-rotation")
end
local function point_key(p) return p[1].."/"..p[2] end
local function edge_key(a,b)
  local u,v=point_key(a),point_key(b)
  if P.byte_less(v,u) then return v.."+"..u,true end
  return u.."+"..v,false
end
local function apply(t,p)
  local q=rotate(p,t.turn)
  return {t.offset[1]+t.scale*q[1],t.offset[2]+t.scale*q[2]}
end
local function rectangle(t,p)
  local a,b=apply(t,p),apply(t,{p[1]+1,p[2]+1})
  return {math.min(a[1],b[1]),math.min(a[2],b[2]),math.max(a[1],b[1]),math.max(a[2],b[2])}
end
local function child_transform(parent,spec)
  local s=parent.scale//2
  local p=rotate(spec.offset,parent.turn)
  return {offset={parent.offset[1]+p[1]*s,parent.offset[2]+p[2]*s},
    scale=s,turn=(parent.turn+spec.turn)%4,chirality=1}
end
local function intersects(a,b)
  return a[1]<b[3] and a[3]>b[1] and a[2]<b[4] and a[4]>b[2]
end
local function grid_coverage(t)
  local result={}
  for _,p in ipairs(occupied) do
    local box=rectangle(t,p)
    for x=box[1],box[3]-1 do for y=box[2],box[4]-1 do
      local key=point_key({x,y})
      assert(not result[key],"aperiodic-prototype-overlap")
      result[key]=true
    end end
  end
  return result
end
local function certify_rule()
  local root={offset={0,0},scale=2,turn=0,chirality=1}
  local expected=grid_coverage(root)
  for _,c in ipairs(children) do
    for key in pairs(grid_coverage(child_transform(root,c))) do
      assert(expected[key],"aperiodic-dissection-overlap-or-escape")
      expected[key]=nil
    end
  end
  assert(not next(expected),"aperiodic-dissection-gap")
end
certify_rule()

function M.prototype()
  return P.snapshot({id="chair/unit",integer_unit_squares=occupied,outline=outline,edge_labels=labels,
    allowed_isometries={quarter_turns={0,1,2,3},translation="integer lattice",reflection=false},
    matching={kind="geometry",class="unit-edge",opposite_directions=true,labels_force_substitution=false}})
end
function M.rule()
  return P.snapshot({id="chair/substitution-v1",expansion=2,children=children,
    certificate="exact 12-unit-square partition of the inflated prototype"})
end

local function sorted_keys(t)
  local out={}
  for key in pairs(t) do out[#out+1]=key end
  table.sort(out,P.byte_less)
  return out
end
local function finite(x) return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<math.huge end
local function valid_query(box,s)
  assert(#box==4,"aperiodic-query-box")
  for _,x in ipairs(box) do assert(finite(x),"aperiodic-query-coordinate") end
  assert(box[1]<box[3] and box[2]<box[4],"aperiodic-query-box")
  assert(box[1]>=0 and box[2]>=0 and box[3]<=2*s and box[4]<=2*s
    and (box[3]<=s or box[4]<=s),"aperiodic-outside-finite-horizon")
end
local function generate_root(depth,context)
  local leaves,nodes,physical_edges,coverage={},{},{},{}
  local root={offset={0,0},scale=2^depth,turn=0,chirality=1}
  root.scale=math.floor(root.scale)
  local function visit(t,address,level,parent)
    if context then context:consume("objects",1) end
    if level>0 then
      local node={transform=t,address=address,level=level,parent=parent,children={}}
      nodes[address]=node
      for _,c in ipairs(children) do
        local id=address..c.id
        node.children[#node.children+1]=id
        visit(child_transform(t,c),id,level-1,address)
      end
    else
      local leaf={address=address,parent=parent,transform=t,segments={},squares={}}
      leaves[#leaves+1]=leaf
      for _,p in ipairs(occupied) do
        local box=rectangle(t,p)
        local key=point_key({box[1],box[2]})
        assert(not coverage[key],"aperiodic-duplicate-or-overlap")
        coverage[key]=address
        leaf.squares[#leaf.squares+1]=box
      end
      for i,p in ipairs(outline) do
        local a,b=apply(t,p),apply(t,outline[i%#outline+1])
        local key,reversed=edge_key(a,b)
        if not physical_edges[key] then physical_edges[key]={from=reversed and b or a,to=reversed and a or b,uses={}} end
        local e=physical_edges[key]
        assert(#e.uses<2 and (#e.uses==0 or e.uses[1].reversed~=reversed),"aperiodic-global-seam-incidence")
        e.uses[#e.uses+1]={address=address,reversed=reversed}
        leaf.segments[i]={key=key,reversed=reversed,label=labels[i]}
      end
    end
  end
  visit(root,"r",depth)
  local expected=grid_coverage(root)
  local count=0
  for key in pairs(coverage) do assert(expected[key],"aperiodic-cell-outside-horizon");expected[key]=nil;count=count+1 end
  assert(not next(expected),"aperiodic-uncovered-root")
  return leaves,nodes,physical_edges,count
end

local function generate_patch(request,context)
  local depth,step,halo=request.depth,request.step_cm,request.halo
  assert(type(depth)=="number" and depth%1==0 and depth>=1 and depth<=4,"aperiodic-depth")
  assert(finite(step) and step>=.125 and step<=4,"aperiodic-leaf-step")
  assert(type(halo)=="number" and halo%1==0 and halo>=3 and halo<=8,"aperiodic-halo-below-leaf-diameter")
  local frame=request.frame
  local origin=frame.origin
  assert(frame.unit=="cm" and frame.dimension==2 and frame.handedness=="right"
    and finite(origin[1]) and finite(origin[2]) and math.abs(origin[1])<=1000 and math.abs(origin[2])<=1000,"aperiodic-frame")
  local side=math.floor(2^depth)
  local box=request.world_query
  local query={}
  for i,v in ipairs(box) do query[i]=(v-origin[(i-1)%2+1])/step end
  local expanded
  if not request.whole_root then
    valid_query(query,side)
    expanded={query[1]-halo,query[2]-halo,query[3]+halo,query[4]+halo}
  end
  local prefix="chair/"..H.value("chair/fixed-root",{frame=frame,depth=depth,step_cm=step,rule=M.rule().id})
  local function tile(address) return prefix.."/tile/"..address end
  local function parent(address) return prefix.."/supertile/"..address end
  local function vertex_id(point) return prefix.."/v/"..point_key(point) end
  local function world(p) return {origin[1]+step*p[1],origin[2]+step*p[2]} end
  local full,all_nodes,global_edges,coverage_count=generate_root(depth,context)
  local selected,selected_nodes={},{}
  local cells,edges,vertices,hierarchy=P.array(),P.array(),P.array(),P.array()
  local keep_edges,keep_vertices={},{}
  local function touch(leaf,b)
    if not b then return true end
    for _,s in ipairs(leaf.squares) do if intersects(s,b) then return true end end
    return false
  end
  local visible=0
  for _,leaf in ipairs(full) do
    if touch(leaf,query) then visible=visible+1 end
    if touch(leaf,expanded) then
      selected[leaf.address]=true
      local a=leaf.parent
      while a do selected_nodes[a]=true;a=all_nodes[a].parent end
      local boundary=P.array()
      for _,use in ipairs(leaf.segments) do
        keep_edges[use.key]=true
        boundary[#boundary+1]={edge=prefix.."/e/"..use.key,reversed=use.reversed,label=use.label}
      end
      local t=leaf.transform
      cells[#cells+1]={id=tile(leaf.address),address=leaf.address,prototype="chair/unit",chirality=1,
        parent=parent(leaf.parent),boundary=boundary,
        isometry={rotation_degrees=90*t.turn,reflection=false,translation=world(t.offset)},
        exact_transform=t,squares=leaf.squares}
    end
  end
  assert(#cells>0,"aperiodic-empty-query")
  for _,key in ipairs(sorted_keys(keep_edges)) do
    local e=global_edges[key]
    local neighbors,found=P.array(),{}
    for _,use in ipairs(e.uses) do
      neighbors[#neighbors+1]=tile(use.address)
      if selected[use.address] then found[#found+1]=tile(use.address) end
    end
    table.sort(neighbors,P.byte_less);table.sort(found,P.byte_less)
    local a,b=vertex_id(e.from),vertex_id(e.to)
    keep_vertices[a],keep_vertices[b]=e.from,e.to
    edges[#edges+1]={id=prefix.."/e/"..key,from=a,to=b,owner=found[1],
      role=#found==2 and "interior" or "patch_boundary",
      global_owner=neighbors[1],global_cells=neighbors,matching_class="unit-edge",
      boundary_reason=#found==2 and "none" or (#neighbors==1 and "root_boundary" or "query_cut")}
  end
  for _,id in ipairs(sorted_keys(keep_vertices)) do
    local v=keep_vertices[id]
    vertices[#vertices+1]={id=id,point=world(v),lattice=v}
  end
  for _,address in ipairs(sorted_keys(selected_nodes)) do
    local n=all_nodes[address]
    local members,complete=P.array(),P.array()
    for _,id in ipairs(n.children) do
      local ref=n.level==1 and tile(id) or parent(id)
      complete[#complete+1]=ref
      if selected[id] or selected_nodes[id] then members[#members+1]=ref end
    end
    hierarchy[#hierarchy+1]={id=parent(address),address=address,level=n.level,children=members,substitution_children=complete,
      parent=n.parent and parent(n.parent) or nil,prototype="chair/unit",exact_transform=n.transform}
  end
  if context then
    context:consume("objects",#cells+#vertices+#edges+#hierarchy)
    context:consume("operations",#full*12+#edges)
  end
  local certificate={source="L-triomino substitution",rule=M.rule().id,finite=true,globally_queryable=false,
    depth=depth,root=parent("r"),step_cm=step,world_origin=P.plain(origin),lattice_horizon={{0,0,2*side,side},{0,side,side,2*side}},
    query=query,whole_root=request.whole_root,halo_lattice_units=halo,root_leaf_count=#full,
    root_unit_square_count=coverage_count,selected_leaf_count=#cells,query_leaf_count=visible,
    hypotheses={"right handed metric frame","fixed root","unit edge coincidence","orientation-preserving quarter turns"},
    checks={"exact inflated dissection","root occupancy coverage and no overlap","global seam incidence",
      "stable address and directed boundaries","ancestral closure","query contained in finite horizon"}}
  return {prefix=prefix,tiling={vertices=vertices,edges=edges,cells=cells,hierarchy=hierarchy},certificate=certificate}
end

local function engine()
  local r=M.route_registry()
  r.register("hierarchical_substitution",{construct=generate_patch,validate=function(p)
    return #p.tiling.cells==p.certificate.selected_leaf_count and p.certificate.root_unit_square_count==3*4^p.certificate.depth
  end})
  return r
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="tiling/finite-substitution",version="1",family="finite-aperiodic-construction",
    units="cm",capabilities={"tiling"},parameters={
      root_depth={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=4,required=true},
      leaf_step={type="number",minimum=.125,maximum=4,required=true},
      halo={type="integer",minimum=3,maximum=8},
      whole_root={type="boolean"},
      route={type="string",enum={"hierarchical_substitution","projection_multigrid","bounded_constraint"}}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Finite chair substitution fixture, no globally queryable claim",
      "Immutable root and integer leaf addresses with complete directed boundaries",
      "Projection/multigrid and bounded constraint routes require a registered provider"}})
end

local function audit_instance(tiling,request)
  local vertices,coverage,ancestors={},{},{}
  local origin,step=request.frame.origin,request.step_cm
  for _,v in ipairs(tiling.vertices) do
    local a=v.lattice
    assert(a[1]%1==0 and a[2]%1==0 and
      v.point[1]==origin[1]+step*a[1] and v.point[2]==origin[2]+step*a[2],"aperiodic-seam-coordinate")
    vertices[v.id]=a
  end
  for _,e in ipairs(tiling.edges) do
    local a,b=vertices[e.from],vertices[e.to]
    assert(math.abs(a[1]-b[1])+math.abs(a[2]-b[2])==1,"aperiodic-nonunit-seam")
  end
  for _,n in ipairs(tiling.hierarchy) do
    assert(#n.substitution_children==4 and n.exact_transform.chirality==1,"aperiodic-parent-child-certificate")
    for _,id in ipairs(n.children) do ancestors[id]=n.id end
  end
  for _,cell in ipairs(tiling.cells) do
    local t=cell.exact_transform
    assert(cell.chirality==1 and t.chirality==1 and cell.isometry.reflection==false
      and t.turn%1==0 and t.turn>=0 and t.turn<4 and cell.isometry.rotation_degrees==t.turn*90,
      "aperiodic-reflection-or-isometry")
    assert(cell.parent==ancestors[cell.id],"aperiodic-parent-child-certificate")
    assert(#cell.squares==3,"aperiodic-prototype-area")
    for _,s in ipairs(cell.squares) do
      local id=point_key({s[1],s[2]})
      assert(not coverage[id],"aperiodic-duplicate-or-overlap")
      coverage[id]=true
    end
  end
  for _,n in ipairs(tiling.hierarchy) do
    assert(n.parent==ancestors[n.id],"aperiodic-parent-child-certificate")
  end
end

local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.substitution
  audit_instance(x.structures.tiling,e.request)
  local providers=engine()
  assert(P.serialize(e.prototype)==P.serialize(M.prototype()) and P.serialize(e.rule)==P.serialize(M.rule())
    and P.serialize(e.capabilities)==P.serialize(providers.capabilities()),"aperiodic-prototype-or-route-certificate")
  local reconstructed=providers.construct(e.route,P.plain(e.request))
  assert(P.serialize(reconstructed.tiling)==P.serialize(x.structures.tiling),"aperiodic-structure-reconstruction")
  assert(P.serialize(reconstructed.certificate)==P.serialize(e.certificate),"aperiodic-certificate-reconstruction")
  assert(P.serialize(x.frame)==P.serialize(e.request.frame),"aperiodic-request-frame")
  return {ok=true,checks=P.plain(e.certificate.checks),construction=P.plain(e.certificate)}
end
function M.validate(x)
  return validate(P.instance(P.plain(x),M.definition()))
end

local palette={{.26,.49,.65},{.86,.68,.32},{.28,.57,.55},{.67,.42,.38}}
local function lower(instance,view,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="stroke_width" or k=="stroke","aperiodic-style:"..k) end
  local width=style.stroke_width or .016
  assert(finite(width) and width>0 and width<.2,"aperiodic-stroke-width")
  local G=require("pattern_geometry")
  local t=instance.structures.tiling
  local vertices,projected,edges,operations={},{},{},{}
  local matrix=P.plain(view.transform)
  local crop=view.crop
  local request=instance.extensions.substitution.request
  if not request.whole_root then
    local inv=G.inverse(matrix,G.policy("cm",request.step_cm))
    local q=request.world_query
    for _,corner in ipairs{{crop[1],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[4]},{crop[1],crop[4]}} do
      local p=G.transform(corner,inv)
      assert(p[1]>=q[1]-1e-10 and p[1]<=q[3]+1e-10 and p[2]>=q[2]-1e-10 and p[2]<=q[4]+1e-10,
        "aperiodic-view-outside-certified-query")
    end
  end

    vertices[v.id]=v.point;projected[v.id]=G.transform(v.point,matrix)
  end
  for _,e in ipairs(t.edges) do edges[e.id]=e end
  local function visible(box,pad)
    return box[1]-pad<=crop[3] and box[3]+pad>=crop[1] and box[2]-pad<=crop[4] and box[4]+pad>=crop[2]
  end
  for _,cell in ipairs(t.cells) do
    local commands={}
    local box={math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge}
    for i,use in ipairs(cell.boundary) do
      local e=edges[use.edge]
      local id=use.reversed and e.to or e.from
      local a,b=vertices[id],projected[id]
      commands[i]={i==1 and "M" or "L",a[1],a[2]}
      box[1],box[2]=math.min(box[1],b[1]),math.min(box[2],b[2])
      box[3],box[4]=math.max(box[3],b[1]),math.max(box[4],b[2])
    end
    if visible(box,0) then
      commands[#commands+1]={"Z"}
      operations[#operations+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=cell.id,commands=commands,transform=matrix,
        paint={fill=palette[cell.exact_transform.turn+1]}}
    end
  end
  local pad=width*math.sqrt(matrix[1]^2+matrix[2]^2+matrix[3]^2+matrix[4]^2)
  for _,e in ipairs(t.edges) do
    local a,b=projected[e.from],projected[e.to]
    if visible({math.min(a[1],b[1]),math.min(a[2],b[2]),math.max(a[1],b[1]),math.max(a[2],b[2])},pad) then
      local p,q=vertices[e.from],vertices[e.to]
      operations[#operations+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=e.id,commands={{"M",p[1],p[2]},{"L",q[1],q[2]}},
        transform=matrix,paint={stroke=style.stroke or {.08,.13,.23},stroke_width=width}}
    end
  end
  return {id=instance.id.."/scene",instance_ref=instance.id,view_ref=view.id,unit="cm",validity=view.validity,
    clip={bounds=P.plain(view.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(view.protected_regions)},operations=operations,resources=P.array()}
end

function M.register(registry)
  local d=M.definition()
  local providers=engine()
  registry:register(d,{generate=function(s,context)
    local a=s.parameters
    local route=a.route or "hierarchical_substitution"
    local request={depth=a.root_depth,step_cm=a.leaf_step,halo=a.halo or 3,frame=P.plain(context.frame),
      world_query=P.plain(s.document.bounds),whole_root=a.whole_root or false}
    local p=providers.construct(route,request,context)
    return {id=p.prefix.."/query/"..H.value("chair/finite-query",request),definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},
      frame=P.plain(context.frame),structures={tiling=p.tiling},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={substitution={route=route,request=request,certificate=p.certificate,
        capabilities=P.plain(providers.capabilities()),prototype=P.plain(M.prototype()),rule=P.plain(M.rule())}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end

return M

-- Host-only immutable binary output, separate from portable byte serializers.
-- Visibility is atomic on the host filesystem; no power-loss durability claim.
local H=require("pattern_hash")
local M={}
local function read(path)local f=io.open(path,"rb");if not f then return nil end;local s=assert(f:read("*a"));assert(f:close());return s end
function M.write(path,bytes)
  assert(type(path)=="string" and type(bytes)=="string" and #bytes<=32*1024*1024,"bounded artifact bytes required")
  local lfs=require("lfs");local lock=path..".lock";assert(lfs.mkdir(lock),"artifact busy: "..path)
  local temp=path..".pending"
  local ok,result=pcall(function()
    local existing=read(path)
    if existing then assert(existing==bytes,"immutable artifact differs: "..path);return H.sha256(bytes)end
    assert(not read(temp),"unfinished artifact requires investigation: "..temp)
    local f=assert(io.open(temp,"wb"));assert(f:write(bytes));assert(f:close());assert(read(temp)==bytes,"artifact write verification failed")
    assert(not read(path),"artifact appeared during owned write");assert(os.rename(temp,path));assert(read(path)==bytes,"artifact publication verification failed")
    return H.sha256(bytes)
  end)
  assert(lfs.rmdir(lock),"artifact lock cleanup failed")
  assert(ok,result);return result
end
return M

-- Incremental observation of the actual authored/grown algorithms. No altered
-- random draws, placement rules or inferred universal attachment guarantees.
local P,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash")
local M={VERSION="legacy-botanical-capture-v1"}
local active=false
local validate_recording
local engines={}
local function engine(mode)
  if not engines[mode]then engines[mode]=require(mode=="grown"and"grow"or"authored").page end
  return engines[mode]
end
local names={"flower","lily","blossom","floret","bud","bell","leaf","leaflet","stem","cyme","sprig","umbel","seedhead","tendril","sparkle","rosette","hedera","butterfly","bee","snail","bird","divider","petal"}

    local a,b=stem.points[i-1],stem.points[i];local dx,dy=b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2];local q=dx*dx+dy*dy
    local u=q>0 and math.max(0,math.min(1,((p[1]-a[1])*dx+(p[2]-a[2])*dy)/q))or 0
    local x,y=a[1]+u*dx,a[2]+u*dy;local distance=math.sqrt((p[1]-x)^2+(p[2]-y)^2)

end
function M.definition(mode)

    transforms={metric_constrained=false,reflection=true,uniform_scale=true},assumptions={"Actual existing composition; preserved quantized watercolor recording","Nested procedure dependencies are distinct from measured stem attachments","Unattached decorations and failed legacy routes are not certified connected"}})
end
-- g is the actual canonical host geometry/settings packet. The document adapter
-- owns physical origin/parity conversion; never silently derive a second origin.
function M.capture(mode,g,style,context,metadata_only)

  local d=M.definition(mode);g=P.plain(g);style=P.plain(style or {})
  for key in pairs(style)do assert(key=="ink"or key=="accent"or key=="lift"or key=="color_mode","unsupported legacy paint option "..key)end

    return c

  local stems,stack,counts,originals={},{"composition"},{},{}
  local function current()return stack[#stack]end
  local function observe(name,fn)
    return function(...)
      if context then context:consume("objects",1);context:consume("operations",1)end
      counts[name]=(counts[name]or 0)+1;local id="primitive/"..name.."/"..counts[name];local point=copy_point(ink,{0,0})
      local args={...};local points
      if name=="stem"and type(args[1])=="table"then
        points={};for _,p in ipairs(args[1])do points[#points+1]=copy_point(ink,p)end
        assert(#points>=2,"legacy stem must have sampled geometry");point=points[1]
      end

      local n={id=id,point=point,parent=attachment and attachment.parent or parent,motif=name,procedure_parent=parent,
        relationship=attachment and"measured-stem-attachment"or(parent=="composition"and"composition-member"or"nested-procedure")}

      if points then n.sampled_points=points end

      return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)

  end

  for _,name in ipairs(names)do if type(flora[name])=="function"then originals[name]=flora[name];flora[name]=observe(name,flora[name])end end
  local stats
  local ok,operations,receipt=pcall(ink.capture,function()
    local rgb=color(style.ink or{0x24/255,0x56/255,0xC4/255});ink.set_ink(table.unpack(rgb))
    rgb=color(style.accent or{0xB4/255,0x66/255,0x2F/255});ink.set_accent(table.unpack(rgb))
    assert(style.lift==nil or type(style.lift)=="number"and style.lift>=0 and style.lift<=1,"invalid lift")
    ink.set_lift(style.lift or 0);ink.set_color_mode(style.color_mode or "color")
    stats=draw(g)
  end,{semantic_ref=current})
  for name,fn in pairs(originals)do flora[name]=fn end;active=false
  if not ok then error(operations,0)end
  local painted={};for _,op in ipairs(operations)do if op.op=="path"then painted[op.semantic_ref]=(painted[op.semantic_ref]or 0)+1 end end
  for _,n in ipairs(nodes)do n.surviving_paint_paths=painted[n.id]or 0;n.observation_scope="actual invoked procedure; zero surviving paths may reflect LOD or reservation rejection"end
  -- Keep the existing per-record object guard. Large watercolor recordings are
  -- stored as independently bounded/hash-verified JSON blocks, not one enormous
  -- nested object graph in the semantic instance.
  assert(#operations<=100000,"legacy recording exceeds100000 drawing operations")
  local chunks=not metadata_only and {} or nil
  if chunks then for first=1,#operations,32 do
    local part={};for i=first,math.min(first+31,#operations)do part[#part+1]=operations[i]end
    local bytes=P.serialize(part);assert(#bytes<=2*1024*1024,"one legacy recording block exceeds bounded JSON profile")
    chunks[#chunks+1]={content=bytes,sha256=H.sha256(bytes),count=#part}
  end end
  local x=P.instance({id=d.id.."/instance/"..H.value("botanical/legacy-input",{geometry=g,style=style}),definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},
    frame=context and P.plain(context.frame)or{id="botanical/world",unit="cm",dimension=2,handedness="right",origin={0,0}},
    structures={growth={nodes=nodes,roots={"composition"}}},provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=g.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
    extensions={legacy={geometry=g,style=style,stats=stats or{},primitive_counts=counts,chunks=chunks,capture=receipt,
      recording_scope=metadata_only and "native host observation; paint emitted by the original sink" or "complete neutral recording",
      attachment_scope="existing sampled stem segments within1e-9cm; otherwise dependency grouping only",paint_scope="frozen original watercolor recording; no arbitrary repaint inference"}}},d)
  return x,d,validate_recording(x,operations)
end
function M.operations(instance)
  local legacy=instance.extensions.legacy;local operations={}
  assert(legacy.chunks,"native observation has no paint blocks; request complete capture to replay vector paint")
  assert(#legacy.chunks<=3125,"legacy block count exceeds recording profile")
  for _,block in ipairs(legacy.chunks)do
    assert(H.sha256(block.content)==block.sha256,"legacy recording block digest mismatch")
    local part=require("pattern_parse").decode(block.content);assert(#part==block.count and #part<=32,"legacy recording block count mismatch")
    for _,op in ipairs(part)do operations[#operations+1]=op end
  end
  assert(#operations==legacy.capture.count,"legacy recording total count mismatch")
  return operations
end
function M.encode_bundle(instance)
  local data=P.plain(instance);local blocks={}
  for _,block in ipairs(assert(data.extensions.legacy.chunks,"bundle requires complete neutral capture"))do
    assert(H.sha256(block.content)==block.sha256,"legacy recording block digest mismatch")
    blocks[block.sha256]=block.content;block.bytes=#block.content;block.content=nil
  end
  local manifest=P.serialize(data);assert(#manifest<=2*1024*1024,"legacy semantic manifest exceeds bounded JSON profile")
  return manifest,blocks
end
function M.decode_bundle(manifest,provider,definition)
  assert(type(provider)=="function","verified legacy recording block provider required")
  local data=require("pattern_parse").decode(manifest)
  local chunks=data.extensions.legacy.chunks;assert(#chunks<=3125,"legacy block count exceeds profile")
  for _,block in ipairs(chunks)do
    assert(block.content==nil and H.is_digest(block.sha256)and block.bytes>0 and block.bytes<=2*1024*1024,"invalid legacy bundle block reference")
    local bytes=provider(block.sha256);assert(type(bytes)=="string"and #bytes==block.bytes and H.sha256(bytes)==block.sha256,"missing or modified legacy bundle block")
    block.content=bytes;block.bytes=nil
  end
  local instance=P.instance(data,definition);M.validate(instance,definition);return instance
end
function M.lower(instance,view,definition)
  local x=P.instance(P.plain(instance),definition);local v=P.view(P.plain(view),x,definition)
  local raw=M.operations(x);local m=P.plain(v.transform)
  local ops,resources,clips,paths,boxes=P.array(),P.array(),{},{},{};local owner
  local Bounds,policy=require("pattern_bounds"),require("pattern_geometry").policy("cm",64)
  local function flush()
    if #paths==0 then return end
    local asset_ops={};for _,clip in ipairs(clips)do asset_ops[#asset_ops+1]=clip end
    for _,p in ipairs(paths)do asset_ops[#asset_ops+1]=p end
    for _=1,#clips do asset_ops[#asset_ops+1]={op="pop_clip"}end
    local bounds=Bounds.union(boxes,"cm");local id="legacy-paint/"..(#resources+1)
    local content=P.serialize({kind="vector_asset",schema_version=1,unit="cm",operations=asset_ops})
    assert(#content<=2*1024*1024,"legacy paint asset block exceeds bounded JSON profile")
    resources[#resources+1]={id=id,kind="symbol",unit="cm",bounds=P.plain(bounds.bounds),variants={scene={encoding="utf8",content=content,sha256=H.sha256(content)}}}
    ops[#ops+1]={op="symbol",semantic_ref=owner,resource_ref=id,transform=m}
    paths,boxes={},{}
  end
  for _,op in ipairs(raw)do
    if op.op=="push_clip"then flush();clips[#clips+1]=op
    elseif op.op=="pop_clip"then flush();assert(table.remove(clips),"legacy recording clip underflow")
    elseif op.op=="path"then
      if owner~=op.semantic_ref or #paths==24 then flush();owner=op.semantic_ref end
      paths[#paths+1]=op;boxes[#boxes+1]=Bounds.path(op.commands,op.paint,op.transform,policy)
    else error("unsupported legacy recording operation")end
  end
  flush();assert(#clips==0,"legacy recording clip imbalance")
  return P.scene({id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
    clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)},operations=ops,resources=resources,extensions={render_profile="segmented-ops-v1"}},x,v,definition)
end
validate_recording=function(x,operations)
  local nodes,painted={},{}
  for _,n in ipairs(x.structures.growth.nodes)do nodes[n.id]=n end
  for _,op in ipairs(operations)do if op.op=="path"then
    assert(nodes[op.semantic_ref],"legacy paint references an absent primitive");painted[op.semantic_ref]=(painted[op.semantic_ref]or 0)+1
  end end

  for _,n in ipairs(x.structures.growth.nodes)do
    assert(n.surviving_paint_paths==(painted[n.id]or 0),"surviving paint count mismatch")

      local a=n.attachment;local parent=assert(nodes[a.parent],"missing attached stem")
      assert(n.parent==parent.id and parent.sampled_points,"attachment parent is not its recorded stem")
      assert(a.tolerance_cm==1e-9 and a.parameter>=0 and a.parameter<=1,"invalid attachment tolerance/parameter")
      local p,q=parent.sampled_points[a.segment],parent.sampled_points[a.segment+1];assert(p and q,"invalid attachment segment")
      local dx,dy=p[1]+a.parameter*(q[1]-p[1])-n.point[1],p[2]+a.parameter*(q[2]-p[2])-n.point[2]
      assert(math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)<=1e-9,"attachment is geometrically disconnected")

  return {ok=true,attachments=attachments,checks={"actual primitive IDs and surviving paint references","sampled stem attachment segment/parameter residual <=1e-9cm","composition dependencies distinguished from verified physical attachment"}}
end
function M.validate(instance,definition)
  local x=P.instance(P.plain(instance),definition)

end
function M.register(registry,mode)
  local d=M.definition(mode)
  registry:register(d,{

-- Named independent adaptation of Wong/Zongker/Salesin1998 sections3.2,4.1,4.2.
-- A bounded grid approximates empty-circle selection; no MAT reproduction claim.
local P,G,N,B,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_geometry"),require("pattern_predicates"),require("pattern_bounds"),require("pattern_hash")
local M={VERSION="asymmetric-garden-v1"}
local function distance(a,b)return math.sqrt((a[1]-b[1])^2+(a[2]-b[2])^2)end
local function clearance(p,polygon)
  local best=math.huge
  for i,a in ipairs(polygon)do local b=polygon[i%#polygon+1];local dx,dy=b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2]
    best=math.min(best,(dx*(p[2]-a[2])-dy*(p[1]-a[1]))/math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy))
  end
  return best
end
local function corners(b)return{{b[1],b[2]},{b[3],b[2]},{b[3],b[4]},{b[1],b[4]}}end

local function admitted(box,polygon,masks)
  for _,p in ipairs(corners(box))do if clearance(p,polygon)<=1e-8 then return false end end
  for _,r in ipairs(masks)do if overlap(box,r.bounds)then return false end end
  return true
end
local function region(s)
  assert(next(P.plain(s.inputs))==nil,"panel takes no opaque external inputs")
  for key in pairs(s.constraints)do assert(key=="region","unsupported panel constraint "..key)end
  local r=assert(s.constraints.region,"explicit nonrectangular region required")
  for key in pairs(r)do assert(key=="unit"or key=="points","unsupported region field")end
  assert(r.unit=="cm"and #r.points>=3 and #r.points<=16,"convex region needs3..16 points in cm")
  local polygon=P.plain(r.points)
  for _,p in ipairs(polygon)do G.point(p);assert(p[1]>=s.document.bounds[1]and p[2]>=s.document.bounds[2]and p[1]<=s.document.bounds[3]and p[2]<=s.document.bounds[4],"region exceeds declared document generation area")end
  for i,a in ipairs(polygon)do local b,c=polygon[i%#polygon+1],polygon[(i+1)%#polygon+1]
    assert(N.orient2d(a,b,c)>0,"only strictly convex CCW botanical regions are supported")

  end

end
local function asset(id,fn,context)
  local ink=require("ink")
  local ops,receipt=ink.capture(function()
    ink.set_ink(0x24/255,0x56/255,0xC4/255);ink.set_accent(0xB4/255,0x66/255,0x2F/255);ink.set_lift(0);ink.set_color_mode("color");fn(ink)
  end)

end

  assert(root and clearance(root,polygon)>0.15,"root anchor must lie inside the actual convex panel")

  local cells={};local bounds=s.document.bounds;local step=0.4

  for iy=math.floor(bounds[2]/step),math.ceil(bounds[4]/step)-1 do for ix=math.floor(bounds[1]/step),math.ceil(bounds[3]/step)-1 do
    local p={(ix+0.5)*step,(iy+0.5)*step};if clearance(p,polygon)>0 then cells[#cells+1]={point=p,id=ix.."/"..iy}end

      c:consume("operations",1);local p=cell.point;local free=clearance(p,polygon)
      for _,r in ipairs(masks)do local b=r.bounds;local dx=math.max(b[1]-p[1],0,p[1]-b[3]);local dy=math.max(b[2]-p[2],0,p[2]-b[4]);free=math.min(free,math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy))end

    local samples=require("ink").sample(curve,24)

    if ok then
      accepted=accepted+1;c:consume("objects",2)
      local branch_id=id.."/branch";nodes[#nodes+1]={id=branch_id,parent=parent.id,point=P.plain(a),motif="stem",controls=controls,sampled_points=samples,direction={dx,dy},attachment={point=P.plain(a),parent=parent.id}}
      local node={id=id,parent=branch_id,point=P.plain(p),motif=kind,direction={dx,dy},attachment={point=P.plain(p),parent=branch_id}}
      nodes[#nodes+1]=node;tips[#tips+1]=node;proxies[#proxies+1]={semantic_ref=id,center=P.plain(p),radius=radius}
      resources[#resources+1]=branch;resources[#resources+1]=motif
      placements[#placements+1]={semantic_ref=branch_id,resource_ref=branch.id,transform={1,0,0,1,0,0},bounds=P.plain(branch.bounds)}
      placements[#placements+1]={semantic_ref=id,resource_ref=motif.id,transform={scale,0,0,scale,p[1],p[2]},bounds=box}
    end
  end
  assert(accepted>=3,"bounded panel search could not establish three connected botanical placements; enlarge permitted space or reduce constraints")

    provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},extensions={panel={region=polygon,protected_regions=masks,resources=resources,placements=placements,proxies=proxies,attempts=attempts,
      bounds=P.plain(s.document.bounds),grid_spacing_cm=step,grid_cells=#cells,iteration_limit=#cells,accepted=accepted,density=s.parameters.density,
      source_scope="independent grid/proxy/serial-rule adaptation; no source MAT or paper-figure reproduction",containment="every conservative whole-paint resource AABB admitted before lowering; no panel clip required"}}}
end
function M.validate(x,d)

function M.register(registry)

    parameters={density={type="number",minimum=0.2,maximum=1,required=true}},transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
