-- Deterministic finite marked-square completion. The assignment verifier
-- does not depend on the search order or on the searcher's success flag.
local P,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash")
local M={VERSION="finite-marked-square-search-v1"}
local names={"north","east","south","west"}
local directions={{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}}
local opposite={3,4,1,2}
local variants={
  {id="blank",marks={0,0,0,0}},
  {id="straight-ns",marks={1,0,1,0}},
  {id="straight-ew",marks={0,1,0,1}},
  {id="elbow-ne",marks={1,1,0,0}},
  {id="elbow-es",marks={0,1,1,0}},
  {id="elbow-sw",marks={0,0,1,1}},
  {id="elbow-wn",marks={1,0,0,1}},
}
local by_id,side_index={},{}
for _,tile in ipairs(variants) do by_id[tile.id]=tile end
for i,name in ipairs(names) do side_index[name]=i end
local function key(x,y) return x.."/"..y end
local function integer(n,lo,hi) return type(n)=="number" and n%1==0 and n>=lo and n<=hi end
local function fields(t,allowed)
  assert(type(t)=="table","constraint-object-required")
  for k in pairs(t) do assert(allowed[k],"constraint-unknown-field:"..tostring(k)) end
end
local function sequence(t)
  assert(type(t)=="table","constraint-array-required")
  local count=0
  for i in pairs(t) do
    assert(integer(i,1,#t),"constraint-dense-array-required")
    count=count+1
  end
  assert(count==#t,"constraint-dense-array-required")
  return t
end
local function coordinate(p,w,h)
  sequence(p)
  assert(type(p)=="table" and #p==2 and integer(p[1],1,w) and integer(p[2],1,h),"constraint-grid-coordinate")
  return key(p[1],p[2])
end
local function normalize(problem)
  fields(problem,{width=true,height=true,holes=true,boundary=true})
  local w,h=problem.width,problem.height
  assert(integer(w,1,6) and integer(h,1,6),"constraint-grid-size")
  local holes,cells,by_key={},P.array(),{}
  for _,p in ipairs(sequence(problem.holes or {})) do
    local id=coordinate(p,w,h)
    assert(not holes[id],"constraint-duplicate-hole")
    holes[id]=true
  end
  for y=1,h do for x=1,w do
    local id=key(x,y)
    if not holes[id] then
      local c={id=id,x=x,y=y}
      cells[#cells+1]=c;by_key[id]=c
    end
  end end
  assert(#cells>0,"constraint-empty-occupancy")
  local override={}
  for _,r in ipairs(sequence(problem.boundary or {})) do
    fields(r,{cell=true,side=true,mark=true})
    local id=coordinate(r.cell,w,h)
    local c,i=by_key[id],side_index[r.side]
    assert(c and i and integer(r.mark,0,1),"constraint-boundary-record")
    local d=directions[i]
    assert(not by_key[key(c.x+d[1],c.y+d[2])],"constraint-boundary-on-interior")
    local k=id.."/"..r.side
    assert(override[k]==nil,"constraint-duplicate-boundary")
    override[k]=r.mark
  end
  for _,c in ipairs(cells) do
    c.sides={}
    for i,d in ipairs(directions) do
      local n=by_key[key(c.x+d[1],c.y+d[2])]
      c.sides[i]=n and {neighbor=n.id} or {fixed=override[c.id.."/"..names[i]] or 0}
    end
  end
  return {width=w,height=h,occupied=cells}
end
local function check_assignment(problem,assignment)
  assert(#sequence(assignment)==#problem.occupied,"constraint-incomplete-assignment")
  local placed={}
  for i,c in ipairs(problem.occupied) do
    local item=assignment[i]
    fields(item,{cell=true,tile=true})
    assert(type(item)=="table" and item.cell==c.id and by_id[item.tile] and not placed[item.cell],"constraint-invalid-assignment")
    placed[c.id]=by_id[item.tile]
  end
  for _,c in ipairs(problem.occupied) do
    for i,s in ipairs(c.sides) do
      local mark=placed[c.id].marks[i]
      local required=s.neighbor and placed[s.neighbor].marks[opposite[i]] or s.fixed
      assert(mark==required,"constraint-mark-mismatch:"..c.id.."/"..names[i])
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function build_receipt(problem,options,route)
  assert(integer(options.seed,0,2^31-1) and integer(options.node_limit,0,200000),"constraint-solver-limits")
  assert(options.deadline_ms==nil or integer(options.deadline_ms,1,5000),"constraint-deadline")
  return {algorithm=M.VERSION,route=route,seed=options.seed,node_limit=options.node_limit,
    deadline_ms=options.deadline_ms,problem_sha256=H.value("constraint/problem",problem),
    order="row-major, fixed oriented tile order",nodes=0}
end
local function search(problem,options,context,clock)
  local receipt=build_receipt(problem,options,"searched")
  local deadline
  if options.deadline_ms then
    assert(type(clock)=="function","constraint-clock-required")
    deadline=clock()+options.deadline_ms/1000
  end
  local placed={}
  local function choose(index)
    if deadline and clock()>=deadline then return "timeout" end
    if index>#problem.occupied then return "complete" end
    if receipt.nodes>=options.node_limit then return "unknown" end
    receipt.nodes=receipt.nodes+1
    local cell=problem.occupied[index]
    for _,tile in ipairs(variants) do
      if context then context:consume("operations",1) end
      local legal=true
      for i,s in ipairs(cell.sides) do
        local neighbor=s.neighbor and placed[s.neighbor]
        local required=neighbor and neighbor.marks[opposite[i]] or s.fixed
        if required~=nil and tile.marks[i]~=required then legal=false;break end
      end
      if legal then
        placed[cell.id]=tile
        local result=choose(index+1)
        if result~="unsatisfiable" then return result end
        placed[cell.id]=nil
      end
    end
    return "unsatisfiable"
  end
  receipt.status=choose(1)
  local assignment
  if receipt.status=="complete" then
    assignment=P.array()
    for i,c in ipairs(problem.occupied) do assignment[i]={cell=c.id,tile=placed[c.id].id} end
    check_assignment(problem,assignment)
    receipt.assignment_sha256=H.value("constraint/assignment",assignment)
  end
  return {problem=problem,assignment=assignment,receipt=receipt}
end
local function replay(problem,options,assignment)
  check_assignment(problem,assignment)
  local receipt=build_receipt(problem,options,"replayed")
  receipt.status="complete"
  receipt.assignment_sha256=H.value("constraint/assignment",assignment)
  return {problem=problem,assignment=P.plain(assignment),receipt=receipt}
end
local function routes(clock)
  local r=require("pattern_aperiodic").route_registry()
  r.register("bounded_constraint",{
    construct=function(request,context)
      local problem=normalize(request.problem)
      if request.assignment then return replay(problem,request.options,request.assignment) end
      return search(problem,request.options,context,clock)
    end,
    validate=function(result)
      if result.receipt.status=="complete" then return check_assignment(result.problem,result.assignment) end
      return result.assignment==nil and

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="tiling/marked-square-completion",version="1",family="finite-marked-square",
    units="cm",capabilities={"graph"},parameters={cell_size={type="number",minimum=.25,maximum=2,required=true},
      node_limit={type="integer",minimum=0,maximum=200000},deadline_ms={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=5000}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},

local function geometry(problem,assignment,frame,step,prefix)

  assert(type(e.step_cm)=="number" and e.step_cm>=.25 and e.step_cm<=2 and
    e.prefix==instance.id and e.prefix==instance_id(instance.frame,e.step_cm,receipt),"constraint-instance-identity")
  check_assignment(problem,e.assignment)

    "all fixed boundary marks and holes respected","assignment digest and graph reconstruction"},solver=P.plain(receipt),
    construction={route="bounded_constraint",finite=true,occupied_cells=#problem.occupied}}

function M.validate(x) return validate(P.instance(P.plain(x),M.definition())) end
local function lower(x,v,style)
  assert(next(style)==nil,"constraint-style")

    clip={bounds=P.plain(crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)}}

function M.register(registry,clock)
  local d,r=M.definition(),routes(clock or (os and os.clock))

    assert(c.frame.unit=="cm" and c.frame.dimension==2 and c.frame.handedness=="right","constraint-frame")
    local step=s.parameters.cell_size
    local request={problem=P.plain(s.inputs.problem),assignment=s.inputs.assignment and P.plain(s.inputs.assignment),
      options={seed=s.seed,node_limit=s.parameters.node_limit or 20000,deadline_ms=s.parameters.deadline_ms}}

    end

    return {id=prefix,definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={graph=graph},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={constraint={route="bounded_constraint",input=request.problem,assignment=built.assignment,
        receipt=receipt,step_cm=step,prefix=prefix,placements=placements}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end
return M

local G,C,P=require("pattern_geometry"),require("pattern_curves"),require("pattern")
local B={VERSION="conservative-ink-v1"}
local function finite(n) assert(type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge,"finite bound required") end
local function box(b)
  assert(type(b)=="table" and #b==4,"[xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] required");for _,v in ipairs(b) do finite(v) end
  for k in pairs(b) do assert(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=4,"dense bounds tuple required") end
  assert(b[1]<=b[3] and b[2]<=b[4],"inverted bounds are not an empty region");return {b[1],b[2],b[3],b[4]}
end
local function include(a,b)
  if not a then return box(b) end

end
local function hypot(a,b) local m=math.max(math.abs(a),math.abs(b));return m==0 and 0 or m*math.sqrt((a/m)^2+(b/m)^2) end
function B.path(commands,paint,matrix,policy)

  matrix=matrix or {1,0,0,1,0,0};G.tolerance(policy)

  for _,cmd in ipairs(commands) do
    local op=cmd[1]
    if op=="M" then assert(#cmd==3,"M arity");current=G.transform({cmd[2],cmd[3]},matrix);start=current
    elseif op=="L" then
      assert(current and #cmd==3,"L requires current point and endpoint");local p=G.transform({cmd[2],cmd[3]},matrix)
      geometry=include(geometry,{math.min(p[1],current[1]),math.min(p[2],current[2]),math.max(p[1],current[1]),math.max(p[2],current[2])});current=p;drawn=drawn+1
    elseif op=="C" then
      assert(current and #cmd==7,"C requires current point and three controls")
      local c={current,G.transform({cmd[2],cmd[3]},matrix),G.transform({cmd[4],cmd[5]},matrix),G.transform({cmd[6],cmd[7]},matrix)}
      geometry=include(geometry,C.tight_bounds(c,policy));current=c[4];drawn=drawn+1
    elseif op=="Z" then
      assert(current and start and #cmd==1,"Z requires an open subpath")
      geometry=include(geometry,{math.min(current[1],start[1]),math.min(current[2],start[2]),math.max(current[1],start[1]),math.max(current[2],start[2])});current=start;drawn=drawn+1
    else error("unsupported path command in bounds: "..tostring(op),0) end
  end

  if paint.stroke then
    local width=paint.stroke_width;finite(width);assert(width>0,"positive stroke width required")
    local cap,join=paint.cap or "butt",paint.join or "miter"
    assert(cap=="butt" or cap=="round" or cap=="square","unsupported cap")
    assert(join=="miter" or join=="round" or join=="bevel","unsupported join")

    if join=="miter" then local limit=paint.miter_limit or 10;finite(limit);assert(limit>=1,"miter limit must be at least1");factor=math.max(factor,limit) end
    local radius=width*factor/2
    padx,pady=radius*hypot(matrix[1],matrix[3]),radius*hypot(matrix[2],matrix[4])
  end
  local pad=G.tolerance(policy,{{geometry[1],geometry[2]},{geometry[3],geometry[4]}})

end
function B.union(records,unit)
  assert(unit=="cm" or unit=="mm" or unit=="bp" or unit=="unit","explicit bounds unit required")
  local out

  return P.snapshot(out and {empty=false,unit=unit,bounds=out} or {empty=true,unit=unit,reason="empty_union"})
end
function B.intersects(a,b)
  a,b=box(a),box(b);return a[1]<=b[3] and a[3]>=b[1] and a[2]<=b[4] and a[4]>=b[2]
end
B.box=box
return B

-- Browser host transport. All construction/validation/rendering stays in the CLI core.
local P,H,B,C,Parse=require('pattern'),require('pattern_hash'),require('pattern_bytes'),require('pattern_cli_core'),require('pattern_parse')
local M={VERSION='pattern-browser-v1'}
local commands={capabilities=true,schema=true,validate=true,generate=true,['validate-instance']=true,render=true,replay=true,diagnose=true}
function M.session(source,runtime)
  assert(type(source)=='table'and type(runtime)=='string'and #runtime>0,'browser source/runtime required')
  local files,outputs={},nil
  local session={}
  function session.put(name,encoded)
    assert(type(name)=='string'and #name<=160 and name:match('^[%w_.-]+$'),'browser input filename')
    local bytes=B.base64_decode(encoded)
    files[name]=(files[name]or'')..bytes
    assert(#files[name]<=32*1024*1024,'browser input file budget')
  end
  function session.dispatch(text)
    outputs=nil
    local data=Parse.decode(text)
    assert(type(data)=='table'and data.schema_version==1 and commands[data.command],'browser request version/command')
    for key in pairs(data)do assert(key=='schema_version'or key=='command'or key=='family'or key=='formats'or key=='limits'or key=='dependencies'or key=='instance_transport'or key=='previous_recipe'or key=='edits'or key=='input_files','browser request field:'..tostring(key))end
    local total,seen=0,{}
    for _,item in ipairs(data.input_files or{})do
      assert(type(item.name)=='string'and not seen[item.name]and type(item.bytes)=='number'and H.is_digest(item.sha256),'browser input descriptor')
      seen[item.name]=true;assert(files[item.name]and #files[item.name]==item.bytes and H.sha256(files[item.name])==item.sha256,'browser input digest mismatch')
      total=total+item.bytes;assert(total<=32*1024*1024,'browser total input budget')
    end
    for name in pairs(files)do assert(seen[name],'browser undeclared input')end
    data.input_files=nil
    if data.command~='capabilities'and data.command~='schema'and data.command~='diagnose'then
      local recipe=require('pattern_recipe').decode(assert(files['recipe.json'],'browser recipe missing'))
      local selected=data.limits or recipe.design.budget or {objects=10000,operations=100000,bytes=2*1024*1024}
      local caps={objects=100000,operations=48000000,bytes=64*1024*1024}
      for name,value in pairs(selected)do assert(caps[name]and type(value)=='number'and value%1==0 and value>=0 and value<=caps[name],'browser execution budget not admitted:'..tostring(name))end
    end
    local result,problem=C.dispatch(data,{runtime=runtime,read=function(name)return assert(files[name],'browser input missing:'..name)end,source=function()return source end})
    if problem then return P.serialize({ok=false,error={code=problem.code,message=table.concat(problem.messages or{},'\n'),status=problem.status}})end
    if data.command=='capabilities'then
      local report=Parse.decode(result['report.json']);report.core_commands=report.commands
      report.commands=P.array();for name in pairs(commands)do report.commands[#report.commands+1]=name end;table.sort(report.commands,P.byte_less)
      report.browser_runtime=runtime;report.browser_protocol=M.VERSION
      report.optional_providers='Pure Lua bounded search is available; native-process solvers are unavailable. Verified supplied solver caches and precomputed instances may replay.'
      result['report.json']=P.serialize(report)
    end
    local assets=P.array();total=0
    for name,bytes in pairs(result)do
      assert(type(name)=='string'and name:match('^[%w_.-]+$')and type(bytes)=='string','browser output asset')
      total=total+#bytes;assert(total<=64*1024*1024,'browser output byte budget')
      assets[#assets+1]={name=name,bytes=#bytes,sha256=H.sha256(bytes)}
    end
    assert(#assets>=1 and #assets<=1024,'browser output object budget');table.sort(assets,function(a,b)return P.byte_less(a.name,b.name)end)
    outputs=result
    return P.serialize({ok=true,assets=assets,output_bytes=total,protocol=M.VERSION})
  end
  function session.chunk(name,offset,count)
    assert(outputs and outputs[name]and type(offset)=='number'and offset%1==0 and offset>=0,'browser output chunk offset')
    assert(type(count)=='number'and count%1==0 and count>=1 and count<=262144,'browser output chunk size')
    return B.base64_encode(outputs[name]:sub(offset+1,offset+count))
  end
  return session
end
return M

-- Portable encodings used by the shared PDF/SVG backends (no native libraries).
local P=require("pattern")
local M={}
local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local reverse={};for i=1,#alphabet do reverse[alphabet:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
function M.base64_decode(text)
  assert(type(text)=="string" and #text%4==0 and #text<=8*1024*1024,"invalid/oversized base64 input")
  local out={}
  for i=1,#text,4 do
    local a,b,c,d=text:sub(i,i),text:sub(i+1,i+1),text:sub(i+2,i+2),text:sub(i+3,i+3)
    assert(reverse[a] and reverse[b] and (reverse[c] or c=="=") and (reverse[d] or d=="="),"invalid base64 alphabet")
    assert((c~="=" or d=="=") and (c~="=" and d~="=" or i==#text-3),"invalid base64 padding")
    local n=reverse[a]*262144+reverse[b]*4096+(reverse[c] or 0)*64+(reverse[d] or 0)
    if c=="=" then assert(reverse[b]%16==0,"noncanonical base64 padding bits") elseif d=="=" then assert(reverse[c]%4==0,"noncanonical base64 padding bits") end
    out[#out+1]=string.char(math.floor(n/65536)%256)
    if c~="=" then out[#out+1]=string.char(math.floor(n/256)%256) end
    if d~="=" then out[#out+1]=string.char(n%256) end
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end
function M.base64_encode(bytes)
  assert(type(bytes)=="string" and #bytes<=6*1024*1024,"base64 bytes exceed limit")
  local out={}
  for i=1,#bytes,3 do
    local a,b,c=bytes:byte(i,i+2);local n=a*65536+(b or 0)*256+(c or 0)
    out[#out+1]=alphabet:sub(math.floor(n/262144)%64+1,math.floor(n/262144)%64+1)
    out[#out+1]=alphabet:sub(math.floor(n/4096)%64+1,math.floor(n/4096)%64+1)
    out[#out+1]=b and alphabet:sub(math.floor(n/64)%64+1,math.floor(n/64)%64+1) or "="
    out[#out+1]=c and alphabet:sub(n%64+1,n%64+1) or "="
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end
function M.utf16_hex(text,bom)
  P.snapshot(text);local out=bom and {"FEFF"} or {}
  for _,cp in utf8.codes(text) do
    if cp<=0xffff then out[#out+1]=string.format("%04X",cp)
    else cp=cp-0x10000;out[#out+1]=string.format("%04X%04X",0xd800+math.floor(cp/1024),0xdc00+cp%1024) end
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end
function M.xml(text)
  P.snapshot(text)
  for _,cp in utf8.codes(text) do assert(cp==9 or cp==10 or cp==13 or cp>=32 and cp~=0xfffe and cp~=0xffff,"text contains a codepoint unsupported by XML1.0") end
  return (text:gsub("&","&"):gsub("<","<"):gsub(">",">"):gsub('"',"""):gsub("'","'"):gsub("\n","
"):gsub("\r",""):gsub("\t","	"))
end
function M.pdf_number(value)
  local s=P.serialize(value);assert(type(value)=="number","PDF number required")
  if not s:find("e",1,true) then return s end
  local mantissa,exponent=s:match("^(.-)e([+-]?%d+)$");assert(mantissa,"invalid canonical numeric spelling")
  local sign="";if mantissa:sub(1,1)=="-" then sign="-";mantissa=mantissa:sub(2) end
  local whole,fraction=mantissa:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$");whole=whole or mantissa;fraction=fraction or ""
  local digits=whole..fraction;local point=#whole+tonumber(exponent)
  if point<=0 then return sign.."0."..string.rep("0",-point)..digits
  elseif point>=#digits then return sign..digits..string.rep("0",point-#digits)
  else return sign..digits:sub(1,point).."."..digits:sub(point+1) end
end
return M

-- Independent implementation of Kaplan and Cohen (2003), sections 3.1-3.3 and 3.5.
local G=require("pattern_geometry")
local N=require("pattern_predicates")
local M={}
local function fail(code,subject) error(code..": "..tostring(subject),0) end
local function valid_id(x)return type(x)=="string" and #x<=48 and x:match("^[%w_-]+$")end
local function coord(x)return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<=1000 end
local function vec(a,b)return{b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2]}end
local function norm(v)return math.sqrt(v[1]^2+v[2]^2)end
local function unit(v)local n=norm(v);return{v[1]/n,v[2]/n}end
local function perp(v)return{-v[2],v[1]}end
local function sum(a,b,s)return{a[1]+s*b[1],a[2]+s*b[2]}end

local function sorted(t)local a={}for k in pairs(t)do a[#a+1]=k end;table.sort(a);return a end

local function on(a,b,p)return p[1]>=math.min(a[1],b[1]) and p[1]<=math.max(a[1],b[1])and p[2]>=math.min(a[2],b[2])and p[2]<=math.max(a[2],b[2])end

  or x==0 and on(a,b,c)or y==0 and on(a,b,d)or z==0 and on(c,d,a)or w==0 and on(c,d,b)
end
local function xor(a,b)return (a+b)%2 end

-- Nodes are midpoint traversals. At each junction pair the two sides
-- bounding each angular sector. Cutting a sector makes two named ends.
function M.topology(scaffold)

 if type(vv)~="table"or type(ee)~="table"or #vv<2 or #vv>128 or #ee<1 or #ee>192 then fail("knot-scaffold-budget","vertices/edges")end

  if not valid_id(v.id)or V[v.id]or not v.point or not coord(v.point[1])or not coord(v.point[2])then fail("knot-vertex",v.id)end

  local a,b=e.from,e.to
  if not valid_id(e.id)or E[e.id]or a==b or not V[a]or not V[b]then fail("knot-edge",e.id)end
  if b<a then a,b=b,a end

  for k,r in pairs(V)do if k~=a and k~=b and contact(p,q,r,r)then fail("knot-vertex-on-edge",e.id.."/"..k)end end
  for k,f in pairs(E)do
   if a==f.a and b==f.b then fail("knot-duplicate-edge",e.id)end
   if a~=f.a and a~=f.b and b~=f.a and b~=f.b and contact(p,q,V[f.a],V[f.b])then fail("knot-nonplanar",e.id.."/"..k)end
  end

  cross[e.id]={id=e.id,point=m,branches={e.id.."/L",e.id.."/R"}}

   local at,other=ends[1],ends[2];local u=unit(vec(m,V[at]));local n=perp(u);local base=e.id.."/"..at
   inc[at][#inc[at]+1]={base=base,angle=math.atan(-u[2],-u[1]),edge=e.id}
   for _,s in ipairs{"L","R"}do
    local d=unit(sum(u,n,s=="L"and 1 or -1))

-- Bounded numerical circle packing for an oriented triangulated disk.
local P=require("pattern")
local M={VERSION="disk-angle-bisection-v1"}
local function finite(x) return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<math.huge end
local function sort_keys(t)
  local ids={}
  for k in pairs(t) do ids[#ids+1]=k end
  table.sort(ids,P.byte_less)
  return ids
end
local function edge_key(a,b)
  if P.byte_less(a,b) then return a.."/"..b else return b.."/"..a end
end
local function join(map,a,b)
  map[a]=map[a] or {}
  map[a][b]=true
end
local function reach(neighbors,start)
  local seen,q={[start]=true},{start}
  local i=1
  while i<=#q do
    for v in pairs(neighbors[q[i]] or {}) do
      if not seen[v] then seen[v]=true;q[#q+1]=v end
    end
    i=i+1
  end
  return #q
end

function M.disk(complex)
  assert(type(complex)=="table" and type(complex.faces)=="table"
    and #complex.faces>=3 and #complex.faces<=120,"packing-face-budget")
  local vertices,edges,adjacent,links={}, {}, {}, {}
  local faces,face_keys={},{}
  for i,f in ipairs(complex.faces) do
    assert(type(f)=="table" and #f==3,"packing-triangle-size")
    for _,v in ipairs(f) do
      assert(type(v)=="string" and #v<=32 and v:match("^[%w_-]+$"),"packing-vertex-id")
      vertices[v]=true
    end
    local a,b,c=table.unpack(f)
    assert(a~=b and b~=c and c~=a,"packing-degenerate-triangle")
    local sorted={a,b,c};table.sort(sorted,P.byte_less)
    local triangle_key=table.concat(sorted,"/")
    assert(not face_keys[triangle_key],"packing-duplicate-triangle")
    face_keys[triangle_key]=true
    faces[i]={a,b,c}
    for j=1,3 do
      local u,v,w=f[j],f[j%3+1],f[(j+1)%3+1]
      local key=edge_key(u,v)
      local e=edges[key]
      if not e then edges[key]={from=u,to=v,faces={i}}
      else
        assert(#e.faces==1 and e.from==v and e.to==u,"packing-edge-incidence-or-orientation")
        e.faces[2]=i
      end
      join(adjacent,u,v);join(adjacent,v,u)
      links[u]=links[u] or {}
      join(links[u],v,w);join(links[u],w,v)
    end
  end
  local ids,edge_ids=sort_keys(vertices),sort_keys(edges)
  assert(#ids<=72 and #ids-#edge_ids+#faces==1,"packing-disk-euler")
  assert(reach(adjacent,ids[1])==#ids,"packing-disconnected-disk")
  local boundary,boundary_adjacent={},{}
  for _,e in pairs(edges) do
    if #e.faces==1 then
      boundary[e.from],boundary[e.to]=true,true
      join(boundary_adjacent,e.from,e.to);join(boundary_adjacent,e.to,e.from)
    end
  end
  local border=sort_keys(boundary)
  assert(#border>=3 and reach(boundary_adjacent,border[1])==#border,"packing-boundary-cycle")
  local interior={}
  for _,u in ipairs(ids) do
    local ring=sort_keys(adjacent[u])
    assert(#ring>=3 and reach(links[u],ring[1])==#ring,"packing-vertex-link")
    local ends=0
    for _,v in ipairs(ring) do
      local n=#sort_keys(links[u][v])
      assert(n==1 or n==2,"packing-link-degree")
      if n==1 then ends=ends+1 end
    end
    if boundary[u] then
      assert(ends==2 and #sort_keys(boundary_adjacent[u])==2,"packing-boundary-link")
    else
      assert(ends==0,"packing-interior-link")
      interior[#interior+1]=u
    end
  end
  assert(#interior>0,"packing-requires-interior-vertex")
  return {ids=ids,faces=faces,edges=edges,edge_ids=edge_ids,adjacent=adjacent,links=links,boundary=boundary,interior=interior}
end

local function angle(ri,rj,rk)
  return 2*math.asin(math.sqrt(rj*rk/((ri+rj)*(ri+rk))))
end
local function angle_sum(r,ri,pairs)
  local out=0
  for _,pair in ipairs(pairs) do out=out+angle(ri,r[pair[1]],r[pair[2]]) end
  return out
end
local function solve_radii(d,tol,maximum,poll)
  local radii,neighbors={},{}
  for _,id in ipairs(d.ids) do
    local n=#sort_keys(d.adjacent[id])
    radii[id]=d.boundary[id] and (1/math.sin(math.pi/(2*n-2))-1) or 1
    neighbors[id]={}
  end
  for _,f in ipairs(d.faces) do
    for j=1,3 do
      local u,v,w=f[j],f[j%3+1],f[(j+1)%3+1]
      neighbors[u][#neighbors[u]+1]={v,w}
    end
  end
  for iteration=1,maximum do
    if poll then poll(#d.faces*180) end
    for _,u in ipairs(d.interior) do
      local lo,hi=1e-6,1e6
      assert(angle_sum(radii,lo,neighbors[u])>2*math.pi and angle_sum(radii,hi,neighbors[u])<2*math.pi,
        "packing-radius-bracket")
      for _=1,60 do
        local mid=math.sqrt(lo*hi)
        if angle_sum(radii,mid,neighbors[u])>2*math.pi then lo=mid else hi=mid end
      end
      radii[u]=math.sqrt(lo*hi)
    end
    local max_residual=0
    for _,u in ipairs(d.interior) do
      max_residual=math.max(max_residual,math.abs(angle_sum(radii,radii[u],neighbors[u])-2*math.pi))
    end
    if max_residual<=tol then return radii,iteration,max_residual end
  end
  error("packing-nonconvergence")
end

local function distance(a,b)
  return math.sqrt((a[1]-b[1])^2+(a[2]-b[2])^2)
end
local function embed(d,r)
  local root=d.faces[1]
  local first,second=root[1],root[2]
  local points={[first]={0,0},[second]={r[first]+r[second],0}}
  local count=2
  while count<#d.ids do
    local previous=count
    for _,f in ipairs(d.faces) do
      for i=1,3 do
        local a,b,c=f[i],f[i%3+1],f[(i+1)%3+1]
        if points[a] and points[b] and not points[c] then
          local A,B=points[a],points[b]
          local ab,ac,bc=distance(A,B),r[a]+r[c],r[b]+r[c]
          local ux,uy=(B[1]-A[1])/ab,(B[2]-A[2])/ab
          local x=(ab*ab+ac*ac-bc*bc)/(2*ab)
          local square=ac*ac-x*x
          assert(square>0,"packing-embedding-degenerate")
          local y=math.sqrt(square)
          points[c]={A[1]+x*ux-y*uy,A[2]+x*uy+y*ux}
          count=count+1
        end
      end
    end
    assert(previous<count,"packing-embedding-disconnected")
  end
  return points,{first,second}
end

function M.solve(complex,settings)
  local disk=M.disk(complex)
  local tol,cap=settings.tolerance or 1e-11,settings.iterations or 600
  assert(finite(tol) and tol>=1e-13 and tol<=1e-7,"packing-tolerance")
  assert(type(cap)=="number" and cap%1==0 and cap>=1 and cap<=3000,"packing-iteration-budget")
  local radius,iterations,angular_residual=solve_radii(disk,tol,cap,settings.poll)
  local centers,root=embed(disk,radius)
  local lo_x,lo_y,hi_x,hi_y=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
  for _,id in ipairs(disk.ids) do
    local p,r=centers[id],radius[id]
    lo_x,lo_y=math.min(lo_x,p[1]-r),math.min(lo_y,p[2]-r)
    hi_x,hi_y=math.max(hi_x,p[1]+r),math.max(hi_y,p[2]+r)
  end
  local scale,tx,ty=1,0,0
  local panel=settings.panel
  if panel then
    assert(#panel==4 and finite(panel[1]) and finite(panel[2]) and finite(panel[3]) and finite(panel[4])
      and panel[3]>panel[1] and panel[4]>panel[2],"packing-panel")
    scale=math.min((panel[3]-panel[1])/(hi_x-lo_x),(panel[4]-panel[2])/(hi_y-lo_y))
    tx=(panel[1]+panel[3]-scale*(lo_x+hi_x))/2
    ty=(panel[2]+panel[4]-scale*(lo_y+hi_y))/2
  end
  local circles={}
  for _,id in ipairs(disk.ids) do
    local p=centers[id]
    circles[id]={center={scale*p[1]+tx,scale*p[2]+ty},radius=scale*radius[id],
      degree=#sort_keys(disk.adjacent[id]),boundary=disk.boundary[id] or false}
  end
  local edge_error,clearance=0,math.huge
  for i,a in ipairs(disk.ids) do
    for j=i+1,#disk.ids do
      local b=disk.ids[j]
      local A,B=circles[a],circles[b]
      local gap=distance(A.center,B.center)-A.radius-B.radius
      if disk.edges[edge_key(a,b)] then edge_error=math.max(edge_error,math.abs(gap))
      else clearance=math.min(clearance,gap) end
    end
  end
  assert(edge_error<=scale*tol*120+1e-12,"packing-tangency-residual")
  assert(clearance>scale*tol*120+1e-12,"packing-nonedge-contact-or-overlap")
  local N=require("pattern_predicates")
  for _,f in ipairs(disk.faces) do
    assert(N.orient2d(circles[f[1]].center,circles[f[2]].center,circles[f[3]].center)>0,"packing-embedding-orientation")
  end
  return {circles=circles,solver=M.VERSION,converged=true,iterations=iterations,tolerance=tol,
    maximum_angular_residual=angular_residual,maximum_tangency_residual=edge_error,minimum_nonedge_clearance=clearance<math.huge and clearance or nil,
    normalization={scale=scale,translation={tx,ty},root=root,panel=panel},complex={faces=disk.faces}}
end

-- Read-only certificate validation for offline results. It deliberately does
-- not iterate radii or place centers.
function M.validate(record)
  assert(record.solver==M.VERSION and record.converged==true,"packing-solver-certificate")
  local tol=record.tolerance
  assert(finite(tol) and tol>=1e-13 and tol<=1e-7,"packing-tolerance")
  assert(type(record.iterations)=="number" and record.iterations%1==0
    and record.iterations>=1 and record.iterations<=3000,"packing-iteration-receipt")
  local d=M.disk(record.complex)
  local circles=record.circles
  assert(#sort_keys(circles)==#d.ids,"packing-circle-count")
  local n=record.normalization
  assert(finite(n.scale) and n.scale>0 and #n.translation==2 and finite(n.translation[1]) and finite(n.translation[2]),
    "packing-normalization")
  assert(n.root[1]==d.faces[1][1] and n.root[2]==d.faces[1][2],"packing-root")
  local epsilon=n.scale*tol*120+1e-12
  for _,id in ipairs(d.ids) do
    local c=assert(circles[id],"packing-missing-circle")
    local degree=#sort_keys(d.adjacent[id])
    assert(c.degree==degree and c.boundary==(d.boundary[id] or false),"packing-circle-correspondence")
    assert(finite(c.radius) and c.radius>0 and finite(c.center[1]) and finite(c.center[2]),"packing-circle-coordinate")
    if c.boundary then
      assert(math.abs(c.radius-n.scale*(1/math.sin(math.pi/(2*degree-2))-1))<=epsilon,"packing-boundary-radius")
    end
    if n.panel then
      local x,y=table.unpack(c.center)
      local r=c.radius
      assert(x-r>=n.panel[1]-epsilon and y-r>=n.panel[2]-epsilon
        and x+r<=n.panel[3]+epsilon and y+r<=n.panel[4]+epsilon,"packing-panel-containment")
    end
  end
  assert(distance(circles[n.root[1]].center,n.translation)<=epsilon,"packing-root-translation")
  local A,B=circles[n.root[1]].center,circles[n.root[2]].center
  assert(B[1]>A[1] and math.abs(B[2]-A[2])<=epsilon,"packing-root-axis")
  local edge_error,clearance=0,math.huge
  for i,a in ipairs(d.ids) do
    for j=i+1,#d.ids do
      local b=d.ids[j]
      local C,D=circles[a],circles[b]
      local gap=distance(C.center,D.center)-C.radius-D.radius
      if d.edges[edge_key(a,b)] then edge_error=math.max(edge_error,math.abs(gap))
      else clearance=math.min(clearance,gap) end
    end
  end
  assert(edge_error<=epsilon and math.abs(edge_error-record.maximum_tangency_residual)<=epsilon,"packing-tangency-residual")
  if clearance==math.huge then
    assert(record.minimum_nonedge_clearance==nil,"packing-nonedge-clearance-receipt")
  else
    assert(clearance>epsilon and finite(record.minimum_nonedge_clearance)
      and math.abs(clearance-record.minimum_nonedge_clearance)<=epsilon,"packing-nonedge-contact-or-overlap")
  end
  local N=require("pattern_predicates")
  -- Compensated accumulation preserves the existing strict certificate bound
  -- when a high-valence wheel's normalized angles are added. The ordinary
  -- sum falsely rejected an admitted60-fan (1.78e-14 versus8.88e-15 with
  -- compensated addition); circles, solver and tolerances are unchanged.
  local sums,correction={},{}
  for _,f in ipairs(d.faces) do
    assert(N.orient2d(circles[f[1]].center,circles[f[2]].center,circles[f[3]].center)>0,"packing-embedding-orientation")
    for i=1,3 do
      local a,b,c=f[i],f[i%3+1],f[(i+1)%3+1]
      local value=angle(circles[a].radius,circles[b].radius,circles[c].radius)
      local adjusted=value-(correction[a]or 0)
      local total=(sums[a]or 0)+adjusted
      correction[a]=(total-(sums[a]or 0))-adjusted;sums[a]=total
    end
  end
  local residual=0
  for _,id in ipairs(d.interior) do residual=math.max(residual,math.abs(sums[id]-2*math.pi)) end
  assert(residual<=tol+1e-14 and math.abs(residual-record.maximum_angular_residual)<=1e-14,"packing-angular-residual")
  return true
end

return M
source.pattern_cli_core.lua:
local P,Q,R,H,V=require("pattern"),require("pattern_recipe"),require("pattern_registry"),
  require("pattern_hash"),require("pattern_render")
local Parse=require("pattern_parse")
local M={VERSION="pattern-cli-v1"}
local families={
  ["botanical/legacy-authored"]={"pattern_botanical_legacy","authored"},
  ["botanical/legacy-grown"]={"pattern_botanical_legacy","grown"},
  ["botanical/asymmetric-garden"]={"pattern_botanical_panel"},
  ["tiling/periodic"]={"pattern_periodic"},
  ["strand/celtic"]={"pattern_celtic"},
  ["ornament/islamic-pic"]={"pattern_islamic"},
  ["ornament/islamic-freeform"]={"pattern_freeform"},
  ["tiling/finite-substitution"]={"pattern_aperiodic"},
  ["tiling/penrose-p3"]={"pattern_penrose"},
  ["tiling/spectre"]={"pattern_spectre"},
  ["tiling/ammann-beenker"]={"pattern_ammann_beenker"},
  ["tiling/hat"]={"pattern_hat"},
  ["tiling/marked-square-completion"]={"pattern_bounded_tiles"},
  ["ornament/gothic-tracery"]={"pattern_tracery"},
  ["tiling/escherization"]={"pattern_escher"},
  ["mosaic/hausner"]={"pattern_mosaic"},
  ["stroke/fields-and-examples"]={"pattern_stroke"},
  ["maze/image-guided"]={"pattern_maze"},
  ["text/digital-micrography"]={"pattern_micrography"},
  ["decoration/decobrush"]={"pattern_decobrush"},
  ["gothic/spatial-ogee"]={"pattern_gothic_microarchitecture"},
  ["collection/ornament"]={"pattern_collection_assets"},
}

function M.registry(family)
  local entry=assert(families[family],"cli-unsupported-family:"..tostring(family))
  local module=require(entry[1])
  local registry=R.new()
  local definition=module.register(registry,entry[2])
  assert(definition.id==family,"cli-family-catalog-mismatch")
  return registry,definition
end

local function request(data)
  assert(type(data)=="table" and data.schema_version==1,"cli-request-version")
  local fields={schema_version=true,command=true,family=true,formats=true,limits=true,dependencies=true,
    instance_transport=true,previous_recipe=true,edits=true}
  for k in pairs(data) do assert(fields[k],"cli-request-field:"..tostring(k)) end
  assert(data.previous_recipe==nil or data.previous_recipe==true,"cli-previous-recipe-flag")
  assert(not data.previous_recipe or data.command=="render" or data.command=="replay","cli-previous-recipe-command")
  assert(data.edits==nil or type(data.edits)=="table","cli-edits-object")
  assert(data.edits==nil or data.command=="validate"or data.command=="generate"or data.command=="render"or data.command=="replay","cli-edits-command")
  local formats=data.formats or {"pdf","svg"}
  assert(type(formats)=="table" and #formats<=2,"cli-formats")
  local seen={}
  for _,f in ipairs(formats) do
    assert((f=="pdf" or f=="svg") and not seen[f],"cli-format")
    seen[f]=true
  end
  return formats
end

function M.dispatch(data,host)
  local formats=request(data)
  local command=data.command
  local outputs={}
  if command=="capabilities" then
    local list=P.array()
    for family in pairs(families) do list[#list+1]=family end
    table.sort(list,P.byte_less)
    outputs["report.json"]=P.serialize({schema_version=1,cli=M.VERSION,families=list,
      commands={"capabilities","schema","validate","generate","validate-instance","render","replay","batch","diagnose"},
      formats={"pdf","svg"},recipe_schema_version=1,instance_schema_version=1,
      input_limit_bytes=2*1024*1024,recipe_edits={schema_version=1,flag="edits",planner_preserved=true},output_profiles={"source","monochrome","palette"},view_style_revision={flag="previous_recipe",previous_file="previous-recipe.json",structural_generation=false},optional_providers="Declared by each family's schema and recipe"})
    return outputs
  end
  if command=="schema" then
    local _,definition=M.registry(data.family)
    outputs["report.json"]=P.serialize({schema_version=1,definition=P.plain(definition),
      recipe_fields={"kind","schema_version","id","definition","design","view","dimension","dependencies"},
      contracts={"definition","instance","view","scene","build_record"}})
    return outputs
  end
  if command=="diagnose" then
    local record=P.build_record(Parse.decode(host.read("record.json")))
    outputs["report.json"]=P.serialize({status=record.status,diagnostics=P.plain(record.diagnostics),
      validation=P.plain(record.validation),budgets=P.plain(record.budgets),lineage=P.plain(record.lineage)})
    return outputs
  end
  local recipe=Q.decode(host.read("recipe.json"))
  if data.edits then
    local receipt;recipe,receipt=require("pattern_editor").apply(recipe,data.edits)
    outputs["edit-receipt.json"]=P.serialize(receipt);outputs["recipe.json"]=Q.encode(recipe)
  end
  local registry,definition=M.registry(recipe.definition.id)
  assert(P.serialize(definition)==P.serialize(recipe.definition),"cli-definition-version-mismatch")
  registry:check_specification(definition.id,recipe.design)
  if command=="validate" then
    outputs["report.json"]=P.serialize({schema_version=1,status="complete",family=definition.id,
      recipe_sha256=H.sha256(Q.encode(recipe)),structural_input_sha256=Q.structural_digest(recipe),checks={"Recipe schema, registered definition and family input preconditions"}})
    return outputs
  end
  assert(command=="generate" or command=="replay" or command=="render" or command=="validate-instance",
    "cli-unsupported-command")
  local source,hashes=host.source(),{}
  for name,bytes in pairs(source) do hashes[name]=H.sha256(bytes) end
  local dependencies={}
  for i,name in ipairs(data.dependencies or {}) do
    assert(type(name)=="string" and not dependencies[name],"cli-dependency-name")
    dependencies[name]=host.read("dependency-"..i..".bin")
  end
  local environment=Q.environment({revision="source/"..H.value("cli/source",hashes),
      files={construction=source,style={},view={},renderer={}}},
    {lua=_VERSION,host=host.runtime},{id=V.VERSION,version="1"},dependencies)
  local result
  if command=="generate" then
    result=Q.execute(recipe,registry,environment,{limits=data.limits})
  else
    local instance
    if data.instance_transport then
      assert(data.instance_transport=="legacy-neutral-bundle@1"
        and recipe.definition.id:match("^botanical/legacy%-"),"cli-instance-transport")
      instance=require("pattern_botanical_legacy").decode_bundle(host.read("instance.json"),
        function(sha) return host.read("block-"..sha..".json") end,definition)
    else instance=Parse.instance(host.read("instance.json")) end
    if data.previous_recipe then
      result=Q.revise(recipe,Q.decode(host.read("previous-recipe.json")),instance,Parse.decode(host.read("record.json")),
        registry,environment,{limits=data.limits})
    else
      result=Q.replay(recipe,instance,Parse.decode(host.read("record.json")),
        registry,environment,{limits=data.limits})
    end
  end
  outputs["record.json"]=P.serialize(result.record)
  if result.record.status~="complete" then
    return outputs,{status=result.record.status,code="construction_failed",messages=P.plain(result.record.diagnostics)}
  end
  outputs["recipe.json"]=Q.encode(recipe)
  if result.instance.extensions.legacy then
    local manifest,blocks=require("pattern_botanical_legacy").encode_bundle(result.instance)
    outputs["instance.json"]=manifest
    outputs["instance-format.json"]=P.serialize({schema="legacy-neutral-bundle@1",
      instance_sha256=H.sha256(result.bytes.instance),manifest_sha256=H.sha256(manifest)})
    for sha,bytes in pairs(blocks) do outputs["block-"..sha..".json"]=bytes end
  else outputs["instance.json"]=result.bytes.instance end
  outputs["view.json"]=P.serialize(result.view)
  outputs["scene.json"]=result.bytes.scene
  if command~="validate-instance" then
    local plan=V.plan(result.scene,result.instance,result.view,definition)
    for _,format in ipairs(formats) do
      outputs["pattern."..format]=V[format](plan)
    end
    if result.instance.structures.curve3d then
      outputs["network.json"]=require("pattern_gothic_microarchitecture").export(result.instance)
    end
  end
  return outputs
end

return M
source.pattern_collection.lua:
local P,H,G,V=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash"),require("pattern_geometry"),require("pattern_render")
local M={VERSION="original-collection-v1"}
local identity={1,0,0,1,0,0}

local function complete_text(plan)
  if #plan.text==0 then return end
  local text_refs={}
  for _,text in ipairs(plan.text) do text_refs[text.semantic_ref]=true end
  local depth=0
  for op in V.operations(plan) do
    if op.op=="push_clip" then depth=depth+1
    elseif op.op=="pop_clip" then depth=depth-1
    elseif text_refs[op.semantic_ref] then
      assert(depth==1,"collection-text-requires-unmasked-plan")
    end
  end
  local fonts={}
  for _,f in ipairs(plan.fonts) do
    local glyphs={}
    for _,g in ipairs(f.glyphs) do glyphs[g.id]=g end
    fonts[f.id]={units=f.units_per_em,glyphs=glyphs}
  end
  for _,text in ipairs(plan.text) do
    local f=assert(fonts[text.font_ref],"collection-text-font")
    for _,g in ipairs(text.glyphs) do
      local b=assert(f.glyphs[g.glyph_ref],"collection-text-glyph").bounds
      local k=text.size/f.units
      local angle=g.rotation or 0
      local c,s=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
      local m=G.compose(text.transform or identity,{c*k,s*k,-s*k,c*k,
        text.origin[1]+g.offset[1],text.origin[2]+g.offset[2]})
      for _,p in ipairs({{b[1],b[2]},{b[3],b[2]},{b[3],b[4]},{b[1],b[4]}}) do
        local q=G.transform(p,m)
        assert(q[1]>=plan.bounds[1]-1e-9 and q[1]<=plan.bounds[3]+1e-9
          and q[2]>=plan.bounds[2]-1e-9 and q[2]<=plan.bounds[4]+1e-9,"collection-clipped-text")
      end
    end
  end
end

function M.palette(plan,options)
  for k in pairs(options) do assert(k=="ink" or k=="accent" or k=="intensity","collection-palette-option:"..k) end
  local intensity=options.intensity or 1
  assert(type(intensity)=="number" and intensity>=0 and intensity<=1,"collection-intensity-range")
  local out=P.plain(plan)
  local operations=P.array()
  for operation in V.operations(plan) do
    local op=P.plain(operation)
    if op.paint then
      for _,key in ipairs({"fill","stroke"}) do
        local color=op.paint[key]
        if color then
          assert(not op.paint.color_space or op.paint.color_space=="rgb","collection-rgb-required")
          local base=(color[1]>color[3] and options.accent or options.ink)
          assert(type(base)=="table" and #base==3,"collection-palette-rgb")
          local shade=.16+.65*(.2126*color[1]+.7152*color[2]+.0722*color[3])
          local result={}
          for i=1,3 do
            assert(base[i]>=0 and base[i]<=1,"collection-palette-range")
            result[i]=1-intensity*(1-base[i])*(1-shade)
          end
          op.paint[key]=result
        end
      end
    end
    operations[#operations+1]=op
  end
  out.operations=operations
  out.operation_segments=nil
  out.operation_count=nil
  return P.snapshot(out)
end

-- Outline paths and logical text undergo the same positive uniform placement.
function M.page(bounds,panels)
  assert(#panels>0 and #panels<=32,"collection-panel-count")
  local vectors,logical,fonts,order=P.array(),P.array(),{},P.array()
  local ids={}
  for _,panel in ipairs(panels) do
    assert(type(panel.id)=="string" and not ids[panel.id],"collection-panel-identity")
    ids[panel.id]=true
    complete_text(panel.plan)
    local plan=P.plain(panel.plan)
    local b,slot=plan.bounds,panel.bounds
    local scale=math.min((slot[3]-slot[1])/(b[3]-b[1]),(slot[4]-slot[2])/(b[4]-b[2]))
    assert(scale>0,"collection-positive-placement")
    local m={scale,0,0,scale,(slot[1]+slot[3]-scale*(b[1]+b[3]))/2,
      (slot[2]+slot[4]-scale*(b[2]+b[4]))/2}
    for _,font in ipairs(plan.fonts) do
      assert(not fonts[font.id] or P.serialize(fonts[font.id])==P.serialize(font),"collection-font-collision")
      fonts[font.id]=font
    end
    for _,text in ipairs(plan.text) do
      text.semantic_ref=panel.id.."/"..text.semantic_ref
      text.transform=G.compose(m,text.transform or identity)
      logical[#logical+1]=text
      order[#order+1]=text.semantic_ref
    end
    local ops=P.array()
    for operation in V.operations(panel.plan) do
      local op=P.plain(operation)
      if op.semantic_ref then op.semantic_ref=panel.id.."/"..op.semantic_ref end
      ops[#ops+1]=op
    end
    plan.operations=ops
    plan.operation_segments=nil
    plan.operation_count=nil
    plan.text=P.array()
    plan.reading_order=P.array()
    plan.fonts=P.array()
    vectors[#vectors+1]={plan=plan,bounds=slot}
  end
  local out=P.plain(V.compose_vectors(bounds,vectors))
  out.text,out.reading_order=logical,order
  local names={}
  for id in pairs(fonts) do names[#names+1]=id end
  table.sort(names,P.byte_less)
  out.fonts=P.array()
  for _,id in ipairs(names) do out.fonts[#out.fonts+1]=fonts[id] end
  return P.snapshot(out)
end

local function polygon(cell,edges,vertices,convex)
  local ring={}
  for _,use in ipairs(cell.boundary) do
    local edge=assert(edges[use.edge],"collection-missing-edge")
    ring[#ring+1]=assert(vertices[use.reversed and edge.to or edge.from],"collection-missing-vertex")
  end
  local center={0,0}
  for _,p in ipairs(ring) do center[1]=center[1]+p[1]/#ring;center[2]=center[2]+p[2]/#ring end
  if convex then
    for i,a in ipairs(ring) do
      local b=ring[i%#ring+1]
      for j,p in ipairs(ring) do
        if j~=i and j~=i%#ring+1 then
          assert(require("pattern_predicates").orient2d(a,b,p)>0,"collection-strictly-convex-ccw-cell")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return center
end

-- A typed decoration overlay retains the certified tiling and global frame.
-- Each edge supplies one midpoint port, with opposite inward normal tangents.
function M.decorate(instance,view,definition,scene,color)
  local before=P.serialize(instance)
  local t=assert(instance.structures.tiling,"collection-tiling-required")
  local vertices,edges={},{}
  for _,v in ipairs(t.vertices) do vertices[v.id]=v.point end
  for _,e in ipairs(t.edges) do edges[e.id]=e end
  local out=P.plain(scene)
  local ports,centers=P.array(),P.array()
  local owners={}
  for _,cell in ipairs(t.cells) do
    local center=polygon(cell,edges,vertices,true)
    centers[#centers+1]={cell=cell.id,point=center,chirality=cell.chirality}
    for _,use in ipairs(cell.boundary) do
      local edge=edges[use.edge]
      local a,b=vertices[edge.from],vertices[edge.to]
      local dx,dy=b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2]
      local length=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
      assert(length>.01,"collection-port-edge-length")
      local sign=use.reversed and -1 or 1
      local normal={-sign*dy/length,sign*dx/length}
      local midpoint={(a[1]+b[1])/2,(a[2]+b[2])/2}
      local h=(center[1]-midpoint[1])*normal[1]+(center[2]-midpoint[2])*normal[2]
      assert(h>0,"collection-port-interior")
      local p={edge=edge.id,cell=cell.id,point=midpoint,inward=normal,
        width_cm=.012,kind="normal-tangent-motif",frame=instance.frame.id}
      local prior=owners[edge.id]
      if prior then
        assert(not prior.paired and prior.cell~=cell.id,"collection-port-incidence")
        assert(P.serialize(prior.point)==P.serialize(midpoint) and prior.inward[1]==-normal[1]
          and prior.inward[2]==-normal[2],"collection-shared-edge-port")
        prior.paired=true
        p.paired=true
      else owners[edge.id]=p end
      ports[#ports+1]=p
      out.operations[#out.operations+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=cell.id,transform=P.plain(view.transform),
        commands={{"M",midpoint[1],midpoint[2]},
          {"C",midpoint[1]+normal[1]*h*.6,midpoint[2]+normal[2]*h*.6,
            center[1]*.85+midpoint[1]*.15,center[2]*.85+midpoint[2]*.15,center[1],center[2]}},
        paint={stroke=color,stroke_width=.012,cap="round"}}
    end
  end
  assert(P.serialize(instance)==before,"collection-decoration-mutated-tiling")
  return P.scene(out,instance,view,definition),P.snapshot({source_sha256=H.sha256(before),
    kind="cell-compass-stars-v1",ports=ports,centers=centers,frame=P.plain(instance.frame)})
end

function M.detail(registry,definition,instance,view,style,context)
  local before=P.serialize(instance)
  local scene=registry:lower(definition.id,instance,view,style,context)
  local out=P.plain(scene)
  local annotations=P.array()
  local t=assert(instance.structures.tiling,"collection-detail-tiling-required")
  assert(t.hierarchy and #t.hierarchy>0,"collection-detail-hierarchy-required")
  local vertices,edges={},{}
  local centers={}
  for _,v in ipairs(t.vertices) do vertices[v.id]=v.point end
  for _,e in ipairs(t.edges) do edges[e.id]=e end
  for _,cell in ipairs(t.cells) do
    local center=polygon(cell,edges,vertices,false)
    centers[cell.id]=center
    local r=.035
    out.operations[#out.operations+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=cell.id,transform=P.plain(view.transform),
      commands={{"M",center[1]-r,center[2]},{"L",center[1]+r,center[2]},
        {"M",center[1],center[2]-r},{"L",center[1],center[2]+r}},
      paint={stroke={.55,.20,.15},stroke_width=.008}}
    annotations[#annotations+1]={ref=cell.id,point=center,prototype=cell.prototype,
      chirality=cell.chirality,parent=cell.parent,lineage_label=cell.lineage_label}
  end
  local nodes={}
  for _,node in ipairs(t.hierarchy) do nodes[node.id]=node end
  local active={}
  local function center(id)
    if centers[id] then return centers[id] end
    assert(not active[id],"collection-hierarchy-cycle")
    active[id]=true
    local node=assert(nodes[id],"collection-hierarchy-child")
    assert(#node.children>0,"collection-hierarchy-empty")
    local p={0,0}
    for _,child in ipairs(node.children) do
      local q=center(child)
      p[1],p[2]=p[1]+q[1]/#node.children,p[2]+q[2]/#node.children
    end
    centers[id]=p
    active[id]=nil
    return p
  end
  local groups=P.array()
  for _,node in ipairs(t.hierarchy) do
    local p=center(node.id)
    groups[#groups+1]={ref=node.id,point=p,children=P.plain(node.children),level=node.level,parent=node.parent}
    local commands=P.array()
    for _,child in ipairs(node.children) do
      local q=center(child)
      commands[#commands+1]={"M",p[1],p[2]}
      commands[#commands+1]={"L",q[1],q[2]}
    end
    local r=.04+.025*node.level
    commands[#commands+1]={"M",p[1]-r,p[2]}
    commands[#commands+1]={"L",p[1],p[2]+r}
    commands[#commands+1]={"L",p[1]+r,p[2]}
    commands[#commands+1]={"L",p[1],p[2]-r}
    commands[#commands+1]={"Z"}
    out.operations[#out.operations+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=node.id,transform=P.plain(view.transform),
      commands=commands,paint={stroke={.55,.20,.15},stroke_width=.008,dash={array={.04,.03},phase=0}}}
  end
  assert(P.serialize(instance)==before,"collection-detail-mutated-source")
  return P.scene(out,instance,view,definition),P.snapshot({source_sha256=H.sha256(before),
    annotations=annotations,groups=groups,hierarchy=P.plain(t.hierarchy),view_sha256=H.value("collection/view",view)})
end

function M.compatibility(options)
  for k in pairs(options) do
    assert(k=="density" or k=="intensity" or k=="theme" or k=="ornament","collection-unsupported-control:"..k)
  end
  local density=options.density
  if density~=nil then density=require("layout").resolve({density=density}).density end
  local intensity=options.intensity or 1
  assert(type(intensity)=="number" and intensity>=0 and intensity<=1,"collection-intensity-range")
  assert(options.theme==nil or options.theme=="botanical" or options.theme=="compass","collection-unsupported-theme")
  assert(options.ornament==nil or options.ornament=="leaf" or options.ornament=="flower" or options.ornament=="divider",
    "collection-unsupported-ornament")
  return {legacy_density=density,intensity=intensity,theme=options.theme or "botanical",ornament=options.ornament}
end

function M.legacy_geometry(geometry,options)
  local controls=M.compatibility(options)
  assert(controls.theme=="botanical" and controls.ornament==nil and options.intensity==nil,
    "collection-legacy-control-scope")
  local out=P.plain(geometry)
  local layout=P.plain(out.layout or {})
  if controls.legacy_density then layout.density=controls.legacy_density end
  out.layout=require("layout").resolve(layout)
  return out
end

function M.controlled_plan(result,definition,options,palette)
  local controls=M.compatibility(options)
  assert(controls.legacy_density==nil and controls.ornament==nil,
    "collection-density-is-generation-and-inline-needs-asset-recipe")
  local scene=result.scene
  if controls.theme=="compass" then
    scene=M.decorate(result.instance,result.view,definition,scene,{.98,.94,.84})
  else
    assert(result.instance.structures.growth or result.instance.structures.strands,
      "collection-botanical-theme-requires-declared-growth-or-hybrid")
  end
  local colors=P.plain(palette)
  colors.intensity=controls.intensity
  return M.palette(V.plan(scene,result.instance,result.view,definition),colors)
end

function M.inline(kind,size,seed,angle)
  assert(kind=="leaf" or kind=="flower" or kind=="divider","collection-unsupported-ornament")
  assert(type(angle)=="number" and math.abs(angle)<=180,"collection-inline-angle")
  local d=require("pattern_collection_assets").definition()
  local radians=angle*math.pi/180
  local a,b=math.cos(radians),math.sin(radians)
  return require("pattern_recipe").from_specification(d,{
    id="collection/inline-"..kind,definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},seed=seed,
    parameters={size=size},inputs={kind=kind},style={},constraints={},
    budget={objects=70000,operations=4000000,bytes=64*1024*1024},
    document={unit="cm",bounds={0,0,4,4},protected_regions=P.array()}},
    {unit="cm",transform={a,b,-b,a,2-2*a+2*b,2-2*b-2*a},crop={0,0,4,4},
      protected_regions=P.array(),derived=false,validity="construction_preserved"},2)
end

function M.record(members,products)
  local out={schema="florilegium-original-collection@1",version=M.VERSION,
    members=P.array(),products=P.plain(products)}
  local ids={}
  for _,member in ipairs(members) do
    assert(type(member.id)=="string" and #member.id<=64 and member.id:match("^[%w_-]+$")
      and not ids[member.id],"collection-member-id")
    ids[member.id]=true
    local encoded=require("pattern_recipe").encode(member.recipe)
    out.members[#out.members+1]={id=member.id,recipe_file=member.id..".recipe",recipe_sha256=H.sha256(encoded),
      instance_file=member.id..".instance",instance_sha256=H.sha256(P.serialize(member.instance)),
      validation=P.plain(member.validation)}
  end
  return P.serialize(out)
end

function M.replay(bytes,registry,environment,resolve)
  assert(type(resolve)=="function","collection-data-resolver-required")
  local data=require("pattern_parse").decode(bytes)
  assert(data.schema=="florilegium-original-collection@1" and data.version==M.VERSION,
    "collection-record-version")
  local results,plans={},{}
  local Q,R=require("pattern_recipe"),require("pattern_registry")
  for _,member in ipairs(data.members) do
    assert(type(member.id)=="string" and #member.id<=64 and member.id:match("^[%w_-]+$")
      and member.recipe_file==member.id..".recipe" and member.instance_file==member.id..".instance",
      "collection-member-file")
    local recipe,instance=resolve(member.recipe_file),resolve(member.instance_file)
    assert(not results[member.id] and H.sha256(recipe)==member.recipe_sha256
      and H.sha256(instance)==member.instance_sha256,"collection-member-integrity")
    local result=Q.execute(Q.decode(recipe),registry,environment)
    assert(result.record.status=="complete" and result.bytes.instance==instance,"collection-member-replay")
    results[member.id]=result
  end
  for _,render in ipairs(data.products.renders) do
    assert(not plans[render.id],"collection-render-id")
    local result=assert(results[render.member],"collection-render-member")
    local definition=registry:definition(result.instance.definition_ref.id)
    local view=render.view and P.view(render.view,result.instance,definition) or result.view
    local context=R.context({seed=result.instance.provenance.seed,source={revision="collection/replay"},
      frame=P.plain(result.instance.frame),limits={objects=70000,operations=4000000,bytes=64*1024*1024}})
    local scene=registry:lower(definition.id,result.instance,view,render.style or {},context)
    if render.overlay=="ports" then
      scene=M.decorate(result.instance,view,definition,scene,{.98,.94,.84})
    elseif render.overlay=="detail" then
      scene=M.detail(registry,definition,result.instance,view,render.style or {},context)
    else assert(render.overlay==nil,"collection-overlay-kind") end
    plans[render.id]=M.palette(V.plan(scene,result.instance,view,definition),data.products.palette)
  end
  local pages=P.array()
  for _,page in ipairs(data.products.pages) do
    local panels=P.array()
    for _,p in ipairs(page.panels) do
      panels[#panels+1]={id=p.id,plan=assert(plans[p.render_ref],"collection-page-render"),bounds=p.bounds}
    end
    pages[#pages+1]=M.page(page.bounds,panels)
  end
  return {plans=plans,pages=pages}
end

return M
source.pattern_collection_assets.lua:
local P=require("pattern")
local M={}
local kinds={leaf=true,flower=true,divider=true,initial=true,folio=true}

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="collection/ornament",version="1",family="original-collection-asset",
    units="cm",capabilities={"growth","text"},
    parameters={size={type="number",minimum=.2,maximum=2}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=false,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Native original botanical primitives","Upright font outlines and logical text labels"}})
end

local function input(s)
  for k in pairs(s.inputs) do assert(k=="kind" or k=="text" or k=="font","collection-asset-input") end
  assert(next(P.plain(s.constraints))==nil,"collection-asset-constraints")
  local kind=s.inputs.kind
  assert(kinds[kind],"collection-asset-kind")
  local text=s.inputs.text or ""
  assert(type(text)=="string" and utf8.len(text) and #text<=16,"collection-asset-text")
  if kind=="initial" or kind=="folio" then
    assert(#text>0 and (kind~="initial" or utf8.len(text)==1),"collection-label-length")
    assert(type(s.inputs.font)=="table","collection-label-font")
  else assert(text=="","collection-ornament-has-no-text") end
  return kind,text
end

function M.register(registry)
  local d=M.definition()
  registry:register(d,{validate_inputs=function(s) input(s);return true end,
    generate=function(s,c)
      local kind,text=input(s)
      local size=s.parameters.size or 1
      local ink,flora=require("ink"),require("flora")
      local ops=ink.capture(function()
        ink.set_ink(.13,.27,.35);ink.set_accent(.62,.36,.21);ink.set_lift(0);ink.set_color_mode("color")
        ink.translate(2,1.6)
        if kind=="flower" then flora.flower(ink.rng(s.seed),size*.65)
        elseif kind=="divider" then flora.divider(ink.rng(s.seed),size)
        else
          ink.push();ink.translate(-.7,-.5);ink.scale(size*.9)
          flora.leaf(ink.rng(s.seed),{w=.32,bend=.12,lobes=3,depth=.3,tone=.35})
          ink.pop()
        end
      end)
      c:consume("operations",#ops)
      c:consume("objects",#ops)
      for _,op in ipairs(ops) do if op.op=="path" then op.semantic_ref="asset/root" end end
      local runs,order=P.array(),P.array()
      if #text>0 then
        runs[1]={id="asset/label",text=text,direction="ltr"}
        order[1]="asset/label"
      end
      return {id=s.id.."/asset",definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),
        structures={growth={nodes={{id="asset/root",point={2,1.6},motif=kind}},roots={"asset/root"}},
          text={runs=runs,reading_order=order}},
        provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction="original-collection-asset-v1"},
        extensions={collection_asset={kind=kind,size=size,operations=ops,font=s.inputs.font and P.plain(s.inputs.font)}}}
    end,
    validate=function(x)
      assert(kinds[x.extensions.collection_asset.kind] and #x.extensions.collection_asset.operations>0,
        "collection-asset-empty")
      return {ok=true,checks={"Native botanical primitive emitted neutral paths","Declared upright label semantics"}}
    end,
    lower=function(x,v,style)
      assert(next(style)==nil,"collection-asset-style-use-shared-palette")
      local e=x.extensions.collection_asset
      local ops=P.plain(e.operations)
      local geom=require("pattern_geometry")
      for _,op in ipairs(ops) do
        if op.op~="pop_clip" then op.transform=geom.compose(P.plain(v.transform),op.transform or {1,0,0,1,0,0}) end
      end
      local resources=P.array()
      for _,run in ipairs(x.structures.text.runs) do
        local cmap={}
        for _,g in ipairs(e.font.glyphs) do cmap[g.unicode]=g end
        local glyphs=P.array()
        local advance=0
        for _,cp in utf8.codes(run.text) do
          local glyph=assert(cmap[utf8.char(cp)],"collection-label-unsupported-glyph")
          glyphs[#glyphs+1]={glyph_ref=glyph.id,offset={advance,0}}
          advance=advance+glyph.advance*e.size/e.font.units_per_em
        end
        assert(advance<=2.8,"collection-label-too-wide")
        ops[#ops+1]={op="text",semantic_ref=run.id,text=run.text,font_ref=e.font.id,
          origin={2-advance/2,1.7},size=e.size,glyphs=glyphs,transform=P.plain(v.transform),
          paint={fill={.13,.27,.35}}}
        resources[1]=P.plain(e.font)
      end
      return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
        operations=ops,resources=resources,reading_order=P.plain(x.structures.text.reading_order),
        clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)}}
    end})
  return d
end

return M

-- Cubic services and certified line-root isolation. General cubic/cubic
-- intersection remains an explicit unsupported operation, never an empty hit set.
local G,N,P=require("pattern_geometry"),require("pattern_predicates"),require("pattern")
local C={VERSION="cubic-bernstein-v1"};local eps=2^-52
local function controls(c)
  assert(type(c)=="table" and #c==4,"four cubic Bezier controls required")
  for k in pairs(c) do assert(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=4,"dense cubic control array required; weighted/rational curves are unsupported") end
  local out={};for i,p in ipairs(c) do out[i]=G.point(p) end;return out
end
local function lerp(a,b,t) return {(1-t)*a[1]+t*b[1],(1-t)*a[2]+t*b[2]} end
local function parameter(t) assert(type(t)=="number" and t>=0 and t<=1,"curve parameter must be in [0,1]") end
function C.evaluate(c,t)
  c=controls(c);parameter(t)
  if t==0 then return c[1] elseif t==1 then return c[4] end
  local a,b,d=lerp(c[1],c[2],t),lerp(c[2],c[3],t),lerp(c[3],c[4],t)
  return G.point(lerp(lerp(a,b,t),lerp(b,d,t),t))
end
function C.split(c,t)
  c=controls(c);parameter(t)
  local a,b,d=lerp(c[1],c[2],t),lerp(c[2],c[3],t),lerp(c[3],c[4],t)
  local e,f=lerp(a,b,t),lerp(b,d,t);local m=lerp(e,f,t)
  return {c[1],a,e,m},{m,f,d,c[4]}
end
function C.bounds(c,policy)
  c=controls(c);local out={c[1][1],c[1][2],c[1][1],c[1][2]}
  for _,p in ipairs(c) do out[1]=math.min(out[1],p[1]);out[2]=math.min(out[2],p[2]);out[3]=math.max(out[3],p[1]);out[4]=math.max(out[4],p[2]) end
  local pad=G.tolerance(policy,c)
  return {out[1]-pad,out[2]-pad,out[3]+pad,out[4]+pad},{method="convex_control_hull",absolute_padding=pad}
end
function C.tight_bounds(c,policy)
  c=controls(c);local points={c[1],c[4]};local fallback=false
  for axis=1,2 do
    local p,q,r,s=c[1][axis],c[2][axis],c[3][axis],c[4][axis]
    local a,b,d=-p+3*q-3*r+s,2*(p-2*q+r),q-p
    local scale=math.max(math.abs(a),math.abs(b),math.abs(d))
    if scale>0 then
      a,b,d=a/scale,b/scale,d/scale;local roots={}
      if a==0 then if b~=0 then roots[1]=-d/b end
      else
        local disc=b*b-4*a*d;local error=32*eps*(b*b+math.abs(4*a*d))
        if math.abs(disc)<=error then fallback=true
        elseif disc>0 then
          local v=-0.5*(b+(b>=0 and 1 or -1)*math.sqrt(disc));roots={v/a,d/v}
        end
      end
      for _,t in ipairs(roots) do if t>0 and t<1 then points[#points+1]=C.evaluate(c,t) end end
    end
  end
  if fallback then local box,receipt=C.bounds(c,policy);receipt.reason="near_multiple_extremum_uses_conservative_hull";return box,receipt end
  local box={points[1][1],points[1][2],points[1][1],points[1][2]}
  for _,p in ipairs(points) do box[1]=math.min(box[1],p[1]);box[2]=math.min(box[2],p[2]);box[3]=math.max(box[3],p[1]);box[4]=math.max(box[4],p[2]) end
  local pad=G.tolerance(policy,c)
  return {box[1]-pad,box[2]-pad,box[3]+pad,box[4]+pad},{method="analytic_derivative_extrema",absolute_padding=pad}
end
local function distance(a,b) return math.sqrt((a[1]-b[1])^2+(a[2]-b[2])^2) end
local function coeff_split(f)
  local a,b,c=N.expansion_half_add(f[1],f[2]),N.expansion_half_add(f[2],f[3]),N.expansion_half_add(f[3],f[4])
  local d,e=N.expansion_half_add(a,b),N.expansion_half_add(b,c);local m=N.expansion_half_add(d,e)
  return {f[1],a,d,m},{m,e,c,f[4]}
end
function C.intersect_segment(c,a,b,policy,options)
  c=controls(c);a,b=G.point(a),G.point(b);options=options or {}
  for k in pairs(options) do assert(k=="max_depth" or k=="max_nodes","unknown curve query option") end
  assert(a[1]~=b[1] or a[2]~=b[2],"curve intersection requires nonzero segment")
  local tolerance=G.tolerance(policy,{c[1],c[2],c[3],c[4],a,b})
  local magnitude=policy.scale;local speed=0
  for i,p in ipairs(c) do magnitude=math.max(magnitude,math.abs(p[1]),math.abs(p[2]));if i>1 then speed=math.max(speed,3*distance(c[i-1],p)) end end
  if speed==0 then return {status="degenerate",reason="constant_curve",events=P.array(),tolerance=tolerance} end
  local paramtol=math.min(1,tolerance/(4*math.max(speed,tolerance)))
  local maxdepth=options.max_depth or 48;local budget=options.max_nodes or 10000
  assert(type(maxdepth)=="number" and type(budget)=="number" and maxdepth%1==0 and maxdepth>=1 and maxdepth<=48 and budget%1==0 and budget>=1 and budget<=1000000,"invalid curve root budget")
  local roots,unresolved={},P.array();local exact_roots={};local visited=0
  local function exact(t,multiplicity)
    if not exact_roots[t] then roots[#roots+1]={lo=t,hi=t,classification=multiplicity%2==0 and "tangent" or "crossing",multiplicity=multiplicity};exact_roots[t]=true end
  end
  local function visit(f,lo,hi,depth)
    visited=visited+1
    if visited>budget then unresolved[#unresolved+1]={interval={lo,hi},reason="root_node_budget"};return end
    local signs={};local changes,previous=0,nil;local nonzero=false
    for i,e in ipairs(f) do local s=N.expansion_sign(e);signs[i]=s;if s~=0 then nonzero=true;if previous and previous~=s then changes=changes+1 end;previous=s end end
    if not nonzero then unresolved[#unresolved+1]={interval={lo,hi},reason="coincident_curve_and_line"};return end
    if signs[1]==0 then local j=2;while signs[j]==0 do j=j+1 end;exact(lo,j-1) end
    if signs[4]==0 then local j=3;while signs[j]==0 do j=j-1 end;exact(hi,4-j) end
    if changes==0 then return end
    if changes==1 and signs[1]*signs[4]<0 and hi-lo<=paramtol then roots[#roots+1]={lo=lo,hi=hi,classification="crossing",multiplicity=1};return end
    if depth==maxdepth then unresolved[#unresolved+1]={interval={lo,hi},reason="near_tangent_or_multiple_root"};return end
    local left,right=coeff_split(f);local mid=(lo+hi)/2
    visit(left,lo,mid,depth+1);visit(right,mid,hi,depth+1)
  end
  visit(N.cubic_line_coefficients(c,a,b),0,1,0)
  table.sort(roots,function(x,y)return x.lo<y.lo end)
  local events=P.array();local previous
  for _,root in ipairs(roots) do
    if previous and root.lo<=previous.hi then unresolved[#unresolved+1]={interval={previous.lo,root.hi},reason="unseparated_roots"} end;previous=root
    local t=(root.lo+root.hi)/2;local p=C.evaluate(c,t);local u=G.parameter(p,a,b)
    local error=speed*(root.hi-root.lo)/2+16*eps*magnitude
    if root.lo==root.hi and (t==0 or t==1) then error=0 end
    local margin=error/distance(a,b)
    if u>=0 and u<=1 and (u>margin and u<1-margin or error==0) then
      events[#events+1]={point=p,curve_parameter=t,curve_interval={root.lo,root.hi},segment_parameter=u,classification=(t==0 or t==1) and "endpoint" or root.classification,multiplicity=root.multiplicity,error_bound=error}
    elseif u>=-margin and u<=1+margin then unresolved[#unresolved+1]={interval={root.lo,root.hi},reason="finite_segment_endpoint_precision"} end
  end
  return {status=#unresolved==0 and "complete" or "unresolved",empty=#events==0 and #unresolved==0,events=events,unresolved=unresolved,tolerance=tolerance,nodes=visited,method="exact_bernstein_sign_isolation"}
end
function C.intersect_cubics()
  error("general cubic/cubic intersection is unsupported; use certified cubic/segment queries or an explicitly validated solver",0)
end
return C
