-- Local/global ARAP over a connected weighted vertex graph.
local M = {}

function M.solve(rest, edges, pins, initial, iterations)
  local positions, adjacency, rotations = {}, {}, {}
  for i, p in ipairs(initial) do
    positions[i] = pins[i] or {p[1], p[2]}
    adjacency[i] = {}
  end
  assert(next(pins), "ARAP requires positional anchors")
  for _, edge in ipairs(edges) do
    local i, j, w = table.unpack(edge)
    assert(i ~= j and adjacency[i] and adjacency[j] and w > 0, "invalid ARAP edge")
    adjacency[i][#adjacency[i] + 1] = {j, w}
    adjacency[j][#adjacency[j] + 1] = {i, w}
  end
  local seen, queue = {}, {}
  for i in pairs(pins) do seen[i] = true; queue[#queue + 1] = i end
  local at = 1
  while queue[at] do
    for _, edge in ipairs(adjacency[queue[at]]) do
      local j = edge[1]
      if not seen[j] then seen[j] = true; queue[#queue + 1] = j end
    end
    at = at + 1
  end
  assert(#queue == #positions, "unanchored ARAP component")
  local function fit_rotations()
    for i, links in ipairs(adjacency) do
      local dot, cross = 0, 0
      for _, edge in ipairs(links) do
        local j, w = table.unpack(edge)
        local ux, uy = rest[i][1] - rest[j][1], rest[i][2] - rest[j][2]
        local vx, vy = positions[i][1] - positions[j][1], positions[i][2] - positions[j][2]
        dot = dot + w * (ux * vx + uy * vy)
        cross = cross + w * (ux * vy - uy * vx)
      end
      local norm = math.sqrt(dot * dot + cross * cross)
      rotations[i] = norm > 1e-12 and {dot / norm, cross / norm} or {1, 0}
    end
  end
  local function target(i, j)
    local ux, uy = rest[i][1] - rest[j][1], rest[i][2] - rest[j][2]
    local a = (rotations[i][1] + rotations[j][1]) / 2
    local b = (rotations[i][2] + rotations[j][2]) / 2
    return a * ux - b * uy, b * ux + a * uy
  end
  local function update(i, links)
    local x, y, weight = 0, 0, 0
    for _, edge in ipairs(links) do
      local j, w = table.unpack(edge)
      local tx, ty = target(i, j)
      x = x + w * (positions[j][1] + tx)
      y = y + w * (positions[j][2] + ty)
      weight = weight + w
    end
    return x / weight, y / weight
  end
  for _ = 1, iterations do
    fit_rotations()
    for _ = 1, 16 do
      for i, links in ipairs(adjacency) do
        if not pins[i] then positions[i] = {update(i, links)} end
      end
    end
  end
  fit_rotations()
  local residual = 0
  for i, links in ipairs(adjacency) do
    if not pins[i] then
      local x, y = update(i, links)
      residual = math.max(residual, math.abs(x - positions[i][1]), math.abs(y - positions[i][2]))
    end
  end
  return positions, {iterations = iterations, residual = residual}
end

return M
source.pattern_deco_cut.lua:
-- Exact integral s/t cut over the overlap lattice.
local M = {}

function M.solve(width, height, capacity)
  assert(width >= 2 and height >= 1 and width * height <= 4096, "invalid overlap lattice")
  local count = width * height
  local source, sink = count + 1, count + 2
  local graph, links, total = {}, {}, 0
  for i = 1, sink do graph[i] = {} end
  local function arc(a, b, cost, back)
    local e = {to = b, remaining = cost}
    local r = {to = a, remaining = back}
    e.reverse, r.reverse = r, e
    graph[a][#graph[a] + 1] = e
    graph[b][#graph[b] + 1] = r
  end
  local function connect(a, b)
    local forward, backward = capacity(a, b), capacity(b, a)
    assert(forward >= 0 and forward % 1 == 0 and backward >= 0 and backward % 1 == 0)
    arc(a, b, forward, backward)
    links[#links + 1] = {a, b, forward, backward}
    total = total + forward + backward
  end
  for y = 1, height do
    for x = 1, width do
      local i = (y - 1) * width + x
      if x < width then connect(i, i + 1) end
      if y < height then connect(i, i + width) end
    end
  end
  local forced = total + 1
  for y = 1, height do
    arc(source, (y - 1) * width + 1, forced, 0)
    arc(y * width, sink, forced, 0)
  end
  local function layers()
    local levels, queue = {[source] = 0}, {source}
    local i = 1
    while queue[i] do
      local a = queue[i]
      for _, e in ipairs(graph[a]) do
        if e.remaining > 0 and not levels[e.to] then
          levels[e.to] = levels[a] + 1
          queue[#queue + 1] = e.to
        end
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return levels
  end
  local flow, levels = 0, layers()
  while levels[sink] do
    local next_arc = {}
    local function send(a, amount)
      if a == sink then return amount end
      local i = next_arc[a] or 1
      while graph[a][i] do
        local e = graph[a][i]
        if e.remaining > 0 and levels[e.to] == levels[a] + 1 then
          local used = send(e.to, math.min(amount, e.remaining))
          if used > 0 then
            e.remaining = e.remaining - used
            e.reverse.remaining = e.reverse.remaining + used
            return used
          end
        end
        i = i + 1
        next_arc[a] = i
      end
      return 0
    end
    local pushed = send(source, forced)
    while pushed > 0 do
      flow = flow + pushed
      pushed = send(source, forced)
    end
    levels = layers()
  end
  local labels, cost, straight = {}, 0, 0
  for i = 1, count do labels[i] = levels[i] ~= nil end
  local function middle(i) return (i - 1) % width < math.floor(width / 2) end
  local function contribution(a, b, f, r) return a == b and 0 or (a and f or r) end
  for _, edge in ipairs(links) do
    local a, b, f, r = table.unpack(edge)
    cost = cost + contribution(labels[a], labels[b], f, r)
    straight = straight + contribution(middle(a), middle(b), f, r)
  end
  assert(flow == cost and cost <= straight, "cut certificate mismatch")
  return labels, {flow = flow, energy = cost, straight_energy = straight}
end

return M
source.pattern_deco_field.lua:
local SDF = require("pattern_deco_sdf")
local Match = require("pattern_deco_match")
local Mesh = require("pattern_deco_mesh")
local Cut = require("pattern_deco_cut")
local M = {}

local function guide_stations(points)
  local angles, stations = {}, {}
  for i = 2, #points do
    local dx, dy = points[i][1]-points[i-1][1], points[i][2]-points[i-1][2]
    assert(dx*dx+dy*dy > 1e-12, "duplicate guide station")
    local angle = math.atan(dy,dx)
    local prior = angles[i-2]
    if prior then angle = prior + (angle-prior+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi end
    angles[i-1] = angle
  end
  local arc = 0
  for i,p in ipairs(points) do
    local a = angles[i-1] or angles[i]
    local b = angles[i] or a
    assert(math.abs(a-b) < math.pi/2, "guide bend exceeds chart limit")
    if i > 1 then
      local dx,dy = p[1]-points[i-1][1],p[2]-points[i-1][2]
      arc = arc + math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
    end
    local turn = (a+b)/2
    assert(p[3] > 0, "guide width must be positive")
    stations[i] = {x=p[1],y=p[2],arc=arc,turn=turn,width=p[3],
      nx=-math.sin(turn),ny=math.cos(turn)}
  end
  return stations
end

local function interpolate(stations, t)
  local i = math.min(#stations-1, math.floor(t))
  local a,b = stations[i],stations[i+1]
  local f = t-i
  local function mix(k) return a[k]+f*(b[k]-a[k]) end
  local turn = mix("turn")
  return {x=mix("x"),y=mix("y"),arc=mix("arc"),width=mix("width"),
    nx=-math.sin(turn),ny=math.cos(turn)}
end

function M.synthesize(points, exemplars, options)
  assert(#points >= 3 and #points <= 65 and #exemplars > 0 and #exemplars <= 32, "guide or library size out of range")
  local subdivisions, height = options.subdivisions, options.rows
  assert(subdivisions >= 4 and subdivisions <= 32 and subdivisions%1 == 0, "invalid guide sampling")
  assert(height >= 4 and height <= 65 and height%1 == 0, "invalid rib sampling")
  local stations, library = guide_stations(points), {}
  for i, piece in ipairs(exemplars) do
    local sample = SDF.prepare(piece.primitives)
    local entry, leave = {}, {}
    for j = 1, 9 do
      local y = (j-5)*piece.width/8
      entry[j], leave[j] = sample(0,y), sample(piece.length,y)
    end
    library[i] = {sample=sample,length=piece.length,width=piece.width,turn=piece.turn,
      role=piece.role,entry_profile=entry,exit_profile=leave}
  end
  local matches, cost = Match.match(stations, library, options.match)
  if not matches then return nil, cost end
  local width = (#points-1)*subdivisions+1
  local grid, evidence = {}, {}
  for _, match in ipairs(matches) do
    local piece = library[match.piece]
    local first,last = match.first,match.last
    local start_arc = stations[first].arc
    local scale = piece.length/(stations[last].arc-start_arc)
    local ribs = {}
    -- Extend each match by half a guide interval at internal joints.
    for twice = math.max(2,2*first-1),math.min(2*#points,2*last+1) do
      local s = interpolate(stations, twice/2)
      s.u = (s.arc-start_arc)*scale
      ribs[#ribs+1] = s
    end
    local mesh, diagnostic = Mesh.fit(ribs,piece.width/2,options.iterations,options.distortion)
    if not mesh then return nil, diagnostic end
    evidence[#evidence+1] = mesh.evidence
    match.mesh = mesh
  end
  local half = math.floor(subdivisions/4)
  local function sample(match,p)
    local u,v = Mesh.inverse(match.mesh,p.x,p.y)
    if not u then return {distance=options.outside} end
    local source = library[match.piece]
    return {distance=source.sample(u,v),piece=match.piece,u=u,v=v}
  end
  local seams, overlap = {}, {}
  local active = 1
  for x = 1,width do
    local right = matches[active+1]
    local center = right and ((right.first-1)*subdivisions+1)
    if center and x > center+half then active = active+1; center = nil end
    local s = interpolate(stations,1+(x-1)/subdivisions)
    for y = 1,height do
      local i = (y-1)*width+x
      local t = ((y-1)/(height-1)-.5)*s.width
      local p = {x=s.x+s.nx*t,y=s.y+s.ny*t}
      grid[i] = p
      p.source = sample(matches[active],p)
      if center and x >= center-half then
        local data = overlap[active] or {}
        overlap[active] = data
        data[(y-1)*(2*half+1)+x-center+half+1] = {i=i,left=p.source,right=sample(right,p)}
      end
    end
  end
  for j,data in ipairs(overlap) do
    local labels, proof = Cut.solve(2*half+1,height,function(a,b)
      local l,r = data[a].left.distance,data[b].right.distance
      local ink = math.max(0,-l)+math.max(0,-r)
      return 1+math.floor(1000*(math.abs(l-r)+ink)+.5)
    end)
    local indices = {}
    for i,pair in ipairs(data) do
      indices[i] = pair.i
      grid[pair.i].source = labels[i] and pair.left or pair.right
    end
    seams[j] = {indices=indices,labels=labels,certificate=proof}
  end
  return {width=width,height=height,grid=grid,seams=seams,matches=matches,
    deformation=evidence,match_cost=cost}
end

return M
source.pattern_deco_match.lua:
-- Dynamic programming over guide intervals, retaining the preceding source piece.
local M = {}

local function seam(left, right)
  local cost = 0
  for i, value in ipairs(left.exit_profile) do
    cost = cost + (value - right.entry_profile[i])^2
  end
  return cost / #left.exit_profile
end

function M.match(guide, library, limits)
  local states = {[1] = {{cost = 0}}}
  for first = 1, #guide - 1 do
    for _, prev in ipairs(states[first] or {}) do
      for index, piece in ipairs(library) do
        for count = limits.min_steps, limits.max_steps do
          local last = first + count
          if last <= #guide
            and (piece.role == "start") == (first == 1)
            and (piece.role == "finish") == (last == #guide) then
            local a, b = guide[first], guide[last]
            local length, turn = b.arc - a.arc, b.turn - a.turn
            local stretch = length / piece.length
            if stretch >= limits.min_stretch and stretch <= limits.max_stretch then
              local rib = (a.width + b.width) / 2
              local fit = math.log(stretch)^2 + (turn - piece.turn)^2 + math.log(rib / piece.width)^2
              local join = prev.piece and seam(library[prev.piece], piece) or 0
              local cost = prev.cost + fit + limits.seam_weight * join
              local row = states[last] or {}
              states[last] = row
              local candidate = {piece = index, first = first, last = last, cost = cost,
                fit = fit, join = join, prev = prev}
              local slot
              for i, state in ipairs(row) do
                if state.piece == index then slot = i; break end
              end
              if not slot then row[#row + 1] = candidate
              elseif cost < row[slot].cost - 1e-12 then row[slot] = candidate end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local best
  for _, state in ipairs(states[#guide] or {}) do
    if not best or state.cost < best.cost - 1e-12 then best = state end
  end
  if not best then return nil, "no endpoint-preserving guide match within stretch limits" end
  local pieces, cost = {}, best.cost
  while best.piece do
    pieces[#pieces + 1] = {piece = best.piece, first = best.first, last = best.last,
      fit = best.fit, join = best.join}
    best = best.prev
  end
  for i = 1, math.floor(#pieces / 2) do
    local j = #pieces + 1 - i
    pieces[i], pieces[j] = pieces[j], pieces[i]
  end
  return pieces, cost
end

return M
source.pattern_deco_mesh.lua:
local ARAP = require("pattern_deco_arap")
local M = {}

local function determinant(a, b, c)
  return (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[2] - a[2]) - (b[2] - a[2]) * (c[1] - a[1])
end

-- Stations include both ends of the extended overlap. The middle rib row is pinned.
function M.fit(stations, half_width, iterations, limits)
  local rest, initial, pins, faces, edges, seen = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  for _, s in ipairs(stations) do
    for row = -1, 1 do
      local t = row * half_width
      local i = #rest + 1
      rest[i] = {s.u, t}
      initial[i] = {s.x + t * s.nx, s.y + t * s.ny}
      if row == 0 then pins[i] = initial[i] end
    end
  end
  local function face(a, b, c)
    faces[#faces + 1] = {a, b, c}
    for _, pair in ipairs({{a,b}, {b,c}, {c,a}}) do
      local i, j = math.min(pair[1], pair[2]), math.max(pair[1], pair[2])
      local key = i .. "/" .. j
      if not seen[key] then
        seen[key] = true
        edges[#edges + 1] = {i, j, 1}
      end
    end
  end
  for s = 1, #stations - 1 do
    for row = 1, 2 do
      local a = (s - 1) * 3 + row
      face(a, a + 3, a + 4)
      face(a, a + 4, a + 1)
    end
  end
  local points, evidence = ARAP.solve(rest, edges, pins, initial, iterations)
  local min_jacobian, max_stretch, min_stretch = math.huge, 0, math.huge
  for _, f in ipairs(faces) do
    local a,b,c = table.unpack(f)
    local jacobian = determinant(points[a],points[b],points[c]) / determinant(rest[a],rest[b],rest[c])
    min_jacobian = math.min(jacobian, min_jacobian)
  end
  for _, edge in ipairs(edges) do
    local i,j = table.unpack(edge)
    local dx,dy = points[i][1]-points[j][1],points[i][2]-points[j][2]
    local ux,uy = rest[i][1]-rest[j][1],rest[i][2]-rest[j][2]
    local stretch = math.sqrt((dx*dx+dy*dy)/(ux*ux+uy*uy))
    min_stretch, max_stretch = math.min(min_stretch,stretch), math.max(max_stretch,stretch)
  end
  evidence.min_jacobian, evidence.min_stretch, evidence.max_stretch = min_jacobian,min_stretch,max_stretch
  if min_jacobian <= limits.min_jacobian or min_stretch < limits.min_stretch
    or max_stretch > limits.max_stretch or evidence.residual > limits.max_residual then
    return nil, "ARAP distortion exceeds limits", evidence
  end
  return {rest=rest, points=points, faces=faces, evidence=evidence}
end

function M.inverse(mesh, x, y)
  local query = {x,y}
  for _, f in ipairs(mesh.faces) do
    local i,j,k = table.unpack(f)
    local a,b,c = mesh.points[i],mesh.points[j],mesh.points[k]
    local area = determinant(a,b,c)
    local u,v = determinant(query,b,c)/area,determinant(a,query,c)/area
    local w = 1-u-v
    if math.min(u,v,w) >= -1e-9 then
      a,b,c = mesh.rest[i],mesh.rest[j],mesh.rest[k]
      return a[1]*u+b[1]*v+c[1]*w, a[2]*u+b[2]*v+c[2]*w
    end
  end
end

return M
source.pattern_deco_refine.lua:
local SDF = require("pattern_deco_sdf")
local M = {}

-- Match source-coordinate neighborhoods at three spatial scales.
-- The caller supplies the exact editable lattice mask and optional ink constraints.
function M.apply(field, exemplars, editable, constraints, radius)
  assert(radius > 0 and radius < 1, "invalid refinement radius")
  constraints = constraints or {}
  local grid, width, height = field.grid, field.width, field.height
  local samplers = {}
  for i,piece in ipairs(exemplars) do samplers[i] = SDF.prepare(piece.primitives) end
  for i,value in pairs(constraints) do
    assert(editable[i] and grid[i] and type(value)=="boolean","invalid refinement constraint")
  end
  local function adjacent(i, dx, dy)
    local x,y = (i-1)%width+1, math.floor((i-1)/width)+1
    if x+dx>=1 and x+dx<=width and y+dy>=1 and y+dy<=height then
      return grid[i+dy*width+dx]
    end
  end
  local receipt = {}
  for _,stride in ipairs({4,2,1}) do
    local pending, accepted = {}, 0
    local delta = radius*stride/4
    for i,p in ipairs(grid) do
      local prior = p.source
      if editable[i] and prior.piece then
        local neighbors = {{0,0,p}}
        for _,offset in ipairs({{-stride,0},{stride,0},{0,-stride},{0,stride}}) do
          local dx,dy = table.unpack(offset)
          local q = adjacent(i,dx,dy)
          if q then neighbors[#neighbors+1] = {dx,dy,q} end
        end
        local function score(candidate)
          local sample = samplers[candidate.piece]
          local error = 0
          for _,n in ipairs(neighbors) do
            local q = n[3]
            local d = math.sqrt((q.x-p.x)^2+(q.y-p.y)^2)
            local u = n[1] == 0 and 0 or (n[1]>0 and d or -d)
            local v = n[2] == 0 and 0 or (n[2]>0 and d or -d)
            error = error+(sample(candidate.u+u,candidate.v+v)-q.source.distance)^2
          end
          if constraints[i] == true and candidate.distance >= -1e-9
            or constraints[i] == false and candidate.distance <= 1e-9 then
            return math.huge
          end
          return error
        end
        local best, cost = prior, score(prior)
        local function offer(piece,u,v)
          if math.abs(u-prior.u)>radius*2 or math.abs(v-prior.v)>radius*2 then return end
          local candidate = {piece=piece,u=u,v=v,distance=samplers[piece](u,v)}
          local value = score(candidate)
          if value < cost-1e-12 then best,cost=candidate,value end
        end
        for _,offset in ipairs({{-delta,0},{delta,0},{0,-delta},{0,delta}}) do
          offer(prior.piece,prior.u+offset[1],prior.v+offset[2])
        end
        for k=2,#neighbors do
          local dx,dy,q = table.unpack(neighbors[k])
          if q.source.piece then
            local d = math.sqrt((q.x-p.x)^2+(q.y-p.y)^2)
            local u = dx == 0 and 0 or (dx>0 and d or -d)
            local v = dy == 0 and 0 or (dy>0 and d or -d)
            offer(q.source.piece,q.source.u-u,q.source.v-v)
          end
        end
        if best ~= prior then pending[i]=best; accepted=accepted+1 end
      end
    end
    for i,source in pairs(pending) do grid[i].source=source end
    receipt[#receipt+1] = {stride=stride,accepted=accepted}
  end
  local unsatisfied = {}
  for i,value in pairs(constraints) do
    local distance = grid[i].source.distance
    if value and distance >= -1e-9 or not value and distance <= 1e-9 then
      unsatisfied[#unsatisfied+1]=i
    end
  end
  table.sort(unsatisfied)
  return {levels=receipt,unsatisfied=unsatisfied}
end

return M
source.pattern_deco_sdf.lua:
-- Exemplar ink is the union of closed polygonal primitives in spine/rib coordinates.
local M = {}
local eps = 1e-10

local function inside(ring, x, y)
  local hit = false
  local a = ring[#ring]
  for _, b in ipairs(ring) do
    if (a[2] > y) ~= (b[2] > y)
      and x < a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (y - a[2]) / (b[2] - a[2]) then
      hit = not hit
    end
    a = b
  end
  return hit
end

local function cross(ax, ay, bx, by) return ax * by - ay * bx end

local function split(edge, other, stops)
  local x, y, u, v = table.unpack(edge)
  local a, b, c, d = table.unpack(other)
  local dx, dy, ex, ey = u - x, v - y, c - a, d - b
  local determinant = cross(dx, dy, ex, ey)
  if math.abs(determinant) > eps then
    local t = cross(a - x, b - y, ex, ey) / determinant
    local s = cross(a - x, b - y, dx, dy) / determinant
    if t > eps and t < 1 - eps and s >= -eps and s <= 1 + eps then
      stops[#stops + 1] = t
    end
  elseif math.abs(cross(a - x, b - y, dx, dy)) < eps then
    local length = dx * dx + dy * dy
    for _, p in ipairs({{a, b}, {c, d}}) do
      local t = ((p[1] - x) * dx + (p[2] - y) * dy) / length
      if t > eps and t < 1 - eps then stops[#stops + 1] = t end
    end
  end
end

function M.prepare(primitives)
  local edges = {}
  for _, primitive in ipairs(primitives) do
    local ring = primitive.ring
    assert(#ring >= 3, "exemplar primitive needs a closed polygon")
    local a = ring[#ring]
    for _, b in ipairs(ring) do
      assert(a[1] ~= b[1] or a[2] ~= b[2], "degenerate exemplar edge")
      edges[#edges + 1] = {a[1], a[2], b[1], b[2]}
      a = b
    end
  end
  assert(#edges > 0 and #edges <= 256, "exemplar edge budget exceeded")
  local function ink(x, y)
    for _, primitive in ipairs(primitives) do
      if inside(primitive.ring, x, y) then return true end
    end
    return false
  end
  local exposed = {}
  for _, edge in ipairs(edges) do
    local stops = {0, 1}
    for _, other in ipairs(edges) do
      if edge ~= other then split(edge, other, stops) end
    end
    table.sort(stops)
    local x, y, u, v = table.unpack(edge)
    local dx, dy = u - x, v - y
    local delta = 1e-8 / math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    for i = 2, #stops do
      local a, b = stops[i - 1], stops[i]
      if b - a > eps then
        local t = (a + b) / 2
        local px, py = x + t * dx, y + t * dy
        if ink(px - delta * dy, py + delta * dx) ~= ink(px + delta * dy, py - delta * dx) then
          exposed[#exposed + 1] = {x + a * dx, y + a * dy, x + b * dx, y + b * dy}
        end
      end
    end
  end
  assert(#exposed > 0, "exemplar has no exposed ink boundary")
  return function(x, y)
    local best = math.huge
    for _, edge in ipairs(exposed) do
      local a, b, c, d = table.unpack(edge)
      local dx, dy = c - a, d - b
      local t = math.max(0, math.min(1, ((x - a) * dx + (y - b) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)))
      best = math.min(best, (x - a - t * dx)^2 + (y - b - t * dy)^2)
    end
    return (ink(x, y) and -1 or 1) * math.sqrt(best)
  end
end

return M

-- Extract a piecewise-linear zero contour on the same triangulated sampling chart.
local M = {}

function M.contours(field)
  local width, height, grid = field.width, field.height, field.grid
  local vertices, outgoing, boundary = {}, {}, {}
  local function vertex(i)
    local k = tostring(i)
    vertices[k] = grid[i]
    return k
  end
  local function crossing(i,j)
    if j < i then i,j = j,i end
    local a,b = grid[i],grid[j]
    local u,v = a.source.distance,b.source.distance
    if u == 0 then return vertex(i) end
    if v == 0 then return vertex(j) end
    local k = i.."/"..j
    if not vertices[k] then
      local t = u/(u-v)
      vertices[k] = {x=a.x+t*(b.x-a.x),y=a.y+t*(b.y-a.y)}
    end
    return k
  end
  local area = 0
  local function triangle(a,b,c)
    local p,q,r = grid[a],grid[b],grid[c]
    assert((q.x-p.x)*(r.y-p.y)-(q.y-p.y)*(r.x-p.x)>0,"folded contour chart")
    local clipped = {}
    for _,edge in ipairs({{a,b},{b,c},{c,a}}) do
      local i,j = table.unpack(edge)
      local inside = grid[i].source.distance < 0
      if inside then clipped[#clipped+1] = vertex(i) end
      if inside ~= (grid[j].source.distance < 0) then
        clipped[#clipped+1] = crossing(i,j)
      end
    end
    for i,k in ipairs(clipped) do
      local l = clipped[i%#clipped+1]
      if k ~= l then
        local x,y = vertices[k],vertices[l]
        area = area + (x.x*y.y-x.y*y.x)/2
        local reverse = l..":"..k
        if boundary[reverse] then boundary[reverse] = nil
        else boundary[k..":"..l] = {k,l} end
      end
    end
  end
  for y = 1,height-1 do
    for x = 1,width-1 do
      local a = (y-1)*width+x
      triangle(a,a+1,a+width+1)
      triangle(a,a+width+1,a+width)
    end
  end
  local keys = {}
  for k,edge in pairs(boundary) do
    local a,b = table.unpack(edge)
    assert(not outgoing[a],"ambiguous zero-contour vertex")
    outgoing[a] = b
    keys[#keys+1] = k
  end
  table.sort(keys)
  local loops, traced = {}, 0
  for _,k in ipairs(keys) do
    local start = boundary[k][1]
    if outgoing[start] then
      local ring, a = {}, start
      repeat
        local b = assert(outgoing[a],"open zero contour")
        outgoing[a] = nil
        local p,q = vertices[a],vertices[b]
        traced = traced + (p.x*q.y-p.y*q.x)/2
        ring[#ring+1] = {p.x,p.y}
        a = b
      until a == start
      loops[#loops+1] = ring
    end
  end
  return loops,{filled_area=area,contour_area=traced,residual=math.abs(area-traced)}
end

return M
source.pattern_decobrush.lua:
local P,H = require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash")
local Field,Refine,Vector = require("pattern_deco_field"),require("pattern_deco_refine"),require("pattern_deco_vector")
local G = require("pattern_geometry")
local M = {VERSION="decobrush-sdf-arap-v1"}

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="decoration/decobrush",version="1",family="example-driven-decorative-brush",
    units="cm",capabilities={"field"},parameters={
      subdivisions={type="integer",minimum=4,maximum=24},
      rows={type="integer",minimum=5,maximum=41},
      refinement_radius={type="number",minimum=.01,maximum=.5}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Closed polygonal exemplar primitives with declared longitudinal spines",
      "Single oriented, nonfolding guide chart with endpoint-specific pieces",
      "Signed distance, anchored ARAP, overlap cuts and masked source-coordinate refinement"}})
end

local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge end

local function input(s)
  local q = P.plain(s.inputs)
  local a = s.parameters
  assert(type(q.guide)=="table" and #q.guide>=3 and #q.guide<=33,"deco-guide-size")
  assert(type(q.library)=="table" and #q.library>=3 and #q.library<=16,"deco-library-size")
  for _,p in ipairs(q.guide) do
    assert(#p==3 and finite(p[1]) and finite(p[2]) and finite(p[3]) and p[3]>.01 and p[3]<=4,"deco-guide-station")
  end
  for _,piece in ipairs(q.library) do
    assert(piece.role=="start" or piece.role=="middle" or piece.role=="finish","deco-piece-role")
    assert(finite(piece.length) and piece.length>.01 and finite(piece.width) and piece.width>.01
      and finite(piece.turn),"deco-piece-metric")
    assert(type(piece.primitives)=="table" and #piece.primitives>0,"deco-piece-primitives")
    for _,primitive in ipairs(piece.primitives) do
      assert(type(primitive.ring)=="table" and #primitive.ring>=3,"deco-primitive-ring")
      for _,v in ipairs(primitive.ring) do
        assert(#v==2 and finite(v[1]) and finite(v[2]),"deco-primitive-point")
      end
    end
  end
  local edit = q.edit or P.array()
  assert(type(edit)=="table" and #edit<=32,"deco-edit-budget")
  for _,box in ipairs(edit) do
    assert(#box==5 and finite(box[1]) and finite(box[2]) and finite(box[3]) and finite(box[4])
      and box[1]<box[3] and box[2]<box[4] and type(box[5])=="boolean","deco-edit-box")
  end
  return {guide=q.guide,library=q.library,edit=edit,subdivisions=a.subdivisions or 16,
    rows=a.rows or 17,radius=a.refinement_radius or .15,bounds=P.plain(s.document.bounds)}
end

local function samples(field)
  local out=P.array()
  for i=1,field.width do
    local p=field.grid[math.floor(field.height/2)*field.width+i]
    local prev=field.grid[math.floor(field.height/2)*field.width+math.max(1,i-1)]
    local next_point=field.grid[math.floor(field.height/2)*field.width+math.min(field.width,i+1)]
    local dx,dy=next_point.x-prev.x,next_point.y-prev.y
    local norm=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
    out[i]={id="deco/rib/"..i,point={p.x,p.y},vector={dx/norm,dy/norm},density=1}
  end
  return out
end

local function generate(d,s,c)
  local q=input(s)
  local width=(#q.guide-1)*q.subdivisions+1
  assert(width*q.rows<=5000,"deco-grid-budget")
  c:consume("objects",width*q.rows)
  c:consume("operations",width*q.rows*64)
  local f,why=Field.synthesize(q.guide,q.library,{subdivisions=q.subdivisions,rows=q.rows,
    iterations=24,outside=1,match={min_steps=1,max_steps=6,min_stretch=.75,max_stretch=1.3,seam_weight=1},
    distortion={min_jacobian=.45,min_stretch=.55,max_stretch=1.6,max_residual=.025}})
  assert(f,why)
  local chart_boundary={}
  local function boundary(i)
    local p=f.grid[i]
    chart_boundary[#chart_boundary+1]={p.x,p.y}
  end
  for i=1,f.width do boundary(i) end
  for j=2,f.height do boundary(j*f.width) end
  for i=f.width-1,1,-1 do boundary((f.height-1)*f.width+i) end
  for j=f.height-1,2,-1 do boundary((j-1)*f.width+1) end
  G.region(chart_boundary,{},G.policy("cm",1),{context=c,max_pair_checks=2000000})
  local seam_mask={}
  for _,seam in ipairs(f.seams) do
    for _,index in ipairs(seam.indices) do seam_mask[index]=true end
  end
  local synthesis=Refine.apply(f,q.library,seam_mask,nil,q.radius)
  local editable,constraints = {},{}
  for i,p in ipairs(f.grid) do
    assert(p.x>=q.bounds[1] and p.x<=q.bounds[3] and p.y>=q.bounds[2] and p.y<=q.bounds[4],
      "deco-chart-outside-document")
    for _,b in ipairs(q.edit) do
      if p.x>=b[1] and p.x<=b[3] and p.y>=b[2] and p.y<=b[4] then
        editable[i]=true
        constraints[i]=b[5]
      end
    end
  end
  assert(#q.edit==0 or next(editable),"deco-empty-edit-mask")
  local refinement=Refine.apply(f,q.library,editable,constraints,q.radius)
  assert(#refinement.unsatisfied==0,"deco-infeasible-edit")
  local contours,area=Vector.contours(f)
  assert(#contours>0 and area.contour_area>0,"deco-empty-output")
  return {id="deco/"..H.value("deco/design",q),definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),
    structures={field={representation="samples",domain={bounds=q.bounds},samples=samples(f)}},
    provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
    extensions={decobrush={request=q,field=f,contours=contours,area=area,synthesis=synthesis,refinement=refinement}}}
end

local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.decobrush
  local contours,proof=Vector.contours(P.plain(e.field))
  assert(P.serialize(contours)==P.serialize(e.contours) and proof.residual<1e-8,"deco-contour-certificate")
  return {ok=true,checks={"Vector boundaries reconstructed from the signed field"}}
end

local function lower(x,v,style)
  local commands=P.array()
  for _,ring in ipairs(x.extensions.decobrush.contours) do
    for i,p in ipairs(ring) do commands[#commands+1]={i==1 and "M" or "L",p[1],p[2]} end
    commands[#commands+1]={"Z"}
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
    operations={{op="path",semantic_ref=x.id,commands=commands,transform=P.plain(v.transform),
      paint={fill=P.plain(style.fill or {.10,.17,.24}),fill_rule="nonzero"}}},
    resources=P.array(),clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)}}
end

function M.register(reg)
  local d=M.definition()
  reg:register(d,{validate_inputs=function(s) input(s);return true end,
    generate=function(s,c) return generate(d,s,c) end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end

return M
source.pattern_document.lua:
-- Validated physical document input, shared with the Design Specification.
-- This is context for the five contracts, not a second pattern representation.
local P=require("pattern")
local M={VERSION="document-context-v1"}
local documents=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function need(ok,why)assert(ok,"document: "..why)end
local function finite(x)return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<math.huge end
local function fields(t,names,label)
  need(type(t)=="table",label.." object required");local map={};for k in names:gmatch('%S+')do map[k]=true end
  for k in pairs(t)do need(map[k],label.." unknown key "..tostring(k))end
end
local function array(t,label)
  need(type(t)=="table",label.." array required");for k in pairs(t)do need(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=#t,label.." must be dense")end
  for i=1,#t do need(t[i]~=nil,label.." must be dense")end
  if #t==0 then setmetatable(t,{__jsontype="array"})end;return t
end
local function tuple(t,n,label,nonnegative)
  array(t,label);need(#t==n,label.." arity");for _,v in ipairs(t)do need(finite(v) and (not nonnegative or v>=0),label.." invalid dimension")end
end
local function id(s,label)need(type(s)=="string" and #s>0,label.." ID required")end
local function box(b,label)tuple(b,4,label);need(b[3]>b[1] and b[4]>b[2],label.." positive bounds required")end
local function inside(a,b)return a[1]>=b[1] and a[2]>=b[2] and a[3]<=b[3] and a[4]<=b[4]end
local function shifted(b,x,y)return {b[1]+x,b[2]+y,b[3]+x,b[4]+y}end
function M.new(input)
  local t=P.plain(input);fields(t,"id unit frame twoside pages spreads","context");id(t.id,"document");need(t.unit=="cm","physical document unit must be cm")
  fields(t.frame,"id origin","frame");id(t.frame.id,"frame");tuple(t.frame.origin,2,"frame.origin")
  need(type(t.twoside)=="boolean","explicit twoside flag required");array(t.pages,"pages");need(#t.pages>0 and #t.pages<=4096,"document needs1..4096 pages/panels")
  local ids,numbers={},{}
  for _,p in ipairs(t.pages)do
    fields(p,"id number size origin trim bleed margins binding_offset offset protected_regions anchors legacy_host","page")
    id(p.id,"page");need(not ids[p.id],"duplicate page ID");ids[p.id]=p
    need(finite(p.number) and p.number%1==0 and p.number>=1 and not numbers[p.number],"unique positive page number required");numbers[p.number]=true
    tuple(p.size,2,"page.size");need(p.size[1]>0 and p.size[2]>0,"positive media size required");tuple(p.origin,2,"page.origin")
    local media={0,0,p.size[1],p.size[2]};p.trim=p.trim or media;box(p.trim,"page.trim");need(inside(p.trim,media),"trim exceeds media")
    p.bleed=p.bleed or {0,0,0,0};tuple(p.bleed,4,"page.bleed",true)
    p.bleed_bounds={p.trim[1]-p.bleed[1],p.trim[2]-p.bleed[2],p.trim[3]+p.bleed[3],p.trim[4]+p.bleed[4]};need(inside(p.bleed_bounds,media),"bleed exceeds physical media")
    p.margins=p.margins or {0,0,0,0};tuple(p.margins,4,"page.margins",true)
    p.binding_offset=p.binding_offset or 0;need(finite(p.binding_offset) and p.binding_offset>=0,"invalid binding offset")
    p.offset=p.offset or {0,0};tuple(p.offset,2,"page.offset")
    p.recto=not t.twoside or p.number%2==1;p.inner_side=p.recto and "left" or "right"
    p.content={p.trim[1]+p.margins[1],p.trim[2]+p.margins[2],p.trim[3]-p.margins[3],p.trim[4]-p.margins[4]}
    if p.recto then p.content[1]=p.content[1]+p.binding_offset else p.content[3]=p.content[3]-p.binding_offset end
    p.content=shifted(p.content,p.offset[1],p.offset[2]);box(p.content,"margins/binding/offset content")
    p.content_within_trim=inside(p.content,p.trim)
    if p.legacy_host then
      fields(p.legacy_host,"dimensions_sp settings","legacy host snapshot")
      need(p.binding_offset==0 and p.offset[1]==0 and p.offset[2]==0,"legacy binding and offsets are already resolved in host dimensions; do not apply twice")
      local g=M.legacy_geometry(p.legacy_host.dimensions_sp,p.number,t.twoside,p.legacy_host.settings).geometry
      local expected={g.actual_left,g.ybot,g.actual_right,g.ytop}
      need(math.abs(p.size[1]-g.pw)<1e-10 and math.abs(p.size[2]-g.ph)<1e-10,"legacy document media differs from actual host dimensions")
      for i=1,4 do need(math.abs(p.content[i]-expected[i])<1e-10,"legacy document content differs from actual host offsets/margins")end
    end
    p.protected_regions=p.protected_regions or P.array();array(p.protected_regions,"protected_regions")
    local reservations={}
    for _,r in ipairs(p.protected_regions)do
      fields(r,"id bounds space role","reservation");id(r.id,"reservation");need(not reservations[r.id],"duplicate reservation ID");reservations[r.id]=true;box(r.bounds,"reservation.bounds")
      need(r.space=="page" or r.space=="content","reservation needs explicit page/content coordinate space")
      need(r.role=="protected_content","reservation role must be protected_content")
      if r.space=="content"then r.bounds=shifted(r.bounds,p.content[1],p.content[2])end;r.space="page"
    end
    p.anchors=p.anchors or P.array();array(p.anchors,"anchors");local anchors={}
    for _,a in ipairs(p.anchors)do
      fields(a,"id role point space","anchor");id(a.id,"anchor");need(not anchors[a.id],"duplicate anchor ID");anchors[a.id]=true;id(a.role,"anchor role");tuple(a.point,2,"anchor.point")
      need(a.space=="world" or a.space=="page" or a.space=="content","explicit anchor space required")
      if a.space=="content"then a.point={a.point[1]+p.content[1],a.point[2]+p.content[2]};a.space="page"end
      if a.space=="page"then a.point={a.point[1]+p.origin[1],a.point[2]+p.origin[2]};a.space="world"end
    end
    p.world_bounds=shifted(media,p.origin[1],p.origin[2]);p.world_content=shifted(p.content,p.origin[1],p.origin[2])
  end
  t.spreads=t.spreads or P.array();array(t.spreads,"spreads");local spreads,used={},{}
  for _,s in ipairs(t.spreads)do
    fields(s,"id left right gutter","spread");id(s.id,"spread");need(not spreads[s.id],"duplicate spread ID");spreads[s.id]=true
    local l,r=ids[s.left],ids[s.right];need(t.twoside and l and r and l~=r,"spread needs two distinct known facing pages")
    need(l.number%2==0 and r.number==l.number+1,"spread needs even verso followed by odd recto")
    need(not used[l.id] and not used[r.id],"page belongs to multiple spreads");used[l.id],used[r.id]=true,true
    need(finite(s.gutter) and s.gutter>=0,"nonnegative explicit gutter required")
    need(math.abs(l.origin[1]+l.size[1]+s.gutter-r.origin[1])<=1e-9 and l.origin[2]==r.origin[2],"spread page origins do not match media widths/gutter")
  end
  t.kind="document_context";t.schema_version=1;local result=P.snapshot(t);documents[result]=true;return result
end
function M.import(data)
  local t=P.plain(data);need(t.kind=="document_context" and t.schema_version==1,"unsupported document schema")
  fields(t,"kind schema_version id unit frame twoside pages spreads","imported context")
  t.kind,t.schema_version=nil,nil
  for _,p in ipairs(array(t.pages,"pages"))do
    fields(p,"id number size origin trim bleed margins binding_offset offset protected_regions anchors legacy_host bleed_bounds recto inner_side content content_within_trim world_bounds world_content","imported page")
    for _,key in ipairs({"bleed_bounds","recto","inner_side","content","content_within_trim","world_bounds","world_content"})do p[key]=nil end
  end
  local result=M.new(t);need(P.serialize(result)==P.serialize(data),"imported derived page metadata differs from recomputed physical context")
  return result
end
function M.page(document,id)
  need(documents[document],"validated document context required; use import after deserialization")
  for _,p in ipairs(document.pages)do if p.id==id then return p end end;error("document: unknown page "..tostring(id),0)
end
function M.masks(page)
  local out=P.array();for _,r in ipairs(page.protected_regions)do out[#out+1]={bounds=P.plain(r.bounds),role="protected_content"}end;return out
end
-- Actual host dimensions in scaled TeX points, not invented equivalents. The
-- legacy function remains the authority for overhang, parity and offsets.
function M.legacy_geometry(dimensions_sp,page,twoside,options,reservations)
  need(type(dimensions_sp)=="table" and finite(page) and page>=1 and page%1==0 and type(twoside)=="boolean","legacy host snapshot required")
  local keys={};for name in ("paperwidth paperheight oddsidemargin evensidemargin hoffset voffset topmargin headheight headsep textwidth textheight footskip"):gmatch('%S+')do
    keys[name]=true;local v=dimensions_sp[name];need(finite(v) and v%1==0 and math.abs(v)<=1073741823,"missing/out-of-range integer scaled-point host dimension "..name)
  end
  for name in pairs(dimensions_sp)do need(keys[name],"unknown host dimension "..tostring(name))end
  for _,name in ipairs({"paperwidth","paperheight","textwidth","textheight"})do need(dimensions_sp[name]>0,"positive host dimension required: "..name)end
  local settings=require("layout").resolve(P.plain(options or {}));local F=require("florilegium")
  local saved={dimen=F.dimen,page=F.page,twoside=F.twoside}
  F.dimen=function(name)return assert(dimensions_sp[name],"missing host dimension")end;F.page=function()return page end;F.twoside=twoside
  local ok,g=pcall(F.geometry,settings.text_gap,settings.side)
  F.dimen,F.page,F.twoside=saved.dimen,saved.page,saved.twoside;need(ok,tostring(g))
  need(g.colright>=1.8,"text-gap leaves less than18mm for the grown garden; reduce text-gap or increase the selected margin")
  g.layout=settings;g.reserves=P.array()
  for _,r in ipairs(reservations or {})do box(r,"legacy physical reservation");g.reserves[#g.reserves+1]=g.mirror and {g.pw-r[3],r[2],g.pw-r[1],r[4]} or P.plain(r)end
  return P.snapshot({geometry=g,settings=settings,canonical_to_page=g.mirror and {-1,0,0,1,g.pw,0} or {1,0,0,1,0,0},
    unit="cm",density_semantics="legacy spacing/branch/detail control, not ink area percentage",text_orientation="native text unchanged; botanical labels counter-reflect in folio.lua",source="existing florilegium.geometry and layout.resolve; no formula rewrite"})
end
function M.from_legacy_host(input)
  local t=P.plain(input);fields(t,"id frame twoside pages spreads","legacy document input");array(t.pages,"legacy pages")
  local pages=P.array()
  for _,p in ipairs(t.pages)do
    fields(p,"id number origin dimensions_sp options protected_regions anchors","legacy page input")
    local resolved=M.legacy_geometry(p.dimensions_sp,p.number,t.twoside,p.options)
    local g=resolved.geometry
    pages[#pages+1]={id=p.id,number=p.number,origin=p.origin,size={g.pw,g.ph},margins={g.actual_left,g.ybot,g.pw-g.actual_right,g.ph-g.ytop},
      binding_offset=0,offset={0,0},protected_regions=p.protected_regions or P.array(),anchors=p.anchors or P.array(),
      legacy_host={dimensions_sp=p.dimensions_sp,settings=P.plain(resolved.settings)}}
  end
  return M.new({id=t.id,unit="cm",frame=t.frame,twoside=t.twoside,pages=pages,spreads=t.spreads or P.array()})
end
function M.legacy_page(document,page_id)
  local p=M.page(document,page_id);need(p.legacy_host,"page has no actual legacy host snapshot")
  local reservations={};for _,r in ipairs(p.protected_regions)do reservations[#reservations+1]=P.plain(r.bounds)end
  return M.legacy_geometry(p.legacy_host.dimensions_sp,p.number,document.twoside,p.legacy_host.settings,reservations)
end
M.shift_box=shifted
return M

-- Backend-neutral drawing grammar shared by scenes and reusable vector assets.
local P,Bytes,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_bytes"),require("pattern_hash")
local M={VERSION="drawing-grammar-v1"}
local function need(ok,why)assert(ok,"drawing: "..why)end
local function fields(t,names,label)
  need(type(t)=="table",label.." object required");local known={};for key in names:gmatch('%S+')do known[key]=true end
  for key in pairs(t)do need(known[key],label.." unknown key "..tostring(key))end
end
local function finite(n)return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge end
local function seq(t,label)
  need(type(t)=="table",label.." array required");local n=#t
  for k in pairs(t)do need(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=n,label.." must be dense")end
  for i=1,n do need(t[i]~=nil,label.." must be dense")end
  return t
end
local function numbers(t,n,label)seq(t,label);need(#t==n,label.." wrong arity");for _,v in ipairs(t)do need(finite(v),label.." finite values required")end end
local function bounds(t,label,positive)numbers(t,4,label);need(positive and t[3]>t[1] and t[4]>t[2] or not positive and t[3]>=t[1] and t[4]>=t[2],label.." invalid bounds")end
local function matrix(t,label)
  numbers(t,6,label);local determinant=t[1]*t[4]-t[2]*t[3]
  need(finite(determinant) and determinant~=0,label.." singular/nonfinite transform")
end
local function commands(list,allow_empty)
  seq(list,"commands");local current,drawn=false,false
  for _,c in ipairs(list)do
    seq(c,"command");local sizes={M=3,L=3,C=7,Z=1};need(sizes[c[1]]==#c,"unsupported path command/arity")
    for i=2,#c do need(finite(c[i]),"nonfinite path coordinate")end
    if c[1]=="M" then current=true else need(current,"path must begin with M");if c[1]~="Z" then drawn=true end end
  end
  need(allow_empty and #list==0 or drawn,"path has no drawn segment")
end
local function rule(v)need(v=="nonzero" or v=="evenodd","unsupported winding rule")end
local function paint(p)
  fields(p,"fill stroke stroke_width color_space opacity blend fill_rule cap join miter_limit dash","paint")
  need(p.fill or p.stroke,"actual fill/stroke required")
  local cs=p.color_space or "rgb";need(cs=="rgb" or cs=="gray","unsupported paint color space")
  for _,k in ipairs({"fill","stroke"})do if p[k]then numbers(p[k],cs=="gray" and 1 or 3,"paint."..k);for _,v in ipairs(p[k])do need(v>=0 and v<=1,"color outside [0,1]")end end end
  if p.opacity~=nil then need(finite(p.opacity) and p.opacity>=0 and p.opacity<=1,"opacity outside [0,1]")end
  if p.blend~=nil then need(p.blend=="normal" or p.blend=="multiply","unsupported blend")end
  if p.fill_rule then rule(p.fill_rule)end
  if p.stroke then
    need(finite(p.stroke_width) and p.stroke_width>0,"positive physical stroke width required; device hairlines unsupported")
    local cap,join=p.cap or "butt",p.join or "miter"
    need(cap=="butt" or cap=="round" or cap=="square","unsupported cap");need(join=="miter" or join=="round" or join=="bevel","unsupported join")
    if p.miter_limit~=nil then need(finite(p.miter_limit) and p.miter_limit>=1,"invalid miter limit")end
    if p.dash then
      fields(p.dash,"array phase","dash");seq(p.dash.array,"dash.array");local sum=0
      for _,v in ipairs(p.dash.array)do need(finite(v) and v>=0,"invalid dash length");sum=sum+v end
      need(#p.dash.array==0 or sum>0,"dash array is allzero");need(finite(p.dash.phase) and p.dash.phase>=0,"invalid dash phase")
    end
  else need(p.stroke_width==nil and p.cap==nil and p.join==nil and p.miter_limit==nil and p.dash==nil,"stroke controls require a stroke")end
end
local validate_ops
local function resources(list)
  local map={};seq(list,"resources")
  for _,r in ipairs(list)do
    fields(r,"id kind unit bounds variants provenance profile glyphs units_per_em family license font_sha256","resource")
    need(type(r.id)=="string" and #r.id>0 and not map[r.id],"unique resource ID required");map[r.id]=r
    need(r.kind=="symbol" or r.kind=="font","unsupported resource kind")
    need(type(r.variants)=="table" and next(r.variants),"actual resource variants required")
    for format,variant in pairs(r.variants)do
      need(format=="scene" or format=="pdf" or format=="svg" or format=="opentype","unsupported resource variant")
      fields(variant,"encoding content media_type graphics_states sha256","resource variant")
      need(type(variant.content)=="string" and #variant.content>0,"actual resource bytes required")
      need(variant.encoding=="utf8" or variant.encoding=="base64","explicit resource encoding required")
      local data=variant.encoding=="base64" and Bytes.base64_decode(variant.content) or variant.content
      if variant.sha256 then need(H.is_digest(variant.sha256) and H.sha256(data)==variant.sha256,"resource byte digest mismatch")end
    end
    if r.kind=="symbol" then
      need(r.unit=="cm" or r.unit=="bp","explicit symbol unit required");bounds(r.bounds,"symbol.bounds",true)
      if r.variants.scene then
        need(r.variants.scene.encoding=="utf8","neutral asset must use UTF-8 JSON")
        local asset=require("pattern_parse").decode(r.variants.scene.content)
        fields(asset,"kind schema_version unit operations","vector asset")
        need(asset.kind=="vector_asset" and asset.schema_version==1 and asset.unit==r.unit,"vector asset schema/unit mismatch")
        validate_ops(asset.operations,{},nil,nil,true)
      end
    else
      need(r.profile=="positioned-outlines-v1","font requires explicit positioned-outline profile; opaque fonts need migration")
      need(finite(r.units_per_em) and r.units_per_em>=16 and r.units_per_em<=1000000,"invalid font units-per-em")
      seq(r.glyphs,"font.glyphs");need(#r.glyphs>0 and #r.glyphs<=255,"font profile needs1..255 glyphs per resource")
      need(type(r.family)=="string" and #r.family>0 and type(r.license)=="string" and #r.license>0,"font attribution/license required")
      local glyphs={}
      for _,g in ipairs(r.glyphs)do
        fields(g,"id unicode advance bounds commands","glyph")
        need(type(g.id)=="string" and #g.id>0 and not glyphs[g.id],"unique glyph ID required");glyphs[g.id]=g
        need(type(g.unicode)=="string" and #g.unicode>0,"glyph Unicode cluster required")
        need(finite(g.advance) and g.advance>=0,"invalid glyph advance");bounds(g.bounds,"glyph.bounds",false);commands(g.commands,true)
      end
      if r.variants.opentype then
        local v=r.variants.opentype;need(v.encoding=="base64","embedded font must use base64")
        local data=Bytes.base64_decode(v.content);local magic=data:sub(1,4)
        need(magic=="OTTO" or magic=="\0\1\0\0","unsupported embedded font container")
        need(H.is_digest(r.font_sha256) and H.sha256(data)==r.font_sha256,"embedded font SHA256 required/mismatched")
      end
    end
  end
  return map
end
validate_ops=function(ops,map,ids,text,asset)
  seq(ops,"operations");need(#ops>0 and #ops<=100000,"nonempty bounded operations required")
  local depth,text_runs=0,{}
  for _,op in ipairs(ops)do
    need(type(op)=="table","operation object required")
    if op.semantic_ref~=nil then need(asset or ids and ids[op.semantic_ref],"missing semantic source")end
    if op.op=="path" then
      fields(op,"op semantic_ref commands paint transform","path operation");need(asset or op.semantic_ref,"path semantic source required")
      commands(op.commands,false);paint(op.paint);if op.transform then matrix(op.transform,"path.transform")end
    elseif op.op=="push_clip" then
      fields(op,"op semantic_ref commands fill_rule transform","clip operation");commands(op.commands,false);rule(op.fill_rule)
      if op.transform then matrix(op.transform,"clip.transform")end;depth=depth+1
    elseif op.op=="pop_clip" then fields(op,"op","clip pop");depth=depth-1;need(depth>=0,"clip stack underflow")
    elseif op.op=="symbol" then
      need(not asset,"nested resource references require an explicit future profile")
      fields(op,"op semantic_ref resource_ref transform","symbol operation");need(ids and ids[op.semantic_ref] and map[op.resource_ref] and map[op.resource_ref].kind=="symbol","missing symbol resource/source");matrix(op.transform,"symbol.transform")
    elseif op.op=="text" then
      need(not asset,"text belongs to semantic scene runs")
      fields(op,"op semantic_ref font_ref text origin size glyphs paint transform","text operation")
      local font=map[op.font_ref];need(font and font.kind=="font" and text,"font resource/text semantics required")
      local run;for _,r in ipairs(text.runs)do if r.id==op.semantic_ref then run=r end end
      need(run and run.text==op.text and #op.text>0 and not text_runs[op.semantic_ref],"text differs from semantic run or is duplicated/empty");text_runs[op.semantic_ref]=true
      numbers(op.origin,2,"text.origin");need(finite(op.size) and op.size>0,"positive text size in cm required")
      paint(op.paint);need(op.paint.fill and not op.paint.stroke,"text profile uses filled glyph outlines")
      if op.transform then matrix(op.transform,"text.transform")end
      local glyphs={};for _,g in ipairs(font.glyphs)do glyphs[g.id]=g end
      seq(op.glyphs,"positioned glyphs");need(#op.glyphs>0,"actual positioned glyphs required")
      local content={}
      for _,g in ipairs(op.glyphs)do
        fields(g,"glyph_ref offset rotation","positioned glyph")
        need(glyphs[g.glyph_ref],"missing glyph");numbers(g.offset,2,"glyph.offset")
        if g.rotation~=nil then need(finite(g.rotation) and math.abs(g.rotation)<=math.pi,"glyph rotation must be finite radians")end
        content[#content+1]=glyphs[g.glyph_ref].unicode
      end
      need(table.concat(content)==op.text,"glyph clusters differ from Unicode content")
    else error("drawing: unsupported operation "..tostring(op.op),0)end
  end
  need(depth==0,"unbalanced clip stack")
  if text then for _,run in ipairs(text.runs)do need(text_runs[run.id],"semantic text run missing from lowering")end end
end
function M.validate_scene(scene,ids,text)
  local map=resources(scene.resources);validate_ops(scene.operations,map,ids,text,false)
  if text then need(P.serialize(scene.reading_order)==P.serialize(text.reading_order),"reading order differs from instance")
  else need(scene.reading_order==nil,"reading order requires text semantics")end
  return true
end
function M.asset(resource)
  resource=P.plain(resource)
  resources({resource});need(resource.variants.scene,"neutral vector variant required by this backend")
  return require("pattern_parse").decode(resource.variants.scene.content)
end
M.validate_commands=commands;M.validate_paint=paint
return M

-- Typed editor intent -> canonical recipe using the actual document planner.
local P,Q,H,D,Planner=require('pattern'),require('pattern_recipe'),require('pattern_hash'),require('pattern_document'),require('pattern_planner')
local M={VERSION='recipe-edit-v1'}
local function fields(t)
 local allowed={schema_version=true,parameters=true,seed=true,inputs=true,style=true,crop=true,protected_regions=true,page_size=true}
 for key in pairs(t)do assert(allowed[key],'recipe edit unknown field:'..tostring(key))end
end
local function merge(target,patch)
 assert(type(patch)=='table','recipe edit requires an object')
 for key,value in pairs(patch)do assert(type(key)=='string','recipe edit named fields required');target[key]=P.plain(value)end
end
local function document_input(document)
 local t=P.plain(D.import(document));t.kind=nil;t.schema_version=nil
 for _,page in ipairs(t.pages)do for _,key in ipairs{'bleed_bounds','recto','inner_side','content','content_within_trim','world_bounds','world_content'}do page[key]=nil end end
 return t
end
function M.apply(recipe,edit)
 local previous=Q.new(recipe);local q=P.plain(previous);edit=P.plain(edit)
 assert(type(edit)=='table'and getmetatable(edit).__jsontype=='object','recipe edit must be an object')
 assert(edit.schema_version==1,'recipe edit schema_version1 required');fields(edit)
 for _,key in ipairs{'parameters','inputs','style'}do
  if edit[key]~=nil then assert(type(edit[key])=='table'and getmetatable(edit[key]).__jsontype=='object','recipe edit '..key..' requires an object')end
 end
 for _,key in ipairs{'crop','protected_regions','page_size'}do
  if edit[key]~=nil then assert(type(edit[key])=='table'and getmetatable(edit[key]).__jsontype=='array','recipe edit '..key..' requires an array')end
 end
 if edit.parameters then merge(q.design.parameters,edit.parameters)end
 if edit.inputs then merge(q.design.inputs,edit.inputs)end
 if edit.style then merge(q.design.style,edit.style)end
 if edit.seed~=nil then
  q.design.seed=edit.seed
  if q.definition.id=='botanical/legacy-authored'or q.definition.id=='botanical/legacy-grown'then
   -- The legacy generator consumes this validated native host packet. Keep
   -- its seed synchronized with the edited design; never reuse old growth.
   local geometry=assert(q.design.extensions and q.design.extensions.legacy_geometry,'Floral seed editing requires actual native host geometry')
   geometry.seed=edit.seed
  end
 end
 if edit.page_size then
  assert(type(edit.page_size)=='table'and #edit.page_size==2,'page size needs width/height in cm')
  for _,n in ipairs(edit.page_size)do assert(type(n)=='number'and n==n and n>=.1 and n<=60,'editor media size must be0.1..60cm')end
 end
 local planned=q.view.extensions and q.view.extensions.document_planning
 if planned then
  local input=document_input(planned.document);local page
  for _,p in ipairs(input.pages)do if p.id==planned.page_id then page=p end end;assert(page,'editor physical page missing')
  local options=P.plain(planned.options)
  if edit.page_size then page.size=P.plain(edit.page_size);page.trim={0,0,page.size[1],page.size[2]};options.crop={0,0,page.size[1],page.size[2]};options.region=nil end
  if edit.protected_regions then
   page.protected_regions=P.array()
   for i,region in ipairs(edit.protected_regions)do page.protected_regions[i]={id='editor-region-'..i,bounds=P.plain(region.bounds),space='page',role='protected_content'}end
  end
  if edit.crop then options.crop=P.plain(edit.crop);options.region=nil end
  local document=D.new(input);local capability=Planner.import_profile(q.definition,planned.profile)
  local next_recipe,problem=Planner.recipe(q.definition,q.design,document,planned.page_id,capability,{},options)
  assert(next_recipe,problem and table.concat(P.plain(problem.diagnostics),'; '))
  local data=P.plain(next_recipe);data.id=q.id;data.dependencies=P.plain(q.dependencies);q=data
 else
  if edit.page_size then
   local b=q.design.document.bounds;local c=q.view.crop
   q.design.document.bounds={b[1],b[2],b[1]+edit.page_size[1],b[2]+edit.page_size[2]}
   q.view.crop={c[1],c[2],c[1]+edit.page_size[1],c[2]+edit.page_size[2]}
  end
  if edit.crop then q.view.crop=P.plain(edit.crop)end
  if edit.protected_regions then q.view.protected_regions=P.plain(edit.protected_regions)end
 end
 local result=Q.new(q)
 return result,{schema_version=1,operation=M.VERSION,input_recipe_sha256=H.sha256(Q.encode(previous)),
  output_recipe_sha256=H.sha256(Q.encode(result)),edit_sha256=H.value('recipe/edit',edit),
  structural_change=Q.structural_digest(previous)~=Q.structural_digest(result)}
end
return M

local P,G,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_geometry"),require("pattern_hash")
local Metric=require("pattern_escher_metric")
local Periodic=require("pattern_escher_periodic")
local P3=require("pattern_escher_p3")
local Penrose=require("pattern_penrose")
local M={VERSION="escher-boundary-coupling-v1"}
-- Turning-function diagnostics use the existing 1e-12 numerical policy.
-- The witness, source geometry and combinatorial certificates remain exact.
local function metric_close(recorded,computed)
  return type(recorded)=="number" and recorded>=0 and recorded<math.huge
    and math.abs(recorded-computed)<=1e-12*math.max(1,math.abs(computed))
end
local function metric_errors(recorded,computed)
  if type(recorded)~="table" or #recorded~=#computed then return false end
  for key in pairs(recorded) do
    if type(key)~="number" or key%1~=0 or key<1 or key>#computed then return false end
  end
  for i,value in ipairs(computed) do
    if not metric_close(recorded[i],value) then return false end
  end
  return true
end
local function domain(request)
  if request.profile=="penrose" then return P3.domain() end
  return Periodic.domain(request.profile=="split")
end
local function shapes(request,values)
  if request.profile=="penrose" then return P3.shapes(values) end
  return Periodic.shapes(values,request)
end
local function goal_records(targets)
  local out={}
  for i,polygon in ipairs(targets) do out[i]=Metric.turning(Metric.polygon(polygon)) end
  return out
end
local function target_list(input,count)
  assert(type(input)=="table" and #input==count,"escher-target-count")
  for k in pairs(input) do
    assert(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=count,"escher-target-array")
  end
  local targets=P.array()
  for i=1,count do targets[i]=P.plain(Metric.polygon(input[i])) end
  return targets
end
local function witness(values,bounds)
  assert(type(values)=="table" and #values==#bounds,"escher-witness-size")
  for k in pairs(values) do
    assert(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=#bounds,"escher-witness-array")
  end
  for i,b in ipairs(bounds) do
    local v=values[i]
    assert(type(v)=="number" and v%1==0 and v>=b[1] and v<=b[2],"escher-witness-outside-domain")
  end
  return P.plain(values)
end
local function request_from(s,c)
  local a=s.parameters
  if a.profile=="penrose" then assert(a.aspect==nil and a.shear==nil,"escher-p3-scaffold-metric-fixed")
  else assert(a.phase==nil,"escher-phase-requires-penrose") end
  local request={profile=a.profile,step_cm=a.edge_length,frame=P.plain(c.frame),query=P.plain(s.document.bounds),
    phase=a.profile=="penrose" and (a.phase or "amber") or nil,
    aspect=a.profile~="penrose" and (a.aspect or 1) or nil,
    shear=a.profile~="penrose" and (a.shear or 0) or nil}
  if a.profile=="penrose" then
    for i,v in ipairs(request.query) do
      assert(math.abs((v-request.frame.origin[(i-1)%2+1])/request.step_cm)<=32,"escher-p3-query-horizon")
    end
  end
  return request
end
local function evaluate(request,targets,context)
  local goals=goal_records(targets)
  local initial=domain(request)
  local base=request.profile=="penrose" and P3.baseline() or shapes(request,initial)
  local baseline,baseline_errors=Metric.objective(base,goals)
  local function score(values)
    local p=shapes(request,values)
    if p then return Metric.objective(p,goals,context) end
  end
  return baseline,baseline_errors,score
end
local function stop(status,receipt)
  receipt.status=status
  error({code="escher_"..status,message="Escherization: "..status,solver=receipt},0)
end
local function solve(request,s,targets,c)
  local baseline,baseline_errors,score=evaluate(request,targets,c)
  local initial,bounds=domain(request)
  local steps=s.parameters.steps or 180
  local receipt={algorithm=Metric.VERSION,seed=s.seed,budget=steps,baseline=baseline,
    baseline_errors=baseline_errors,targets_sha256=H.value("escher/targets",targets),
    objective=#targets==1 and "turning-L2" or "max-of-two-turning-L2",
    target_assignment=request.profile=="penrose" and {"thick","thin"} or
      (request.profile=="split" and {"west","east"} or {"mono"})}
  local values
  if s.inputs.witness then
    values=witness(s.inputs.witness,bounds)
    receipt.route="replayed"
    receipt.evaluations=1
    receipt.score,receipt.errors=score(values)
    if not receipt.score then stop("inadmissible_witness",receipt) end
  else
    receipt.route="annealed"
    if steps==0 then stop("limited",receipt) end
    local result=Metric.anneal(initial,bounds,steps,c:stream("shape-anneal",request.profile),score)
    values=result.values
    receipt.evaluations=steps+1
    receipt.score,receipt.errors=result.score,result.errors
    receipt.accepted,receipt.invalid_proposals,receipt.improvements=result.accepted,result.invalid_proposals,result.improvements
    receipt.temperature=result.temperature
  end
  if receipt.score>=baseline-1e-8 then stop("no_improvement",receipt) end
  receipt.status="improved"
  receipt.witness_sha256=H.value("escher/witness",values)
  return values,receipt
end
local function base_penrose(reg,d,request,seed,budget,c)
  local s={id="escher/penrose-source",definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},
    seed=seed,parameters={edge_length=request.step_cm,phase=request.phase},inputs={},style={},constraints={},
    budget=P.plain(budget),document={unit="cm",bounds=P.plain(request.query),protected_regions=P.array()}}
  local r,e=reg:generate(d.id,s,c)
  assert(r,e and P.serialize(e))
  return r.instance
end
local function prefix(request,values)
  local key=P.plain(request)
  key.query=nil
  return "escher/"..H.value("escher/geometry",{method=M.VERSION,request=key,values=values})
end
local function build(request,values,source,c)
  local key=prefix(request,values)
  if request.profile=="penrose" then return P3.patch(source,values,request.query,key,c) end
  return Periodic.patch(request,values,key,c)
end
function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="tiling/escherization",version="1",family="boundary-coupled-escherization",
    units="cm",capabilities={"tiling"},parameters={
      profile={type="string",enum={"periodic","split","penrose"},required=true},
      edge_length={type="number",minimum=.2,maximum=2,required=true},
      aspect={type="number",minimum=.65,maximum=1.7},shear={type="number",minimum=-.45,maximum=.45},
      phase={type="string",enum={"amber","indigo"}},steps={type="integer",minimum=0,maximum=480}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Bounded IH41 and split-IH41 translation charts",
      "Four active source quasivertex controls and paired fundamental edges for Penrose P3",
      "Normalized turning distance and deterministic bounded annealing for simple CCW targets",
      "Retained source scaffold and explicit finite deformation validation"}})
end
local function check_inputs(s)
  for k in pairs(s.inputs) do assert(k=="targets" or k=="witness","escher-input:"..k) end
  assert(next(P.plain(s.constraints))==nil,"escher-unsupported-constraints")
  target_list(s.inputs.targets,s.parameters.profile=="periodic" and 1 or 2)
  return true
end
local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.escher
  local request=e.request
  assert(P.serialize(x.frame)==P.serialize(request.frame),"escher-frame")
  local _,bounds=domain(request)
  local values=witness(e.values,bounds)
  local targets=target_list(e.targets,request.profile=="periodic" and 1 or 2)
  local baseline,baseline_errors,score=evaluate(request,targets)
  local best,errors=score(values)
  assert(best and best<baseline-1e-8,"escher-witness-does-not-improve")
  local s=e.solver
  assert(s.algorithm==Metric.VERSION and s.status=="improved" and s.seed==x.provenance.seed
    and s.targets_sha256==H.value("escher/targets",targets) and s.witness_sha256==H.value("escher/witness",values),
    "escher-solver-provenance")
  assert(s.route=="annealed" or s.route=="replayed","escher-solver-route")
  assert(metric_close(s.baseline,baseline) and metric_close(s.score,best) and metric_errors(s.errors,errors)
    and metric_errors(s.baseline_errors,baseline_errors),"escher-objective-reconstruction")
  if request.profile=="penrose" then
    local q=e.scaffold.extensions.penrose.request
    assert(P.serialize(e.scaffold.frame)==P.serialize(x.frame) and q.step_cm==request.step_cm
      and q.phase==request.phase and P.serialize(q.world_query)==P.serialize(request.query),"escher-source-scaffold")
    Penrose.validate(e.scaffold)
  else assert(e.scaffold==nil,"escher-unexpected-scaffold") end
  local tiling,proof=build(request,values,e.scaffold)
  assert(P.serialize(tiling)==P.serialize(x.structures.tiling) and P.serialize(proof)==P.serialize(e.certificate),
    "escher-patch-reconstruction")
  return {ok=true,solver=P.plain(s),construction=P.plain(proof),
    checks={"simple positive prototile contours and an improving witness",
      "matched directed edge classes and reconstructed shared paths",
      "bounded source chart and finite query coverage"}}
end
function M.validate(x) return validate(P.instance(P.plain(x),M.definition())) end
local function intersects(points,crop,pad)
  local l,b,r,t=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
  for _,p in ipairs(points) do l,b,r,t=math.min(l,p[1]),math.min(b,p[2]),math.max(r,p[1]),math.max(t,p[2]) end
  return l<=crop[3]+pad and b<=crop[4]+pad and r>=crop[1]-pad and t>=crop[2]-pad
end
local function indexed(items)
  local map={}
  for _,v in ipairs(items) do map[v.id]=v end
  return map
end
local function points_of(cell,edges)
  local out={}
  for _,use in ipairs(cell.boundary) do
    local path=edges[use.edge].path
    for i=1,#path-1 do out[#out+1]=path[use.reversed and #path-i+1 or i] end
  end
  return out
end
local colors={mono={.31,.59,.64},west={.21,.42,.58},east={.82,.63,.37},
  thick={.28,.54,.51},thin={.86,.65,.39}}
local function lower(x,v,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="display","escher-style:"..k) end
  local display=style.display or "design"
  assert(display=="design" or display=="scaffold","escher-display")
  local e=x.extensions.escher
  local transform=P.plain(v.transform)
  local crop=v.crop
  local inverse=G.inverse(transform,G.policy("cm",e.request.step_cm))
  local q=e.request.query
  for _,corner in ipairs{{crop[1],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[4]},{crop[1],crop[4]}} do
    local p=G.transform(corner,inverse)
    assert(p[1]>=q[1]-1e-10 and p[2]>=q[2]-1e-10 and p[1]<=q[3]+1e-10 and p[2]<=q[4]+1e-10,
      "escher-view-outside-certified-query")
  end
  local tiling=x.structures.tiling
  local edges=indexed(tiling.edges)
  local source_cells,source_edges,source_vertices
  if e.scaffold then
    local s=e.scaffold.structures.tiling
    source_cells,source_edges,source_vertices=indexed(s.cells),indexed(s.edges),indexed(s.vertices)
  end
  local function scaffold_points(cell)
    if source_cells then
      local out={}
      for i,use in ipairs(source_cells[cell.source_ref].boundary) do
        local edge=source_edges[use.edge]
        out[i]=source_vertices[use.reversed and edge.to or edge.from].point
      end
      return out
    end
    local i,j=table.unpack(cell.source_slot)
    local left=cell.prototype=="east" and i+.5 or i
    local right=cell.prototype=="west" and i+.5 or i+1
    local points={}
    for n,p in ipairs{{left,j},{right,j},{right,j+1},{left,j+1}} do
      points[n]={x.frame.origin[1]+e.request.step_cm*(p[1]+e.request.shear*p[2]),
        x.frame.origin[2]+e.request.step_cm*e.request.aspect*p[2]}
    end
    return points
  end
  local ops=P.array()
  local scale=math.sqrt(transform[1]^2+transform[2]^2+transform[3]^2+transform[4]^2)
  local function path(ref,points,paint,closed)
    local commands,projected={},{}
    for i,p in ipairs(points) do
      commands[i]={i==1 and "M" or "L",p[1],p[2]}
      projected[i]=G.transform(p,transform)
    end
    if not intersects(projected,crop,(paint.stroke_width or 0)*scale) then return end
    if closed then commands[#commands+1]={"Z"} end
    ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=ref,commands=commands,transform=transform,paint=paint}
  end
  if display=="design" then
    for _,c in ipairs(tiling.cells) do path(c.id,points_of(c,edges),{fill=colors[c.prototype]},true) end
    for _,edge in ipairs(tiling.edges) do path(edge.id,edge.path,{stroke={.10,.21,.27},stroke_width=.014},false) end
  else
    for _,c in ipairs(tiling.cells) do
      path(c.id,scaffold_points(c),{fill=colors[c.prototype],stroke={.10,.21,.27},stroke_width=.014},true)
    end
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,operations=ops,resources=P.array(),
    clip={bounds=P.plain(crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)}}
end
function M.register(registry)
  local d=M.definition()
  local base=require("pattern_registry").new()
  local pd=Penrose.register(base)
  registry:register(d,{validate_inputs=check_inputs,generate=function(s,c)
    assert(c.frame.unit=="cm" and c.frame.dimension==2 and c.frame.handedness=="right","escher-frame")
    local request=request_from(s,c)
    local targets=target_list(s.inputs.targets,request.profile=="periodic" and 1 or 2)
    local values,solver=solve(request,s,targets,c)
    local source
    if request.profile=="penrose" then source=base_penrose(base,pd,request,s.seed,s.budget,c) end
    local tiling,certificate=build(request,values,source,c)
    return {id=prefix(request,values).."/query/"..H.value("escher/query",request.query),
      definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={tiling=tiling},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={escher={request=request,targets=targets,values=values,solver=solver,certificate=certificate,
        scaffold=source and P.plain(source) or nil}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end
return M
