-- Bounded direct evaluation of the normalized polygon turning-function metric.
local P,G=require("pattern"),require("pattern_geometry")
local M={VERSION="turning-l2-anneal-v1"}
local pi,tau=math.pi,2*math.pi
local policy=G.policy("cm",16,1e-12,1e-12)
local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge end
function M.polygon(input)
  assert(type(input)=="table" and #input>=3 and #input<=40,"escher-silhouette-size")
  for _,p in ipairs(input) do
    assert(type(p)=="table" and #p==2 and finite(p[1]) and finite(p[2])
      and math.abs(p[1])<=1024 and math.abs(p[2])<=1024,"escher-silhouette-coordinate")
  end
  return G.region(input,P.array(),policy).outer
end
function M.turning(points)
  local length,total,angles={0},0,{}
  local previous
  for i,p in ipairs(points) do
    local q=points[i%#points+1]
    local dx,dy=q[1]-p[1],q[2]-p[2]
    local l=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
    assert(l>1e-12,"escher-zero-edge")
    local theta=math.atan(dy,dx)
    if previous then theta=previous+(theta-previous+pi)%tau-pi end
    angles[i]=theta;previous=theta
    total=total+l;length[i+1]=total
  end
  for i=2,#length do length[i]=length[i]/total end
  return {breaks=length,angles=angles}
end
local function variance(p,q,offset)
  local n,m=#p.angles,#q.angles
  local i,j,turn,s=1,1,0,0
  while j<m and q.breaks[j+1]<=offset do j=j+1 end
  local mean,square=0,0
  while i<=n and s<1 do
    local qe=q.breaks[j+1]+turn-offset
    local pe=p.breaks[i+1]
    local z=math.min(pe,qe,1)
    local d=p.angles[i]-q.angles[j]-turn*tau
    local width=math.max(0,z-s)
    mean=mean+width*d
    square=square+width*d*d
    s=math.max(z,s)
    if qe<=z then
      if j==m then j=1;turn=turn+1 else j=j+1 end
    end
    if pe<=z then i=i+1 end
  end
  return math.max(0,square-mean*mean)
end
function M.distance(p,q)
  local best=math.huge
  for i=1,#p.angles do
    for j=1,#q.angles do
      local shift=(q.breaks[j]-p.breaks[i])%1
      best=math.min(best,variance(p,q,shift))
    end
  end
  return math.sqrt(best)
end
function M.objective(shapes,goals,context)
  assert(#shapes==#goals,"escher-target-count")
  local errors={}
  for i,p in ipairs(shapes) do
    local ok,ring=pcall(M.polygon,p)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local q=goals[i]
    if context then context:consume("operations",#p*#q.angles*(#p+#q.angles)) end
    errors[i]=M.distance(M.turning(ring),q)
  end
  return math.max(table.unpack(errors)),errors
end
function M.anneal(initial,bounds,steps,rng,evaluate)
  local values=P.plain(initial)
  local score,errors=evaluate(values)
  assert(score,"escher-initial-shape-invalid")
  local best,best_score,best_errors=P.plain(values),score,errors
  local accepted,rejected,improved=0,0,0
  for i=1,steps do
    local progress=(i-1)/math.max(1,steps-1)
    local temperature=.18*(.004/.18)^progress
    local k=rng.int(1,#values)
    local lo,hi=table.unpack(bounds[k])
    local jump=math.max(1,math.floor((hi-lo)*(.25-.225*progress)))
    local proposal=P.plain(values)
    proposal[k]=math.max(lo,math.min(hi,proposal[k]+rng.int(-jump,jump)))
    local candidate,e=evaluate(proposal)
    if not candidate then
      rejected=rejected+1
    elseif candidate<=score or rng.u()<math.exp((score-candidate)/temperature) then
      values,score=proposal,candidate
      accepted=accepted+1
      if score<best_score-1e-12 then
        best,best_score,best_errors=P.plain(values),score,e
        improved=improved+1
      end
    end
  end
  return {values=best,score=best_score,errors=best_errors,accepted=accepted,
    invalid_proposals=rejected,improvements=improved,steps=steps,
    temperature={start=.18,finish=.004,law="geometric"}}
end
return M
source.pattern_escher_p3.lua:
-- Kaplan thesis Figure 4.23 and Kaplan–Salesin Figure 6. Every
-- quasivertex lives in an integer chart of Q(zeta_20), not a snapped plane.
local P,G,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_geometry"),require("pattern_hash")
local Metric=require("pattern_escher_metric")
local M={VERSION="p3-quasivertex-fig423-v1",DENOMINATOR=1024}
local D=M.DENOMINATOR
local function zero() return {0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0} end
local roots={{1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0}}
for j=2,20 do
  local a=roots[j-1]
  roots[j]={-a[8],a[1],a[2]+a[8],a[3],a[4]-a[8],a[5],a[6]+a[8],a[7]}
end
local function root(k) return roots[k%20+1] end
local function add(a,b)
  local out={}
  for i=1,8 do out[i]=a[i]+b[i] end
  return out
end
local function scale(a,k)
  local out={}
  for i=1,8 do out[i]=a[i]*k end
  return out
end
local function sub(a,b) return add(a,scale(b,-1)) end
local function rotate(a,k)
  local out=zero()
  for i=1,8 do
    if a[i]~=0 then
      local r=root(i-1+k)
      for j=1,8 do out[j]=out[j]+a[i]*r[j] end
    end
  end
  return out
end
local function around(center,k,p) return add(center,rotate(sub(p,center),k)) end
local function key(a) return table.concat(a,",") end
local re,im={},{}
for i=1,8 do re[i],im[i]=math.cos((i-1)*math.pi/10),math.sin((i-1)*math.pi/10) end
local function coordinates(a,denominator)
  local x,y=0,0
  for i=1,8 do x=x+a[i]*re[i];y=y+a[i]*im[i] end
  return {x/denominator,y/denominator}
end
local labels={
  thick={"a","b","c","d","e","f","e","g","a","b","h","g"},
  thin={"a","f","c","d","e","g","a","b","h","g"},
}
local classes={a=1,g=1,b=2,e=2,c=3,d=3,f=4,h=4}
local forward={a=true,b=true,c=true,f=true}
local partners={a="g",g="a",b="e",e="b",c="d",d="c",f="h",h="f"}
local anchors={thick="2+2-1-1+",thin="1-2+2-1+"}
local function original(k)
  local a=scale(rotate(sub(root(k),root(-k)),-5),D)
  local b=scale(rotate(add(root(k),root(-k)),5),D)
  return a,b,scale(a,-1),scale(b,-1)
end
local function prototypes(values)
  local function delta(i,k)
    return scale(sub(scale(root(k),values[i]),scale(root(k+5),values[i+1])),2)
  end
  local a,b,_,d=original(2)
  local e,f=add(a,delta(1,7)),add(a,delta(3,7))
  local g,h=around(b,-4,f),around(b,-4,e)
  local i,j=add(d,delta(3,5)),add(d,delta(1,5))
  local k,l,m=around(d,-4,j),around(d,-4,i),around(d,-4,h)
  local thick={a,e,f,b,g,h,i,j,d,k,l,m}
  local c
  a,b,c,d=original(1)
  e,f=add(a,delta(1,12)),add(b,delta(3,14))
  g=around(c,-8,f)
  h,i=add(d,delta(1,6)),add(d,delta(1,2))
  j,k=around(a,8,f),around(a,8,e)
  return {thick=thick,thin={a,e,f,c,g,h,d,i,j,k}}
end
local function middle(a,b,amount)
  return add(scale(add(a,b),D),scale(rotate(sub(b,a),5),2*amount))
end
local function shape(proto,kind,values)
  local out={}
  for i,a in ipairs(proto) do
    local b=proto[i%#proto+1]
    local label=labels[kind][i]
    local q=values[4+classes[label]]
    out[#out+1]=coordinates(a,2*D)
    if q~=0 then out[#out+1]=coordinates(middle(a,b,forward[label] and q or -q),4*D*D) end
  end
  return out
end
function M.shapes(values)
  local p=prototypes(values)
  return {shape(p.thick,"thick",values),shape(p.thin,"thin",values)}
end
function M.baseline()
  local out={}
  for _,k in ipairs{2,1} do
    local a={}
    for _,p in ipairs{original(k)} do a[#a+1]=coordinates(p,2*D) end
    out[#out+1]=a
  end
  return out
end
function M.domain()
  return {75,70,204,20,0,0,0,0},{{42,105},{45,104},{170,246},{8,48},
    {-28,28},{-28,28},{-28,28},{-28,28}}
end
local function lifted(k)
  local point=zero()
  for i,v in ipairs(k) do point=add(point,scale(root(4*(i-1)),2*D*v)) end
  return point
end
local function placement(cell,edges,vertices)
  local corners,marks={},{}
  for i,use in ipairs(cell.boundary) do
    local edge=edges[use.edge]
    local from=use.reversed and edge.to or edge.from
    corners[i]=vertices[from].lift
    marks[i]=edge.matching.multiplicity..(edge.matching.from==from and "+" or "-")
  end
  for i,k in ipairs(corners) do
    local tag={}
    for j=0,3 do tag[#tag+1]=marks[(i+j-1)%4+1] end
    if table.concat(tag)==anchors[cell.prototype] then
      local next_lift=corners[i%4+1]
      local direction
      for j,v in ipairs(k) do
        local d=next_lift[j]-v
        if d~=0 then
          assert(not direction and math.abs(d)==1,"escher-p3-source-edge-direction")
          direction=4*(j-1)+(d<0 and 10 or 0)
        end
      end
      assert(direction,"escher-p3-zero-source-edge")
      return lifted(k),direction-(cell.prototype=="thick" and 7 or 6),k
    end
  end
  error("escher-p3-arrow-anchor")
end
local function map(items)
  local out={}
  for _,v in ipairs(items) do out[v.id]=v end
  return out
end
local function sorted(t)
  local out={}
  for k in pairs(t) do out[#out+1]=k end
  table.sort(out,P.byte_less)
  return out
end
local function bounds(points)
  local a,b,c,d=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
  for _,p in ipairs(points) do a,b,c,d=math.min(a,p[1]),math.min(b,p[2]),math.max(c,p[1]),math.max(d,p[2]) end
  return {a,b,c,d}
end
local function hits(a,b)
  return a[1]<=b[3] and a[2]<=b[4] and a[3]>=b[1] and a[4]>=b[2]
end
local function winding(polygons,query,scale_cm)
  local policy=G.policy("cm",scale_cm)
  for _,f in ipairs{{.437,.563},{.291,.467},{.739,.317}} do
    local q={query[1]+f[1]*(query[3]-query[1]),query[2]+f[2]*(query[4]-query[2])}
    local inside,boundary=0,false
    for _,poly in ipairs(polygons) do
      if hits(poly.box,{q[1],q[2],q[1],q[2]}) then
        local r=G.region(poly.points,P.array(),policy)
        local classified=G.contains(r,q)
        if classified=="boundary" then boundary=true
        elseif classified=="inside" then inside=inside+1 end
      end
    end
    if not boundary then
      assert(inside==1,"escher-p3-query-winding")
      return q
    end
  end
  error("escher-p3-no-unambiguous-winding-witness")
end
function M.patch(source,values,query,prefix,context)
  local protos=prototypes(values)
  for _,p in ipairs(M.shapes(values)) do Metric.polygon(p) end
  local request=source.extensions.penrose.request
  local origin,step=source.frame.origin,request.step_cm
  local function world(a,d)
    local p=coordinates(a,d)
    return {origin[1]+step*p[1],origin[2]+step*p[2]}
  end
  local tiling=source.structures.tiling
  local vertices,edges=map(tiling.vertices),map(tiling.edges)
  local global,point_map,polygons={},{},{}
  local cells=P.array()
  local function ensure_point(a)
    local k=key(a)
    if not point_map[k] then
      point_map[k]={id=prefix.."/v/"..k,point=world(a,2*D),cyclotomic=a}
    end
    return point_map[k]
  end
  for _,cell in ipairs(tiling.cells) do
    local anchor,rotation,lift=placement(cell,edges,vertices)
    local proto=protos[cell.prototype]
    local points,walk,boundary={},P.array(),P.array()
    for i,p in ipairs(proto) do points[i]=add(anchor,rotate(sub(p,proto[1]),rotation)) end
    local id=prefix.."/c/"..table.concat(cell.address,"/")
    for i,a in ipairs(points) do
      local b=points[i%#points+1]
      local va,vb=ensure_point(a),ensure_point(b)
      local ka,kb=key(a),key(b)
      local reverse=P.byte_less(kb,ka)
      local eid=reverse and kb.."+"..ka or ka.."+"..kb
      local label=labels[cell.prototype][i]
      local amount=values[4+classes[label]]*(forward[label] and 1 or -1)
      local bend=amount~=0 and middle(a,b,amount) or nil
      walk[#walk+1]=va.point
      if bend then walk[#walk+1]=world(bend,4*D*D) end
      local e=global[eid]
      if not e then
        e={id=prefix.."/e/"..eid,from=reverse and vb.id or va.id,to=reverse and va.id or vb.id,
          midpoint=bend,uses={},family=classes[label]}
        global[eid]=e
      else
        local first=e.uses[1]
        assert(#e.uses==1 and first.reverse~=reverse and partners[first.label]==label,
          "escher-p3-fundamental-edge-incidence")
        assert((not bend and not e.midpoint) or (bend and e.midpoint and key(bend)==key(e.midpoint)),
          "escher-p3-coupled-bend-mismatch")
      end
      e.uses[#e.uses+1]={cell=id,label=label,reverse=reverse}
      boundary[i]={edge=e.id,reversed=reverse}
    end
    polygons[#polygons+1]={points=walk,box=bounds(walk)}
    cells[#cells+1]={id=id,prototype=cell.prototype,chirality=1,boundary=boundary,
      source_ref=cell.id,source_anchor=lift,rotation=rotation}
  end
  local out_edges,out_vertices=P.array(),P.array()
  local pairs,outer=0,0
  for _,k in ipairs(sorted(global)) do
    local e=global[k]
    local first,second=table.unpack(e.uses)
    local role=second and "interior" or "patch_boundary"
    local a,b=k:match("^([^+]+)%+([^+]+)$")
    local path={point_map[a].point}
    if e.midpoint then path[2]=world(e.midpoint,4*D*D) end
    path[#path+1]=point_map[b].point
    if second then pairs=pairs+1 else
      outer=outer+1
      assert(not hits(bounds(path),query),"escher-p3-unpaired-side-in-query")
    end
    local owner=second and P.byte_less(second.cell,first.cell) and second.cell or first.cell
    out_edges[#out_edges+1]={id=e.id,from=e.from,to=e.to,owner=owner,role=role,path=path,
      class=e.family,incidence=e.uses,exact_midpoint=e.midpoint}
  end
  for _,k in ipairs(sorted(point_map)) do out_vertices[#out_vertices+1]=point_map[k] end
  if context then context:consume("objects",#cells+#out_edges+#out_vertices) end
  local proof={method=M.VERSION,paired_edges=pairs,outer_edges=outer,query=P.plain(query),
    winding_witness=winding(polygons,query,step),winding=1,coordinate_denominator=2*D,
    midpoint_denominator=4*D*D,source_sha256=H.sha256(P.serialize(source)),
    edge_pairs={{"a","g"},{"b","e"},{"c","d"},{"f","h"}}}
  return {cells=cells,edges=out_edges,vertices=out_vertices},proof
end
return M
source.pattern_escher_periodic.lua:
-- Bounded IH41 parallelogram chart. The periodic displacement map
-- F(x,y)=(x+g(y),y+f(x)) preserves the partition when Lip(f)*Lip(g)<1.
local P,R=require("pattern"),require("pattern_exact")
local M={VERSION="ih41-translation-chart-v1"}
local D=512
local half=R.new(1,2)
local function knot(i) return R.new(i,4) end
local function number(q) return q[1]/q[2] end
local function value_at(values,t)
  if t[1]==t[2] then return values[5] end
  local k=(4*t[1])//t[2]
  return R.add(values[k+1],R.mul(R.sub(values[k+2],values[k+1]),R.sub(R.mul(R.new(4),t),R.new(k))))
end
local function controls(values,start)
  return {R.new(0),R.new(values[start],D),R.new(values[start+1],D),R.new(values[start+2],D),R.new(0)}
end
local function slope(values)
  local maximum=0
  for i=1,4 do maximum=math.max(maximum,4*math.abs(number(R.sub(values[i+1],values[i])))) end
  return maximum
end
local function chart(values,split)
  local f,g=controls(values,1),controls(values,4)
  local a,b=slope(f),slope(g)
  if a*b>=.92 then return nil end
  local horizontal,vertical={},{}
  for i=0,4 do
    horizontal[i+1]={knot(i),f[i+1]}
    vertical[i+1]={g[i+1],knot(i)}
  end
  local paths={vertical=vertical}
  if split then
    paths.west={horizontal[1],horizontal[2],horizontal[3]}
    paths.east={horizontal[3],horizontal[4],horizontal[5]}
    local seam={}
    local h=controls(values,7)
    local function add(y)
      local x=R.add(half,value_at(h,y))
      assert(R.compare(x,knot(1))>0 and R.compare(x,knot(3))<0,"escher-split-outside-chart")
      seam[#seam+1]={R.add(x,value_at(g,y)),R.add(y,value_at(f,x))}
    end
    for i=0,3 do
      add(knot(i))
      local u,v=h[i+1],h[i+2]
      if u[1]*v[1]<0 then
        add(R.add(knot(i),R.mul(knot(1),R.div(u,R.sub(u,v)))))
      end
    end
    add(knot(4))
    paths.split=seam
  else
    paths.horizontal=horizontal
  end
  return paths,{f_lipschitz=a,g_lipschitz=b,product=a*b}
end
local function use(name,x,y,reversed) return {family=name,x=x,y=y,reversed=reversed or false} end
local mono={{prototype="mono",edges={use("horizontal",0,0),use("vertical",1,0),
  use("horizontal",0,1,true),use("vertical",0,0,true)}}}
local split_faces={
  {prototype="west",edges={use("west",0,0),use("split",0,0),use("west",0,1,true),use("vertical",0,0,true)}},
  {prototype="east",edges={use("east",0,0),use("vertical",1,0),use("east",0,1,true),use("split",0,0,true)}},
}
local function world(p,request)
  local x,y=number(p[1]),number(p[2])
  return {request.frame.origin[1]+request.step_cm*(x+request.shear*y),
    request.frame.origin[2]+request.step_cm*request.aspect*y}
end
local function translate(p,x,y)
  return {R.add(p[1],R.new(x)),R.add(p[2],R.new(y))}
end
local function face_points(face,paths,request)
  local out={}
  for _,e in ipairs(face.edges) do
    local line=paths[e.family]
    for i=1,#line-1 do
      local p=line[e.reversed and #line-i+1 or i]
      out[#out+1]=world(translate(p,e.x,e.y),request)
    end
  end
  return out
end
function M.shapes(values,request)
  local split=request.profile=="split"
  local paths=chart(values,split)
  if not paths then return nil end
  local out={}
  local basis={frame={origin={0,0}},step_cm=1,shear=request.shear,aspect=request.aspect}
  for i,face in ipairs(split and split_faces or mono) do out[i]=face_points(face,paths,basis) end
  return out
end
function M.domain(split)
  local values,bounds={},{}
  for i=1,(split and 9 or 6) do
    values[i]=0
    local max=i>6 and 96 or 82
    bounds[i]={-max,max}
  end
  return values,bounds
end
local function key(p)
  return p[1][1]..":"..p[1][2]..","..p[2][1]..":"..p[2][2]
end
local function sorted(map)
  local out={}
  for k in pairs(map) do out[#out+1]=k end
  table.sort(out,P.byte_less)
  return out
end
local function index_limits(request)
  local q,o=request.query,request.frame.origin
  local lo,hi={math.huge,math.huge},{-math.huge,-math.huge}
  for _,p in ipairs{{q[1],q[2]},{q[3],q[2]},{q[3],q[4]},{q[1],q[4]}} do
    local y=(p[2]-o[2])/(request.step_cm*request.aspect)
    local x=(p[1]-o[1])/request.step_cm-request.shear*y
    assert(math.abs(x)<=64 and math.abs(y)<=64,"escher-periodic-query-horizon")
    lo[1],lo[2]=math.min(lo[1],x),math.min(lo[2],y)
    hi[1],hi[2]=math.max(hi[1],x),math.max(hi[2],y)
  end
  for i=1,2 do lo[i],hi[i]=math.floor(lo[i])-1,math.ceil(hi[i])+1 end
  assert((hi[1]-lo[1]+1)*(hi[2]-lo[2]+1)<=300,"escher-periodic-cell-budget")
  return lo,hi
end
function M.patch(request,values,prefix,context)
  local split=request.profile=="split"
  local paths,proof=chart(values,split)
  assert(paths,"escher-periodic-noncontractive")
  local lo,hi=index_limits(request)
  local vertices,edges,cells=P.array(),P.array(),P.array()
  local by_point,by_edge={},{}
  local function vertex(p)
    local k=key(p)
    if not by_point[k] then
      by_point[k]={id=prefix.."/v/"..k,point=world(p,request),rational_chart=p}
    end
    return by_point[k].id
  end
  for j=lo[2],hi[2] do for i=lo[1],hi[1] do
    for _,face in ipairs(split and split_faces or mono) do
      local id=prefix.."/c/"..i.."/"..j.."/"..face.prototype
      local boundary=P.array()
      for n,use in ipairs(face.edges) do
        local x,y=i+use.x,j+use.y
        local k=use.family.."/"..x.."/"..y
        local e=by_edge[k]
        if not e then
          local geometry,points={},{}
          for m,p in ipairs(paths[use.family]) do
            geometry[m]=translate(p,x,y)
            points[m]=world(geometry[m],request)
          end
          e={id=prefix.."/e/"..k,from=vertex(geometry[1]),to=vertex(geometry[#geometry]),
            path=points,rational_chart=geometry,incidence=P.array(),family=use.family}
          by_edge[k]=e
        end
        local first=e.incidence[1]
        assert(#e.incidence<2 and (not first or first.reversed~=use.reversed),"escher-periodic-incidence")
        e.incidence[#e.incidence+1]={cell=id,reversed=use.reversed}
        boundary[n]={edge=e.id,reversed=use.reversed}
      end
      cells[#cells+1]={id=id,prototype=face.prototype,chirality=1,boundary=boundary,source_slot={i,j}}
    end
  end end
  local paired=0
  for _,k in ipairs(sorted(by_edge)) do
    local e=by_edge[k]
    local first,second=table.unpack(e.incidence)
    e.owner=second and P.byte_less(second.cell,first.cell) and second.cell or first.cell
    e.role=second and "interior" or "patch_boundary"
    if second then paired=paired+1 end
    edges[#edges+1]=e
  end
  for _,k in ipairs(sorted(by_point)) do vertices[#vertices+1]=by_point[k] end
  if context then context:consume("objects",#cells+#edges+#vertices) end
  proof.method=M.VERSION
  proof.isohedral="IH41"
  proof.split=split
  proof.paired_edges=paired
  proof.rectangular_source_slots={lo,hi}
  proof.source_basis={{request.step_cm,0},{request.step_cm*request.shear,request.step_cm*request.aspect}}
  proof.families=split and {{"west","east"},"vertical","split"} or {"horizontal","vertical"}
  return {cells=cells,edges=edges,vertices=vertices},proof
end
return M
source.pattern_exact.lua:
-- Bounded reduced rational coordinates. Overflow/complexity is a diagnostic,
-- never a silent conversion to floating-point construction coordinates.
local M={VERSION="rational-26-v1",MAX_COMPONENT=67108864}
local safe=9007199254740991
local function integer(n)
  assert(type(n)=="number" and n==n and n%1==0 and n>=-safe and n<=safe,"exact rational integer outside safe range")
  return assert(math.tointeger(n))
end
local function gcd(a,b) a,b=math.abs(a),math.abs(b);while b~=0 do a,b=b,a%b end;return a end
function M.new(n,d)
  n,d=integer(n),integer(d or 1);assert(d~=0,"zero rational denominator")
  if d<0 then n,d=-n,-d end
  local g=gcd(n,d);n,d=n//g,d//g
  assert(math.abs(n)<=M.MAX_COMPONENT and d<=M.MAX_COMPONENT,"rational coordinate complexity budget exceeded")
  return {n,d}
end
function M.validate(r)
  assert(type(r)=="table" and #r==2,"rational [numerator,denominator] required")
  for k in pairs(r) do assert(k==1 or k==2,"unknown rational key") end
  local v=M.new(r[1],r[2]);assert(v[1]==r[1] and v[2]==r[2],"rational must be reduced with positive denominator")
  return v
end
function M.add(a,b) a,b=M.validate(a),M.validate(b);return M.new(a[1]*b[2]+b[1]*a[2],a[2]*b[2]) end
function M.neg(a) a=M.validate(a);return {-a[1],a[2]} end
function M.sub(a,b) return M.add(a,M.neg(b)) end
function M.mul(a,b)
  a,b=M.validate(a),M.validate(b)
  local g,h=gcd(a[1],b[2]),gcd(b[1],a[2])
  return M.new((a[1]//g)*(b[1]//h),(a[2]//h)*(b[2]//g))
end
function M.div(a,b) b=M.validate(b);assert(b[1]~=0,"rational division by zero");return M.mul(a,M.new(b[2],b[1])) end
function M.compare(a,b) a,b=M.validate(a),M.validate(b);local v=a[1]*b[2]-b[1]*a[2];return v>0 and 1 or v<0 and -1 or 0 end
function M.point(components)
  assert(type(components)=="table" and (#components==2 or #components==3),"exact point dimension must be 2 or 3")
  for k in pairs(components) do assert(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=#components,"dense exact coordinate array required") end
  for i=1,#components do assert(components[i]~=nil,"sparse exact coordinate array") end
  local out={coordinate_type="rational",components={}}
  for i,r in ipairs(components) do out.components[i]=M.validate(r) end
  return out
end
function M.validate_point(p,dimension)
  assert(type(p)=="table" and p.coordinate_type=="rational" and type(p.components)=="table" and #p.components==dimension,"rational exact point with matching dimension required")
  for k in pairs(p) do assert(k=="coordinate_type" or k=="components","unknown exact coordinate field") end
  for k,r in pairs(p.components) do assert(type(k)=="number" and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=dimension,"dense exact coordinate components required");M.validate(r) end
  for i=1,dimension do assert(p.components[i]~=nil,"sparse exact coordinate components") end
  return true
end
function M.to_numbers(p)
  M.validate_point(p,#p.components);local out={};local errors={}
  for i,r in ipairs(p.components) do out[i]=r[1]/r[2];errors[i]=math.abs(out[i])*2^-52 end
  return out,{operation="rational-to-binary64-v1",absolute_error_bounds=errors}
end
function M.orient2d(a,b,c)
  for _,p in ipairs({a,b,c}) do M.validate_point(p,2) end
  local ax=M.sub(a.components[1],c.components[1]);local ay=M.sub(a.components[2],c.components[2])
  local bx=M.sub(b.components[1],c.components[1]);local by=M.sub(b.components[2],c.components[2])
  return M.compare(M.mul(ax,by),M.mul(ay,bx))
end
return M
source.pattern_freeform.lua:
-- Lin and Kaplan (freeform finite Euclidean profile), Sections 3 and 4.
local P=require("pattern")
local Packing=require("pattern_circle_packing")
local PIC=require("pattern_islamic")
local N=require("pattern_predicates")
local M={}
local function sub(a,b) return {a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2]} end
local function add(a,b,k) return {a[1]+k*b[1],a[2]+k*b[2]} end
local function dot(a,b) return a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2] end
local function det(a,b) return a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1] end
local function norm(a) return math.sqrt(dot(a,a)) end
local function unit(a)
  local length=norm(a)
  assert(length>0,"freeform-zero-vector")
  return {a[1]/length,a[2]/length}
end
local function mid(a,b) return add(a,sub(b,a),.5) end
local function keys(t)
  local result={}
  for k in pairs(t) do result[#result+1]=k end
  table.sort(result,P.byte_less)
  return result
end
local function key(a,b)
  if P.byte_less(b,a) then return b.."+"..a end
  return a.."+"..b
end
local function cycle_points(vertices,ids)
  local p={}
  for i,id in ipairs(ids) do p[i]=assert(vertices[id],"freeform-patch-vertex") end
  return p
end
local function check_face(polygon)
  for i,p in ipairs(polygon) do
    for j,q in ipairs(polygon) do
      if j~=i and j~=i%#polygon+1 then
        assert(N.orient2d(p,polygon[i%#polygon+1],q)>0,"freeform-nonconvex-polygon")
      end
    end
  end
end
local function tri_incenter(a,b,c)
  local wa,wb,wc=norm(sub(b,c)),norm(sub(a,c)),norm(sub(a,b))
  local sum=wa+wb+wc
  return {(wa*a[1]+wb*b[1]+wc*c[1])/sum,(wa*a[2]+wb*b[2]+wc*c[2])/sum}
end

function M.patch(packing,tau)
  assert(type(tau)=="number" and tau>=.5 and tau<1,"freeform-tau")
  local disk=Packing.disk(packing.complex)
  local C=packing.circles
  local vertices,faces,triangle_arcs={},{},{}
  for i,f in ipairs(disk.faces) do
    for j,u in ipairs(f) do
      local v,w=f[j%3+1],f[(j+1)%3+1]
      triangle_arcs[u.."/"..v.."/"..w]=i
    end
  end
  for _,u in ipairs(disk.ids) do
    local circle=C[u]
    local neighbors=keys(disk.adjacent[u])
    local angles={}
    for _,v in ipairs(neighbors) do
      local d=sub(C[v].center,circle.center)
      angles[v]=math.atan(d[2],d[1])
    end
    table.sort(neighbors,function(a,b)return angles[a]<angles[b] end)
    local cycle={}
    for i,v in ipairs(neighbors) do
      local w=neighbors[i%#neighbors+1]
      local theta=angles[v]
      local spread=(angles[w]-theta)%(2*math.pi)
      local face=triangle_arcs[u.."/"..v.."/"..w]
      assert(face or circle.boundary,"freeform-arc-link")
      assert(not face or spread<math.pi,"freeform-triangle-arc")
      local tangent="t/"..u.."/"..v
      local arc="arc/"..u.."/"..(face or "exterior")
      assert(not vertices[arc],"freeform-multiple-exterior-arcs")
      vertices[tangent]=add(circle.center,{math.cos(theta),math.sin(theta)},tau*circle.radius)
      local phi=theta+spread/2
      vertices[arc]=add(circle.center,{math.cos(phi),math.sin(phi)},tau*circle.radius)
      cycle[#cycle+1]=tangent;cycle[#cycle+1]=arc
    end
    if not circle.boundary then faces[#faces+1]={id="wheel/"..u,kind="cyclic",circle=u,vertices=cycle} end
  end
  for i,f in ipairs(disk.faces) do
    local center="incenter/"..i
    vertices[center]=tri_incenter(C[f[1]].center,C[f[2]].center,C[f[3]].center)
    for j,u in ipairs(f) do
      local v=f[j%3+1]
      local cycle={"arc/"..u.."/"..i,"t/"..u.."/"..v,"t/"..v.."/"..u,"arc/"..v.."/"..i,center}
      faces[#faces+1]={id="pentagon/"..i.."/"..j,kind="filler",triangle=i,vertices=cycle}
    end
  end
  local edges={}
  for _,f in ipairs(faces) do
    check_face(cycle_points(vertices,f.vertices))
    for i,a in ipairs(f.vertices) do
      local b=f.vertices[i%#f.vertices+1]
      local id=key(a,b)
      local e=edges[id]
      if not e then edges[id]={from=a,to=b,faces={f.id}}
      else
        assert(#e.faces==1 and a==e.to and b==e.from,"freeform-patch-incidence")
        e.faces[2]=f.id
      end
    end
  end
  return {vertices=vertices,faces=faces,edges=edges}
end

local function wheel_alpha(n,theta)
  local a=math.pi/n
  return 1-2*math.sin(a)*math.sin(math.pi/2-a)*math.sin(theta-a)/math.sin(math.pi/2+2*a-theta)
end
local function wheel(face,polygon,circle,tau,angle)
  local n=#polygon
  local alpha=wheel_alpha(n,math.rad(angle))
  local radius=alpha*tau*circle.radius*math.cos(math.pi/n)
  assert(alpha>0 and alpha<1 and radius>0,"freeform-wheel-angle")
  local center=circle.center
  local mids,paths={},{}
  for i,p in ipairs(polygon) do mids[i]=mid(p,polygon[i%n+1]) end
  for i,a in ipairs(mids) do
    local j=(i+1)%n+1
    local b=mids[j]
    local chord=unit(sub(a,b))
    local normal={-chord[2],chord[1]}
    local m=mid(a,b)
    local foot=add(center,chord,dot(sub(center,m),chord)*-1)
    local h=radius^2-dot(sub(foot,center),sub(foot,center))
    assert(h>0,"freeform-wheel-no-bisector-intersection:"..face.id)
    local sign=dot(sub(m,center),normal)>=0 and 1 or -1
    local meet=add(foot,normal,sign*math.sqrt(h))
    for k,p in ipairs(polygon) do
      assert(det(sub(p,polygon[k%n+1]),sub(p,meet))>=-1e-10,"freeform-wheel-outside-polygon")
    end
    paths[#paths+1]={from=i,to=j,bend=meet}
  end
  return mids,paths,alpha
end

function M.ornament(packing,patch,tau,angle)
  local nodes,links,ports,degree={},{},{},{}
  local wheel_directions,wheel_evidence={},{}
  local function contact(face,index,side,point,direction)
    local ids=face.vertices
    local seam=key(ids[index],ids[index%#ids+1])
    local id="contact/"..seam.."/"..(side==1 and "plus" or "minus")
    local old=ports[id]
    if old then
      assert(#old.faces==1 and norm(sub(nodes[id],point))<1e-10,"freeform-seam-position")
      assert(norm(add(old.direction,direction,1))<1e-9,"freeform-seam-direction")
      old.faces[2]=face.id
    else
      nodes[id]=point
      ports[id]={faces={face.id},direction=direction,scaffold_edge=seam}
    end
    return id,seam
  end
  local function add_bend(face,i,point,a,b)
    local name=face.id.."/"..i
    local bend="bend/"..name
    nodes[bend]=point
    for _,v in ipairs{a,b} do degree[v]=(degree[v]or 0)+1 end
    links[#links+1]={id="path/"..name.."/a",from=a,to=bend,face=face.id}
    links[#links+1]={id="path/"..name.."/b",from=bend,to=b,face=face.id}
  end
  for _,face in ipairs(patch.faces) do
    if face.kind=="cyclic" then
      local polygon=cycle_points(patch.vertices,face.vertices)
      local circle=packing.circles[face.circle]
      local mids,paths,alpha=wheel(face,polygon,circle,tau,angle)
      wheel_evidence[face.id]={order=#polygon,alpha=alpha,circle=face.circle}
      for i,p in ipairs(paths) do
        local a,b=mids[p.from],mids[p.to]
        local direction1,direction2=unit(sub(p.bend,a)),unit(sub(p.bend,b))
        local port1,e1=contact(face,p.from,1,a,direction1)
        local port2,e2=contact(face,p.to,-1,b,direction2)
        wheel_directions[e1]=wheel_directions[e1] or {}
        wheel_directions[e2]=wheel_directions[e2] or {}
        wheel_directions[e1][1]={-direction1[1],-direction1[2]}
        wheel_directions[e2][-1]={-direction2[1],-direction2[2]}
        add_bend(face,i,p.bend,port1,port2)
      end
    end
  end
  for _,face in ipairs(patch.faces) do
    if face.kind=="filler" then
      local polygon=cycle_points(patch.vertices,face.vertices)
      local function copy(i,side)
        local k=key(face.vertices[i],face.vertices[i%#face.vertices+1])
        local seam=wheel_directions[k]
        return seam and seam[side]
      end
      local motif=PIC.motif(polygon,angle,0,nil,copy)
      for _,r in ipairs(motif.rays) do r.port=contact(face,r.edge,r.side,r.origin,r.direction) end
      for i,p in ipairs(motif.paths) do
        add_bend(face,i,p.point,motif.rays[p.first].port,motif.rays[p.second].port)
      end
    end
  end
  for id,p in pairs(ports) do
    assert(degree[id]==#p.faces and #p.faces==#patch.edges[p.scaffold_edge].faces,"freeform-seam-incidence")
  end
  return {nodes=nodes,links=links,ports=ports,wheels=wheel_evidence}
end

local function records(graph)
  local vertices,contacts=P.array(),P.array()
  for _,id in ipairs(keys(graph.nodes)) do vertices[#vertices+1]={id=id,point=graph.nodes[id]} end
  for _,id in ipairs(keys(graph.ports)) do
    local p=graph.ports[id]
    contacts[#contacts+1]={id=id,faces=p.faces,direction=p.direction,scaffold_edge=p.scaffold_edge}
  end
  return {vertices=vertices,edges=graph.links},contacts
end
function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="ornament/islamic-freeform",version="1",family="finite-circle-packing",
    units="cm",capabilities={"graph"},parameters={
      tau={type="number",minimum=.5,maximum=.99},
      contact_angle={type="number",minimum=45,maximum=80},
      tolerance={type="number",minimum=1e-13,maximum=1e-7},
      max_iterations={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=3000}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,uniform_scale=true,reflection=false},
    assumptions={"Oriented triangular disk with positive source boundary radii",

        construction="lin-kaplan-freeform-v1"},

        contacts=ports,wheels=ornament.wheels}}}
  end

end

-- Explicit document-unit geometry. Exact topological predicates are separate

local function point(p)
  assert(type(p)=="table" and #p==2,"2D point required")

  for _,v in ipairs(p) do number(v);assert(math.abs(v)<=1e50 and (v==0 or math.abs(v)>=1e-50),"geometry coordinate outside admitted range; normalize frame") end

local function same(a,b) return a[1]==b[1] and a[2]==b[2] end

  assert(unit=="cm" or unit=="mm" or unit=="bp" or unit=="unit","explicit supported unit required")
  scale=number(scale);relative=number(relative or 1e-10);absolute=number(absolute or 0)
  assert(scale>=1e-40 and scale<=1e40 and relative>=0 and relative<=0.01 and absolute>=0,"invalid tolerance policy")

end

  assert(policy and policy.scale and policy.unit,"explicit geometry policy required")
  local magnitude=policy.scale

  p=point(p);assert(type(m)=="table" and #m==6,"affine [a,b,c,d,tx,ty] required");for _,v in ipairs(m) do number(v) end

function G.parameter(p,a,b)

  end

end
G.point=point
return G

local M = {}
local sqrt, abs = math.sqrt, math.abs
local epsilon = 1e-8

local function radicand(value)
  assert(value >= -epsilon, "gothic-invalid-circle-intersection")
  return sqrt(math.max(0, value))
end

function M.top(circle, x)
  local dx = x - circle.center[1]
  return circle.center[2] + circle.branch * radicand(circle.radius ^ 2 - dx ^ 2)
end

function M.side(length, height, join)
  assert(height > length and length > 0 and join > epsilon and join < length - epsilon,
    "gothic-side-chart-requires-height-greater-than-run-and-interior-crossing")
  local r = (length ^ 2 + height ^ 2) / (2 * length)
  local t = join / length
  return {length=length, height=height, join={join, t * height},
    lower={center={t * r, 0}, radius=t * r, curvature=-1},
    upper={center={length - (1 - t) * r, height}, radius=(1 - t) * r, curvature=1}}
end

function M.height(side, x)
  if x <= 0 then return 0 end
  if x >= side.length then return side.height end
  if x <= side.join[1] then
    return radicand(x * (2 * side.lower.radius - x))
  end
  local d = side.length - x
  return side.height - radicand(d * (2 * side.upper.radius - d))
end

function M.point(unit, replica, x)
  return {replica.x + replica.sx * x, replica.y + replica.sy * M.top(unit.circle, x),
    unit.origin[3] + M.height(unit.side, x - unit.start)}
end

-- Intersect the two full compass circles, then retain points on both selected arcs.
function M.crossings(unit, a, b)
  local c = unit.circle.center
  local ax, ay = a.x + a.sx * c[1], a.y + a.sy * c[2]
  local bx, by = b.x + b.sx * c[1], b.y + b.sy * c[2]
  local dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
  local d = sqrt(dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2)
  assert(d > epsilon, "gothic-coincident-replica-circles")
  local result = {}
  local r = unit.circle.radius
  if d >= 2 * r - epsilon then return result end
  local h = radicand(r ^ 2 - d ^ 2 / 4)
  for _, sign in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
    local x, y = (ax + bx) / 2 - sign * h * dy / d, (ay + by) / 2 + sign * h * dx / d
    local ua, ub = a.sx * (x - a.x), b.sx * (x - b.x)
    if ua >= unit.start and ua <= unit.finish and ub >= unit.start and ub <= unit.finish
      and abs(a.y + a.sy * M.top(unit.circle, ua) - y) < epsilon
      and abs(b.y + b.sy * M.top(unit.circle, ub) - y) < epsilon then
      result[#result + 1] = {top={x,y}, a=ua, b=ub, joined=abs(ua-ub)<epsilon}
    end
  end
  return result
end

-- The sole extremum of the graph's deviation from its chord occurs where
-- the circle tangent equals the chord slope. Evaluate that point exactly.
local function chord_error(circle, lo, hi, evaluate)
  local a, b = evaluate(lo), evaluate(hi)
  local slope = (b - a) / (hi - lo)
  local x = circle.center[1] - circle.branch * circle.radius * slope / sqrt(1 + slope ^ 2)
  x = math.max(lo, math.min(hi, x))
  return abs(evaluate(x) - (a + slope * (x - lo)))
end

function M.sample(unit, knots, tolerance, context)
  local result = {knots[1]}
  local function refine(a, b, depth)
    context:consume("operations", 1)
    local x0 = unit.start
    local side = unit.side
    local upper = a >= x0 + side.join[1]
    local arc = upper and side.upper or side.lower
    local circle = {center={x0 + arc.center[1], arc.center[2]}, radius=arc.radius,
      branch=upper and -1 or 1}
    local et = chord_error(unit.circle, a, b, function(x) return M.top(unit.circle, x) end)
    local ez = chord_error(circle, a, b, function(x) return M.height(side, x - x0) end)
    if sqrt(et ^ 2 + ez ^ 2) <= tolerance * .999 then
      context:consume("objects", 1)
      result[#result + 1] = b
      return
    end
    assert(depth < 24, "gothic-sampling-resolution")
    local mid = (a + b) / 2
    refine(a, mid, depth + 1)
    refine(mid, b, depth + 1)
  end
  for i = 2, #knots do refine(knots[i-1], knots[i], 0) end
  return result
end

return M
source.pattern_gothic_microarchitecture.lua:
local P, H = require("pattern"), require("pattern_hash")
local G = require("pattern_gothic_geometry")
local M = {VERSION="compass-biarc-network-v1"}
local abs, epsilon = math.abs, 1e-8

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="gothic/spatial-ogee", version="1", family="gothic-microarchitecture",
    units="cm", capabilities={"curve3d"},
    parameters={tolerance={type="number",minimum=.001,maximum=.05}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Circular compass arcs on monotone straightedge charts",
      "Side biarcs use a true replica crossing and vertical end tangents",
      "Orthographic wire views without surface occlusion"}})
end

local function number(n)
  assert(type(n)=="number" and abs(n)<=100, "gothic-bounded-coordinate")
  return n
end

local function input(s)
  local q = P.plain(s.inputs)
  assert(type(q.units)=="table" and #q.units>=1 and #q.units<=8, "gothic-unit-count")
  assert(not next(P.plain(s.constraints)), "gothic-constraints-in-construction-input")
  return q.units, s.parameters.tolerance or .004
end

local function construct(spec, units, vertices)
  local id = "unit/" .. (#units + 1)
  local radius, start, finish = number(spec.radius), number(spec.start), number(spec.finish)
  assert(radius>0 and -radius<start and start<finish and finish<radius, "gothic-top-chart")
  local circle = {center={0,0}, radius=radius, branch=1}
  local start_y = G.top(circle, start)
  local origin, anchor = {0,0,0}, nil
  if spec.parent then
    local parent = assert(units[spec.parent], "gothic-parent-must-precede-child")
    local replica = assert(parent.replicas[spec.parent_replica or 1], "gothic-parent-replica")
    anchor = replica.finish_id
    origin = vertices[anchor]
  else
    assert(type(spec.origin)=="table" and #spec.origin==2, "gothic-ground-origin")
    origin = {number(spec.origin[1]),number(spec.origin[2]),0}
  end
  local ox, oy = origin[1]-start, origin[2]-start_y
  local replicas = P.array({{x=ox,y=oy,sx=1,sy=1}})
  assert(type(spec.replicas)=="table" and #spec.replicas>=1 and #spec.replicas<=4, "gothic-replica-count")
  for _,r in ipairs(spec.replicas) do
    assert(type(r)=="table" and #r==4 and abs(number(r[3]))==1 and abs(number(r[4]))==1,
      "gothic-planar-isometry")
    replicas[#replicas+1]={x=ox+number(r[1]),y=oy+number(r[2]),sx=r[3],sy=r[4]}
  end
  local unit={id=id, origin=origin, circle=circle, start=start, finish=finish, replicas=replicas,
    construction={
      {id=id.."/center",op="compass-center",point={0,0}},
      {id=id.."/circle",op="compass-circle",dependencies={id.."/center"},radius=radius},
      {id=id.."/start-line",op="straightedge-line",x=start},
      {id=id.."/finish-line",op="straightedge-line",x=finish},
      {id=id.."/start",op="circle-line-intersection",dependencies={id.."/circle",id.."/start-line"},
        branch=1,point={start,start_y},ground_mark=not anchor,support=anchor},
      {id=id.."/finish",op="circle-line-intersection",dependencies={id.."/circle",id.."/finish-line"},
        branch=1,point={finish,G.top(circle,finish)}}},
    crossings=P.array(), support=anchor}
  local best, score
  for i=1,#replicas do
    for j=i+1,#replicas do
      for _,x in ipairs(G.crossings(unit,replicas[i],replicas[j])) do
        x.first,x.second=i,j
        x.id=id.."/crossing/"..(#unit.crossings+1)
        unit.crossings[#unit.crossings+1]=x
        if i==1 and x.joined and x.a>start+epsilon and x.a<finish-epsilon then
          local distance=abs(x.a-(start+finish)/2)
          if not score or distance<score-epsilon then best,score=x,distance end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  assert(best, "gothic-missing-interior-primary-replica-crossing")
  unit.primary=best.id
  unit.side=G.side(finish-start,number(spec.height),best.a-start)
  return unit
end

local function generate(d,s,c)
  local specs,tolerance=input(s)
  local units,curves,points=P.array(),P.array(),P.array()
  local vertices={}
  local function vertex(id,point)
    if not vertices[id] then
      vertices[id]=point
      points[#points+1]={id=id,point=point}
    else
      for k=1,3 do assert(abs(vertices[id][k]-point[k])<epsilon, "gothic-junction-position") end
    end
  end
  for _,spec in ipairs(specs) do
    local unit=construct(spec,units,vertices)
    units[#units+1]=unit
    for _,x in ipairs(unit.crossings) do
      x.first_height=unit.origin[3]+G.height(unit.side,x.a-unit.start)
      x.second_height=unit.origin[3]+G.height(unit.side,x.b-unit.start)
      assert(x.joined==(abs(x.first_height-x.second_height)<epsilon), "gothic-crossing-height")
    end
    for i,r in ipairs(unit.replicas) do
      local id=unit.id.."/curve/"..i
      local by_x={[unit.start]=(i==1 and unit.support) or id.."/a",[unit.finish]=id.."/b"}
      local knots={unit.start,unit.start+unit.side.join[1],unit.finish}
      for _,x in ipairs(unit.crossings) do
        local t=i==x.first and x.a or i==x.second and x.b or nil
        if t then
          if x.joined then
            assert(not by_x[t], "gothic-ambiguous-multiple-or-endpoint-junction")
            by_x[t]=x.id
          end
          knots[#knots+1]=t
        end
      end
      table.sort(knots)
      local distinct={}
      for _,x in ipairs(knots) do
        if #distinct==0 or x-distinct[#distinct]>epsilon then
          distinct[#distinct+1]=x
        elseif by_x[x] then
          distinct[#distinct]=x
        end
      end
      local samples=P.array()
      for j,x in ipairs(G.sample(unit,distinct,tolerance,c)) do
        local key=by_x[x] or id.."/sample/"..j
        vertex(key,G.point(unit,r,x))
        samples[j]={x=x,vertex=key}
      end
      r.finish_id=id.."/b"
      curves[#curves+1]={id=id,from=samples[1].vertex,to=samples[#samples].vertex,
        unit=unit.id,replica=i,samples=samples}
    end
  end
  return {id="gothic/"..H.value("gothic/spatial-input",{specs=specs,tolerance=tolerance}),
    definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),
    structures={curve3d={vertices=points,curves=curves}},
    provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
    extensions={gothic_spatial={units=units,chord_tolerance_cm=tolerance}}}
end

local function validate(x)
  local points={}
  for _,v in ipairs(x.structures.curve3d.vertices) do points[v.id]=v.point end
  local units={}
  for _,u in ipairs(x.extensions.gothic_spatial.units) do
    units[u.id]=u
    local a,b,j=u.side.lower,u.side.upper,u.side.join
    local ax,ay=j[1]-a.center[1],j[2]-a.center[2]
    local bx,by=j[1]-b.center[1],j[2]-b.center[2]
    assert(abs(ax^2+ay^2-a.radius^2)<epsilon and abs(bx^2+by^2-b.radius^2)<epsilon
      and abs(ax*by-ay*bx)<epsilon and ax*bx+ay*by<0 and a.curvature==-b.curvature, "gothic-biarc-certificate")
  end
  for _,curve in ipairs(x.structures.curve3d.curves) do
    local u=units[curve.unit]
    local previous=-math.huge
    for _,sample in ipairs(curve.samples) do
      local p=G.point(u,u.replicas[curve.replica],sample.x)
      for k=1,3 do assert(abs(p[k]-points[sample.vertex][k])<epsilon, "gothic-curve-sample") end
      assert(sample.x>previous, "gothic-curve-sample-order")
      previous=sample.x
    end
  end
  return {ok=true,checks={"Shared spatial junctions and nested support",
    "Opposite signed curvature with common tangent",
    "Ordered spatial samples reconstructed from analytic curves"}}
end

local function camera(matrix)
  for i=0,2 do
    for j=i,2 do
      local dot=0
      for k=1,3 do dot=dot+matrix[4*i+k]*matrix[4*j+k] end
      assert(abs(dot-(i==j and 1 or 0))<epsilon, "gothic-orthonormal-camera")
    end
  end
  assert(matrix[13]==0 and matrix[14]==0 and matrix[15]==0 and matrix[16]==1, "gothic-affine-camera")
end

local function project(m,p)
  local out={}
  for i=0,2 do out[i+1]=m[4*i+1]*p[1]+m[4*i+2]*p[2]+m[4*i+3]*p[3]+m[4*i+4] end
  return out
end

local function lower(x,v,style)
  local m=v.projection.matrix
  camera(m)
  local points={}
  for _,p in ipairs(x.structures.curve3d.vertices) do points[p.id]=project(m,p.point) end
  local paths,ops={},P.array()
  local depth_sorted=v.projection.depth_policy=="depth_sorted"
  for _,c in ipairs(x.structures.curve3d.curves) do
    local a=points[c.from]
    local commands=P.array({{"M",a[1],a[2]}})
    for i=2,#c.samples do
      local b=points[c.samples[i].vertex]
      if depth_sorted then
        paths[#paths+1]={id=c.id,index=i,depth=(a[3]+b[3])/2,
          commands={{"M",a[1],a[2]},{"L",b[1],b[2]}}}
      else
        commands[#commands+1]={"L",b[1],b[2]}
      end
      a=b
    end
    if not depth_sorted then paths[#paths+1]={id=c.id,commands=commands} end
  end
  if depth_sorted then
    table.sort(paths,function(a,b)
      local da,db=math.floor(a.depth*1e8+.5),math.floor(b.depth*1e8+.5)
      if da~=db then return da<db end
      if a.id~=b.id then return a.id<b.id end
      return a.index<b.index
    end)
  end
  local colors={{.10,.24,.34},{.60,.31,.16},{.28,.44,.34}}
  for _,p in ipairs(paths) do
    local index=tonumber(p.id:match("^unit/(%d+)/"))
    ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=p.id,commands=p.commands,transform=P.plain(v.transform),
      paint={stroke=P.plain(style.stroke or colors[(index-1)%#colors+1]),
        stroke_width=style.stroke_width or .018,cap="round",join="round"}}
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
    operations=ops,resources=P.array(),clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)}}
end

function M.export(x)
  return P.serialize({schema="florilegium-curve-network@1",frame=x.frame,network=x.structures.curve3d,
    construction=x.extensions.gothic_spatial,provenance=x.provenance})
end

function M.register(reg)
  local d=M.definition()
  reg:register(d,{validate_inputs=function(s) input(s);return true end,
    generate=function(s,c) return generate(d,s,c) end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end

return M

-- SHA-256 from FIPS 180-4 sections 4.1.2, 4.2.2, 5.1.1, 5.3.3, 6.2.
-- Independent implementation; 32-bit words held in Lua 5.3 integers.
local P=require("pattern")
assert(math.maxinteger and math.maxinteger>=9007199254740991 and #string.pack("n",1)==8,"pattern hashes require Lua int64/binary64; runtime parity is an explicit gate")
local M={VERSION="sha256-frame-v1"}
local K={
  0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
  0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
  0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
  0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
  0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
  0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
  0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
  0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2}
local mask=0xffffffff
local function r(x,n) return ((x>>n)|(x<<(32-n)))&mask end
local function compute_sha256(bytes)
  assert(type(bytes)=="string" and #bytes<=64*1024*1024,"SHA-256 input must be bytes within 64 MiB")
  local len=#bytes;local bits=len*8
  bytes=bytes.."\128"..string.rep("\0",(55-len)%64)..string.pack(">I8",bits)
  local h={0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19}
  for pos=1,#bytes,64 do
    local w={};for i=1,16 do w[i]=string.unpack(">I4",bytes,pos+(i-1)*4) end
    for i=17,64 do
      local a,b=w[i-15],w[i-2]
      w[i]=(w[i-16]+(r(a,7)~r(a,18)~(a>>3))+w[i-7]+(r(b,17)~r(b,19)~(b>>10)))&mask
    end
    local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,j=table.unpack(h)
    for i=1,64 do
      local t1=(j+(r(e,6)~r(e,11)~r(e,25))+((e&f)~((~e)&g))+K[i]+w[i])&mask
      local t2=((r(a,2)~r(a,13)~r(a,22))+((a&b)~(a&c)~(b&c)))&mask
      j,g,f,e,d,c,b,a=g,f,e,(d+t1)&mask,c,b,a,(t1+t2)&mask
    end
    for i,v in ipairs({a,b,c,d,e,f,g,j}) do h[i]=(h[i]+v)&mask end
  end
  local out={};for i,v in ipairs(h) do out[i]=string.format("%08x",v) end;return table.concat(out)
end
-- Operational reuse only: Lua strings are immutable byte sequences. Keys are
-- the complete input bytes, never caller-owned tables, rounded coordinates or
-- an unverified supplied digest. This cache does not select pattern instances
-- or renderings. Its fixed limits include oversized-input bypass and FIFO
-- eviction; the original64MiB hashing contract and compression code are intact.
local CACHE_BYTES,CACHE_ENTRIES,CACHE_ENTRY=4*1024*1024,256,2*1024*1024
local cache,slots={},{}
local head,tail,count,held=1,1,0,0
local hits,misses,evictions,bypasses=0,0,0,0
local function evict()
  local bytes=slots[head];slots[head]=nil;head=head%CACHE_ENTRIES+1
  cache[bytes]=nil;count=count-1;held=held-#bytes;evictions=evictions+1
end
function M.sha256(bytes)
  assert(type(bytes)=='string'and #bytes<=64*1024*1024,'SHA-256 input must be bytes within 64 MiB')
  local value=cache[bytes]
  if value then hits=hits+1;return value end
  misses=misses+1;value=compute_sha256(bytes)
  if #bytes>CACHE_ENTRY then bypasses=bypasses+1;return value end
  while count>=CACHE_ENTRIES or held+#bytes>CACHE_BYTES do evict()end
  cache[bytes]=value;slots[tail]=bytes;tail=tail%CACHE_ENTRIES+1
  count=count+1;held=held+#bytes
  return value
end
-- Diagnostics/reset are for operational measurements. Never hash these
-- counters into recipes, instances, scenes or Build-record semantics. A host
-- SHA override (the pinned browser bridge) remains a separate implementation.
function M.sha256_cache_stats()
  return {implementation='pure-lua-sha256-byte-fifo-v1',entries=count,payload_bytes=held,
    maximum_entries=CACHE_ENTRIES,maximum_payload_bytes=CACHE_BYTES,maximum_entry_bytes=CACHE_ENTRY,
    hits=hits,misses=misses,evictions=evictions,oversized_bypasses=bypasses}
end
function M.clear_sha256_cache()
  cache,slots={},{};head,tail,count,held=1,1,0,0;hits,misses,evictions,bypasses=0,0,0,0
end
local function frame(s) return tostring(#s)..":"..s end
function M.bytes(domain,bytes)
  assert(type(domain)=="string" and #domain>0 and type(bytes)=="string","hash domain and bytes required")
  return M.sha256("pattern-platform\0hash-v1\0"..frame(domain)..frame(bytes))
end
function M.value(domain,value) return M.bytes(domain,P.serialize(value)) end
function M.is_digest(s) return type(s)=="string" and #s==64 and not s:find("[^0-9a-f]") end
return M
source.pattern_hat.lua:
local P,H,G=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash"),require("pattern_geometry")
local Rules=require("pattern_hat_rules")
local M={VERSION="hat-four-metatile-polykite-v1"}
local sqrt3=math.sqrt(3)
local function key(p) return table.concat(p,"/") end
local function sorted_keys(t)
  local keys={}
  for k in pairs(t) do keys[#keys+1]=k end
  table.sort(keys,P.byte_less)
  return keys
end
local function cross(a,b) return a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1] end
local function area2(points)
  local total=0
  for i,a in ipairs(points) do total=total+cross(a,points[i%#points+1]) end
  return total
end
local function winding(points)
  if area2(points)>0 then return points end
  local out={points[1]}
  for i=#points,2,-1 do out[#out+1]=points[i] end
  return out
end
local function side(p,q)
  local a,b=key(p),key(q)
  if P.byte_less(b,a) then return b.."+"..a,true end
  return a.."+"..b,false
end
local function polygon_signature(points)
  local keys={}
  for i,p in ipairs(points) do keys[i]=key(p) end
  table.sort(keys,P.byte_less)
  return table.concat(keys,"+")
end
local kite_shapes={}
do
  local corners={{0,0},{1,1},{0,2},{-1,2}}
  for _=1,6 do
    kite_shapes[polygon_signature(corners)]=true
    for i,p in ipairs(corners) do corners[i]={-p[2],p[1]+p[2]} end
  end
end
local function simplified_cycle(points)
  local turns={}
  for i,p in ipairs(points) do
    local a,b=points[(i-2)%#points+1],points[i%#points+1]
    if cross({p[1]-a[1],p[2]-a[2]},{b[1]-p[1],b[2]-p[2]})~=0 then
      turns[#turns+1]=key(p)
    end
  end
  local start=1
  for i=2,#turns do if P.byte_less(turns[i],turns[start]) then start=i end end
  local out={}
  for i=1,#turns do out[i]=turns[(i+start-2)%#turns+1] end
  return table.concat(out,"+")
end
local function certify(cluster)
  local occupied,seams={},{}
  local coset
  for n,item in ipairs(cluster.leaves) do
    assert(#item.points==13 and #item.kites==8,"hat-polykite-prototype")
    assert(area2(item.points)==(item.transform.reflected and -32 or 32),"hat-prototype-orientation")
    local local_sides={}
    for _,raw in ipairs(item.kites) do
      local center=raw[1]
      local u,v=center[1],center[2]
      local residue=key({(2*u+v)%6,(v-u)%6})
      coset=coset or residue
      assert(coset==residue,"hat-incompatible-kite-center-coset")
      local relative={}
      for i,p in ipairs(raw) do relative[i]={p[1]-u,p[2]-v} end
      assert(kite_shapes[polygon_signature(relative)],"hat-off-grid-kite")
      local signature=polygon_signature(raw)
      assert(not occupied[signature],"hat-kite-overlap")
      occupied[signature]=true
      local points=winding(raw)
      assert(area2(points)==4,"hat-kite-area")
      for i,p in ipairs(points) do
        local q=points[i%4+1]
        local id,reverse=side(p,q)
        local prior=local_sides[id]
        assert(not prior or (not prior.paired and prior.reverse~=reverse),"hat-interior-kite-incidence")
        if prior then prior.paired=true else local_sides[id]={from=p,to=q,reverse=reverse} end
      end
    end
    local outgoing={}
    local boundary_size=0
    for _,edge in pairs(local_sides) do
      if not edge.paired then
        local id=key(edge.from)
        assert(not outgoing[id],"hat-branching-leaf-boundary")
        outgoing[id]=edge
        boundary_size=boundary_size+1
      end
    end
    item.boundary={}
    local start=key(item.points[1])
    local at=start
    for i=1,boundary_size do
      local e=assert(outgoing[at],"hat-open-leaf-boundary")
      outgoing[at]=nil
      item.boundary[i]=e.from
      at=key(e.to)
      local id,reverse=side(e.from,e.to)
      local seam=seams[id]
      if not seam then
        seam={from=reverse and e.to or e.from,to=reverse and e.from or e.to,uses={}}
        seams[id]=seam
      end
      assert(#seam.uses<2 and (#seam.uses==0 or seam.uses[1].reverse~=reverse),"hat-root-seam-incidence")
      seam.uses[#seam.uses+1]={leaf=n,reverse=reverse}
    end
    assert(at==start and simplified_cycle(item.boundary)==simplified_cycle(winding(item.points)),"hat-kite-outline")
  end
  local neighbors,balance={},{}
  local root_area,shared,border=0,0,0
  for _,edge in pairs(seams) do
    local a,b=edge.uses[1],edge.uses[2]
    if b then
      neighbors[a.leaf]=neighbors[a.leaf] or {}
      neighbors[b.leaf]=neighbors[b.leaf] or {}
      neighbors[a.leaf][#neighbors[a.leaf]+1]=b.leaf
      neighbors[b.leaf][#neighbors[b.leaf]+1]=a.leaf
      shared=shared+1
    else
      local p,q=edge.from,edge.to
      if a.reverse then p,q=q,p end
      root_area=root_area+cross(p,q)
      balance[key(p)]=(balance[key(p)] or 0)+1
      balance[key(q)]=(balance[key(q)] or 0)-1
      border=border+1
    end
  end
  for _,n in pairs(balance) do assert(n==0,"hat-open-root-boundary") end
  local queue,seen={1},{[1]=true}
  local i=1
  while queue[i] do
    for _,n in ipairs(neighbors[queue[i]] or {}) do
      if not seen[n] then seen[n]=true;queue[#queue+1]=n end
    end
    i=i+1
  end
  local count=#cluster.leaves
  assert(#queue==count and root_area==32*count,"hat-root-area-or-connectivity")
  return seams,{tiles=count,kites=8*count,reflected=cluster.reflection_count,
    root_boundary_edges=border,shared_edges=shared,area2=root_area,center_coset=coset}
end
local function extent(points)
  local x0,y0,x1,y1=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
  for _,p in ipairs(points) do
    x0,y0,x1,y1=math.min(x0,p[1]),math.min(y0,p[2]),math.max(x1,p[1]),math.max(y1,p[2])
  end
  return {x0,y0,x1,y1}
end
local function hits(a,b,e)
  return a[1]<=b[3]+e and a[3]+e>=b[1] and a[2]<=b[4]+e and a[4]+e>=b[2]
end
local function finite(x) return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<math.huge end
local function construct(request,context)
  local frame,step,query=request.frame,request.step_cm,request.world_query
  assert(frame.unit=="cm" and frame.dimension==2 and frame.handedness=="right","hat-frame")
  assert(finite(step) and step>=.1 and step<=1,"hat-step")
  assert(#query==4 and query[1]<query[3] and query[2]<query[4],"hat-query")
  local cluster=Rules.cluster(request.root,request.depth)
  if context then context:consume("operations",#cluster.leaves*140) end
  local seams,proof=certify(cluster)
  local prefix="hat/"..H.value("hat/root",{root=request.root,depth=request.depth,step=step,frame=frame,method=M.VERSION})
  local function cell_id(item) return prefix.."/leaf/"..table.concat(item.address,".") end
  local function vertex_id(p) return prefix.."/v/"..key(p) end
  local function world(p)
    return {frame.origin[1]+step*(p[1]+p[2]/2),frame.origin[2]+step*(sqrt3/2*p[2])}
  end
  local visible,points={},{}
  local cells,edges,vertices=P.array(),P.array(),P.array()
  for n,item in ipairs(cluster.leaves) do
    local world_outline={}
    for i,p in ipairs(item.points) do world_outline[i]=world(p) end
    if request.whole_root or hits(extent(world_outline),query,.04) then
      visible[n]=true
      local boundary={}
      for i,p in ipairs(item.boundary) do
        local q=item.boundary[i%#item.boundary+1]
        local id,reversed=side(p,q)
        boundary[i]={edge=prefix.."/e/"..id,reversed=reversed}
        points[key(p)]=p
      end
      local t=item.transform
      cells[#cells+1]={id=cell_id(item),prototype="hat-eight-kite",chirality=t.reflected and -1 or 1,
        boundary=boundary,address=item.address,parent_address=item.parent,label=item.label,
        lattice_transform=t,outline=item.points,kites=item.kites,
        isometry={rotation_degrees=60*t.turn,reflection=t.reflected,translation=world(t.offset)}}
    end
  end
  for _,id in ipairs(sorted_keys(seams)) do
    local e=seams[id]
    local global,selected={},{}
    for _,use in ipairs(e.uses) do
      local cid=cell_id(cluster.leaves[use.leaf])
      global[#global+1]=cid
      if visible[use.leaf] then selected[#selected+1]=cid end
    end
    if #selected>0 then
      table.sort(global,P.byte_less);table.sort(selected,P.byte_less)
      local interior=#selected==2
      edges[#edges+1]={id=prefix.."/e/"..id,from=vertex_id(e.from),to=vertex_id(e.to),
        role=interior and "interior" or "patch_boundary",owner=selected[1],global_cells=global,global_owner=global[1],
        boundary_reason=interior and "none" or (#global==1 and "root_boundary" or "query_cut")}
    end
  end
  for _,id in ipairs(sorted_keys(points)) do
    local p=points[id]
    vertices[#vertices+1]={id=vertex_id(p),point=world(p),lattice=p}
  end
  assert(#cells>0,"hat-empty-query")
  if context then context:consume("objects",#cells+#edges+#vertices+#cluster.nodes) end
  proof.method=M.VERSION
  proof.reference_hash=H.sha256(cluster.reference_bytes)
  proof.selected_tiles=#cells
  proof.checks={"four source metatile recurrences and canonical cluster addresses",
    "eight distinct elementary kites per Hat with common global center coset",
    "both prototype orientations retained and matched to determinant",
    "closed exact leaf boundaries and opposite shared edge incidence",
    "connected root and exact lattice area correspondence"}
  return {prefix=prefix,tiling={cells=cells,edges=edges,vertices=vertices},hierarchy=cluster.nodes,certificate=proof}
end
function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="tiling/hat",version="1",family="hat-four-metatile",units="cm",capabilities={"tiling"},
    parameters={root={type="string",enum={"H","T","P","F"}},depth={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=3,required=true},
      kite_edge={type="number",minimum=.1,maximum=1,required=true},whole_root={type="boolean"}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=true,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"The Hat's eight-kite geometry and both leaf orientations",
      "Finite H/T/P/F hierarchy with exact metatile guides and a separate leaf-union proof"}})
end
local function routes()
  local r=require("pattern_aperiodic").route_registry()
  r.register("hierarchical_substitution",{construct=construct,validate=function(p)
    return p.certificate.kites==8*p.certificate.tiles and p.certificate.area2==32*p.certificate.tiles
  end})
  return r
end
local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.hat
  local r=routes()
  assert(e.route=="hierarchical_substitution" and P.serialize(e.request.frame)==P.serialize(x.frame),"hat-route-frame")
  assert(P.serialize(e.capabilities)==P.serialize(r.capabilities()),"hat-route-capabilities")
  local actual=r.construct(e.route,P.plain(e.request))
  assert(P.serialize(actual.tiling)==P.serialize(x.structures.tiling),"hat-geometry-reconstruction")
  assert(P.serialize(actual.hierarchy)==P.serialize(e.hierarchy),"hat-hierarchy-reconstruction")
  assert(P.serialize(actual.certificate)==P.serialize(e.certificate),"hat-certificate-reconstruction")
  return {ok=true,checks=P.plain(e.certificate.checks),construction=P.plain(e.certificate)}
end
function M.validate(x) return validate(P.instance(P.plain(x),M.definition())) end
local palette={H={.25,.48,.63},H1={.71,.32,.25},T={.69,.55,.33},P={.41,.60,.52},F={.61,.56,.68}}
local function lower(x,v,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="display","hat-style:"..k) end
  local display=style.display or "lineage"
  assert(display=="lineage" or display=="kites","hat-display")
  local request=x.extensions.hat.request
  local crop,transform=v.crop,P.plain(v.transform)
  local inverse=G.inverse(transform,G.policy("cm",request.step_cm))
  local query=request.world_query
  for _,p in ipairs{{crop[1],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[4]},{crop[1],crop[4]}} do
    local q=G.transform(p,inverse)
    assert(q[1]>=query[1]-1e-10 and q[1]<=query[3]+1e-10 and q[2]>=query[2]-1e-10 and q[2]<=query[4]+1e-10,
      "hat-view-outside-query")
  end
  local function point(p)
    return {x.frame.origin[1]+request.step_cm*(p[1]+p[2]/2),
      x.frame.origin[2]+request.step_cm*(sqrt3/2*p[2])}
  end
  local ops=P.array()
  local scale=math.sqrt(transform[1]^2+transform[2]^2+transform[3]^2+transform[4]^2)
  local function path(ref,lattice,paint)
    local cmds,view_points={},{}
    for i,p in ipairs(lattice) do
      local q=point(p)
      view_points[i]=G.transform(q,transform)
      cmds[i]={i==1 and "M" or "L",q[1],q[2]}
    end
    if hits(extent(view_points),crop,(paint.stroke_width or 0)*scale) then
      cmds[#cmds+1]={"Z"}
      ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=ref,commands=cmds,transform=transform,paint=paint}
    end
  end
  for _,c in ipairs(x.structures.tiling.cells) do
    path(c.id,c.outline,{fill=palette[c.label]})
    if display=="kites" then
      for _,kite in ipairs(c.kites) do
        path(c.id,kite,{stroke={.92,.93,.90},stroke_width=.008,opacity=.72})
      end
    end
  end
  local points={}
  for _,p in ipairs(x.structures.tiling.vertices) do points[p.id]=p.point end
  for _,e in ipairs(x.structures.tiling.edges) do
    local a,b=points[e.from],points[e.to]
    if hits(extent{G.transform(a,transform),G.transform(b,transform)},crop,.012*scale) then
      ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=e.id,commands={{"M",a[1],a[2]},{"L",b[1],b[2]}},
        transform=transform,paint={stroke={.13,.19,.23},stroke_width=.012}}
    end
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
    clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)},operations=ops,resources=P.array()}
end
function M.register(registry)
  local d,r=M.definition(),routes()
  registry:register(d,{generate=function(s,c)
    local a=s.parameters
    local request={root=a.root or "H",depth=a.depth,step_cm=a.kite_edge,whole_root=a.whole_root==true,
      frame=P.plain(c.frame),world_query=P.plain(s.document.bounds)}
    local p=r.construct("hierarchical_substitution",request,c)
    return {id=p.prefix.."/query/"..H.value("hat/query",request),definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},
      frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={tiling=p.tiling},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={hat={route="hierarchical_substitution",request=request,certificate=p.certificate,
        hierarchy=p.hierarchy,capabilities=P.plain(r.capabilities())}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end
return M
