-- Exact triangular-chart adaptation of the HatViz H/T/P/F placement data.
-- Copyright (c) 2023, Craig S. Kaplan, BSD-3-Clause.
-- See docs/research/licenses/HATVIZ-BSD-3-Clause.txt and the source receipt.
local P,R=require("pattern"),require("pattern_exact")
local M={}
local function rational(p) return {R.new(p[1]),R.new(p[2])} end
local function chart(points)
  local out={}
  for i,p in ipairs(points) do out[i]=rational(p) end
  return out
end
local function integral(p)
  assert(p[1][2]==1 and p[2][2]==1,"hat-leaf-outside-integer-chart")
  return {p[1][1],p[2][1]}
end
local outline=chart{{0,0},{-1,-1},{0,-2},{2,-2},{2,-1},{4,-2},{5,-1},
  {4,0},{3,0},{2,2},{0,3},{0,2},{-1,2}}
local kite=chart{{0,0},{1,1},{0,2},{-1,2}}
local kite_placements={{0,0,0},{0,0,3},{0,0,4},{0,0,5},{2,2,2},{2,2,3},{4,-2,0},{4,-2,1}}
local function add(a,b) return {R.add(a[1],b[1]),R.add(a[2],b[2])} end
local function sub(a,b) return {R.sub(a[1],b[1]),R.sub(a[2],b[2])} end
local function rotate(p,turn)
  local a,b=p[1],p[2]
  for _=1,turn%6 do a,b=R.neg(b),R.add(a,b) end
  return {a,b}
end
local function linear(p,t)
  if t.reflected then p={R.add(p[1],p[2]),R.neg(p[2])} end
  return rotate(p,t.turn)
end
local function apply(t,p) return add(t.offset,linear(p,t)) end
local function transform(turn,offset,reflected)
  return {turn=turn%6,offset=offset,reflected=reflected or false}
end
local identity=transform(0,rational{0,0})
local function compose(a,b)
  return transform(a.turn+(a.reflected and -b.turn or b.turn),apply(a,b.offset),a.reflected~=b.reflected)
end
local function equal(a,b) return R.compare(a[1],b[1])==0 and R.compare(a[2],b[2])==0 end
local function match(a,b,p,q)
  local source,target=sub(b,a),sub(q,p)
  assert(not equal(source,identity.offset),"hat-degenerate-guide-edge")
  for turn=0,5 do
    if equal(rotate(source,turn),target) then
      return transform(turn,sub(p,rotate(a,turn)))
    end
  end
  error("hat-guide-isometry-mismatch")
end
local function det(a,b) return R.sub(R.mul(a[1],b[2]),R.mul(a[2],b[1])) end
local function intersection(p,q,a,b)
  local x,y=sub(q,p),sub(b,a)
  local d,n=det(x,y),det(sub(a,p),y)
  assert(d[1]~=0,"hat-parallel-guides")
  local t=R.div(n,d)
  return add(p,{R.mul(x[1],t),R.mul(x[2],t)})
end
local function slot(shape,t) return {shape=shape,transform=t} end
local function meta(name,guide,children) return {name=name,guide=guide,children=children} end
local function leaf(name) return {name=name} end
local function seeds()
  local h=chart{{0,0},{8,0},{8,2},{0,10},{-2,10},{-2,2}}
  return {
    H=meta("H",h,{
      slot(leaf("H"),match(outline[6],outline[8],h[6],h[1])),
      slot(leaf("H"),match(outline[10],outline[12],h[2],h[3])),
      slot(leaf("H"),match(outline[6],outline[8],h[4],h[5])),
      slot(leaf("H1"),transform(2,rational{4,2},true))}),
    T=meta("T",chart{{0,0},{6,0},{0,6}},{slot(leaf("T"),transform(0,rational{0,2}))}),
    P=meta("P",chart{{0,0},{8,0},{4,4},{-4,4}},
      {slot(leaf("P"),transform(0,rational{2,2})),slot(leaf("P"),transform(-1,rational{-2,4}))}),
    F=meta("F",chart{{0,0},{6,0},{6,2},{4,4},{-4,4}},
      {slot(leaf("F"),transform(0,rational{2,2})),slot(leaf("F"),transform(-1,rational{-2,4}))}),
  }
end
-- The pinned reference's 0-based placement indices, translated by accessors.
local placement={
  {"H"},{0,0,"P",2},{1,0,"H",2},{2,0,"P",2},{3,0,"H",2},{4,4,"P",2},
  {0,4,"F",3},{2,4,"F",3},{4,1,3,2,"F",0},{8,3,"H",0},{9,2,"P",0},
  {10,2,"H",0},{11,4,"P",2},{12,0,"H",2},{13,0,"F",3},{14,2,"F",1},
  {15,3,"H",4},{8,2,"F",1},{17,3,"H",0},{18,2,"P",0},{19,2,"H",2},
  {20,4,"F",3},{20,0,"P",2},{22,0,"H",2},{23,4,"F",3},{23,0,"F",3},
  {16,0,"P",2},{9,4,0,2,"T",2},{4,0,"F",3},
}
local function next_level(shapes)
  local patch={}
  local function vertex(slot_index,point_index)
    local child=patch[slot_index+1]
    local guide=child.shape.guide
    return apply(child.transform,guide[point_index%#guide+1])
  end
  for _,row in ipairs(placement) do
    if #row==1 then
      patch[#patch+1]=slot(shapes[row[1]],identity)
    else
      local a,b,shape,index
      if #row==4 then
        a,b=vertex(row[1],row[2]+1),vertex(row[1],row[2])
        shape,index=shapes[row[3]],row[4]
      else
        a,b=vertex(row[3],row[4]),vertex(row[1],row[2])
        shape,index=shapes[row[5]],row[6]
      end
      local g=shape.guide
      patch[#patch+1]=slot(shape,match(g[index+1],g[(index+1)%#g+1],a,b))
    end
  end
  local function children(indices)
    local out={}
    for _,i in ipairs(indices) do out[#out+1]=patch[i+1] end
    return out
  end
  local bps1,bps2=vertex(8,2),vertex(21,2)
  local p62,p72,p252=vertex(6,2),vertex(7,2),vertex(25,2)
  local rbps=add(bps1,rotate(sub(bps2,bps1),-2))
  local llc=intersection(bps1,rbps,p62,p72)
  local w=rotate(sub(p62,llc),-1)
  local h2,h3=add(bps1,w),vertex(14,2)
  local h4=sub(h3,rotate(w,-1))
  local t0=add(bps1,sub(h4,p62))
  local t1=add(t0,rotate(sub(h2,t0),-1))
  return {
    H=meta("H",{llc,bps1,h2,h3,h4,p62},children{0,9,16,27,26,6,1,8,10,15}),
    T=meta("T",{t0,t1,h2},children{11}),
    P=meta("P",{p72,add(p72,sub(bps1,llc)),bps1,llc},children{7,2,3,4,28}),
    F=meta("F",{bps2,vertex(24,2),vertex(25,0),p252,add(p252,sub(llc,bps1))},
      children{21,20,22,23,24,25}),
  }
end
local function world_points(shape,t)
  local out={}
  for _,p in ipairs(shape) do out[#out+1]=apply(t,p) end
  return out
end
function M.cluster(root,depth)
  assert(type(depth)=="number" and depth%1==0 and depth>=1 and depth<=3,"hat-depth")
  local shapes=seeds()
  for _=2,depth do shapes=next_level(shapes) end
  local tree=assert(shapes[root],"hat-root")
  local leaves,nodes={},{}
  local lo={}
  local function visit(shape,t,address,parent)
    if shape.children then
      local guide=world_points(shape.guide,t)
      local record={address=address,parent=parent,label=shape.name,guide=guide,transform=t,children={}}
      nodes[#nodes+1]=record
      for i,child in ipairs(shape.children) do
        local path={table.unpack(address)}
        path[#path+1]=i
        record.children[i]=path
        visit(child.shape,compose(t,child.transform),path,address)
      end
    else
      local points=world_points(outline,t)
      for _,p in ipairs(points) do
        for i=1,2 do if not lo[i] or R.compare(p[i],lo[i])<0 then lo[i]=p[i] end end
      end
      leaves[#leaves+1]={address=address,parent=parent,label=shape.name,points=points,transform=t}
    end
  end
  visit(tree,identity,P.array(),nil)
  local lines,reflections={},0
  for i,item in ipairs(leaves) do
    local t=transform(item.transform.turn,sub(item.transform.offset,lo),item.transform.reflected)
    item.transform=transform(t.turn,integral(t.offset),t.reflected)
    local coordinates={}
    item.kites={}
    for j,p in ipairs(item.points) do
      p=integral(sub(p,lo));item.points[j]=p;coordinates[j]=p[1]..","..p[2]
    end
    for j,placed in ipairs(kite_placements) do
      local q=compose(t,transform(placed[3],rational{placed[1],placed[2]}))
      local k=world_points(kite,q)
      for n,p in ipairs(k) do k[n]=integral(p) end
      item.kites[j]=k
    end
    if t.reflected then reflections=reflections+1 end
    lines[i]=table.concat(item.address,".")..":"..item.label..":"..(t.reflected and "-" or "+")..":"..table.concat(coordinates,";")
  end
  for _,item in ipairs(nodes) do
    item.transform=transform(item.transform.turn,sub(item.transform.offset,lo),item.transform.reflected)
    for i,p in ipairs(item.guide) do item.guide[i]=sub(p,lo) end
  end
  return {nodes=nodes,leaves=leaves,reflection_count=reflections,reference_bytes=table.concat(lines,"\n")}
end
return M
source.pattern_ink.lua:
-- Compatibility bridge for existing neutral-captured primitive mathematics.
local P,B,G,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_bounds"),require("pattern_geometry"),require("pattern_hash")
local M={}
function M.flower(seed,size)
  local ink,flora=require("ink"),require("flora")
  local operations,receipt=ink.capture(function()
    ink.set_color_mode("color");ink.set_ink(0x24/255,0x56/255,0xC4/255);ink.set_accent(0xB4/255,0x66/255,0x2F/255)
    ink.set_transform({ink.CM,0,0,ink.CM,3*ink.CM,3*ink.CM})
    flora.flower(ink.rng(seed),size)
  end)
  local bounds={};local policy=G.policy("cm",8)
  for _,o in ipairs(operations)do if o.op=="path"then bounds[#bounds+1]=B.path(o.commands,o.paint,nil,policy)end end
  local box=B.union(bounds,"cm");assert(not box.empty,"empty captured flower")
  local content=P.serialize({kind="vector_asset",schema_version=1,unit="cm",operations=operations})
  return {id="example/floral/resource",kind="symbol",unit="cm",bounds=P.plain(box.bounds),
    variants={scene={encoding="utf8",content=content,sha256=H.sha256(content),media_type="application/vnd.pattern.vector+json"}},provenance=receipt}
end
return M
source.pattern_islamic.lua:
-- Euclidean polygons in contact. See Kaplan (2005), sections 3 and 4.
local P = require("pattern")
local N = require("pattern_predicates")
local M = {}
local function sub(a,b) return {a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2]} end
local function add(a,b,k) return {a[1]+k*b[1],a[2]+k*b[2]} end
local function det(a,b) return a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1] end
local function dot(a,b) return a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2] end
local function norm(a) return math.sqrt(dot(a,a)) end
local function unit(a)
  local length=norm(a)
  assert(length>0,"pic-zero-edge")
  return {a[1]/length,a[2]/length}
end
local function midpoint(a,b) return add(a,sub(b,a),.5) end
local function number(x) return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<math.huge end
local function inside(p,polygon,tolerance)
  for i,a in ipairs(polygon) do
    local edge=sub(polygon[i%#polygon+1],a)
    if det(edge,sub(p,a)) < -tolerance*norm(edge) then return false end
  end
  return true
end
local function assert_convex(polygon)
  assert(type(polygon)=="table" and #polygon>=3 and #polygon<=24,"pic-polygon-size")
  for _,p in ipairs(polygon) do
    assert(type(p)=="table" and number(p[1]) and number(p[2]),"pic-polygon-coordinate")
  end
  for i,a in ipairs(polygon) do
    local b=polygon[i%#polygon+1]
    for j,p in ipairs(polygon) do
      if j~=i and j~=i%#polygon+1 then
        assert(N.orient2d(a,b,p)>0,"pic-strict-convex-ccw")
      end
    end
  end
end

-- An optional angle callback supplies already established contact geometry
-- from neighboring motifs, as in Kaplan and Salesin's Euclidean gap inference.
function M.motif(polygon,angle,displacement,contact_angle,contact_direction)
  assert_convex(polygon)
  assert(number(displacement) and displacement>=0,"pic-displacement")
  local rays,pairs_,used,segments={},{},{},{}
  local scale=0
  for i,a in ipairs(polygon) do
    local b=polygon[i%#polygon+1]
    local edge=sub(b,a)
    local length=norm(edge)
    assert(displacement<length,"pic-displacement-reaches-edge-end")
    scale=math.max(scale,length)
    local theta=contact_angle and contact_angle(i) or angle
    assert(number(theta) and theta>0 and theta<90,"pic-contact-angle")
    local t=unit(edge)
    local c,s=math.cos(theta*math.pi/180),math.sin(theta*math.pi/180)
    for _,side in ipairs{-1,1} do
      local direction={side*c*t[1]-s*t[2],side*c*t[2]+s*t[1]}
      local actual=contact_direction and contact_direction(i,side)
      local measured=theta
      if actual then
        direction=unit(actual)
        assert(det(t,direction)>0,"pic-contact-direction-outward")
        measured=math.deg(math.atan(math.abs(det(t,direction)),math.abs(dot(t,direction))))
      end
      rays[#rays+1]={edge=i,side=side,origin=add(midpoint(a,b),t,-side*displacement/2),
        direction=direction,angle=measured}
    end
  end
  local tolerance=scale*1e-10
  for i,a in ipairs(rays) do
    for j=i+1,#rays do
      local b=rays[j]
      if a.edge~=b.edge then
        local between=sub(b.origin,a.origin)
        local denominator=det(a.direction,b.direction)
        local point,cost,kind
        if math.abs(denominator)>1e-12 then
          local ta,tb=det(between,b.direction)/denominator,det(between,a.direction)/denominator
          if ta>tolerance and tb>tolerance then
            point=add(a.origin,a.direction,ta)
            if inside(point,polygon,tolerance) then cost,kind=ta+tb,"intersection" end
          end
        elseif math.abs(det(between,a.direction))<=tolerance
          and dot(a.direction,b.direction)<0 and dot(between,a.direction)>tolerance then
          point,cost,kind=midpoint(a.origin,b.origin),norm(between),"opposing_collinear"
        end
        if cost then
          pairs_[#pairs_+1]={first=i,second=j,point=point,cost=cost,kind=kind,
            rank=math.floor(cost/tolerance+.5)}
        end
      end
    end
  end
  table.sort(pairs_,function(a,b)
    if a.rank~=b.rank then return a.rank<b.rank end
    if a.first~=b.first then return a.first<b.first end
    return a.second<b.second
  end)
  for _,p in ipairs(pairs_) do
    if not used[p.first] and not used[p.second] then
      used[p.first],used[p.second]=true,true
      p.rank=nil
      segments[#segments+1]=p
    end
  end
  for i,r in ipairs(rays) do
    assert(used[i],"pic-unmatched-ray:"..r.edge.."/"..r.side)
  end
  return {rays=rays,paths=segments}
end

function M.rosette_inset(polygon,ratio)
  assert_convex(polygon)
  local n=#polygon
  assert(n>=5,"pic-rosette-needs-five-sides")
  ratio=ratio or 1
  assert(number(ratio) and ratio>0,"pic-rosette-ratio")
  local center={0,0}
  for _,p in ipairs(polygon) do center=add(center,p,1/n) end
  local radius=norm(sub(polygon[1],center))
  local length=norm(sub(polygon[2],polygon[1]))
  local alpha=math.pi/n
  local inset_radius=ratio*radius*(math.cos(alpha)-math.sin(alpha)*math.tan(math.pi*(n-2)/(4*n)))
  assert(inset_radius>0 and inset_radius<radius*math.cos(alpha),"pic-rosette-inset-outside")
  local vertices,spokes={},{}
  for i,p in ipairs(polygon) do
    local q=polygon[i%n+1]
    assert(math.abs(norm(sub(p,center))-radius)<=radius*1e-9 and math.abs(norm(sub(q,p))-length)<=length*1e-9,
      "pic-rosette-requires-regular-polygon")
    local edge_mid=midpoint(p,q)
    local inner=add(center,unit(sub(edge_mid,center)),inset_radius)
    vertices[i]=inner
    spokes[i]={from=inner,to=edge_mid}
  end
  return {center=center,radius=radius,inset_radius=inset_radius,vertices=vertices,spokes=spokes}
end

-- Translate stage 09 cell boundaries into CCW faces with shared vertex IDs.
function M.faces(tiling)
  local vertices,edges,faces={},{},{}
  for _,v in ipairs(tiling.vertices) do vertices[v.id]=P.plain(v.point) end
  for _,e in ipairs(tiling.edges) do edges[e.id]=e end
  for _,cell in ipairs(tiling.cells) do
    local face={id=cell.id,vertices={},prototype=cell.prototype}
    for _,use in ipairs(cell.boundary) do
      local e=edges[use.edge]
      face.vertices[#face.vertices+1]=use.reversed and e.to or e.from
    end
    faces[#faces+1]=face
  end
  return vertices,faces
end

local function points(ids,vertices)
  local p={}
  for i,id in ipairs(ids) do p[i]=assert(vertices[id],"pic-missing-scaffold-vertex") end
  return p
end
local function edge_id(a,b)
  if P.byte_less(b,a) then return b.."+"..a end
  return a.."+"..b
end

-- The original sides disappear. The bounded transformed patch keeps inset
-- octagons and complete vertex fans, leaving only outer-patch boundary ports.
function M.rosette_patch(vertices,faces,ratio)
  local out,transformed,fans,lineage={},{},{},{}
  for _,face in ipairs(faces) do
    local poly=points(face.vertices,vertices)
    local anchors={}
    if #poly==8 then
      local inset=M.rosette_inset(poly,ratio)
      local id="inset/"..face.id
      for i,p in ipairs(inset.vertices) do
        anchors[i]=id.."/v"..i
        out[anchors[i]]=p
      end
      transformed[#transformed+1]={id=id,vertices=anchors,prototype="inset-octagon"}
      lineage[id]={parent=face.id,kind="regular-inset",radius=inset.radius,inset_radius=inset.inset_radius}
    elseif #poly==4 then
      assert_convex(poly)
      local a,b,c,d=table.unpack(poly)
      local center=midpoint(a,c)
      assert(norm(sub(center,midpoint(b,d)))<1e-10 and
        math.abs(dot(sub(b,a),sub(d,a)))<1e-10 and math.abs(norm(sub(b,a))-norm(sub(d,a)))<1e-10,
        "pic-rosette-square-bisectors")
      local id="bisectors/"..face.id
      out[id]=center
      for i=1,4 do anchors[i]=id end
    else
      error("pic-rosette-unsupported-scaffold")
    end
    for i,vertex in ipairs(face.vertices) do
      local fan=fans[vertex]
      if not fan then fan={anchors={},parents={},octagons=0};fans[vertex]=fan end
      fan.parents[#fan.parents+1]=face.id
      if #poly==8 then fan.octagons=fan.octagons+1 end
      fan.anchors[anchors[i]]=true
      fan.anchors[anchors[(i-2)%#poly+1]]=true
    end
  end
  local keys={}
  for k in pairs(fans) do keys[#keys+1]=k end
  table.sort(keys,P.byte_less)
  for _,v in ipairs(keys) do
    local fan=fans[v]
    if #fan.parents==3 and fan.octagons==2 then
      local center=vertices[v]
      local ring={}
      for a in pairs(fan.anchors) do ring[#ring+1]=a end
      table.sort(ring,function(a,b)
        local u,w=sub(out[a],center),sub(out[b],center)
        return math.atan(u[2],u[1])<math.atan(w[2],w[1])
      end)
      assert(#ring==5,"pic-rosette-pentagon-incidence")
      assert_convex(points(ring,out))
      local id="fan/"..v
      table.sort(fan.parents,P.byte_less)
      transformed[#transformed+1]={id=id,vertices=ring,prototype="vertex-pentagon"}
      lineage[id]={parents=fan.parents,vertex=v,kind="bisector-fan"}
    else
      assert(#fan.parents<3,"pic-rosette-unexpected-vertex-fan")
    end
  end
  return out,transformed,lineage
end

-- A motif vertex is either an interior bend or a branch at a shared edge.
-- Zero displacement keeps two coincident positions as distinct strands.
function M.assemble(vertices,faces,angle,displacement,gradient)
  local nodes,links,motifs,ports,degree={},{},{},{},{}
  local function vertex(id,p)
    local existing=nodes[id]
    if existing then
      assert(norm(sub(existing,p))<1e-9,"pic-seam-position-mismatch")
    else nodes[id]=p end
  end
  local function join(id,a,b,face)
    assert(a~=b and norm(sub(nodes[a],nodes[b]))>1e-10,"pic-zero-link")
    links[#links+1]={id=id,from=a,to=b,face=face}
    degree[a]=(degree[a]or 0)+1
    degree[b]=(degree[b]or 0)+1
  end
  for _,f in ipairs(faces) do
    local polygon=points(f.vertices,vertices)
    local function angle_at(i)
      local a,b=polygon[i],polygon[i%#polygon+1]
      return angle+(gradient or 0)*midpoint(a,b)[1]
    end
    local motif=M.motif(polygon,angle,displacement,angle_at)
    motifs[f.id]=motif
    for _,r in ipairs(motif.rays) do
      local a,b=f.vertices[r.edge],f.vertices[r.edge%#polygon+1]
      local reversed=P.byte_less(b,a)
      local side=(displacement==0 or not reversed) and r.side or -r.side
      local key=edge_id(a,b).."/"..(side==1 and "plus" or "minus")
      local id="contact/"..key
      vertex(id,r.origin)
      r.port=id
      local p=ports[id]
      if not p then p={point=nodes[id],direction=r.direction,angle=r.angle,faces={f.id}};ports[id]=p
      else
        assert(#p.faces==1 and math.abs(p.angle-r.angle)<1e-10,"pic-seam-angle-or-incidence")
        local direction=p.direction
        if displacement>0 then
          local tangent=unit(sub(vertices[b],vertices[a]))
          direction=add({-direction[1],-direction[2]},tangent,2*dot(direction,tangent))
        else direction={-direction[1],-direction[2]} end
        assert(norm(sub(direction,r.direction))<1e-9,"pic-seam-direction-mismatch")
        p.faces[2]=f.id
      end
    end
    for i,path in ipairs(motif.paths) do
      local a,b=motif.rays[path.first].port,motif.rays[path.second].port
      local key=f.id.."/"..i
      local id="bend/"..key
      vertex(id,path.point)
      join("path/"..key.."/a",a,id,f.id)
      join("path/"..key.."/b",id,b,f.id)
    end
  end
  for id,p in pairs(ports) do
    assert(degree[id]==#p.faces and degree[id]<=2,"pic-seam-degree")
    p.role=degree[id]==2 and "interior" or "patch_boundary"
  end
  return {nodes=nodes,links=links,motifs=motifs,ports=ports}
end

local function sorted_keys(t)
  local keys={}
  for k in pairs(t) do keys[#keys+1]=k end
  table.sort(keys,P.byte_less)
  return keys
end
local function summarize(graph)
  local vertices,contacts=P.array(),P.array()
  for _,id in ipairs(sorted_keys(graph.nodes)) do
    vertices[#vertices+1]={id=id,point=graph.nodes[id]}
  end
  for _,id in ipairs(sorted_keys(graph.ports)) do
    local p=graph.ports[id]
    contacts[#contacts+1]={id=id,faces=p.faces,angle=p.angle,direction=p.direction,role=p.role}
  end
  return {vertices=vertices,edges=graph.links},contacts
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="ornament/islamic-pic",version="1",family="euclidean-polygons-in-contact",
    units="cm",capabilities={"graph"},parameters={
      scaffold={type="string",enum={"square","hexagonal","4.8.8","4.6.12"},required=true},
      contact_angle={type="number",minimum=1,maximum=89,required=true},
      displacement={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=10},
      lattice_step={type="number",minimum=.25,maximum=20,required=true},
      rotation={type="number",minimum=-360,maximum=360},
      parquet_gradient={type="number",minimum=-15,maximum=15},
      rosette_ratio={type="number",minimum=.5,maximum=1.5}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,uniform_scale=true,reflection=false},
    assumptions={"Euclidean only, strict convex faces and complete greedy pairing",
      "Scaffold contact IDs and ornament graph are separate. Crop does not regenerate geometry.",
      "Midpoint branch crossings are undecorated. No over/under paint order is claimed."}})
end

local function validate(x)
  local k=x.extensions.pic
  local graph=M.assemble(P.plain(k.scaffold_vertices),P.plain(k.scaffold_faces),k.contact_angle,k.displacement,k.parquet_gradient)
  local structure,ports=summarize(graph)
  assert(P.serialize(structure)==P.serialize(x.structures.graph),"pic-graph-reconstruction")
  assert(P.serialize(ports)==P.serialize(k.contacts),"pic-contact-reconstruction")
  if k.rosette then
    local vertices,faces,lineage=M.rosette_patch(P.plain(k.rosette.original_vertices),P.plain(k.rosette.original_faces),k.rosette.ratio)
    assert(P.serialize(vertices)==P.serialize(k.scaffold_vertices) and P.serialize(faces)==P.serialize(k.scaffold_faces)
      and P.serialize(lineage)==P.serialize(k.rosette.lineage),"pic-rosette-reconstruction")
  end
  return {ok=true,checks={"source greedy ray pairs and incidence","seam branch and shared angle consistency","rosette lineage reconstruction"}}
end

function M.validate(instance) return validate(P.instance(P.plain(instance),M.definition())) end

local function lower(x,v,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="stroke" or k=="stroke_width","pic-unsupported-style:"..k) end
  local width=style.stroke_width or .024
  assert(number(width) and width>0 and width<=.3,"pic-stroke-width")
  local G=require("pattern_geometry")
  local matrix=P.plain(v.transform)
  local crop=v.crop
  local world,page,ops={},{},{}
  for _,n in ipairs(x.structures.graph.vertices) do
    world[n.id]=n.point
    page[n.id]=G.transform(n.point,matrix)
  end
  local pad=width*math.sqrt(matrix[1]^2+matrix[2]^2+matrix[3]^2+matrix[4]^2)
  for _,e in ipairs(x.structures.graph.edges) do
    local a,b=page[e.from],page[e.to]
    if math.min(a[1],b[1])-pad<=crop[3] and math.max(a[1],b[1])+pad>=crop[1]
      and math.min(a[2],b[2])-pad<=crop[4] and math.max(a[2],b[2])+pad>=crop[2] then
      local p,q=world[e.from],world[e.to]
      ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=e.id,commands={{"M",p[1],p[2]},{"L",q[1],q[2]}},
        transform=matrix,paint={stroke=style.stroke or {.13,.29,.49},stroke_width=width}}
    end
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
    clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)},operations=ops,resources=P.array()}
end

M.lower_graph=lower

function M.register(registry)
  local R,T=require("pattern_registry"),require("pattern_periodic")
  local base=R.new()
  local periodic=T.register(base)
  local definition=M.definition()
  local function generate(s,c)
    local a=s.parameters
    if a.rosette_ratio then assert(a.scaffold=="4.8.8","pic-rosette-requires-4.8.8") end
    local scaffold=P.specification({id=s.id.."/scaffold",definition_ref={id=periodic.id,version=periodic.version},
      seed=s.seed,parameters={family=a.scaffold,lattice_step=a.lattice_step,rotation_degrees=a.rotation},
      inputs={},constraints={},style={},budget=P.plain(s.budget),document=P.plain(s.document)},periodic)
    local request,reason=base:generate(periodic.id,scaffold,c)
    assert(request,reason and P.serialize(reason))
    local vertices,faces=M.faces(request.instance.structures.tiling)
    local rosette
    if a.rosette_ratio then
      local source_vertices,source_faces=vertices,faces
      local lineage
      vertices,faces,lineage=M.rosette_patch(vertices,faces,a.rosette_ratio)
      rosette={original_vertices=source_vertices,original_faces=source_faces,lineage=lineage,ratio=a.rosette_ratio}
    end
    assert(#faces<=360,"pic-face-budget")
    for _,face in ipairs(faces) do
      c:consume("operations",4*(#face.vertices)^2)
      c:consume("objects",8*#face.vertices)
    end
    local delta,gradient=a.displacement or 0,a.parquet_gradient or 0
    local graph,contacts=summarize(M.assemble(vertices,faces,a.contact_angle,delta,gradient))
    return {id=s.id.."/pic",definition_ref={id=definition.id,version=definition.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),
      structures={graph=graph},provenance={generator=definition.id,generator_version=definition.version,seed=s.seed,
        construction="kaplan-pic-euclidean-v1"},
      extensions={pic={scaffold_vertices=vertices,scaffold_faces=faces,contacts=contacts,contact_angle=a.contact_angle,
        displacement=delta,parquet_gradient=gradient,rosette=rosette}}}
  end
  registry:register(definition,{generate=generate,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return definition
end

return M

      pairs, type, tostring, tonumber, getmetatable, setmetatable

local strrep, gsub, strsub, strbyte, strchar, strfind, strlen, strformat =
      string.rep, string.gsub, string.sub, string.byte, string.char,
      string.find, string.len, string.format
local strmatch = string.match
local concat = table.concat

local json = { version = "dkjson 2.11" }

local jsonlpeg = {}

if register_global_module_table then
  if always_use_lpeg then
    _G[global_module_name] = jsonlpeg
  else
    _G[global_module_name] = json
  end
end

local _ENV = nil -- blocking globals in Lua 5.2 and later

pcall (function()
  -- Enable access to blocked metatables.
  -- Don't worry, this module doesn't change anything in them.
  local debmeta = require "debug".getmetatable
  if debmeta then getmetatable = debmeta end
end)

json.null = setmetatable ({}, {
  __tojson = function () return "null" end
})

local function isarray (tbl)
  local max, n, arraylen = 0, 0, 0
  for k,v in pairs (tbl) do
    if k == 'n' and type(v) == 'number' then
      arraylen = v
      if v > max then
        max = v
      end
    else
      if type(k) ~= 'number' or k < 1 or floor(k) ~= k then
        return false
      end
      if k > max then
        max = k
      end
      n = n + 1
    end
  end
  if max > 10 and max > arraylen and max > n * 2 then
    return false -- don't create an array with too many holes
  end
  return true, max
end

local escapecodes = {
  ["\""] = "\\\"", ["\\"] = "\\\\", ["\b"] = "\\b", ["\f"] = "\\f",
  ["\n"] = "\\n",  ["\r"] = "\\r",  ["\t"] = "\\t"
}

local function escapeutf8 (uchar)
  local value = escapecodes[uchar]
  if value then
    return value
  end
  local a, b, c, d = strbyte (uchar, 1, 4)
  a, b, c, d = a or 0, b or 0, c or 0, d or 0
  if a <= 0x7f then
    value = a
  elseif 0xc0 <= a and a <= 0xdf and b >= 0x80 then
    value = (a - 0xc0) * 0x40 + b - 0x80
  elseif 0xe0 <= a and a <= 0xef and b >= 0x80 and c >= 0x80 then
    value = ((a - 0xe0) * 0x40 + b - 0x80) * 0x40 + c - 0x80
  elseif 0xf0 <= a and a <= 0xf7 and b >= 0x80 and c >= 0x80 and d >= 0x80 then
    value = (((a - 0xf0) * 0x40 + b - 0x80) * 0x40 + c - 0x80) * 0x40 + d - 0x80
  else
    return ""
  end
  if value <= 0xffff then
    return strformat ("\\u%.4x", value)
  elseif value <= 0x10ffff then
    -- encode as UTF-16 surrogate pair
    value = value - 0x10000
    local highsur, lowsur = 0xD800 + floor (value/0x400), 0xDC00 + (value % 0x400)
    return strformat ("\\u%.4x\\u%.4x", highsur, lowsur)
  else
    return ""
  end
end

local function fsub (str, pattern, repl)
  -- gsub always builds a new string in a buffer, even when no match
  -- exists. First using find should be more efficient when most strings
  -- don't contain the pattern.
  if strfind (str, pattern) then
    return gsub (str, pattern, repl)
  else
    return str
  end
end

local function quotestring (value)
  -- based on the regexp "escapable" in https://github.com/douglascrockford/JSON-js
  value = fsub (value, "[%z\1-\31\"\\\127]", escapeutf8)
  if strfind (value, "[\194\216\220\225\226\239]") then
    value = fsub (value, "\194[\128-\159\173]", escapeutf8)
    value = fsub (value, "\216[\128-\132]", escapeutf8)
    value = fsub (value, "\220\143", escapeutf8)
    value = fsub (value, "\225\158[\180\181]", escapeutf8)
    value = fsub (value, "\226\128[\140-\143\168-\175]", escapeutf8)
    value = fsub (value, "\226\129[\160-\175]", escapeutf8)
    value = fsub (value, "\239\187\191", escapeutf8)
    value = fsub (value, "\239\191[\176-\191]", escapeutf8)
  end
  return "\"" .. value .. "\""
end
json.quotestring = quotestring

local function replace(str, o, n)
  local i, j = strfind (str, o, 1, true)
  if i then
    return strsub(str, 1, i-1) .. n .. strsub(str, j+1, -1)
  else
    return str
  end
end

-- locale independent num2str and str2num functions
local decpoint, numfilter

local function updatedecpoint ()
  decpoint = strmatch(tostring(0.5), "([^05+])")
  -- build a filter that can be used to remove group separators
  numfilter = "[^0-9%-%+eE" .. gsub(decpoint, "[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]", "%%%0") .. "]+"
end

updatedecpoint()

local function num2str (num)
  return replace(fsub(tostring(num), numfilter, ""), decpoint, ".")
end

local function str2num (str)
  local num = tonumber(replace(str, ".", decpoint))
  if not num then
    updatedecpoint()
    num = tonumber(replace(str, ".", decpoint))
  end
  return num
end

local function addnewline2 (level, buffer, buflen)
  buffer[buflen+1] = "\n"
  buffer[buflen+2] = strrep ("  ", level)
  buflen = buflen + 2
  return buflen
end

function json.addnewline (state)
  if state.indent then
    state.bufferlen = addnewline2 (state.level or 0,
                           state.buffer, state.bufferlen or #(state.buffer))
  end
end

local encode2 -- forward declaration

local function addpair (key, value, prev, indent, level, buffer, buflen, tables, globalorder, state)
  local kt = type (key)
  if kt ~= 'string' and kt ~= 'number' then
    return nil, "type '" .. kt .. "' is not supported as a key by JSON."
  end
  if prev then
    buflen = buflen + 1
    buffer[buflen] = ","
  end
  if indent then
    buflen = addnewline2 (level, buffer, buflen)
  end
  -- When Lua is compiled with LUA_NOCVTN2S this will fail when
  -- numbers are mixed into the keys of the table. JSON keys are always
  -- strings, so this would be an implicit conversion too and the failure
  -- is intentional.
  buffer[buflen+1] = quotestring (key)
  buffer[buflen+2] = ":"
  return encode2 (value, indent, level, buffer, buflen + 2, tables, globalorder, state)
end

local function appendcustom(res, buffer, state)
  local buflen = state.bufferlen
  if type (res) == 'string' then
    buflen = buflen + 1
    buffer[buflen] = res
  end
  return buflen
end

local function exception(reason, value, state, buffer, buflen, defaultmessage)
  defaultmessage = defaultmessage or reason
  local handler = state.exception
  if not handler then
    return nil, defaultmessage
  else
    state.bufferlen = buflen
    local ret, msg = handler (reason, value, state, defaultmessage)
    if not ret then return nil, msg or defaultmessage end
    return appendcustom(ret, buffer, state)
  end
end

function json.encodeexception(reason, value, state, defaultmessage)
  return quotestring("<" .. defaultmessage .. ">")
end

encode2 = function (value, indent, level, buffer, buflen, tables, globalorder, state)
  local valtype = type (value)
  local valmeta = getmetatable (value)
  valmeta = type (valmeta) == 'table' and valmeta -- only tables
  local valtojson = valmeta and valmeta.__tojson
  if valtojson then
    if tables[value] then
      return exception('reference cycle', value, state, buffer, buflen)
    end
    tables[value] = true
    state.bufferlen = buflen
    local ret, msg = valtojson (value, state)
    if not ret then return exception('custom encoder failed', value, state, buffer, buflen, msg) end
    tables[value] = nil
    buflen = appendcustom(ret, buffer, state)
  elseif value == nil then
    buflen = buflen + 1
    buffer[buflen] = "null"
  elseif valtype == 'number' then
    local s
    if value ~= value or value >= huge or -value >= huge then
      -- This is the behaviour of the original JSON implementation.
      s = "null"
    else
      s = num2str (value)
    end
    buflen = buflen + 1
    buffer[buflen] = s
  elseif valtype == 'boolean' then
    buflen = buflen + 1
    buffer[buflen] = value and "true" or "false"
  elseif valtype == 'string' then
    buflen = buflen + 1
    buffer[buflen] = quotestring (value)
  elseif valtype == 'table' then
    if tables[value] then
      return exception('reference cycle', value, state, buffer, buflen)
    end
    tables[value] = true
    level = level + 1
    local isa, n = isarray (value)
    if n == 0 and valmeta and valmeta.__jsontype == 'object' then
      isa = false
    end
    local msg
    if isa then -- JSON array
      buflen = buflen + 1
      buffer[buflen] = "["
      for i = 1, n do
        buflen, msg = encode2 (value[i], indent, level, buffer, buflen, tables, globalorder, state)
        if not buflen then return nil, msg end
        if i < n then
          buflen = buflen + 1
          buffer[buflen] = ","
        end
      end
      buflen = buflen + 1
      buffer[buflen] = "]"
    else -- JSON object
      local prev = false
      buflen = buflen + 1
      buffer[buflen] = "{"
      local order = valmeta and valmeta.__jsonorder or globalorder
      if order then
        local used = {}
        n = #order
        for i = 1, n do
          local k = order[i]
          local v = value[k]
          if v ~= nil then
            used[k] = true
            buflen, msg = addpair (k, v, prev, indent, level, buffer, buflen, tables, globalorder, state)
            if not buflen then return nil, msg end
            prev = true -- add a seperator before the next element
          end
        end
        for k,v in pairs (value) do
          if not used[k] then
            buflen, msg = addpair (k, v, prev, indent, level, buffer, buflen, tables, globalorder, state)
            if not buflen then return nil, msg end
            prev = true -- add a seperator before the next element
          end
        end
      else -- unordered
        for k,v in pairs (value) do
          buflen, msg = addpair (k, v, prev, indent, level, buffer, buflen, tables, globalorder, state)
          if not buflen then return nil, msg end
          prev = true -- add a seperator before the next element
        end
      end
      if indent then
        buflen = addnewline2 (level - 1, buffer, buflen)
      end
      buflen = buflen + 1
      buffer[buflen] = "}"
    end
    tables[value] = nil
  else
    return exception ('unsupported type', value, state, buffer, buflen,
      "type '" .. valtype .. "' is not supported by JSON.")
  end
  return buflen
end

function json.encode (value, state)
  state = state or {}
  local oldbuffer = state.buffer
  local buffer = oldbuffer or {}
  state.buffer = buffer
  updatedecpoint()
  local ret, msg = encode2 (value, state.indent, state.level or 0,
                   buffer, state.bufferlen or 0, state.tables or {}, state.keyorder, state)
  if not ret then
    error (msg, 2)
  elseif oldbuffer == buffer then
    state.bufferlen = ret
    return true
  else
    state.bufferlen = nil
    state.buffer = nil
    return concat (buffer)
  end
end

local function loc (str, where)
  local line, pos, linepos = 1, 1, 0
  while true do
    pos = strfind (str, "\n", pos, true)
    if pos and pos < where then
      line = line + 1
      linepos = pos
      pos = pos + 1
    else
      break
    end
  end
  return strformat ("line %d, column %d", line, where - linepos)
end

local function unterminated (str, what, where)
  return nil, strlen (str) + 1, "unterminated " .. what .. " at " .. loc (str, where)
end

local function scanwhite (str, pos)
  while true do
    pos = strmatch (str, "%s*()", pos)
    local n1, n2, n3 = strbyte (str, pos, pos + 2)
    if n1 == 239 and n2 == 187 and n3 == 191 then
      -- UTF-8 Byte Order Mark
      pos = pos + 3
    elseif n1 == 47 then
      if n2 == 47 then -- "//"
        pos = strfind (str, "[\n\r]", pos + 2)
        if not pos then return nil end
      elseif n2 == 42 then -- "/*"
        pos = strfind (str, "*/", pos + 2)
        if not pos then return nil end
        pos = pos + 2
      else
        return pos, n1
      end
    elseif n1 == nil then
      return nil
    else
      return pos, n1
    end
  end
end

local escapechars = {
  ["\""] = "\"", ["\\"] = "\\", ["/"] = "/", ["b"] = "\b", ["f"] = "\f",
  ["n"] = "\n", ["r"] = "\r", ["t"] = "\t"
}

local function unichar (value)
  if value < 0 then
    return nil
  elseif value <= 0x007f then
    return strchar (value)
  elseif value <= 0x07ff then
    return strchar (0xc0 + floor(value/0x40),
                    0x80 + (floor(value) % 0x40))
  elseif value <= 0xffff then
    return strchar (0xe0 + floor(value/0x1000),
                    0x80 + (floor(value/0x40) % 0x40),
                    0x80 + (floor(value) % 0x40))
  elseif value <= 0x10ffff then
    return strchar (0xf0 + floor(value/0x40000),
                    0x80 + (floor(value/0x1000) % 0x40),
                    0x80 + (floor(value/0x40) % 0x40),
                    0x80 + (floor(value) % 0x40))
  else
    return nil
  end
end

local function scanstring (str, pos)
  local lastpos = pos + 1
  local buffer, n = {}, 0
  while true do
    local nextpos = strfind (str, "[\"\\]", lastpos)
    if not nextpos then
      return unterminated (str, "string", pos)
    end
    if nextpos > lastpos then
      n = n + 1
      buffer[n] = strsub (str, lastpos, nextpos - 1)
    end
    if strbyte (str, nextpos) == 34 then -- '"'
      lastpos = nextpos + 1
      break
    else
      local escchar = strsub (str, nextpos + 1, nextpos + 1)
      local value
      if escchar == "u" then
        value = tonumber (strsub (str, nextpos + 2, nextpos + 5), 16)
        if value then
          local value2
          if 0xD800 <= value and value <= 0xDBff then
            -- we have the high surrogate of UTF-16. Check if there is a
            -- low surrogate escaped nearby to combine them.
            if strsub (str, nextpos + 6, nextpos + 7) == "\\u" then
              value2 = tonumber (strsub (str, nextpos + 8, nextpos + 11), 16)
              if value2 and 0xDC00 <= value2 and value2 <= 0xDFFF then
                value = (value - 0xD800)  * 0x400 + (value2 - 0xDC00) + 0x10000
              else
                value2 = nil -- in case it was out of range for a low surrogate
              end
            end
          end
          value = value and unichar (value)
          if value then
            if value2 then
              lastpos = nextpos + 12
            else
              lastpos = nextpos + 6
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if not value then
        value = escapechars[escchar] or escchar
        lastpos = nextpos + 2
      end
      n = n + 1
      buffer[n] = value
    end
  end
  if n == 1 then
    return buffer[1], lastpos
  elseif n > 1 then
    return concat (buffer), lastpos
  else
    return "", lastpos
  end
end

local scanvalue -- forward declaration

local function scanobject (str, startpos, nullval, objectmeta, arraymeta)
  local tbl = setmetatable ({}, objectmeta)
  local pos = startpos + 1

  while true do
    local char
    pos, char = scanwhite (str, pos)
    local key, err
    if char == 34 then -- '"'
      key, pos, err = scanstring (str, pos)
    elseif char == 125 then -- "}"
      return tbl, pos + 1
    elseif not pos then
      return unterminated (str, "object", startpos)
    else
      return nil, pos, "invalid key at " .. loc (str, pos)
    end
    if err then return nil, pos, err end

    char = strbyte (str, pos)
    if char ~= 58 then -- ":"
      pos, char = scanwhite (str, pos)
      if not pos then
        return unterminated (str, "object", startpos)
      elseif char ~= 58 then
        return nil, pos, "missing colon at " .. loc (str, pos)
      end
    end

    pos = scanwhite (str, pos + 1)
    if not pos then return unterminated (str, "object", startpos) end
    local val
    val, pos, err = scanvalue (str, pos, nullval, objectmeta, arraymeta)
    if err then return nil, pos, err end
    tbl[key] = val

    char = strbyte (str, pos)
    if char == 44 then -- ","
      pos = pos + 1
    else
      pos, char = scanwhite (str, pos)

      if char == 44 then
        pos = pos + 1
      elseif not pos then
        return unterminated (str, "object", startpos)
      end
    end
  end
end

local function scanarray (str, startpos, nullval, objectmeta, arraymeta)
  local tbl, n = setmetatable ({}, arraymeta), 0
  local pos = startpos + 1

  while true do
    local char
    pos, char = scanwhite (str, pos)

    if char == 93 then -- "]"
      return tbl, pos + 1
    elseif not pos then
      return unterminated (str, "array", startpos)
    end

    local val, err
    val, pos, err = scanvalue (str, pos, nullval, objectmeta, arraymeta)
    if err then return nil, pos, err end
    n = n + 1
    tbl[n] = val

    char = strbyte (str, pos)
    if char == 44 then -- ","
      pos = pos + 1
    else
      pos, char = scanwhite (str, pos)

      if char == 44 then
        pos = pos + 1
      elseif not pos then
        return unterminated (str, "array", startpos)
      end
    end
  end
end

local function scaninvalid (str, pos)
  return nil, pos, "no valid JSON value at " .. loc (str, pos)
end

local function scanliteral (str, pos, expected, value)
  local pstart, pend = strfind (str, "^%a%w*", pos)
  local name = strsub (str, pstart, pend)
  if name == expected then
    return value, pend + 1
  else
    return scaninvalid (str, pos)
  end
end

local function scannumber (str, pos)
  local pstart, pend = strfind (str, "^%-?[%d%.]*[eE]?[%+%-]?%d*", pos)
  local number = str2num (strsub (str, pstart, pend))
  if number then
    return number, pend + 1
  else
    return scaninvalid (str, pos)
  end
end

scanvalue = function (str, pos, nullval, objectmeta, arraymeta)
  pos = pos or 1
  local c
  pos, c = scanwhite (str, pos)

  if not pos then
    return nil, strlen (str) + 1, "no valid JSON value (reached the end)"
  elseif c == 34 then -- '"'
    return scanstring (str, pos)
  elseif c == 123 then -- "{"
    return scanobject (str, pos, nullval, objectmeta, arraymeta)
  elseif c == 91 then -- "["
    return scanarray (str, pos, nullval, objectmeta, arraymeta)
  elseif c == 45 or (c >= 48 and c <= 57) then -- "-", "0"..."9"
    return scannumber (str, pos)
  elseif c == 116 then -- "t"
    return scanliteral (str, pos, "true", true)
  elseif c == 102 then -- "f"
    return scanliteral (str, pos, "false", false)
  elseif c == 110 then -- "n"
    return scanliteral (str, pos, "null", nullval)
  else
    return scaninvalid (str, pos)
  end
end

local function optionalmetatables(...)
  if select("#", ...) > 0 then
    return ...
  else
    return {__jsontype = 'object'}, {__jsontype = 'array'}
  end
end

function json.decode (str, pos, nullval, ...)
  local objectmeta, arraymeta = optionalmetatables(...)
  return scanvalue (str, pos, nullval, objectmeta, arraymeta)
end

function json.use_lpeg ()
  local g = require ("lpeg")

  if type(g.version) == 'function' and g.version() == "0.11" then
    error "due to a bug in LPeg 0.11, it cannot be used for JSON matching"
  end

  local pegmatch = g.match
  local P, S, R = g.P, g.S, g.R

  local function ErrorCall (str, pos, msg, state)
    if not state.msg then
      state.msg = msg .. " at " .. loc (str, pos)
      state.pos = pos
    end
    return false
  end

  local function Err (msg)
    return g.Cmt (g.Cc (msg) * g.Carg (2), ErrorCall)
  end

  local function ErrorUnterminatedCall (str, pos, what, state)
    return ErrorCall (str, pos - 1, "unterminated " .. what, state)
  end

  local SingleLineComment = P"//" * (1 - S"\n\r")^0
  local MultiLineComment = P"/*" * (1 - P"*/")^0 * P"*/"
  local Space = (S" \n\r\t" + P"\239\187\191" + SingleLineComment + MultiLineComment)^0

  local function ErrUnterminated (what)
    return g.Cmt (g.Cc (what) * g.Carg (2), ErrorUnterminatedCall)
  end

  local PlainChar = 1 - S"\"\\\n\r"
  local EscapeSequence = (P"\\" * g.C (S"\"\\/bfnrt" + Err "unsupported escape sequence")) / escapechars
  local HexDigit = R("09", "af", "AF")
  local function UTF16Surrogate (match, pos, high, low)
    high, low = tonumber (high, 16), tonumber (low, 16)
    if 0xD800 <= high and high <= 0xDBff and 0xDC00 <= low and low <= 0xDFFF then
      return true, unichar ((high - 0xD800)  * 0x400 + (low - 0xDC00) + 0x10000)
    else
      return false
    end
  end
  local function UTF16BMP (hex)
    return unichar (tonumber (hex, 16))
  end
  local U16Sequence = (P"\\u" * g.C (HexDigit * HexDigit * HexDigit * HexDigit))
  local UnicodeEscape = g.Cmt (U16Sequence * U16Sequence, UTF16Surrogate) + U16Sequence/UTF16BMP
  local Char = UnicodeEscape + EscapeSequence + PlainChar
  local String = P"\"" * (g.Cs (Char ^ 0) * P"\"" + ErrUnterminated "string")
  local Integer = P"-"^(-1) * (P"0" + (R"19" * R"09"^0))
  local Fractal = P"." * R"09"^0
  local Exponent = (S"eE") * (S"+-")^(-1) * R"09"^1
  local Number = (Integer * Fractal^(-1) * Exponent^(-1))/str2num
  local Constant = P"true" * g.Cc (true) + P"false" * g.Cc (false) + P"null" * g.Carg (1)
  local SimpleValue = Number + String + Constant
  local ArrayContent, ObjectContent

  -- The functions parsearray and parseobject parse only a single value/pair
  -- at a time and store them directly to avoid hitting the LPeg limits.
  local function parsearray (str, pos, nullval, state)
    local obj, cont
    local start = pos
    local npos
    local t, nt = {}, 0
    repeat
      obj, cont, npos = pegmatch (ArrayContent, str, pos, nullval, state)
      if cont == 'end' then
        return ErrorUnterminatedCall (str, start, "array", state)
      end
      pos = npos
      if cont == 'cont' or cont == 'last' then
        nt = nt + 1
        t[nt] = obj
      end
    until cont ~= 'cont'
    return pos, setmetatable (t, state.arraymeta)
  end

  local function parseobject (str, pos, nullval, state)
    local obj, key, cont
    local start = pos
    local npos
    local t = {}
    repeat
      key, obj, cont, npos = pegmatch (ObjectContent, str, pos, nullval, state)
      if cont == 'end' then
        return ErrorUnterminatedCall (str, start, "object", state)
      end
      pos = npos
      if cont == 'cont' or cont == 'last' then
        t[key] = obj
      end
    until cont ~= 'cont'
    return pos, setmetatable (t, state.objectmeta)
  end

  local Array = P"[" * g.Cmt (g.Carg(1) * g.Carg(2), parsearray)
  local Object = P"{" * g.Cmt (g.Carg(1) * g.Carg(2), parseobject)
  local Value = Space * (Array + Object + SimpleValue)
  local ExpectedValue = Value + Space * Err "value expected"
  local ExpectedKey = String + Err "key expected"
  local End = P(-1) * g.Cc'end'
  local ErrInvalid = Err "invalid JSON"
  ArrayContent = (Value * Space * (P"," * g.Cc'cont' + P"]" * g.Cc'last'+ End + ErrInvalid)  + g.Cc(nil) * (P"]" * g.Cc'empty' + End  + ErrInvalid)) * g.Cp()
  local Pair = g.Cg (Space * ExpectedKey * Space * (P":" + Err "colon expected") * ExpectedValue)
  ObjectContent = (g.Cc(nil) * g.Cc(nil) * P"}" * g.Cc'empty' + End + (Pair * Space * (P"," * g.Cc'cont' + P"}" * g.Cc'last' + End + ErrInvalid) + ErrInvalid)) * g.Cp()
  local DecodeValue = ExpectedValue * g.Cp ()

  jsonlpeg.version = json.version
  jsonlpeg.encode = json.encode
  jsonlpeg.null = json.null
  jsonlpeg.quotestring = json.quotestring
  jsonlpeg.addnewline = json.addnewline
  jsonlpeg.encodeexception = json.encodeexception
  jsonlpeg.using_lpeg = true

  function jsonlpeg.decode (str, pos, nullval, ...)
    local state = {}
    state.objectmeta, state.arraymeta = optionalmetatables(...)
    local obj, retpos = pegmatch (DecodeValue, str, pos, nullval, state)
    if state.msg then
      return nil, state.pos, state.msg
    else
      return obj, retpos
    end
  end

  -- cache result of this function:
  json.use_lpeg = function () return jsonlpeg end
  jsonlpeg.use_lpeg = json.use_lpeg

  return jsonlpeg
end

if always_use_lpeg then
  return json.use_lpeg()
end

return json
