-- Trusted LuaLaTeX host. Recipes remain bounded data; no subprocess is used.
local P,H,V=require('pattern'),require('pattern_hash'),require('pattern_render')
local B=require('pattern_bytes')
local F=require('florilegium');local M={};local CM=2.54/(72.27*65536)
local core,source,root;local bindings={};local declarations=P.array();local pages=P.array();local inline=P.array()
local started,shipped=false,0;local pending
local function need(ok,why)assert(ok,'florilegium patterns: '..why)end
local function read(path,limit)
  local file=assert(io.open(path,'rb'),'florilegium patterns: file not found '..path)
  local bytes=file:read((limit or 2*1024*1024)+1);file:close()
  need(bytes and #bytes<=(limit or 2*1024*1024),'input exceeds byte limit: '..path);return bytes
end
local function resolve(path)
  need(type(path)=='string' and #path>0 and not path:find('%z'),'invalid input filename')
  local file=io.open(path,'rb');if file then file:close();return path end
  local found=kpse.find_file(path)
  need(found,'input not found '..path)
  return found
end
local function source_bytes()
  local lfs=require('lfs');root=root or assert(kpse.find_file('pattern.lua','lua')):gsub('[^/\\]+$','')
  local files={}
  for name in lfs.dir(root)do
    if name:match('%.lua$') or name:match('^florilegium.*%.sty$') or name:match('^florilegium.*%.def$')then
      files[name]=read(root..name,16*1024*1024)
    end
  end
  return files
end
local function init()
  if not core then
    source=source_bytes()
    core=require('pattern_tex').new({source=source,runtime='LuaLaTeX/'..tostring(status.luatex_version)..'/'..tostring(status.luatex_revision)})
  end
  return core
end
local function write_new(path,bytes)
  local old=io.open(path,'rb')
  if old then local existing=old:read('*a');old:close();need(existing==bytes,'existing generated filename has different bytes: '..path);return end
  local file=assert(io.open(path,'wb'));assert(file:write(bytes));assert(file:close())
end
local function persist(key,files)
  local prefix='florilegium-pattern-'..key
  local hashes={}
  for suffix,bytes in pairs(files)do
    local path=prefix..'.'..suffix;write_new(path,bytes);hashes[suffix]=H.sha256(bytes)
  end
  return prefix,hashes
end
local function instance_files(asset)
  local files={recipe=asset.recipe_bytes,record=P.serialize(asset.result.record),view=P.serialize(asset.result.view),scene=asset.result.bytes.scene}
  if asset.result.instance.extensions.legacy then
    local manifest,blocks=require('pattern_botanical_legacy').encode_bundle(asset.result.instance)
    files.instance=manifest
    for hash,bytes in pairs(blocks)do files['block-'..hash..'.json']=bytes end
  else files.instance=asset.result.bytes.instance end
  return files
end
function M.input(name,path)
  need(shipped==0,'declare dependency files before the first shipped page')
  need(type(name)=='string' and #name>0 and not bindings[name],'duplicate or empty dependency name')
  bindings[name]=read(resolve(path))
end
function M.declare(name,path)
  need(shipped==0,'declare recipes before the first shipped page')
  local bytes=read(resolve(path));local q=require('pattern_recipe').decode(bytes);local inputs={}
  for _,group in pairs(q.dependencies)do for key in pairs(group)do inputs[key]=assert(bindings[key],'florilegium patterns: bind dependency '..key..' before declaring this recipe')end end
  local asset=init():declare(name,bytes,inputs);local prefix,hashes=persist(asset.key,instance_files(asset))
  declarations[#declarations+1]={name=name,family=asset.definition.id,prefix=prefix,hashes=hashes,
    instance_sha256=asset.instance_sha256,generation_record=asset.result.record.id}
end
function M.begin_document()started=true end
function M.use(name,width)
  need(started,'inline patterns require the document body')
  need(type(width)=='number' and width>=0,'inline width must be nonnegative')
  local plan,asset,physical=init():inline(name,width*CM)
  local pdf=V.pdf(plan);local key=H.value('tex/inline',{source=asset.environment.source.digest,pdf=H.sha256(pdf)})
  local prefix,hashes=persist(key,{pdf=pdf})
  local size=width>0 and ('[width='..B.pdf_number(width*CM)..'cm]') or ''
  local actual_width,actual_height=physical.width,physical.height
  inline[#inline+1]={name=name,prefix=prefix,hashes=hashes,width_sp=width,instance_sha256=asset.instance_sha256,
    print_requirements=physical.print_requirements}
  F.mark('pattern_inline',{inline_ref=#inline,name=name,prefix=prefix,width=actual_width,height=actual_height})
  tex.sprint('\\includegraphics'..size..'{'..prefix..'.pdf}')
end
function M.queue(name,region,spread,protect,padding)
  need(started,'page patterns require the document body');init():asset(name)
  need(protect=='true' or protect=='false','protect-text must be true or false')
  F.mark('pattern_view',{name=name,options={region=region,spread=spread,protect_text=protect=='true',padding=padding*CM}})
end
function M.capture(box,label)
  if not core then return end
  local dimensions={};for name in ('paperwidth paperheight oddsidemargin evensidemargin hoffset voffset topmargin headheight headsep textwidth textheight footskip'):gmatch('%S+')do dimensions[name]=F.dimen(name)end
  local g=F.geometry(nil,'left');local headsep=dimensions.headsep*CM;local headheight=dimensions.headheight*CM
  local page={size={g.pw,g.ph},content={g.actual_left,g.ybot,g.actual_right,g.ytop},logical_number=F.page(),label=label,
    twoside=not not F.twoside,dimensions_sp=dimensions,header_top=g.ytop+headsep+headheight,markers=P.array(),inline_positions=P.array(),
    footer_bottom=g.footy-.5,running_regions={{g.actual_left,g.ytop+headsep,g.actual_right,g.ytop+headsep+headheight},
      {g.actual_left,g.footy-.5,g.actual_right,g.footy+.5}},reservations=P.array(),anchors=P.array()}
  local requests=P.array()
  for _,mark in ipairs(F.page_marks(box))do
    if mark.kind=='reserve_page'then page.reservations[#page.reservations+1]=P.plain(mark.arg)
    elseif mark.kind=='reserve_box'then
      local a=mark.arg;page.reservations[#page.reservations+1]={mark.x-a.pad,mark.y-a.d-a.pad,mark.x+a.w+a.pad,mark.y+a.h+a.pad}
    elseif mark.kind=='pattern_view'then requests[#requests+1]=P.plain(mark.arg)
    else
      page.anchors[#page.anchors+1]={id='mark/'..(#page.anchors+1),role=mark.kind,point={mark.x,mark.y},space='page'}
      page.markers[#page.markers+1]={kind=mark.kind,arg=mark.arg,x=mark.x,y=mark.y}
      if mark.kind=='pattern_inline'then
        local position=P.plain(mark.arg);position.x,position.y=mark.x,mark.y
        page.inline_positions[#page.inline_positions+1]=position
      end
    end
  end
  pending={page=page,requests=requests}
end
function M.background(index)
  if not core then return end
  need(pending,'shipout capture is missing');local item=pending;pending=nil;shipped=index
  local page=item.page;page.index=index;local results=P.array()
  for _,request in ipairs(item.requests)do
    local valid,result=pcall(core.place,core,request.name,page,request.options)
    need(valid,type(result)=='table' and result.message or tostring(result))
    local prefix,hashes=persist(result.key,{pdf=result.pdf,view=result.bytes.view,scene=result.bytes.scene,record=result.bytes.record})
    results[#results+1]={name=request.name,prefix=prefix,hashes=hashes,instance_sha256=result.asset.instance_sha256,
      record=result.record.id,view_ref=result.view.id,crop=P.plain(result.crop),transform=P.plain(result.view.transform),
      spread_document=result.spread_document and P.plain(result.spread_document) or nil}
    tex.sprint(string.format('\\put(%scm,%scm){\\makebox(0,0)[lb]{\\includegraphics{%s.pdf}}}',
      B.pdf_number(result.crop[1]-page.dimensions_sp.hoffset*CM),
      B.pdf_number(result.crop[2]-page.size[2]+page.dimensions_sp.voffset*CM),prefix))
  end
  pages[#pages+1]={geometry=P.plain(page),outputs=results}
end
function M.finish()
  if not core then return end
  core:finish()
  local current=source_bytes()
  for name,bytes in pairs(source)do need(current[name]==bytes,'source changed during this document build: '..name);current[name]=nil end
  need(next(current)==nil,'new source file appeared during this document build')
  local receipt={schema_version=1,adapter=require('pattern_tex').VERSION,runtime=core and 'LuaLaTeX',
    source_files=core.source_hashes,declarations=declarations,pages=pages,inline=inline,
    unique_generations=core.generations,physical_views=core.views,actual_shipped_pages=shipped,
    construction_policy='Recipe execution before shipout; cached validated instances and original planner-selected scenes at shipout'}
  local file=assert(io.open(tex.jobname..'-patterns.json','wb'));assert(file:write(P.serialize(receipt)));assert(file:close())
end
return M
source.pattern_maze.lua:
local P,R,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_registry"),require("pattern_hash")
local F,C,G=require("pattern_stroke_field"),require("pattern_maze_chart"),require("pattern_maze_graph")
local Penrose=require("pattern_penrose")
local M={VERSION="image-guided-perfect-maze-v1"}

local function configuration(s)
  local a,b=s.parameters,s.document.bounds
  local w,h=b[3]-b[1],b[4]-b[2]
  assert(w>=2 and h>=2 and w<=25 and h<=25,"maze-document-bounds")
  assert(next(P.plain(s.constraints))==nil,"maze-unsupported-constraints")
  for k in pairs(s.inputs) do assert(k=="entry" or k=="exit" or k=="guide" or k=="holes","maze-input:"..k) end
  local function point(p)
    local v=F.point(p)
    assert(v[1]>=b[1] and v[1]<=b[3] and v[2]>=b[2] and v[2]<=b[4],"maze-point-outside-document")
    return v
  end
  local entry=point(s.inputs.entry or {b[1],b[2]+h*.26})
  local exit=point(s.inputs.exit or {b[3],b[2]+h*.74})
  assert(F.distance2(entry,exit,exit)>.01,"maze-endpoint-targets-not-distinct")
  local guide=P.array()
  if s.inputs.guide then
    assert(type(s.inputs.guide)=="table" and #s.inputs.guide>=1 and #s.inputs.guide<=12,"maze-guide-count")
    for i,p in ipairs(s.inputs.guide) do guide[i]=point(p) end
  end
  local holes=P.array()
  if s.inputs.holes then
    assert(a.profile=="holed" and type(s.inputs.holes)=="table" and #s.inputs.holes<=10,"maze-holes-profile")
    for i,v in ipairs(s.inputs.holes) do
      assert(#v==3 and F.finite(v[1]) and F.finite(v[2]) and F.finite(v[3])
        and v[1]>0 and v[1]<1 and v[2]>0 and v[2]<1 and v[3]>0 and v[3]<.8,"maze-hole-unit-chart")
      holes[i]=P.plain(v)
    end
  end
  local q={bounds=P.plain(b),profile=a.profile,image=a.image or "ramp",cols=a.columns or 22,rows=a.rows or 15,
    min_wall=a.min_wall or .013,min_passage=a.min_passage or .035,max_spacing=a.max_spacing or .48,
    guided=a.guided~=false,bias=a.bias or .62,relax=a.relax or 6,perspective=a.perspective or 0,
    edge_length=a.edge_length or .44,notch=a.notch or false,entry=entry,exit=exit,guide=guide,holes=holes}
  assert(q.max_spacing>q.min_wall+q.min_passage,"maze-tone-range")
  assert(q.cols*q.rows<=650,"maze-cell-budget")
  assert(q.profile~="aperiodic" or q.perspective==0,"maze-aperiodic-perspective-unsupported")
  return q
end

local function penrose(reg,d,s,c,q)
  local b=q.bounds
  local spec={id="maze/aperiodic-source",definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},seed=s.seed,
    parameters={edge_length=q.edge_length,phase="amber"},inputs={},style={},constraints={},budget=P.plain(s.budget),
    document={unit="cm",bounds=b,protected_regions=P.array()}}
  local result,err=reg:generate(d.id,spec,c)
  assert(result,err and P.serialize(err))
  local source=result.instance
  local t=source.structures.tiling
  local edges,points,cells={},{},{}
  for _,e in ipairs(t.edges) do edges[e.id]=e end
  for _,v in ipairs(t.vertices) do
    points[v.id]={point=P.plain(v.point),uv={(v.point[1]-b[1])/(b[3]-b[1]),(v.point[2]-b[2])/(b[4]-b[2])}}
  end
  for _,v in ipairs(t.cells) do
    local ids,inside,x,y={},true,0,0
    for j,e in ipairs(v.boundary) do
      local edge=edges[e.edge]
      local id=e.reversed and edge.to or edge.from
      local p=points[id].uv
      if p[1]<.02 or p[1]>.98 or p[2]<.02 or p[2]>.98 then inside=false end
      ids[j]=id
      x,y=x+p[1]/4,y+p[2]/4
    end
    if inside then
      cells[#cells+1]={id=v.id,vertices=ids,center={b[1]+x*(b[3]-b[1]),b[2]+y*(b[4]-b[2])},
        light=C.light(q.image,x,y),source_ref=v.id}
    end
  end
  return points,cells,{profile="aperiodic",scaffold_ref=source.id,phase=source.extensions.penrose.request.phase,
    source_cells=#t.cells,selection="complete rhombi with inset rectangular corner test"}
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="maze/image-guided",version="1",family="image-guided-dual-tree-maze",
    units="cm",capabilities={"graph"},parameters={
      profile={type="string",enum={"directional","spiral","vortex","random","holed","aperiodic"},required=true},
      image={type="string",enum={"ramp","radial","ribbon","constant"}},columns={type="integer",minimum=4,maximum=45},
      rows={type="integer",minimum=3,maximum=32},min_wall={type="number",minimum=.005,maximum=.08},
      min_passage={type="number",minimum=.018,maximum=.14},max_spacing={type="number",minimum=.15,maximum=.95},
      guided={type="boolean"},bias={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=.9},relax={type="integer",minimum=0,maximum=20},
      perspective={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=.65},edge_length={type="number",minimum=.27,maximum=.9},
      notch={type="boolean"}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Finite embedded cell graph and positively separated wall geometry",
      "Image-derived spacing and widths, controlled routing bias and a simple pinned-route profile",
      "Perfect full maze, with display-only crops and separate aperiodic/holed extensions"}})
end

local function graph(points,cells,walls)
  local vertices,edges=P.array(),P.array()
  local cell_index={}
  for i,c in ipairs(cells) do
    vertices[i]={id=c.id,point=c.center}
    cell_index[c.id]=true
  end
  for _,w in ipairs(walls) do
    if w.open then
      local a,b=table.unpack(w.cells)
      if not b then
        b="maze/terminal/"..w.terminal
        vertices[#vertices+1]={id=b,point=w.mid}
      end
      edges[#edges+1]={id=w.id,from=a,to=b}
    end
  end
  return {vertices=vertices,edges=edges}
end

local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.maze
  local rebuilt=G.wall_graph(e.points,e.cells,e.request)
  assert(#rebuilt==#e.walls,"maze-wall-count")
  local open,terminal=0,{}
  local by_id={}
  for i,w in ipairs(e.walls) do
    local a=rebuilt[i]
    for k,v in pairs(a) do assert(P.serialize(v)==P.serialize(w[k]),"maze-wall-reconstruction:"..k) end
    by_id[w.id]=w
    if w.open then
      if #w.cells==2 then open=open+1
      else
        assert((w.terminal=="entry" or w.terminal=="exit") and not terminal[w.terminal],"maze-terminal-incidence")
        terminal[w.terminal]=w.id
      end
    end
  end
  local s=e.solution
  assert(open==#e.cells-1 and s.passages==open and s.entry==terminal.entry and s.exit==terminal.exit,"maze-passage-count")
  local g=graph(e.points,e.cells,e.walls)
  assert(P.serialize(g)==P.serialize(x.structures.graph),"maze-passage-graph-reconstruction")
  local adjacency={}
  for _,v in ipairs(g.vertices) do adjacency[v.id]={} end
  for _,a in ipairs(g.edges) do
    local u,v=adjacency[a.from],adjacency[a.to]
    u[#u+1]=a.to;v[#v+1]=a.from
  end
  local queue,visited={"maze/terminal/entry"},{["maze/terminal/entry"]=true}
  local i=1
  while i<=#queue do
    for _,v in ipairs(adjacency[queue[i]]) do
      if not visited[v] then visited[v]=true;queue[#queue+1]=v end
    end
    i=i+1
  end
  assert(#queue==#g.vertices,"maze-disconnected-passage-graph")
  assert(#s.crossings==#s.route-1 and s.route[1]==by_id[s.entry].cells[1]
    and s.route[#s.route]==by_id[s.exit].cells[1],"maze-solution-endpoints")
  local marked,route_cells={},{ }
  for i,v in ipairs(s.route) do assert(not route_cells[v],"maze-route-cycle");route_cells[v]=true end
  for i,id in ipairs(s.crossings) do
    local w=assert(by_id[id],"maze-missing-solution-wall")
    assert(w.open and #w.cells==2 and ((w.cells[1]==s.route[i] and w.cells[2]==s.route[i+1])
      or (w.cells[2]==s.route[i] and w.cells[1]==s.route[i+1])),"maze-solution-crosses-wall")
    marked[id]=true
  end
  for _,id in ipairs(s.guide) do assert(marked[id],"maze-solution-skips-guide") end
  return {ok=true,checks={"Convex cell incidences and physical wall limits reconstructed",
    "Connected passage graph with tree edge count","Unique route uses only real openings"},
    construction={cells=#e.cells,passages=open,route_cells=#s.route}}
end

local function lower(x,v,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="display","maze-style:"..k) end
  local display=style.display or "walls"
  assert(display=="walls" or display=="solution","maze-display")
  local e=x.extensions.maze
  local ops,by_wall=P.array(),{}
  local function path(ref,points,width,color)
    local p={}
    for i,v in ipairs(points) do p[i]={i==1 and "M" or "L",v[1],v[2]} end
    ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=ref,commands=p,transform=P.plain(v.transform),
      paint={stroke=color,stroke_width=width,cap="round",join="round"}}
  end
  for _,w in ipairs(e.walls) do
    by_wall[w.id]=w
    if not w.open then path(x.id,{e.points[w.from].point,e.points[w.to].point},w.width,{.10,.16,.21}) end
  end
  if display=="solution" then
    local cells={}
    for _,c in ipairs(e.cells) do cells[c.id]=c.center end
    local s=e.solution
    local points={by_wall[s.entry].mid}
    for i,id in ipairs(s.route) do
      points[#points+1]=cells[id]
      if s.crossings[i] then points[#points+1]=by_wall[s.crossings[i]].mid end
    end
    points[#points+1]=by_wall[s.exit].mid
    path(x.id,points,e.request.min_passage*.45,{.75,.23,.12})
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,operations=ops,
    resources=P.array(),clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)}}
end

function M.register(reg)
  local d=M.definition()
  local source=R.new()
  local pd=Penrose.register(source)
  reg:register(d,{validate_inputs=function(s) configuration(s);return true end,generate=function(s,c)
    local q=configuration(s)
    local points,cells,chart
    if q.profile=="aperiodic" then points,cells,chart=penrose(source,pd,s,c,q)
    else points,cells,chart=C.build(q,c:stream("maze-embedding",q.profile)) end
    local walls=G.wall_graph(points,cells,q)
    c:consume("objects",#walls+#cells)
    c:consume("operations",#walls*4+#cells*4)
    local solution=G.route(points,cells,walls,q,c:stream("maze-wall-order","kruskal"))
    return {id="maze/"..H.value("maze/design",{q=q,seed=s.seed,method=M.VERSION}),
      definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={graph=graph(points,cells,walls)},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={maze={request=q,points=points,cells=P.array(cells),walls=walls,chart=chart,solution=solution,
        guarantee="unique full-maze route; crop is display only"}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end

return M
source.pattern_maze_chart.lua:
local M={VERSION="image-guided-maze-charts-v1"}
local min,max,abs,sqrt,pi=math.min,math.max,math.abs,math.sqrt,math.pi

function M.light(image,u,v)
  if image=="ramp" then return max(0,min(1,u)) end
  if image=="radial" then return max(0,min(1,2*sqrt((u-.5)^2+(v-.5)^2))) end
  if image=="ribbon" then
    return abs(v-(.5+.19*math.sin(2*pi*u)))<.18 and .18 or .78
  end
  return .55
end

function M.tone(g,wmin,pmin,smax)
  local level=pmin/smax+(1-(pmin+wmin)/smax)*g
  if level<=pmin/(pmin+wmin) then
    return pmin/level,pmin*(1-level)/level,level
  end
  return wmin/(1-level),wmin,level
end

local function chart(bounds,q)
  local l,b,r,t=table.unpack(bounds)
  local function project(u,v)
    local k=q.perspective
    local z=1+k*v
    local x=(u-.5)/z+.5
    local y=(1+k)*v/z
    return {l+(r-l)*x,b+(t-b)*y}
  end
  return project
end

local function partition(n,q,axis)
  local weights={}
  local sum=0
  for i=1,n do
    local x=(i-.5)/n
    local g=axis=="x" and M.light(q.image,x,.5) or M.light(q.image,.5,x)
    local step=M.tone(g,q.min_wall,q.min_passage,q.max_spacing)
    weights[i]=step
    sum=sum+step
  end
  local p={0}
  for i,v in ipairs(weights) do p[i+1]=p[i]+v/sum end
  p[#p]=1
  return p
end

local function edge_key(i,j)
  return "grid/"..i.."/"..j
end

local function grid(q,rng)
  local points,cells={},{}
  local map=chart(q.bounds,q)
  local xs,ys=partition(q.cols,q,"x"),partition(q.rows,q,"y")
  if q.profile=="random" or q.profile=="holed" then
    for i=0,q.cols do xs[i+1]=i/q.cols end
    for j=0,q.rows do ys[j+1]=j/q.rows end
  end
  local raw={}
  for j,v in ipairs(ys) do
    for i,u in ipairs(xs) do raw[edge_key(i,j)]={u,v} end
  end
  local relaxations=0
  if q.profile=="random" then
    for j=2,q.rows do
      for i=2,q.cols do
        local a=raw[edge_key(i,j)]
        a[1]=a[1]+(rng.u()-.5)*.31/q.cols
        a[2]=a[2]+(rng.u()-.5)*.31/q.rows
      end
    end
    -- Bounded spring relaxation with a fixed boundary. Small initial
    -- displacement and convex mixing keep the two line families ordered.
    for _=1,q.relax do
      local next_points={}
      for j=1,q.rows+1 do
        for i=1,q.cols+1 do
          local id=edge_key(i,j)
          local p=raw[id]
          if i>1 and i<=q.cols and j>1 and j<=q.rows then
            local x,y=0,0
            for _,k in ipairs{edge_key(i-1,j),edge_key(i+1,j),edge_key(i,j-1),edge_key(i,j+1)} do
              x,y=x+raw[k][1],y+raw[k][2]
            end
            p={.91*p[1]+.0225*x,.91*p[2]+.0225*y}
          end
          next_points[id]=p
        end
      end
      raw=next_points
      relaxations=relaxations+1
    end
  end
  for id,p in pairs(raw) do points[id]={point=map(p[1],p[2]),uv=p} end
  local removed={}
  for j=1,q.rows do
    for i=1,q.cols do
      local u,v=(xs[i]+xs[i+1])/2,(ys[j]+ys[j+1])/2
      local absent=false
      if q.profile=="holed" then
        for _,h in ipairs(q.holes) do
          if (u-h[1])^2+(v-h[2])^2<h[3]^2 then absent=true;break end
        end
        if q.notch and i<=2 and j>=q.rows-1 then absent=true end
      end
      local id="grid/cell/"..i.."/"..j
      if absent then removed[#removed+1]=id
      else
        cells[#cells+1]={id=id,vertices={edge_key(i,j),edge_key(i+1,j),edge_key(i+1,j+1),edge_key(i,j+1)},
          center=map(u,v),slot={i,j},light=M.light(q.image,u,v)}
      end
    end
  end
  return points,cells,{removed=removed,relaxations=relaxations,profile=q.profile,axes={xs,ys}}
end

local function polar(q)
  local points,cells={},{}
  local map=chart(q.bounds,q)
  local n,k=q.cols,q.rows
  local rings={0}
  local sum=0
  for i=1,k do
    local g=M.light(q.image,.5+.45*(i-.5)/k,.5)
    local step=M.tone(g,q.min_wall,q.min_passage,q.max_spacing)
    sum=sum+step
    rings[i+1]=sum
  end
  for i=2,#rings do rings[i]=.48*rings[i]/sum end
  local function vertex(r,i) return "ring/"..r.."/"..(i%n) end
  local function uv(r,i)
    local theta=2*pi*i/n
    return .5+r*math.cos(theta),.5+r*math.sin(theta)
  end
  points.center={point=map(.5,.5),uv={.5,.5}}
  for j=1,k do
    for i=0,n-1 do
      local u,v=uv(rings[j+1],i)
      points[vertex(j,i)]={point=map(u,v),uv={u,v}}
    end
  end
  for j=1,k do
    for i=0,n-1 do
      local u,v=uv((rings[j]+rings[j+1])/2,i+.5)
      local ids
      if j==1 then ids={"center",vertex(j,i),vertex(j,i+1)}
      else ids={vertex(j-1,i),vertex(j,i),vertex(j,i+1),vertex(j-1,i+1)} end
      cells[#cells+1]={id="polar/cell/"..j.."/"..i,vertices=ids,center=map(u,v),slot={j,i},light=M.light(q.image,u,v)}
    end
  end
  return points,cells,{profile=q.profile,radii=rings,angular_sectors=n}
end

function M.build(q,rng)
  if q.profile=="spiral" or q.profile=="vortex" then return polar(q) end
  return grid(q,rng)
end

return M
source.pattern_maze_graph.lua:
local P,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash")
local Field=require("pattern_stroke_field")
local Charts=require("pattern_maze_chart")
local M={VERSION="maze-weighted-dual-tree-v1"}

local function midpoint(a,b)
  return {(a[1]+b[1])/2,(a[2]+b[2])/2}
end

local function area(a,b,c)
  return (b[1]-a[1])*(c[2]-a[2])-(b[2]-a[2])*(c[1]-a[1])
end

local function key(a,b)
  if P.byte_less(b,a) then a,b=b,a end
  return a.."|"..b
end

local function sorted(t)
  local out={}
  for k in pairs(t) do out[#out+1]=k end
  table.sort(out,P.byte_less)
  return out
end

function M.wall_graph(points,cells,q)
  local walls,index={},{}
  local clearance_probes={}
  for _,cell in ipairs(cells) do
    assert(not index[cell.id],"maze-duplicate-cell")
    index[cell.id]=cell
    local ids=cell.vertices
    local probes,radius={},0
    for i,a in ipairs(ids) do
      local b=ids[i%#ids+1]
      local u,v=points[a].point,points[b].point
      probes[i]={key=key(a,b),point=midpoint(u,v)}
      radius=math.max(radius,Field.distance2(cell.center,probes[i].point,probes[i].point))
      assert(area(u,v,cell.center)>1e-10,"maze-center-outside-convex-cell")
      for j,c in ipairs(ids) do
        if j~=i and j~=i%#ids+1 then assert(area(u,v,points[c].point)>1e-10,"maze-cell-not-strictly-convex") end
      end
      local id=key(a,b)
      local edge=walls[id]
      if edge then
        assert(#edge.cells==1 and edge.from==b and edge.to==a,"maze-nonmanifold-wall")
        edge.cells[2]=cell.id
      else
        edge={id="maze/wall/"..H.value("maze/wall-key",id),from=a,to=b,cells={cell.id}}
        walls[id]=edge
      end
    end
    clearance_probes[#clearance_probes+1]={center=cell.center,probes=probes,radius=math.sqrt(radius)}
  end
  local out=P.array()
  for _,k in ipairs(sorted(walls)) do
    local e=walls[k]
    local a,b=points[e.from],points[e.to]
    local u=midpoint(a.uv,b.uv)
    local g=Charts.light(q.image,u[1],u[2])
    e.light=g
    local desired,width=Charts.tone(g,q.min_wall,q.min_passage,q.max_spacing)
    e.target_spacing,e.target_width=desired,width
    local capacity=math.huge
    for _,cell in ipairs(clearance_probes) do
      local center_distance=Field.distance2(cell.center,a.point,b.point)
      local horizon=cell.radius+(width+q.min_passage)/2
      if center_distance<horizon*horizon then
        local distance=center_distance
        for _,probe in ipairs(cell.probes) do
          if probe.key~=k then
            distance=math.min(distance,Field.segment_gap2(cell.center,probe.point,a.point,b.point))
          end
        end
        capacity=math.min(capacity,2*math.sqrt(distance)-q.min_passage)
      end
    end
    assert(capacity>=q.min_wall-1e-12,"maze-minimum-physical-passage-unattainable")
    e.width=math.min(width,capacity)
    e.width_limited=e.width<width-1e-12
    e.mid=midpoint(a.point,b.point)
    local length=math.sqrt(Field.distance2(a.point,b.point,b.point))
    assert(length>=q.min_passage+q.min_wall,"maze-wall-too-short-for-passage")
    out[#out+1]=e
  end
  return out,index
end

local function bias(e,points,q)
  if q.profile=="directional" then
    local a,b=points[e.from].uv,points[e.to].uv
    return math.abs(b[1]-a[1])>math.abs(b[2]-a[2])
  elseif q.profile=="spiral" or q.profile=="vortex" then
    local a,b=points[e.from].uv,points[e.to].uv
    local r,s=(a[1]-.5)^2+(a[2]-.5)^2,(b[1]-.5)^2+(b[2]-.5)^2
    local radial=math.abs(r-s)>1e-10
    if q.profile=="vortex" then
      local m=midpoint(a,b)
      local theta=math.atan(m[2]-.5,m[1]-.5)
      return radial or math.abs(math.sin(2*theta))<.32
    end
    return radial
  end
end

local function bfs(adj,source,target,excluded)
  local queue={source}
  local parent={[source]=false}
  local n=1
  while n<=#queue and parent[target]==nil do
    local a=queue[n]
    for _,step in ipairs(adj[a]) do
      if parent[step.to]==nil and not (excluded and excluded[step.to]) then
        parent[step.to]={from=a,wall=step.wall}
        queue[#queue+1]=step.to
      end
    end
    n=n+1
  end
  if parent[target]==nil then return nil end
  local vertices,edges={target},{}
  local cursor=target
  while parent[cursor] do
    local e=parent[cursor]
    edges[#edges+1]=e.wall
    vertices[#vertices+1]=e.from
    cursor=e.from
  end
  local v,w=P.array(),P.array()
  for i=#vertices,1,-1 do v[#v+1]=vertices[i] end
  for i=#edges,1,-1 do w[#w+1]=edges[i] end
  return v,w
end

local function terminal(walls,target,forbid)
  local nearest,best=nil,math.huge
  for _,e in ipairs(walls) do
    if #e.cells==1 and (not forbid or forbid.id~=e.id and forbid.cells[1]~=e.cells[1]) then
      local d=Field.distance2(target,e.mid,e.mid)
      if d<best-1e-12 then nearest,best=e,d end
    end
  end
  assert(nearest,"maze-distinct-boundary-endpoints-required")
  return nearest
end

local function closest_cell(cells,p)
  local best,chosen=math.huge
  for _,cell in ipairs(cells) do
    local d=Field.distance2(p,cell.center,cell.center)
    if d<best-1e-12 then best,chosen=d,cell.id end
  end
  return chosen
end

local function link(adj,e)
  local a,b=table.unpack(e.cells)
  adj[a][#adj[a]+1]={to=b,wall=e}
  adj[b][#adj[b]+1]={to=a,wall=e}
end

function M.route(points,cells,walls,q,rng)
  assert(#cells>=2,"maze-insufficient-cells")
  local adj,tree,parents,depth={},{},{},{}
  for _,c in ipairs(cells) do adj[c.id]={};tree[c.id]={};parents[c.id]=c.id;depth[c.id]=1 end
  local function root(a)
    while parents[a]~=a do
      parents[a]=parents[parents[a]]
      a=parents[a]
    end
    return a
  end
  local function join(e)
    local a,b=root(e.cells[1]),root(e.cells[2])
    if a==b then return false end
    if depth[a]<depth[b] then a,b=b,a end
    parents[b]=a
    if depth[a]==depth[b] then depth[a]=depth[a]+1 end
    e.open=true
    link(tree,e)
    return true
  end
  local candidates={}
  for _,e in ipairs(walls) do
    e.open=false
    if #e.cells==2 then
      local sample=rng.u()
      local favored=bias(e,points,q)
      e.bias=favored==nil and "isotropic" or (favored and "preferred-removal" or "preferred-retention")
      local strength=q.guided and q.bias or 0
      if favored==nil then e.weight=sample
      elseif favored then e.weight=sample*(1-strength)
      else e.weight=strength+sample*(1-strength) end
      e.random=sample
      candidates[#candidates+1]=e
      link(adj,e)
    end
  end
  local entry=terminal(walls,q.entry)
  local exit=terminal(walls,q.exit,entry)
  local pin_count=0
  local pins=P.array()
  if #q.guide>0 then
    local waypoints={entry.cells[1]}
    for _,p in ipairs(q.guide) do waypoints[#waypoints+1]=closest_cell(cells,p) end
    waypoints[#waypoints+1]=exit.cells[1]
    local reserved={}
    for i=1,#waypoints do
      assert(not reserved[waypoints[i]],"maze-guide-repeats-cell")
      reserved[waypoints[i]]=true
    end
    local visited={}
    for i=1,#waypoints-1 do
      local from,to=waypoints[i],waypoints[i+1]
      reserved[from],reserved[to]=nil,nil
      local blocked={}
      for k in pairs(reserved) do blocked[k]=true end
      for k in pairs(visited) do blocked[k]=true end
      blocked[from]=nil
      local vertices,edges=bfs(adj,from,to,blocked)
      assert(vertices,"maze-guide-infeasible")
      for _,k in ipairs(vertices) do visited[k]=true end
      for _,e in ipairs(edges) do
        assert(join(e),"maze-guide-cycle")
        e.guide=true
        pins[#pins+1]=e.id
        pin_count=pin_count+1
      end
    end
  end
  table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
    local x,y=math.floor(a.weight*1e12+.5),math.floor(b.weight*1e12+.5)
    if x==y then return P.byte_less(a.id,b.id) end
    return x<y
  end)
  local open=pin_count
  for _,e in ipairs(candidates) do if join(e) then open=open+1 end end
  assert(open==#cells-1,"maze-disconnected-domain")
  entry.open,exit.open=true,true
  entry.terminal,exit.terminal="entry","exit"
  local route,crossings=bfs(tree,entry.cells[1],exit.cells[1])
  assert(route and #route>=2,"maze-endpoints-unreachable")
  local ids=P.array()
  for i,e in ipairs(crossings) do ids[i]=e.id end
  return {entry=entry.id,exit=exit.id,route=route,crossings=ids,guide=pins,passages=open,
    objective="minimum-weight-spanning-tree-with-pinned-guide",weight_tie_resolution=1e-12}
end

return M
source.pattern_micro_field.lua:
local M={VERSION="micrography-signed-boundary-rosy-v1"}
local abs,min,max,sqrt,pi=math.abs,math.min,math.max,math.sqrt,math.pi

local function cross(a,b)
  return a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1]
end
local function sub(a,b) return {a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2]} end
local function dot(a,b) return a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2] end
local function length(a) return sqrt(dot(a,a)) end
local function unit(a)
  local n=length(a)
  return {a[1]/n,a[2]/n}
end
local function rotate(v,a)
  local c,s=math.cos(a),math.sin(a)
  return {c*v[1]-s*v[2],s*v[1]+c*v[2]}
end
local function mix(a,b,t)
  return {(1-t)*a[1]+t*b[1],(1-t)*a[2]+t*b[2]}
end

function M.contained(panel,p,padding)
  for i,a in ipairs(panel) do
    local v=sub(panel[i%4+1],a)
    if cross(v,sub(p,a))<padding*length(v)-1e-12 then return false end
  end
  return true
end

local function alignment(a,b)
  local angle=math.acos(min(1,abs(dot(a,b))))
  local x=1-4*angle/pi
  local e=math.exp(2*x)
  return (e-1)/(e+1)
end

local function distance_factor(cm,size,sigma)
  local d=max(cm/size-5,0)
  return math.exp(-(d/sigma)^2)
end

local function attraction(panel,sample,size)
  local inward={-sample.tangent[2],sample.tangent[1]}
  local hits={}
  for _,angle in ipairs{-.28,-.14,0,.14,.28} do
    local ray=rotate(inward,angle)
    local best,opposite=math.huge
    for i,a in ipairs(panel) do
      local b=panel[i%4+1]
      local side=sub(b,a)
      local denom=cross(ray,side)
      if abs(denom)>1e-12 then
        local rel=sub(a,sample.point)
        local t,u=cross(rel,side)/denom,cross(rel,ray)/denom
        if t>1e-10 and t<best and u>=-1e-12 and u<=1+1e-12 then
          best,opposite=t,unit(side)
        end
      end
    end
    if opposite then
      hits[#hits+1]={distance=best,alignment=alignment(sample.tangent,opposite)}
    end
  end
  assert(#hits>=3,"micrography-opposite-ray-horizon")
  table.sort(hits,function(a,b) return a.distance<b.distance end)
  local d,a=0,0
  for i=2,#hits-1 do d,a=d+hits[i].distance,a+hits[i].alignment end
  local n=#hits-2
  return max(0,a/n)*distance_factor(d/n,size,20),hits
end

local function boundary(panel,size,n,omega,fixed)
  local samples,edges={},{}
  local sum_weights,sum_attract=0,0
  local function node(i,j) return (j-1)*(n+1)+i end
  for side,a in ipairs(panel) do
    local b=panel[side%4+1]
    for k=1,3 do
      local t=k/4
      local i,j=1+t*n,1
      if side==2 then i,j=n+1,1+t*n
      elseif side==3 then i,j=n+1-t*n,n+1
      elseif side==4 then i,j=1,n+1-t*n end
      local s={point=mix(a,b,t),tangent=unit(sub(b,a)),side=side,node=node(i,j)}
      s.attraction,s.opposite=attraction(panel,s,size)
      sum_attract=sum_attract+s.attraction^2
      samples[#samples+1]=s
    end
  end
  -- The chart is convex, so every boundary sample pair is mutually visible.
  for i,a in ipairs(samples) do
    for j=i+1,#samples do
      local b=samples[j]
      local w=alignment(a.tangent,b.tangent)*distance_factor(length(sub(a.point,b.point)),size,10)
      edges[#edges+1]={i,j,w}
      sum_weights=sum_weights+2*w*w
    end
  end
  local scale=sum_attract>0 and sqrt(sum_weights/sum_attract) or 0
  local function energy(mask)
    local e=0
    for _,v in ipairs(edges) do
      if ((mask>>(v[1]-1))&1)~=((mask>>(v[2]-1))&1) then e=e+2*v[3] end
    end
    for i,s in ipairs(samples) do
      if ((mask>>(i-1))&1)==0 then e=e+omega*scale*s.attraction end
    end
    return e
  end
  local best,best_mask,count=math.huge,nil,0
  for mask=0,(1<<#samples)-1 do
    local admissible=true
    for _,lock in ipairs(fixed) do
      if ((mask>>(lock[1]-1))&1)~=lock[2] then admissible=false;break end
    end
    if admissible then
      count=count+1
      local e=energy(mask)
      if e<best-1e-12 then best,best_mask=e,mask end
    end
  end
  local active=0
  for i,s in ipairs(samples) do
    s.label=(best_mask>>(i-1))&1
    active=active+s.label
  end
  assert(active>0,"micrography-no-active-boundary")
  return {samples=samples,edges=edges,attraction_scale=scale,omega=omega,energy=best,mask=best_mask,
    examined=count,all_aligned=energy((1<<#samples)-1),none_aligned=energy(0),fixed=fixed}
end

local function mesh(panel,n)
  local points,triangles,neighbors={},{},{}
  local function node(i,j) return (j-1)*(n+1)+i end
  for j=1,n+1 do
    for i=1,n+1 do
      local u,v=(i-1)/n,(j-1)/n
      local a,b=mix(panel[1],panel[2],u),mix(panel[4],panel[3],u)
      local id=node(i,j)
      points[id]=mix(a,b,v)
      neighbors[id]={}
    end
  end
  local function add(a,b,c)
    assert(cross(sub(points[b],points[a]),sub(points[c],points[a]))>1e-10,"micrography-degenerate-triangle")
    triangles[#triangles+1]={a,b,c}
    for _,e in ipairs{{a,b},{b,c},{c,a}} do neighbors[e[1]][e[2]]=true;neighbors[e[2]][e[1]]=true end
  end
  for j=1,n do
    for i=1,n do
      local a,b,c,d=node(i,j),node(i+1,j),node(i+1,j+1),node(i,j+1)
      if (i+j)%2==0 then add(a,b,c);add(a,c,d) else add(a,b,d);add(b,c,d) end
    end
  end
  for i,adj in ipairs(neighbors) do
    local list={}
    for id in pairs(adj) do list[#list+1]=id end
    table.sort(list)
    neighbors[i]=list
  end
  return points,triangles,neighbors
end

function M.solve(panel,size,omega,fixed,n,budget,step)
  local labels=boundary(panel,size,n,omega,fixed)
  if step then step(labels.examined*(#labels.edges+#labels.samples)) end
  local points,triangles,neighbors=mesh(panel,n)
  local constraints={}
  for _,s in ipairs(labels.samples) do
    if s.label==1 then
      local x,y=table.unpack(s.tangent)
      constraints[s.node]={x*x-y*y,2*x*y}
    end
  end
  local vectors={}
  for i=1,#points do vectors[i]={1,0} end
  local residual,iterations=math.huge,0
  local function update(i)
    local c=constraints[i]
    local x,y=0,0
    if c then x,y=c[1],c[2] end
    for _,j in ipairs(neighbors[i]) do x,y=x+vectors[j][1],y+vectors[j][2] end
    local d=#neighbors[i]+(c and 1 or 0)
    return x/d,y/d
  end
  for k=1,budget do
    iterations=k
    if step then step(#points) end
    for i=1,#points do vectors[i]={update(i)} end
    residual=0
    for i=1,#points do
      local x,y=update(i)
      residual=max(residual,abs(x-vectors[i][1]),abs(y-vectors[i][2]))
    end
    if residual<1e-10 then break end
  end
  assert(residual<1e-8,"micrography-field-budget-exhausted")
  local lower,upper=math.huge,-math.huge
  for _,v in ipairs(vectors) do lower=min(lower,v[1]);upper=max(upper,v[1]) end
  assert(lower>.15,"micrography-field-not-horizontal-monotone")
  return {labels=labels,points=points,triangles=triangles,vectors=vectors,iterations=iterations,residual=residual,
    min_representation_x=lower,max_representation_x=upper}
end

function M.at(field,p)
  local points,vectors=field.points,field.vectors
  for _,t in ipairs(field.triangles) do
    local a,b,c=points[t[1]],points[t[2]],points[t[3]]
    if p[1]>=min(a[1],b[1],c[1])-1e-10 and p[1]<=max(a[1],b[1],c[1])+1e-10
        and p[2]>=min(a[2],b[2],c[2])-1e-10 and p[2]<=max(a[2],b[2],c[2])+1e-10 then
      local ab,ac,ap=sub(b,a),sub(c,a),sub(p,a)
      local d=cross(ab,ac)
      local v,w=cross(ap,ac)/d,cross(ab,ap)/d
      local u=1-v-w
      if min(u,v,w)>=-1e-9 then
        local x,y,z=vectors[t[1]],vectors[t[2]],vectors[t[3]]
        local theta=.5*math.atan(u*x[2]+v*y[2]+w*z[2],u*x[1]+v*y[1]+w*z[1])
        return {math.cos(theta),math.sin(theta)},theta
      end
    end
  end
end

return M
source.pattern_micrography.lua:
local P,H,G=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash"),require("pattern_geometry")
local F,S=require("pattern_micro_field"),require("pattern_stroke_field")
local M={VERSION="digital-micrography-monotone-v1"}
local font_digest="9b9f100958cca036fcc3102719c91ba3804a362ebc215d5ecc16d6f38d9add69"
local font_resource_digest="29c4e364cd81b53416894f8b9f363a0ac0c76abb3c2aadff0dfd7f24c300c9a6"
local abs,min,max,sqrt=math.abs,math.min,math.max,math.sqrt
local function finite(n)return type(n)=='number'and n==n and abs(n)<math.huge end

local function stop(code,receipt)
  error({code="micrography_"..code,message="Micrography: "..code,solver=receipt},0)
end

local function input(s)
  for k in pairs(s.inputs) do
    assert(k=="text" or k=="panel" or k=="font" or k=="fixed","micrography-input:"..k)
  end
  assert(next(P.plain(s.constraints))==nil and #s.document.protected_regions==0,"micrography-use-explicit-panel")
  local q,a=s.document.bounds,s.parameters
  local panel=s.inputs.panel or {{q[1],q[2]},{q[3],q[2]},{q[3],q[4]},{q[1],q[4]}}
  assert(type(panel)=="table" and #panel==4,"micrography-four-sided-convex-panel")
  local clean={}
  for i,p in ipairs(panel) do
    clean[i]=S.point(p)
    assert(p[1]>=q[1] and p[1]<=q[3] and p[2]>=q[2] and p[2]<=q[4],"micrography-panel-outside-document")
  end
  for i,u in ipairs(clean) do
    local v=clean[i%4+1]
    for j,p in ipairs(clean) do
      if j~=i and j~=i%4+1 then
        assert((v[1]-u[1])*(p[2]-u[2])-(v[2]-u[2])*(p[1]-u[1])>1e-7,"micrography-panel-not-convex")
      end
    end
  end
  local text=s.inputs.text
  assert(type(text)=="string" and #text>0 and #text<=2200 and utf8.len(text) and
    not text:match("^ ") and not text:match(" $") and not text:match("  "),"micrography-text-profile")
  local font=s.inputs.font
  assert(type(font)=="table" and font.id=="font/micrography" and font.font_sha256==font_digest,"micrography-pinned-font")
  local fixed,seen=P.array(),{}
  if s.inputs.fixed then
    assert(type(s.inputs.fixed)=="table" and #s.inputs.fixed<=12,"micrography-fixed-boundary-count")
    for i,v in ipairs(s.inputs.fixed) do
      assert(#v==2 and type(v[1])=="number" and v[1]%1==0 and v[1]>=1 and v[1]<=12 and
        (v[2]==0 or v[2]==1) and not seen[v[1]],"micrography-fixed-label")
      fixed[i]=P.plain(v);seen[v[1]]=true
    end
  end
  return {panel=clean,bounds=P.plain(q),text=text,font=P.plain(font),fixed=fixed,size=a.size or .34,
    min_size=a.min_size or .27,spacing=a.spacing or 1.34,omega=a.omega or 1,step=a.step or .065,
    iterations=a.iterations or 3500,max_curvature=a.max_curvature or 1.1}
end

local function shape(text,font)
  local cmap={}
  for _,g in ipairs(font.glyphs) do cmap[g.unicode]=g end
  local codepoints={}
  for _,c in utf8.codes(text) do codepoints[#codepoints+1]=utf8.char(c) end
  local graphemes={}
  for _,v in ipairs(codepoints) do
    if v=="\204\129" then
      assert(#graphemes>0 and cmap[graphemes[#graphemes]..v],"micrography-unsupported-combining-sequence")
      graphemes[#graphemes]=graphemes[#graphemes]..v
    else
      assert(cmap[v],"micrography-unsupported-script-or-glyph")
      graphemes[#graphemes+1]=v
    end
  end
  local groups,word={},{}
  local i=1
  while i<=#graphemes do
    local token=graphemes[i]
    local count=1
    if token=="f" and (graphemes[i+1]=="i" or graphemes[i+1]=="l") then
      token=token..graphemes[i+1]
      count=2
    end
    local g=assert(cmap[token],"micrography-missing-shaped-glyph")
    word[#word+1]={glyph=g,first=i,last=i+count-1}
    if token==" " then groups[#groups+1]=word;word={} end
    i=i+count
  end
  if #word>0 then groups[#groups+1]=word end
  return groups,graphemes
end

local function left_seed(panel,y,padding)
  local x=math.huge
  for i,a in ipairs(panel) do
    local b=panel[i%4+1]
    if (y>=min(a[2],b[2]) and y<=max(a[2],b[2])) and abs(a[2]-b[2])>1e-10 then
      local u=(y-a[2])/(b[2]-a[2])
      x=min(x,a[1]+u*(b[1]-a[1]))
    end
  end
  if x==math.huge then return nil end
  for i=2,6 do
    local p={x+padding*i,y}
    if F.contained(panel,p,padding) then return p end
  end
end

local function lines(q,field)
  local top,bottom=-math.huge,math.huge
  for _,v in ipairs(q.panel) do top=max(top,v[2]);bottom=min(bottom,v[2]) end
  local out={}
  local separation=q.size*q.spacing
  local padding=q.size*.86
  local max_steps=math.ceil((q.bounds[3]-q.bounds[1])*1.6/q.step)
  assert(max_steps<=800,"micrography-tracing-horizon")
  for y=top-padding,bottom+padding,-separation*1.18 do
    local p=left_seed(q.panel,y,padding)
    if p then
      local points,arc={p},{0}
      local curvature=0
      local reason="step_budget"
      local last_angle
      for _=1,max_steps do
        local u=F.at(field,p)
        if not u then reason="field_domain";break end
        local middle={p[1]+q.step*u[1]/2,p[2]+q.step*u[2]/2}
        local v,angle=F.at(field,middle)
        if not v then reason="panel";break end
        local next_p={p[1]+q.step*v[1],p[2]+q.step*v[2]}
        if not F.contained(q.panel,next_p,padding) then reason="panel";break end
        local k=last_angle and abs(angle-last_angle)/q.step or 0
        if k>q.max_curvature then reason="curvature";break end
        local allowed=true
        for _,line in ipairs(out) do
          for i,a in ipairs(line.points) do
            local b=line.points[i+1]
            if b and b[1]>=p[1]-separation and a[1]<=next_p[1]+separation and
              S.segment_gap2(p,next_p,a,b)<separation^2 then allowed=false;break end
          end
          if not allowed then break end
        end
        if not allowed then reason="separation";break end
        curvature=max(curvature,k)
        points[#points+1]=next_p
        arc[#arc+1]=arc[#arc]+q.step
        p,last_angle=next_p,angle
      end
      if arc[#arc]>=q.size*5 then
        out[#out+1]={points=points,arc=arc,length=arc[#arc],max_curvature=curvature,stop=reason}
      end
    end
  end
  return out
end

local function location(line,s)
  local i=min(#line.points-1,math.floor(s/(line.arc[2]-line.arc[1]))+1)
  local t=(s-line.arc[i])/(line.arc[i+1]-line.arc[i])
  local p,q=line.points[i],line.points[i+1]
  return {p[1]+t*(q[1]-p[1]),p[2]+t*(q[2]-p[2])},math.atan(q[2]-p[2],q[1]-p[1])
end

local function corners(g,place,scale)
  local l,b,r,t=table.unpack(g.bounds)
  local c,s=math.cos(place.rotation),math.sin(place.rotation)
  local points={}
  for i,p in ipairs{{l,b},{r,b},{r,t},{l,t}} do
    points[i]={place.offset[1]+scale*(c*p[1]-s*p[2]),place.offset[2]+scale*(s*p[1]+c*p[2])}
  end
  return points
end

local function layout(q,field,groups,clusters)
  local streamlines=lines(q,field)
  local runs,order,positions=P.array(),P.array(),P.array()
  local scale=q.size/q.font.units_per_em
  local spacing=q.size*.019
  local at=1
  for i,line in ipairs(streamlines) do
    local glyphs,span,chunk=P.array(),P.array(),{}
    local cursor=q.size*.18
    while groups[at] do
      local advance=0
      for _,g in ipairs(groups[at]) do advance=advance+g.glyph.advance*scale+spacing end
      if cursor+advance+q.size*.20>line.length then break end
      for _,g in ipairs(groups[at]) do
        local p,rotation=location(line,cursor)
        local placement={glyph_ref=g.glyph.id,offset=p,rotation=rotation}
        for _,corner in ipairs(corners(g.glyph,placement,scale)) do
          assert(F.contained(q.panel,corner,0),"micrography-glyph-outside-panel")
        end
        glyphs[#glyphs+1]=placement
        span[#span+1]={g.first,g.last}
        chunk[#chunk+1]=g.glyph.unicode
        cursor=cursor+g.glyph.advance*scale+spacing
      end
      at=at+1
    end
    if #glyphs>0 then
      local id="micrography/line/"..i
      runs[#runs+1]={id=id,text=table.concat(chunk),direction="ltr"}
      order[#order+1]=id
      positions[#positions+1]={line=i,glyphs=glyphs,spans=span}
    end
    if not groups[at] then break end
  end
  local solver={algorithm=F.VERSION,search="bounded-exact-binary-labels",examined=field.labels.examined,
    labels=field.labels.mask,objective=field.labels.energy,field_iterations=field.iterations,field_residual=field.residual,
    streamlines=#streamlines,words_placed=at-1,words_total=#groups,graphemes=#clusters}
  if at<=#groups then solver.status="insufficient_space";stop("insufficient_space",solver) end
  solver.status="complete"
  return {runs=runs,reading_order=order},positions,P.array(streamlines),solver
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="text/digital-micrography",version="1",family="boundary-optimized-micrography",
    units="cm",capabilities={"text","field"},parameters={
      size={type="number",minimum=.22,maximum=.65},min_size={type="number",minimum=.22,maximum=.65},
      spacing={type="number",minimum=1.25,maximum=2.1},omega={type="number",minimum=.2,maximum=5},
      step={type="number",minimum=.035,maximum=.14},iterations={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=5000},
      max_curvature={type="number",minimum=.002,maximum=2.5}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Convex quadrilateral, exact signed boundary labeling and finite doubled-angle field",
      "Monotone separated streamlines and bounded Latin/Greek grapheme shaping",
      "Pinned GUST font with visible outlines and searchable Unicode layers"}})
end

local function field_samples(field,q)
  local samples=P.array()
  for i,p in ipairs(field.points) do
    local r=field.vectors[i]
    local angle=.5*math.atan(r[2],r[1])
    samples[i]={id="micrography/field/"..i,point=p,vector={math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)},density=1}
  end
  return {representation="samples",domain={bounds=q.bounds},samples=samples}
end

-- Reconstruct the claimed field/layout. Continuous leaves admit only the same
-- binary64 roundoff bound used by the independent native/browser checker;
-- connectivity, labels, spans, indices and unknown leaves remain exact.
local continuous={
  '^field/points/%d+/[12]$','^field/vectors/%d+/[12]$',
  '^field/residual$','^field/min_representation_x$','^field/max_representation_x$',
  '^field/labels/attraction_scale$','^field/labels/energy$',
  '^field/labels/all_aligned$','^field/labels/none_aligned$',
  '^field/labels/edges/%d+/3$','^field/labels/samples/%d+/attraction$',
  '^field/labels/samples/%d+/point/[12]$','^field/labels/samples/%d+/tangent/[12]$',
  '^field/labels/samples/%d+/opposite/%d+/distance$','^field/labels/samples/%d+/opposite/%d+/alignment$',
  '^positions/%d+/glyphs/%d+/offset/[12]$','^positions/%d+/glyphs/%d+/rotation$',
  '^streamlines/%d+/points/%d+/[12]$','^streamlines/%d+/arc/%d+$',
  '^streamlines/%d+/length$','^streamlines/%d+/max_curvature$',
  '^solver/field_residual$','^solver/objective$'}
continuous[#continuous+1]='^structure/field/samples/%d+/point/[12]$'
continuous[#continuous+1]='^structure/field/samples/%d+/vector/[12]$'
local function reconstructed(actual,expected,path)
  assert(type(actual)==type(expected),'micrography-reconstruction-type:'..path)
  if type(expected)=='table'then
    for k,v in pairs(expected)do reconstructed(actual[k],v,path..'/'..tostring(k))end
    for k in pairs(actual)do assert(expected[k]~=nil,'micrography-reconstruction-key:'..path)end
  elseif type(expected)=='number'then
    assert(finite(actual),'micrography-reconstruction-nonfinite:'..path)
    if actual~=expected then
      local permitted=false;for _,pattern in ipairs(continuous)do if path:match(pattern)then permitted=true;break end end
      assert(permitted and abs(actual-expected)<=min(1e-10,32*2^-52*max(1,abs(actual),abs(expected))),
        'micrography-reconstruction-value:'..path)
    end
  else assert(actual==expected,'micrography-reconstruction-value:'..path)end
end
local function validate(x,context)
  local e=x.extensions.micrography
  local t=x.structures.text
  local q=e.request
  assert(H.value('micrography/font-resource',q.font)==font_resource_digest,'micrography-font-resource-integrity')
  -- Admitted requests have a bounded quadrilateral mesh and bounded solver.
  local parameters={};for key,rule in pairs(M.definition().parameters)do
    local v=q[key];assert(finite(v)and v>=rule.minimum and v<=rule.maximum and (rule.type~='integer'or v%1==0),'micrography-request-range:'..key);parameters[key]=v
  end
  local normalized=input({parameters=parameters,inputs={panel=q.panel,text=q.text,font=q.font,fixed=q.fixed},constraints={},document={bounds=q.bounds,protected_regions=P.array()}})
  assert(P.serialize(normalized)==P.serialize(q),'micrography-request-normalization')
  local field=F.solve(q.panel,q.size,q.omega,q.fixed,12,q.iterations,context and function(n)context:consume('operations',n)end)
  reconstructed(e.field,field,'field')
  local groups,source_clusters=shape(q.text,q.font)
  local text,positions,streamlines,solver=layout(q,field,groups,source_clusters)
  reconstructed(e.positions,positions,'positions');reconstructed(e.streamlines,streamlines,'streamlines')
  reconstructed(e.solver,solver,'solver');reconstructed(e.clusters,source_clusters,'clusters')
  reconstructed(t,text,'text')
  reconstructed(x.structures.field,field_samples(e.field,e.request),'structure/field')
  local clusters={}
  local next_cluster=1
  local cmap={}
  for _,g in ipairs(e.request.font.glyphs) do cmap[g.id]=g end
  for i,run in ipairs(t.runs) do
    clusters[#clusters+1]=run.text
    assert(run.id==t.reading_order[i],"micrography-run-order")
    local line=e.positions[i]
    local parts={}
    for j,g in ipairs(line.glyphs) do
      local span=line.spans[j]
      assert(span[1]==next_cluster and span[2]>=span[1],"micrography-cluster-conservation")
      next_cluster=span[2]+1
      local glyph=cmap[g.glyph_ref]
      local source={}
      for k=span[1],span[2] do source[#source+1]=e.clusters[k] end
      assert(table.concat(source)==glyph.unicode,"micrography-glyph-cluster-mapping")
      parts[#parts+1]=glyph.unicode
      for _,p in ipairs(corners(glyph,g,e.request.size/e.request.font.units_per_em)) do
        assert(F.contained(e.request.panel,p,0),"micrography-glyph-containment")
      end
    end
    assert(table.concat(parts)==run.text,"micrography-run-content")
  end
  assert(table.concat(clusters)==e.request.text and next_cluster==#e.clusters+1,"micrography-text-conservation")
  return {ok=true,solver=P.plain(e.solver),checks={"Pinned grapheme-to-glyph and run order verified",
    "Doubled-angle samples reconstructed","Field, boundary labels, mesh references and complete layout reconstructed",
    "Glyph envelopes contained in the source panel"}}
end

local function lower(x,v,style)
  assert(next(P.plain(style))==nil and #v.protected_regions==0,"micrography-view-with-hidden-text")
  local e=x.extensions.micrography
  local transform=P.plain(v.transform)
  local crop=v.crop
  local cmap={}
  for _,g in ipairs(e.request.font.glyphs) do cmap[g.id]=g end
  local ops=P.array()
  local order=x.structures.text.reading_order
  for i,run in ipairs(x.structures.text.runs) do
    local gs=e.positions[i].glyphs
    for _,g in ipairs(gs) do
      for _,p in ipairs(corners(cmap[g.glyph_ref],g,e.request.size/e.request.font.units_per_em)) do
        local q=G.transform(p,transform)
        assert(q[1]>=crop[1]-1e-10 and q[1]<=crop[3]+1e-10 and q[2]>=crop[2]-1e-10 and q[2]<=crop[4]+1e-10,
          "micrography-crop-would-hide-text")
      end
    end
    ops[i]={op="text",semantic_ref=run.id,font_ref=e.request.font.id,text=run.text,origin={0,0},
      size=e.request.size,glyphs=P.plain(gs),paint={fill={.10,.17,.24}},transform=transform}
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,operations=ops,
    resources={P.plain(e.request.font)},reading_order=P.plain(order),clip={bounds=P.plain(crop),protected_regions=P.array()}}
end

function M.register(reg)
  local d=M.definition()
  reg:register(d,{validate_inputs=function(s) input(s);return true end,generate=function(s,c)
    local q=input(s)
    if q.size<q.min_size then stop("legibility",{status="size_below_minimum",size=q.size,minimum=q.min_size}) end
    assert(H.value("micrography/font-resource",q.font)==font_resource_digest,"micrography-font-resource-integrity")
    local groups,clusters=shape(q.text,q.font)
    -- Text semantics count against the caller's object budget before solving.
    c:consume("objects",#clusters)
    local field=F.solve(q.panel,q.size,q.omega,q.fixed,12,q.iterations,function(n) c:consume("operations",n) end)
    local text,positions,lines,solver=layout(q,field,groups,clusters)
    local identity=P.plain(q)
    identity.font=q.font.font_sha256
    return {id="micrography/"..H.value("micrography/design",identity),
      definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={text=text,field=field_samples(field,q)},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={micrography={request=q,field=field,streamlines=lines,positions=positions,
        clusters=P.array(clusters),solver=solver,export="visible positioned outlines with actual Unicode text layers"}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end
return M
source.pattern_mosaic.lua:
local P,R,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_registry"),require("pattern_hash")
local C=require("pattern_mosaic_cpu")
local M={VERSION=C.VERSION}
local function finite(x)
  return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<=100
end
local function point(p,b)
  assert(type(p)=="table" and #p==2 and finite(p[1]) and finite(p[2]),"mosaic-point")
  assert(p[1]>=b[1] and p[1]<=b[3] and p[2]>=b[2] and p[2]<=b[4],"mosaic-point-outside-bounds")
  return P.plain(p)
end
local function rgb(c)
  assert(type(c)=="table" and #c==3,"mosaic-rgb")
  for _,v in ipairs(c) do assert(finite(v) and v>=0 and v<=1,"mosaic-rgb") end
  return P.plain(c)
end
local function request(s)
  local a,b=s.parameters,s.document.bounds
  local input=s.inputs
  for k in pairs(input) do assert(k=="panel" or k=="features" or k=="image" or k=="witness","mosaic-input:"..k) end
  assert(next(P.plain(s.constraints))==nil,"mosaic-constraints")
  assert(b[3]-b[1]<=20 and b[4]-b[2]<=20,"mosaic-bounds")
  local panel=input.panel or {{b[1],b[2]},{b[3],b[2]},{b[3],b[4]},{b[1],b[4]}}
  assert(type(panel)=="table" and #panel>=3 and #panel<=16,"mosaic-panel-count")
  local area=0
  for i,p in ipairs(panel) do
    point(p,b)
    local q=point(panel[i%#panel+1],b)
    area=area+p[1]*q[2]-p[2]*q[1]
    for j,r in ipairs(panel) do
      if j~=i and j~=i%#panel+1 then
        point(r,b)
        assert((q[1]-p[1])*(r[2]-p[2])-(q[2]-p[2])*(r[1]-p[1])>1e-8,"mosaic-panel-must-be-strictly-convex-ccw")
      end
    end
  end
  local features=input.features or P.array()
  assert(type(features)=="table" and #features<=12,"mosaic-feature-count")
  for _,line in ipairs(features) do
    assert(type(line)=="table" and #line>=2 and #line<=64,"mosaic-feature-point-count")
    for i,p in ipairs(line) do
      point(p,b)
      if i>1 then assert((p[1]-line[i-1][1])^2+(p[2]-line[i-1][2])^2>1e-12,"mosaic-degenerate-feature") end
    end
  end
  local image=input.image
  assert(type(image)=="table" and type(image.layers)=="table" and #image.layers<=12,"mosaic-analytic-image")
  local clean_image={background=rgb(image.background),layers=P.array()}
  for i,l in ipairs(image.layers) do
    assert(l.shape=="ellipse" or l.shape=="band","mosaic-image-layer")
    assert(type(l.extent)=="table" and #l.extent==2 and finite(l.extent[1]) and finite(l.extent[2])
      and l.extent[1]>0 and l.extent[2]>0,"mosaic-image-extent")
    assert(l.shape~="band" or finite(l.curve),"mosaic-image-curve")
    clean_image.layers[i]={shape=l.shape,center=point(l.center,b),extent=P.plain(l.extent),color=rgb(l.color),curve=l.curve}
  end
  return {bounds=P.plain(b),panel=P.plain(panel),panel_area=area/2,features=P.plain(features),image=clean_image,
    count=a.count,size=a.tile_size,sample=a.sample_step,grout=a.grout or .02,
    guided=a.guided~=false,influence=a.influence or .8,aspect=a.aspect or 1,
    size_variation=a.size_variation or 0,exclusion=a.exclusion or 0,avoid_steps=a.avoid_steps or 0,
    iterations=a.iterations or 12,tolerance=a.tolerance or .005,min_scale=a.min_scale or .18}
end

local function sample(image,p)
  local color=image.background
  for _,l in ipairs(image.layers) do
    local x=(p[1]-l.center[1])/l.extent[1]
    local y=(p[2]-l.center[2])/l.extent[2]
    if (l.shape=="ellipse" and x*x+y*y<=1) or (l.shape=="band" and math.abs(x)<=1 and math.abs(y-l.curve*x*x)<=1) then
      color=l.color
    end
  end
  return P.plain(color)
end

local function geometry(q,centers)
  assert(type(centers)=="table" and #centers==q.count,"mosaic-witness-count")
  for _,p in ipairs(centers) do
    point(p,q.bounds)
    assert(C.inside(q.panel,p[1],p[2]),"mosaic-center-outside-panel")
  end
  local tiles,rejected,area=C.pack(q,centers)
  local field={representation="samples",domain={bounds=q.bounds},samples=P.array()}
  for _,t in ipairs(tiles) do
    t.id="mosaic/site/"..t.site
    t.color=sample(q.image,t.center)
    field.samples[#field.samples+1]={id=t.id,point=t.center,vector=t.axis,density=1}
  end
  return field,{tiles=P.array(tiles),rejected=P.array(rejected),area=area,coverage=area/q.panel_area,
    status=#tiles==0 and "empty_packing" or (#rejected>0 and "partial_packing" or "all_sites_packed")}
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="mosaic/hausner",version="1",family="hausner-decorative-mosaic",units="cm",
    capabilities={"field"},parameters={
      count={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=320,required=true},
      tile_size={type="number",minimum=.08,maximum=4,required=true},
      sample_step={type="number",minimum=.025,maximum=.5,required=true},
      grout={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=.4},guided={type="boolean"},
      influence={type="number",minimum=.05,maximum=4},aspect={type="number",minimum=1,maximum=3},
      size_variation={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=.6},exclusion={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=4},
      avoid_steps={type="integer",minimum=0,maximum=20},iterations={type="integer",minimum=0,maximum=48},
      tolerance={type="number",minimum=.0001,maximum=.05},min_scale={type="number",minimum=.05,maximum=1}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Convex bounded panel and analytic layered color sampler",
      "CPU samples of rotated weighted L1 pyramids, with artist-feature exclusion and Lloyd updates",
      "Ordered rectangle scale projection with separating-axis grout and explicit rejected sites"}})
end

local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.mosaic
  local field,pack=geometry(e.request,e.centers)
  assert(P.serialize(field)==P.serialize(x.structures.field),"mosaic-field-reconstruction")
  assert(P.serialize(pack)==P.serialize(e.packing),"mosaic-packing-reconstruction")
  assert(e.solver.witness_sha256==H.value("mosaic/centers",e.centers),"mosaic-witness-digest")
  return {ok=true,solver=P.plain(e.solver),construction={coverage=pack.coverage,status=pack.status},checks={"Field samples reconstructed", "Vector packing reconstructed", "Saved centers digest verified"}}
end

local function lower(x,v,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="features","mosaic-style:"..k) end
  assert(style.features==nil or type(style.features)=="boolean","mosaic-feature-overlay")
  local ops=P.array()
  local e=x.extensions.mosaic
  local function draw(ref,points,closed,paint)
    local commands={}
    for i,p in ipairs(points) do commands[i]={i==1 and "M" or "L",p[1],p[2]} end
    if closed then commands[#commands+1]={"Z"} end
    ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=ref,commands=commands,transform=P.plain(v.transform),paint=paint}
  end
  draw(x.id,e.request.panel,true,{fill={.18,.17,.15}})
  for _,t in ipairs(e.packing.tiles) do draw(t.id,t.corners,true,{fill=t.color}) end
  if style.features then
    for _,line in ipairs(e.request.features) do draw(x.id,line,false,{stroke={1,.8,.3},stroke_width=.012}) end
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,operations=ops,
    resources=P.array(),clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)}}
end

function M.register(reg)
  local d=M.definition()
  reg:register(d,{validate_inputs=function(s) request(s);return true end,generate=function(s,c)
    local q=request(s)
    -- Charge requested sites before either solving or accepting a witness.
    c:consume("objects",q.count)
    local solver,centers
    if s.inputs.witness then
      centers=P.plain(s.inputs.witness)
      solver={route="replayed",status="saved_centers",evaluations=0}
    else
      local result=C.solve(q,c:stream("lloyd-start","mosaic"),function(n) c:consume("operations",n) end)
      centers=result.centers
      solver={route="sampled_lloyd",status=result.status,initial=result.initial,history=P.array(result.history),
        evaluations=#result.history+1,final_energy=result.final_energy,samples=result.samples}
    end
    solver.algorithm=M.VERSION
    solver.witness_sha256=H.value("mosaic/centers",centers)
    local field,packing=geometry(q,centers)
    local identity=P.plain(q)
    identity.iterations,identity.tolerance,identity.avoid_steps=nil,nil,nil
    return {id="mosaic/"..H.value("mosaic/geometry",{identity=identity,centers=centers}),
      definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={field=field},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={mosaic={request=q,centers=centers,solver=solver,packing=packing}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end

return M
source.pattern_mosaic_cpu.lua:
local M={VERSION="hausner-l1-cpu-v1"}
local abs,min,max,sqrt=math.abs,math.min,math.max,math.sqrt

local function cross(a,b,x,y)
  return (b[1]-a[1])*(y-a[2])-(b[2]-a[2])*(x-a[1])
end

local function inside(panel,x,y)
  for i,a in ipairs(panel) do
    if cross(a,panel[i%#panel+1],x,y)<-1e-12 then return false end
  end
  return true
end
M.inside=inside

local function field(features,x,y)
  local best,ux,uy=math.huge,1,0
  for _,line in ipairs(features) do
    for j=1,#line-1 do
      local a,b=line[j],line[j+1]
      local dx,dy=b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2]
      local n=dx*dx+dy*dy
      local t=max(0,min(1,((x-a[1])*dx+(y-a[2])*dy)/n))
      local d=(x-a[1]-t*dx)^2+(y-a[2]-t*dy)^2
      if d<best-1e-12 then best,ux,uy=d,dx/sqrt(n),dy/sqrt(n) end
    end
  end
  return ux,uy,sqrt(best)
end
M.field=field

local function oriented(q,x,y)
  local ux,uy,d=field(q.features,x,y)
  local f=q.guided and max(0,1-d/q.influence) or 0
  local size=q.size*(1-q.size_variation*f)
  local aspect=1+(q.aspect-1)*f
  if not q.guided then ux,uy=1,0 end
  return {x=x,y=y,ux=ux,uy=uy,half_u=size*sqrt(aspect)/2,half_v=size/sqrt(aspect)/2}
end

local function samples(q)
  local out={}
  local l,b,r,t=table.unpack(q.bounds)
  local nx,ny=math.ceil((r-l)/q.sample),math.ceil((t-b)/q.sample)
  assert(nx*ny<=12000,"mosaic-sampling-horizon")
  for j=1,ny do
    for i=1,nx do
      local x,y=l+(i-.5)*(r-l)/nx,b+(j-.5)*(t-b)/ny
      if inside(q.panel,x,y) then
        local _,_,d=field(q.features,x,y)
        out[#out+1]={x,y,d<q.exclusion}
      end
    end
  end
  assert(#out>0,"mosaic-empty-sampling-panel")
  return out
end

local function diagram(grid,sites,strip)
  local accum,energy,used={},0,0
  for i=1,#sites do accum[i]={0,0,0} end
  for _,p in ipairs(grid) do
    if not strip or not p[3] then
      local best,winner=math.huge
      for i,s in ipairs(sites) do
        local dx,dy=p[1]-s.x,p[2]-s.y
        local distance=abs(s.ux*dx+s.uy*dy)/s.half_u+abs(s.ux*dy-s.uy*dx)/s.half_v
        if distance<best-1e-12 then best,winner=distance,i end
      end
      local a=accum[winner]
      a[1],a[2],a[3]=a[1]+p[1],a[2]+p[2],a[3]+1
      energy,used=energy+best,used+1
    end
  end
  return accum,used>0 and energy/used or 0,used
end

local function round(v)
  return math.floor(v*1e10+.5)/1e10
end

function M.solve(q,rng,step)
  local grid=samples(q)
  assert(q.count<=#grid,"mosaic-more-sites-than-samples")
  assert(#grid*q.count*(q.iterations+1)<=24000000,"mosaic-evaluation-horizon")
  local indices={}
  for i=1,#grid do indices[i]=i end
  local centers={}
  for i=1,q.count do
    local j=rng.int(i,#grid)
    indices[i],indices[j]=indices[j],indices[i]
    local p=grid[indices[i]]
    centers[i]={round(p[1]),round(p[2])}
  end
  local initial=centers
  local history={}
  local status="iteration_budget"
  for i=1,q.iterations do
    local strip=q.guided and q.exclusion>0 and i<=q.avoid_steps
    local sites={}
    for j,p in ipairs(centers) do sites[j]=oriented(q,p[1],p[2]) end
    if step then step(#grid*q.count) end
    local accum,energy,used=diagram(grid,sites,strip)
    local moved,empty,next_centers=0,0,{}
    for j,a in ipairs(accum) do
      local x,y=table.unpack(centers[j])
      local next_point=centers[j]
      if a[3]>0 then
        local xx,yy=round(a[1]/a[3]),round(a[2]/a[3])
        moved=max(moved,sqrt((x-xx)^2+(y-yy)^2))
        next_point={xx,yy}
      else empty=empty+1 end
      next_centers[j]=next_point
    end
    history[i]={phase=strip and "feature-exclusion" or "full",energy=energy,samples=used,
      max_motion=moved,empty_regions=empty}
    centers=next_centers
    if used==0 then status="no_active_samples";break end
    if not strip and moved<=q.tolerance and empty==0 then status="stationary";break end
  end
  local sites={}
  for i,p in ipairs(centers) do sites[i]=oriented(q,p[1],p[2]) end
  if step then step(#grid*q.count) end
  local _,final_energy,used=diagram(grid,sites,false)
  return {initial=initial,centers=centers,history=history,status=status,
    final_energy=final_energy,samples=used}
end

local function corners(s,scale)
  local a,b=s.half_u*scale,s.half_v*scale
  local out={}
  for i,k in ipairs{{-1,-1},{1,-1},{1,1},{-1,1}} do
    out[i]={s.x+k[1]*a*s.ux-k[2]*b*s.uy,s.y+k[1]*a*s.uy+k[2]*b*s.ux}
  end
  return out
end

local function overlaps(a,b,gap)
  for _,axis in ipairs{a,b} do
    for j=1,2 do
      local x,y=axis.ux,axis.uy
      if j==2 then x,y=-y,x end
      local function radius(s)
        return (s.half_u*abs(s.ux*x+s.uy*y)+s.half_v*abs(s.ux*y-s.uy*x))*s.scale
      end
      if abs((a.x-b.x)*x+(a.y-b.y)*y)>=radius(a)+radius(b)+gap then return false end
    end
  end
  return true
end

function M.pack(q,centers)
  local sites,tiles,rejected={},{},{}
  local area=0
  for i,p in ipairs(centers) do
    local s=oriented(q,p[1],p[2])
    local function fits(scale)
      for _,v in ipairs(corners(s,scale)) do
        if not inside(q.panel,v[1],v[2]) then return false end
      end
      s.scale=scale
      for _,other in ipairs(sites) do
        if overlaps(s,other,q.grout) then return false end
      end
      return true
    end
    if fits(q.min_scale) then
      local lo,hi=q.min_scale,1
      if fits(1) then lo=1
      else
        for _=1,22 do
          local mid=(lo+hi)/2
          if fits(mid) then lo=mid else hi=mid end
        end
      end
      s.scale=lo
      sites[#sites+1]=s
      tiles[#tiles+1]={site=i,center=p,axis={s.ux,s.uy},corners=corners(s,lo),scale=lo}
      area=area+4*s.half_u*s.half_v*lo*lo
    else rejected[#rejected+1]=i end
  end
  return tiles,rejected,area
end

return M
source.pattern_output_style.lua:
-- Shared paint-only output treatment. No topology, paths, clips or dimensions change.
local P,H,Parse,D=require('pattern'),require('pattern_hash'),require('pattern_parse'),require('pattern_draw')
local M={VERSION='output-paint-v1'}
local function keys(t,allowed)
 local yes={};for k in allowed:gmatch('%S+')do yes[k]=true end
 for k in pairs(t)do assert(yes[k],'output profile unknown field:'..tostring(k))end
end
function M.split(style)
 local family=P.plain(style);local profile=family.output_profile;family.output_profile=nil
 if not profile then return family,nil end
 assert(type(profile)=='table'and profile.schema_version==1,'output profile schema_version1 required')
 keys(profile,'schema_version mode fill stroke')
 assert(profile.mode=='source'or profile.mode=='monochrome'or profile.mode=='palette','unsupported output profile mode')
 if profile.mode=='palette'then
  for _,name in ipairs{'fill','stroke'}do
   local c=profile[name];assert(type(c)=='table'and #c==3,'palette requires fill/stroke RGB triples')
   for k,v in pairs(c)do assert(type(k)=='number'and k%1==0 and k>=1 and k<=3 and type(v)=='number'and v==v and v>=0 and v<=1,'palette RGB outside0..1')end
  end
 else assert(profile.fill==nil and profile.stroke==nil,'colors require palette mode')end
 return family,profile
end
local function tone(c,space)
 -- Same encoded-RGB weights and three-decimal neutral precision as ink.lua.
 local v=space=='gray'and c[1]or .2126*c[1]+.7152*c[2]+.0722*c[3]
 return assert(tonumber((string.format('%.3f',v):gsub(',','.'))))
end
function M.apply(scene,profile,context)
 if not profile or profile.mode=='source'then return scene end
 local out=P.plain(scene)
 local function paint(p)
  local original=p.color_space or 'rgb'
  for _,name in ipairs{'fill','stroke'}do if p[name]then
   local g=tone(p[name],original)
   if profile.mode=='monochrome'then p[name]={g}
   else local c=profile[name];p[name]={(1-g)*c[1]+g,(1-g)*c[2]+g,(1-g)*c[3]+g}end
  end end
  p.color_space=profile.mode=='monochrome'and'gray'or'rgb';D.validate_paint(p)
  if context then context:consume('operations',1)end
 end
 local function operations(list)
  for _,op in ipairs(list)do if op.op=='path'or op.op=='text'then paint(op.paint)end end
 end
 operations(out.operations)
 for _,resource in ipairs(out.resources)do if resource.kind=='symbol'then
  local asset=D.asset(resource);operations(asset.operations)
  local content=P.serialize(asset);assert(#content<=2*1024*1024,'styled vector resource exceeds bounded profile')
  resource.variants.scene={encoding='utf8',content=content,sha256=H.sha256(content)}
 end end
 out.extensions=out.extensions or{};out.extensions.output_profile=P.plain(profile)
 return out
end
return M

-- Strict RFC 8259 grammar with bounded resources and duplicate decoded-key rejection.
-- dkjson decodes only already-validated quoted strings (including escape spelling).
local P,J=require("pattern"),require("pattern_json")
local M={}
local function decode(text,instance)
  local bytes=instance and 32*1024*1024 or 2*1024*1024
  local node_limit=instance and 1000000 or 100000
  assert(type(text)=="string" and #text<=bytes,instance and "instance JSON exceeds 32 MiB limit" or "recipe JSON exceeds 2 MiB limit")
  assert(utf8.len(text),"recipe JSON is not UTF-8")
  local at,nodes=1,0
  local function fail(why) error("recipe JSON byte "..at..": "..why,0) end
  local function ws() while text:sub(at,at):match("[ \t\r\n]") do at=at+1 end end
  local function quoted()
    local start=at;at=at+1
    while at<=#text do
      local ch=text:sub(at,at);local code=text:byte(at)
      if ch=='"' then
        at=at+1;local value,_,err=J.decode(text:sub(start,at-1));if err then fail(err) end;return value
      elseif code<32 then fail("unescaped control character")
      elseif ch=='\\' then
        at=at+1;ch=text:sub(at,at)
        if ch=='u' then
          local hex=text:sub(at+1,at+4);if #hex~=4 or hex:find('[^%da-fA-F]') then fail("invalid Unicode escape") end
          local u=tonumber(hex,16);at=at+5
          if u>=0xd800 and u<=0xdbff then
            if text:sub(at,at+1)~='\\u' then fail("unpaired high surrogate") end
            local low=text:sub(at+2,at+5);local v=tonumber(low,16)
            if #low~=4 or low:find('[^%da-fA-F]') or not v or v<0xdc00 or v>0xdfff then fail("invalid low surrogate") end
            at=at+6
          elseif u>=0xdc00 and u<=0xdfff then fail("unpaired low surrogate") end
        elseif ch:match('["\\/bfnrt]') and ch~='' then at=at+1
        else fail("invalid escape") end
      else at=at+1 end
    end
    fail("unterminated string")
  end
  local value
  value=function(depth)
    nodes=nodes+1;if depth>60 or nodes>node_limit then fail("nesting/node budget exceeded") end
    ws();local ch=text:sub(at,at)
    if ch=='"' then return quoted()
    elseif ch=='{' or ch=='[' then
      local object=ch=='{';local close=object and '}' or ']'
      local out=object and {} or P.array();local seen={};at=at+1;ws()
      if text:sub(at,at)==close then at=at+1;return out end
      while true do
        ws();local key
        if object then
          if text:sub(at,at)~='"' then fail("expected object key") end
          key=quoted();if seen[key] then fail("duplicate object key "..key) end;seen[key]=true
          ws();if text:sub(at,at)~=':' then fail("expected colon") end;at=at+1
        else key=#out+1 end
        out[key]=value(depth+1);ws();ch=text:sub(at,at);at=at+1
        if ch==close then return out end
        if ch~=',' then fail("expected comma or closing delimiter") end
      end
    elseif text:sub(at,at+3)=='true' then at=at+4;return true
    elseif text:sub(at,at+4)=='false' then at=at+5;return false
    elseif text:sub(at,at+3)=='null' then fail("null is not supported in recipes")
    elseif ch=='-' or ch:match('%d') then
      local start=at;if ch=='-' then at=at+1 end
      ch=text:sub(at,at)
      if ch=='0' then at=at+1
      elseif ch:match('[1-9]') then repeat at=at+1 until not text:sub(at,at):match('%d')
      else fail("expected number digit") end
      if text:sub(at,at)=='.' then
        at=at+1;if not text:sub(at,at):match('%d') then fail("fraction needs a digit") end
        repeat at=at+1 until not text:sub(at,at):match('%d')
      end
      ch=text:sub(at,at)
      if ch=='e' or ch=='E' then
        at=at+1;ch=text:sub(at,at);if ch=='+' or ch=='-' then at=at+1 end
        if not text:sub(at,at):match('%d') then fail("exponent needs a digit") end
        repeat at=at+1 until not text:sub(at,at):match('%d')
      end
      -- tonumber obeys Lua's C-locale-independent numeric conversion.
      local v=tonumber(text:sub(start,at-1));if not v or v~=v or math.abs(v)==math.huge then fail("nonfinite number") end
      return v
    end
    fail("expected JSON value")
  end
  local out=value(0);ws();if at<=#text then fail("trailing input") end
  return P.plain(out)
end
-- Input type selects a fixed admission profile; callers cannot supply arbitrary
-- limits. Recipes/requests retain their original smaller limits. Both routes
-- enforce the same strict grammar, duplicate-key, nonfinite and depth checks.
function M.decode(text)return decode(text,false)end
function M.instance(text)return decode(text,true)end
return M
