-- de Bruijn (1981), I sections 4-5: exact classification of regular pentagrid crossings.
local P=require("pattern")
local H=require("pattern_hash")
local M={VERSION="regular-pentagrid-p3-v1"}
local sqrt5=math.sqrt(5)
local phi=(1+sqrt5)/2
local c1,c2=(sqrt5-1)/4,-(sqrt5+1)/4
local s1,s2=math.sqrt(10+2*sqrt5)/4,math.sqrt(10-2*sqrt5)/4
local directions={{1,0},{c1,s1},{c2,s2},{c2,-s2},{c1,-s1}}
local sine={{0,0},{0,1},{1,0},{-1,0},{0,-1}}
local phase_profiles={
  amber={numerators={1,2,4,8,-15},denominator=31},
  indigo={numerators={-7,3,11,-4,-3},denominator=37},
}
local function integer(x) return type(x)=="number" and math.type(x)=="integer" end
local function finite(x) return type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<math.huge end
local function sine_ratio(n,d)
  local a,b=sine[n%5+1],sine[d%5+1]
  assert(b[1]~=0 or b[2]~=0,"penrose-parallel-grid-families")
  if b[1]~=0 then return {a[1]*b[1],a[2]*b[1]} end
  return {(a[2]-a[1])*b[2],a[1]*b[2]}
end
local function projection_ratios(i,j,l)
  return sine_ratio(j-l,j-i),sine_ratio(l-i,j-i)
end
function M.phase(numerators,denominator)
  assert(type(numerators)=="table" and #numerators==5 and integer(denominator)
    and denominator>=1 and denominator<=257,"penrose-phase-domain")
  local sum=0
  for _,v in ipairs(numerators) do
    assert(integer(v) and math.abs(v)<=denominator*8,"penrose-phase-coordinate")
    sum=sum+v
  end
  assert(sum==0,"penrose-phase-must-sum-zero")
  local witnesses={}
  for i=1,3 do for j=i+1,4 do for l=j+1,5 do
    local a,b=projection_ratios(i,j,l)
    local u=(-a[1]*numerators[i]-b[1]*numerators[j]+numerators[l])%denominator
    local v=(-a[2]*numerators[i]-b[2]*numerators[j])%denominator
    assert(u~=0 or v~=0,"penrose-phase-not-certified-regular")
    witnesses[#witnesses+1]={families={i,j,l},residue={u,v}}
  end end end
  return {numerators=P.plain(numerators),denominator=denominator,regularity=witnesses}
end
local function sign_integer(x)
  if x<0 then return -1 elseif x>0 then return 1 else return 0 end
end
local function exact_sign(a,b)
  local x,y=2*a+b,b
  local sx,sy=sign_integer(x),sign_integer(y)
  if sx==0 then return sy elseif sy==0 or sx==sy then return sx end
  assert(math.abs(x)<=2^29 and math.abs(y)<=2^29,"penrose-algebraic-sign-budget")
  return sx*sign_integer(x*x-5*y*y)
end
local function exact_ceiling(a,b,d)
  local ceiling=math.ceil((a+b*phi)/d)
  while exact_sign(a-(ceiling-1)*d,b)<=0 do ceiling=ceiling-1 end
  while exact_sign(a-ceiling*d,b)>0 do ceiling=ceiling+1 end
  assert(exact_sign(a-ceiling*d,b)~=0,"penrose-singular-crossing")
  return ceiling
end
local function sum(k)
  local n=0
  for i=1,5 do n=n+k[i] end
  return n
end
local function project(k)
  local x,y=0,0
  for i,u in ipairs(directions) do x=x+k[i]*u[1];y=y+k[i]*u[2] end
  return {x,y}
end
local function add_lifts(k,i,j)
  local p={table.unpack(k)}
  if i then p[i]=p[i]+1 end
  if j then p[j]=p[j]+1 end
  return p
end
local function crossing(i,j,m,n,phase)
  local d,g=phase.denominator,phase.numerators
  local u,v=d*m-g[i],d*n-g[j]
  local lift={}
  for l=1,5 do
    if l==i then lift[l]=m
    elseif l==j then lift[l]=n
    else
      local a,b=projection_ratios(i,j,l)
      lift[l]=exact_ceiling(a[1]*u+b[1]*v+g[l],a[2]*u+b[2]*v,d)
    end
  end
  local delta=j-i
  local ccw_i,ccw_j=i,j
  if delta>=3 then ccw_i,ccw_j=j,i end
  local thick=delta==1 or delta==4
  local corners={lift,add_lifts(lift,ccw_i),add_lifts(lift,i,j),add_lifts(lift,ccw_j)}
  local points,indices={},{}
  local box={math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge}
  for a,k in ipairs(corners) do
    local p=project(k)
    local index=sum(k)
    assert(index>=1 and index<=4,"penrose-vertex-index-outside-window")
    indices[a]=index;points[a]=p
    box[1],box[2]=math.min(box[1],p[1]),math.min(box[2],p[2])
    box[3],box[4]=math.max(box[3],p[1]),math.max(box[4],p[2])
  end
  return {address={i,j,m,n},lift=lift,corners=corners,points=points,indices=indices,
    box=box,prototype=thick and "thick" or "thin",acute_at_base=thick}
end
local function lift_key(k) return table.concat(k,"/") end
local function edge_key(a,b)
  if P.byte_less(b,a) then return b.."+"..a,true end
  return a.."+"..b,false
end
local function arrow(cell,i)
  local j=i%4+1
  local a,b=cell.indices[i],cell.indices[j]
  assert(math.abs(a-b)==1,"penrose-edge-index-step")
  local green=(math.min(a,b)==1 or math.max(a,b)==4)
  local forward
  if green then forward=(a==2 and b==1) or (a==3 and b==4)
  else forward=(i%2==1)==cell.acute_at_base end
  return {class=green and "green" or "red",multiplicity=green and 2 or 1,forward=forward}
end
local function sorted_keys(t)
  local out={}
  for k in pairs(t) do out[#out+1]=k end
  table.sort(out,P.byte_less)
  return out
end
local function grow(b,h) return {b[1]-h,b[2]-h,b[3]+h,b[4]+h} end
local function intersects(a,b,eps)

-- Globally anchored, edge-to-edge periodic constructions. Query bounds select

local T,W=require("pattern_periodic_templates"),require("pattern_wallpaper")

local function cell_id(prefix,i,j,name)return prefix.."/c/"..i.."/"..j.."/"..name end

local function edge_id(prefix,a,b)return prefix.."/e/"..T.key(a)..":"..T.key(b)end
local function linear(m,p)

local function chart(t,step,degrees,origin)

local function frame_identity(t,step,angle,frame)

    c:consume("objects",1)

      isometry={rotation_degrees=(angle+f.rotation_degrees)%360,reflection=false,center=world(t,matrix,T.shift(f.center,i,j))},boundary={}}

-- Periodic polygon templates in exact lattice coordinates. A point is
-- {(u0+u1 sqrt(D))/6, (v0+v1 sqrt(D))/6}, stored as four integers.

local function shift(p,i,j)return{p[1]+6*i,p[2],p[3]+6*j,p[4]}end

local function sign(a,b,d)

  if a==0 then return b>0 and 1 or -1 end
  if a>0 and b>0 then return 1 elseif a<0 and b<0 then return -1 end

local function cross(a,b,d)

local function orient(a,b,c,d)local x,y=cross(sub(b,a),sub(c,a),d);return sign(x,y,d)end

  local x=2*(a[1]*b[1]+d*a[2]*b[2]+a[3]*b[3]+d*a[4]*b[4])
  local y=2*(a[1]*b[2]+a[2]*b[1]+a[3]*b[4]+a[4]*b[3])

end

  local ok,value=pcall(fn);if ok then return value end

-- Filtered exact orientation for admitted binary64 inputs.
-- Independent Lua implementation of error-free arithmetic described by
-- Shewchuk, CMU-CS-96-140R (1997), sections 2.3--2.5 and 4.3.
local M={VERSION="orient2d-expansion-v1"}
local eps=2^-53
local function coordinate(n)
  assert(type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<=1e50 and (n==0 or math.abs(n)>=1e-50),"orientation coordinate outside admitted zero or 1e-50..1e50 range")

local function point(p) assert(type(p)=="table" and #p==2,"2D point required");return coordinate(p[1]),coordinate(p[2]) end
local function sum(a,b)
  local x=a+b;local bv=x-a;local av=x-bv

local function difference(a,b)
  local x=a-b;local bv=a-x;local av=x+bv

end
local function split(a)

end
local function sign(n) return n>0 and 1 or n<0 and -1 or 0 end

function M.equal(a,b) local ax,ay=point(a);local bx,by=point(b);return ax==bx and ay==by end

  keys(t.view,"unit transform crop protected_regions derived validity projection extensions","recipe.view")

-- Registration is independent of family semantics and renderer selection.
local P=require("pattern")
local M={}
function M.context(options)

  local seed=options.seed
  assert(type(seed)=="number" and seed%1==0 and seed>=0 and seed<2^31,"invalid construction seed")
  local limits=P.plain(options.limits or {objects=10000,operations=100000,bytes=2*1024*1024})
  for k,n in pairs(limits) do assert(type(k)=="string" and type(n)=="number" and n%1==0 and n>=0 and n<math.huge,"invalid construction budget") end
  local spent,cancelled={},false
  local on_cancel,provider,input_provider=options.cancelled,options.stream_provider,options.input_provider
  local metadata={seed=seed,source=P.snapshot(options.source),versions=P.snapshot(options.versions or {}),frame=P.snapshot(options.frame or {id="world",unit="cm",dimension=2,handedness="right",origin={0,0}})}
  if options.planning~=nil then metadata.planning=P.snapshot(options.planning)end
  local ctx=setmetatable({},{__index=metadata,__newindex=function(t,k,v) assert(metadata[k]==nil,"immutable construction context metadata");rawset(t,k,v) end})
  function ctx:consume(name,n)
    if cancelled or on_cancel and on_cancel() then cancelled=true;error({code="cancelled",message="construction cancelled"},0) end
    assert(limits[name]~=nil,"unknown budget "..tostring(name))
    assert(type(n)=="number" and n%1==0 and n>=0,"invalid budget charge")
    if (spent[name] or 0)+n>limits[name] then error({code="budget_exhausted",message="construction budget exhausted: "..name},0) end
    spent[name]=(spent[name] or 0)+n

    assert(type(name)=="string" and name~="" and type(semantic_id)=="string" and semantic_id~="","named semantic stream required")
    assert(type(provider)=="function","named stream derivation is not configured; stage 04 supplies it")
    return provider(name,semantic_id,seed)
  end
  function ctx:input(name)
    assert(type(name)=="string" and #name>0 and type(input_provider)=="function","verified named input provider required")
    return input_provider(name)
  end

end
function M.new()

  end

      context:consume("objects",0)

      return {instance=instance,definition=d,validation=validation}
    end
    local ok,value=pcall(execute)
    if ok then return value end
    local code=type(value)=="table" and value.code or "failed"
    local message=type(value)=="table" and value.message or tostring(value)
    return nil,{status=code=="cancelled" and "cancelled" or "failed",code=code,diagnostics={message},
      budgets=context:receipt(),solver=type(value)=="table" and value.solver or nil}
  end

    local entry=assert(entries[id],"unknown generator "..tostring(id))
    local d=entry.definition
    local x=P.instance(P.plain(instance),d);local v=P.view(P.plain(view),x,d)
    local data=entry.implementation.lower(x,v,P.plain(style),context)
    local scene=P.scene(data,x,v,d)
    context:consume("operations",#scene.operations)
    context:consume("bytes",#P.serialize(scene))
    return scene
  end
  return registry
end
return M

        append(content,{path(o.commands,true),kind=="stroke" and 'S' or p.fill_rule=="evenodd" and 'f*' or 'f','Q'})
      end end
    end
  end
  local fonts,fontrefs={},{}
  for fi,f in ipairs(plan.fonts)do
    local procs,differences,widths,mappings,codes={}, {'1'},{},{},{}
    local box={math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge}
    for i,g in ipairs(f.glyphs)do
      codes[g.id]=i;widths[#widths+1]=n(g.advance);differences[#differences+1]='/g'..i

      procs[#procs+1]='/g'..i..' '..stream(data)..' 0 R';mappings[#mappings+1]=string.format('<%02X> <%s>',i,B.utf16_hex(g.unicode))
      box={math.min(box[1],g.bounds[1]),math.min(box[2],g.bounds[2]),math.max(box[3],g.bounds[3]),math.max(box[4],g.bounds[4])}
    end
    local chunks={};for i=1,#mappings,100 do local batch={};for j=i,math.min(i+99,#mappings)do batch[#batch+1]=mappings[j]end;chunks[#chunks+1]=#batch..' beginbfchar\n'..table.concat(batch,'\n')..'\nendbfchar'end
    local cmap=stream('/CIDInit /ProcSet findresource begin\n12 dict begin\nbegincmap\n/CIDSystemInfo << /Registry (Adobe) /Ordering (UCS) /Supplement 0 >> def\n/CMapName /SceneUnicode def\n/CMapType 2 def\n1 begincodespacerange\n<00> <FF>\nendcodespacerange\n'..table.concat(chunks,'\n')..'\nendcmap\nCMapName currentdict /CMap defineresource pop\nend\nend')
    local font=obj('<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type3 /Name /F'..fi..' /FontBBox ['..nums(box)..'] /FontMatrix ['..nums({1/f.units_per_em,0,0,1/f.units_per_em,0,0})..'] /CharProcs << '..table.concat(procs,' ')..' >> /Encoding << /Type /Encoding /Differences ['..table.concat(differences,' ')..'] >> /FirstChar 1 /LastChar '..#f.glyphs..' /Widths ['..table.concat(widths,' ')..'] /Resources << >> /ToUnicode '..cmap..' 0 R >>')

      content[#content+1]=nums({1,0,0,1,o.origin[1]+first.offset[1],o.origin[2]+first.offset[2]})..
        ' Tm <'..table.concat(encoded)..'> Tj'
    else
    for _,g in ipairs(o.glyphs)do content[#content+1]=nums({1,0,0,1,o.origin[1]+g.offset[1],o.origin[2]+g.offset[2]})..' Tm '..string.format('<%02X> Tj',font.codes[g.glyph_ref])end
    end

  end

  local page=obj('<< /Type /Page /Parent '..pages..' 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 '..nums({(b[3]-b[1])*k,(b[4]-b[2])*k})..'] /Resources << /ExtGState << '..table.concat(gstates,' ')..' >> /Font << '..table.concat(fontrefs,' ')..' >> >> /Contents '..contents..' 0 R >>')

  end
  objects[catalog]='<< /Type /Catalog /Pages '..pages..' 0 R >>';objects[pages]='<< /Type /Pages /Kids ['..table.concat(references,' ')..'] /Count '..#references..' >>'
  return require("pdfwriter").encode(objects,catalog)
end
function M.pdf(plan)return M.pdf_document({plan})end
return M

-- Deterministic bounded AABB sweep index; IDs never come from coordinates.
local P,B=require("pattern"),require("pattern_bounds")
local S={VERSION="aabb-sweep-v1"}
function S.new(max_objects)
  max_objects=max_objects or 10000;assert(type(max_objects)=="number" and max_objects%1==0 and max_objects>=1 and max_objects<=100000,"invalid index object budget")
  local objects,ids={},{};local dirty=false;local index={}
  function index:insert(id,bounds)
    assert(type(id)=="string" and #id>0 and not ids[id],"unique semantic index ID required")
    P.snapshot(id)
    assert(#objects<max_objects,"spatial index budget exhausted")
    local b=B.box(bounds);objects[#objects+1]={id=id,bounds=b};ids[id]=true;dirty=true
  end
  function index:query(bounds)
    local b=B.box(bounds)
    if dirty then table.sort(objects,function(a,c)return a.bounds[1]<c.bounds[1] or a.bounds[1]==c.bounds[1] and P.byte_less(a.id,c.id) end);dirty=false end
    local result=P.array();local examined=0
    for _,v in ipairs(objects) do
      if v.bounds[1]>b[3] then break end;examined=examined+1
      if B.intersects(v.bounds,b) then result[#result+1]=v.id end
    end
    table.sort(result,P.byte_less);return P.snapshot(result),{method=S.VERSION,examined=examined,total=#objects}
  end
  return index
end
return S

-- Smith, Myers, Kaplan and Goodman-Strauss (2024), Figures 2.1 and 5.1.
-- Exact 30-degree lattice coordinates: (a+b*sqrt(3), c+d*sqrt(3))/2.
local P,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash")
local M={VERSION="spectre-s-curve-hierarchy-v1"}
local root3=math.sqrt(3)
local names={G="Gamma",D="Delta",T="Theta",L="Lambda",X="Xi",P="Pi",S="Sigma",F="Phi",Y="Psi"}
local inverse={}
for id,name in pairs(names) do inverse[name]=id end
local slots={
  G="PD-TSXFG",D="XDXFSPFG",T="YDPFSPFG",L="YDXFSPFG",X="YDPFSYFG",
  P="YDXFSYFG",S="XDXFSPLG",F="YDYFSPFG",Y="YDYFSYFG",
}
local function point(a,b,c,d) return {a,b,c,d} end
local zero=point(0,0,0,0)
local function add(p,q) return point(p[1]+q[1],p[2]+q[2],p[3]+q[3],p[4]+q[4]) end
local function sub(p,q) return point(p[1]-q[1],p[2]-q[2],p[3]-q[3],p[4]-q[4]) end
local function times(p,s) return point(p[1]*s,p[2]*s,p[3]*s,p[4]*s) end
local function ninety(p) return point(-p[3],-p[4],p[1],p[2]) end
local function mirror(p) return point(-p[1],-p[2],p[3],p[4]) end
local function rotate(p,turn)
  for _=1,turn%12 do
    local a,b,c,d=table.unpack(p)
    assert((3*b-c)%2==0 and (a-d)%2==0 and (a+3*d)%2==0 and (b+c)%2==0,"spectre-lattice-parity")
    p=point((3*b-c)//2,(a-d)//2,(a+3*d)//2,(b+c)//2)
  end
  return p
end
local function map(t,p)
  if t.reflected then p=mirror(p) end
  return add(t.offset,rotate(p,t.turn))
end
local function compose(a,b)
  return {turn=(a.turn+(a.reflected and -b.turn or b.turn))%12,
    reflected=a.reflected~=b.reflected,offset=map(a,b.offset)}
end
local function same(p,q)
  return p[1]==q[1] and p[2]==q[2] and p[3]==q[3] and p[4]==q[4]
end
local function xy(p,denominator)
  local d=denominator or 2
  return {(p[1]+p[2]*root3)/d,(p[3]+p[4]*root3)/d}
end
local function scalar_mul(a,b,c,d)
  return a*c+3*b*d,a*d+b*c
end
local function cross(p,q)
  local a,b=scalar_mul(p[1],p[2],q[3],q[4])
  local c,d=scalar_mul(p[3],p[4],q[1],q[2])
  return a-c,b-d
end
local function sign(a,b)
  if a==0 then return b<0 and -1 or b>0 and 1 or 0 end
  if b==0 or (a<0)==(b<0) then return a<0 and -1 or 1 end
  assert(math.abs(a)<=2^29 and math.abs(b)<=2^29,"spectre-exact-sign-budget")
  local n=a*a-3*b*b
  return ((a<0)==(n>0)) and -1 or 1
end
local function exact_area(poly)
  local a,b=0,0
  local origin=poly[1]
  for i=2,#poly-1 do
    local x,y=cross(sub(poly[i],origin),sub(poly[i+1],origin))
    a,b=a+x,b+y
  end
  return {rational=a,radical=b,denominator=8,radicand=3}
end
local turns={0,10,1,3,0,2,5,7,4,6,6,8,11,9}
local outline={}
local p=zero
for _,t in ipairs(turns) do
  outline[#outline+1]=p
  p=add(p,rotate(point(2,0,0,0),t))
end
assert(same(p,zero),"spectre-prototype-closure")
local unit_area=exact_area(outline)
assert(sign(unit_area.rational,unit_area.radical)>0,"spectre-prototype-orientation")
local base_quad={outline[4],outline[6],outline[8],outline[12]}
local joins={{2,4,2},{0,3,1},{2,4,2},{2,4,2},{0,3,1},{2,4,2},{-4,4,4}}
local next_anchors={{7,3},{6,2},{4,3},{1,2}}

local function levels(depth)
  local quad=base_quad
  local result={}
  for i=1,depth do
    local placed={{turn=0,reflected=false,offset=zero}}
    for j,join in ipairs(joins) do
      local previous=placed[j]
      local turn=(previous.turn+join[1])%12
      local vertex=map(previous,quad[join[2]])
      placed[j+1]={turn=turn,reflected=false,offset=sub(vertex,rotate(quad[join[3]],turn))}
      assert(same(map(placed[j+1],quad[join[3]]),vertex),"spectre-slot-anchor")
    end
    local reflect={turn=0,reflected=true,offset=zero}
    for j,t in ipairs(placed) do placed[j]=compose(reflect,t) end
    local next_quad={}
    for j,mark in ipairs(next_anchors) do next_quad[j]=map(placed[mark[1]],quad[mark[2]]) end
    result[i]={children=placed,quad=next_quad}
    quad=next_quad
  end
  return result
end
local function round(x) return math.floor(x*1e6+.5) end
local function full(depth,root_type,context)
  local root=assert(inverse[root_type],"spectre-root-type")
  assert(type(depth)=="number" and depth%1==0 and depth>=1 and depth<=3,"spectre-root-depth")
  local rules=levels(depth)
  local leaves,nodes,reference={},{},{}
  local function emit(t,name,address,parent)
    assert(not t.reflected,"spectre-illicit-reflected-leaf")
    if context then context:consume("operations",#outline) end
    local vertices,row={},{}
    for i,v in ipairs(outline) do
      vertices[i]=map(t,v)
      local a=xy(vertices[i])
      row[i]={round(a[1]),round(a[2])}
    end
    reference[#reference+1]={name,row}
    leaves[#leaves+1]={address=address,parent=parent,transform=t,vertices=vertices,label=name,ordinal=#leaves+1}
  end
  local function walk(t,typ,depth,address,parent)
    if context then context:consume("objects",1) end
    if depth==0 and typ~="G" then emit(t,names[typ],address,parent);return end
    local n={address=address,parent=parent,type=names[typ],level=depth,transform=t,children={}}
    nodes[address]=n
    if depth==0 then
      n.children={{address=address.."a",kind="leaf"},{address=address.."b",kind="leaf"}}
      emit(t,"Gamma1",address.."a",address)
      emit(compose(t,{turn=1,reflected=false,offset=outline[9]}),"Gamma2",address.."b",address)
    else
      for slot=1,8 do
        local child=slots[typ]:sub(slot,slot)
        if child~="-" then
          local id=address..slot
          n.children[#n.children+1]={address=id,kind=(depth==1 and child~="G") and "leaf" or "node"}
          walk(compose(t,rules[depth].children[slot]),child,depth-1,id,address)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  walk({turn=0,reflected=depth%2==1,offset=zero},root,depth,"r")
  return leaves,nodes,H.sha256(P.serialize(reference)),rules
end
function M.reference(depth,root)
  local leaves,_,digest=full(depth,root)
  return {count=#leaves,digest=digest,area=unit_area}
end
local function key(p) return table.concat(p,"/") end
local function sorted_keys(map)
  local out={}
  for k in pairs(map) do out[#out+1]=k end
  table.sort(out,P.byte_less)
  return out
end
local function edge_key(a,b)
  if P.byte_less(b,a) then return b.."+"..a,true end
  return a.."+"..b,false
end
local function controls(a,b)
  local d=sub(b,a)
  local n=ninety(d)
  return add(add(times(a,96),times(d,32)),times(n,6)),
    sub(add(times(a,96),times(d,64)),times(n,6))
end
local function bounds(poly,denominator)
  local b={math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge}
  for _,v in ipairs(poly) do
    local q=xy(v,denominator)
    b[1],b[2]=math.min(b[1],q[1]),math.min(b[2],q[2])
    b[3],b[4]=math.max(b[3],q[1]),math.max(b[4],q[2])
  end
  return b
end
local function grow(b,m)
  return {b[1]-m,b[2]-m,b[3]+m,b[4]+m}
end
local function meet(a,b,pad)
  return a[1]-pad<=b[3] and a[3]+pad>=b[1] and a[2]-pad<=b[4] and a[4]+pad>=b[2]
end
local function less(a,b) return sign(a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2])<0 end
local function projection(hull,origin,axis)
  local lo,hi
  for _,p in ipairs(hull) do
    local a,b=cross(axis,sub(p,origin))
    local value={a,b}
    if not lo or less(value,lo) then lo=value end
    if not hi or less(hi,value) then hi=value end
  end
  return lo,hi
end
local function separated(p,q,touch)
  for _,hull in ipairs{p,q} do
    for i,o in ipairs(hull) do
      local axis=sub(hull[i%#hull+1],o)
      local alo,ahi=projection(p,o,axis)
      local blo,bhi=projection(q,o,axis)
      local left=sign(ahi[1]-blo[1],ahi[2]-blo[2])
      local right=sign(bhi[1]-alo[1],bhi[2]-alo[2])
      if left<0 or right<0 or touch and (left==0 or right==0) then return true end
    end
  end
  return false
end
local function validate_hulls(edges,context)
  local sequence={}
  for _,e in pairs(edges) do
    local a,b=times(e.a,96),times(e.b,96)
    e.hull={a,e.c2,b,e.c1}
    e.box=bounds(e.hull,192)
    sequence[#sequence+1]=e
  end
  table.sort(sequence,function(a,b)
    if a.box[1]==b.box[1] then return P.byte_less(a.id,b.id) end
    return a.box[1]<b.box[1]
  end)
  local tests=0
  for i,a in ipairs(sequence) do
    for j=i+1,#sequence do
      local b=sequence[j]
      if b.box[1]>a.box[3]+1e-10 then break end
      if meet(a.box,b.box,1e-10) then
        local shared=same(a.a,b.a) or same(a.a,b.b) or same(a.b,b.a) or same(a.b,b.b)
        assert(separated(a.hull,b.hull,shared),"spectre-curve-hull-intersection:"..a.id.."+"..b.id)
        tests=tests+1
      end
    end
  end
  if context then context:consume("operations",tests) end
  return tests
end
local function global_complex(leaves,context)
  local points,edges,duplicates={},{},{}
  for _,leaf in ipairs(leaves) do
    local ids={}
    for i,p in ipairs(leaf.vertices) do ids[i]=key(p);points[ids[i]]=p end
    local signature={table.unpack(ids)}
    table.sort(signature,P.byte_less)
    signature=table.concat(signature,"+")
    assert(not duplicates[signature],"spectre-duplicate-tile")
    duplicates[signature]=true
    leaf.uses={}
    leaf.box=bounds(leaf.vertices)
    for i,a in ipairs(ids) do
      local b=ids[i%#ids+1]
      local id,reversed=edge_key(a,b)
      local e=edges[id]
      if not e then
        local p,q=points[reversed and b or a],points[reversed and a or b]
        local c1,c2=controls(p,q)
        e={id=id,from=reversed and b or a,to=reversed and a or b,a=p,b=q,c1=c1,c2=c2,uses={}}
        edges[id]=e
      end
      assert(#e.uses<2 and (#e.uses==0 or e.uses[1].reversed~=reversed),"spectre-edge-pairing")
      e.uses[#e.uses+1]={address=leaf.address,reversed=reversed}
      leaf.uses[i]={id=id,reversed=reversed}
    end

  local outside,inside=0,0
  local area_a,area_b=0,0
  for _,leaf in ipairs(leaves) do adjacency[leaf.address]={} end
  for _,e in pairs(edges) do
    if #e.uses==1 then
      outside=outside+1
      local rev=e.uses[1].reversed
      local p,q=rev and e.b or e.a,rev and e.a or e.b

      area_a,area_b=area_a+a,area_b+b
      local s,t=key(p),key(q)
      balance[s]=(balance[s] or 0)+1
      balance[t]=(balance[t] or 0)-1
    else
      inside=inside+1
      local a,b=e.uses[1].address,e.uses[2].address
      adjacency[a][#adjacency[a]+1]=b
      adjacency[b][#adjacency[b]+1]=a
    end

  local first=leaves[1].address
  local seen,queue={[first]=true},{first}
  local i=1
  while i<=#queue do
    for _,id in ipairs(adjacency[queue[i]]) do
      if not seen[id] then seen[id]=true;queue[#queue+1]=id end
    end
    i=i+1
  end
  assert(#queue==#leaves,"spectre-disconnected-root")
  local pairs=validate_hulls(edges,context)
  return points,edges,{root_boundary_edges=outside,root_shared_edges=inside,hull_pairs=pairs,
    root_area={rational=area_a,radical=area_b,denominator=8,radicand=3}}
end
function M.check_root(depth,kind)
  local leaves,_,digest=full(depth,kind)
  local _,_,proof=global_complex(leaves)
  return {leaves=#leaves,digest=digest,proof=proof}
end
local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge end
local function patch(request,context)
  local depth,root=request.depth,request.root
  local leaves,nodes,reference,rules=full(depth,root,context)

  local frame=request.frame
  local origin=frame.origin

  assert(finite(step) and step>=.1 and step<=2,"spectre-edge-length")
  assert(frame.unit=="cm" and frame.dimension==2 and frame.handedness=="right","spectre-frame")
  assert(request.boundary=="spectre-s" or request.boundary=="tile-1-1","spectre-boundary-profile")
  local whole=request.whole_root
  local query={}
  for i,q in ipairs(request.world_query) do
    query[i]=(q-origin[(i-1)%2+1])/step
    assert(finite(query[i]) and math.abs(query[i])<=4096,"spectre-query-coordinate")
  end
  local halo=request.halo
  assert(finite(halo) and halo>=4 and halo<=8,"spectre-query-halo")
  local expanded=grow(query,halo)
  local prefix="spectre/"..H.value("spectre/finite-root",{depth=depth,root=root,frame=frame,step_cm=step,method=M.VERSION})
  local function tile_id(a) return prefix.."/tile/"..a end
  local function node_id(a) return prefix.."/cluster/"..a end
  local function vertex_id(a) return prefix.."/v/"..a end
  local function edge_id(a) return prefix.."/e/"..a end

    local v=xy(exact,denominator)
    return {origin[1]+step*v[1],origin[2]+step*v[2]}
  end
  local selected,ancestors,kept_edges,kept_vertices={},{},{},{}
  local cells,boundaries,vertices,hierarchy=P.array(),P.array(),P.array(),P.array()
  for _,leaf in ipairs(leaves) do
    if whole or meet(leaf.box,expanded,.063) then
      selected[leaf.address]=true
      local a=leaf.parent
      while a do ancestors[a]=true;a=nodes[a].parent end
      local b=P.array()

        kept_edges[use.id]=true
        b[i]={edge=edge_id(use.id),reversed=use.reversed,prototype_edge=i}
      end
      local t=leaf.transform
      cells[#cells+1]={id=tile_id(leaf.address),prototype="tile-1-1-equilateral",chirality=1,address=leaf.address,
        lineage_label=leaf.label,reference_ordinal=leaf.ordinal,parent=node_id(leaf.parent),boundary=b,
        exact_transform=t,isometry={rotation_degrees=30*t.turn,reflection=false,translation=world(t.offset)}}
    end

  assert(#cells>0 and #cells<=200,"spectre-selected-cell-budget")
  local cuts=0

    local e=edges[key]
    local global,local_={},{}

      local id=tile_id(use.address)
      global[#global+1]=id
      if selected[use.address] then local_[#local_+1]=id end
    end
    table.sort(global,P.byte_less);table.sort(local_,P.byte_less)

    if reason=="query_cut" then cuts=cuts+1 end
    kept_vertices[e.from],kept_vertices[e.to]=true,true
    local cubic

      cubic={kind="centrally_symmetric_cubic",denominator=192,control1=e.c1,control2=e.c2}
    end
    boundaries[#boundaries+1]={id=edge_id(key),from=vertex_id(e.from),to=vertex_id(e.to),owner=local_[1],
      role=internal and "interior" or "patch_boundary",boundary_reason=reason,global_owner=global[1],global_cells=global,curve=cubic}
  end
  for _,k in ipairs(sorted_keys(kept_vertices)) do
    vertices[#vertices+1]={id=vertex_id(k),point=world(points[k]),lattice=points[k]}
  end
  for _,a in ipairs(sorted_keys(ancestors)) do
    local node=nodes[a]
    local members,complete=P.array(),P.array()
    for _,child in ipairs(node.children) do
      local id=child.kind=="leaf" and tile_id(child.address) or node_id(child.address)
      complete[#complete+1]=id
      if selected[child.address] or ancestors[child.address] then members[#members+1]=id end
    end
    hierarchy[#hierarchy+1]={id=node_id(a),address=a,type=node.type,level=node.level,
      parent=node.parent and node_id(node.parent) or nil,children=members,source_children=complete,
      exact_transform=node.transform}
  end
  if context then context:consume("objects",#cells+#boundaries+#vertices+#hierarchy) end
  local certificate={method=M.VERSION,source="Smith, Myers, Kaplan and Goodman-Strauss 2024, Figures 2.1 and 5.1; Lemma 2.1",
    root_type=root,depth=depth,frame=P.plain(frame),normalized_odd_depth_reflection=depth%2==1,
    geometry_case=request.boundary=="spectre-s" and "strictly_chiral_s_curve_spectre" or "weakly_chiral_tile_1_1_diagnostic",
    strictly_chiral=request.boundary=="spectre-s",finite=true,root_leaf_count=#leaves,selected_leaf_count=#cells,
    exact_outline=P.plain(outline),unit_area=unit_area,root_complex=proof,reference_coordinate_digest=reference,
    root_quad=rules[depth].quad,halo_edge_units=halo,query_cuts=cuts,normalized_query=query,
    control_profile={tangent_offset={1,16},evaluation_tolerance_cm=1e-10,central_symmetry=true,exact_coefficient_denominator=192,
      world_realization="binary64 coordinates from exact quadratic coefficients"},
    hypotheses={"one chirality at leaf level","source cluster joins","whole unit edges","centrally symmetric edge replacement"},
    checks={"exact source slot anchors and transforms","homochiral leaves and duplicate rejection","paired unit edge incidence",
      "closed root boundary and exact area correspondence","exact cubic control hull separation","fixed root query and lineage"}}
  return {prefix=prefix,tiling={cells=cells,edges=boundaries,vertices=vertices,hierarchy=hierarchy},certificate=certificate}
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="tiling/spectre",version="1",family="spectre-marked-hierarchy",units="cm",capabilities={"tiling"},
    parameters={depth={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=3,required=true},
      root={type="string",enum={"Gamma","Delta","Theta","Lambda","Xi","Pi","Sigma","Phi","Psi"}},
      edge_length={type="number",minimum=.1,maximum=2,required=true},
      boundary={type="string",enum={"spectre-s","tile-1-1"}},whole_root={type="boolean"},
      halo={type="number",minimum=4,maximum=8}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Published marked hierarchy on a bounded root; no mixed reflected leaves",
      "A centrally symmetric smooth S curve is the genuine Spectre case",
      "Straight Tile(1,1) is a separately identified diagnostic; the Hat is distinct"}})
end
local function provider()
  local routes=require("pattern_aperiodic").route_registry()
  routes.register("hierarchical_substitution",{construct=patch,validate=function(x)
    return #x.tiling.cells==x.certificate.selected_leaf_count and x.certificate.root_complex.hull_pairs>0
  end})
  return routes
end
local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.spectre
  local routes=provider()
  assert(e.route=="hierarchical_substitution" and P.serialize(e.capabilities)==P.serialize(routes.capabilities()),
    "spectre-route-certificate")
  local t=x.structures.tiling
  local vertices={}
  for _,v in ipairs(t.vertices) do vertices[v.id]=v.lattice end
  for _,c in ipairs(t.cells) do
    assert(c.chirality==1 and c.isometry.reflection==false and c.exact_transform.reflected==false,
      "spectre-illicit-reflected-leaf")
  end
  for _,edge in ipairs(t.edges) do
    if e.request.boundary=="spectre-s" then
      local a,b=controls(vertices[edge.from],vertices[edge.to])
      local q=edge.curve
      assert(q and q.denominator==192 and same(q.control1,a) and same(q.control2,b),"spectre-incorrectly-paired-curve")
    else
      assert(not edge.curve,"spectre-straight-diagnostic-curve")
    end
  end
  assert(P.serialize(e.request.frame)==P.serialize(x.frame),"spectre-fixed-frame")
  local result=routes.construct(e.route,P.plain(e.request))
  assert(P.serialize(result.tiling)==P.serialize(t),"spectre-source-hierarchy-reconstruction")
  assert(P.serialize(result.certificate)==P.serialize(e.certificate),"spectre-source-certificate")
  return {ok=true,checks=P.plain(e.certificate.checks),construction=P.plain(e.certificate)}
end
function M.validate(x) return validate(P.instance(P.plain(x),M.definition())) end

local palette={
  Gamma1={.74,.52,.30},Gamma2={.85,.68,.36},Delta={.34,.58,.58},Theta={.64,.43,.38},
  Lambda={.50,.55,.74},Xi={.31,.49,.64},Pi={.64,.70,.64},Sigma={.46,.61,.43},Phi={.57,.58,.72},Psi={.76,.67,.55},
}
local function lower(x,v,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="stroke_width" or k=="display","spectre-style:"..k) end
  local display=style.display or "lineage"
  assert(display=="lineage" or display=="uniform","spectre-display")
  local width=style.stroke_width or .010
  assert(finite(width) and width>0 and width<.1,"spectre-stroke-width")
  local G=require("pattern_geometry")
  local request=x.extensions.spectre.request
  local origin=request.frame.origin
  local step=request.step_cm
  local m=P.plain(v.transform)
  local crop=v.crop
  if not request.whole_root then
    local inverse=G.inverse(m,G.policy("cm",step))
    local q=request.world_query
    for _,corner in ipairs{{crop[1],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[2]},{crop[3],crop[4]},{crop[1],crop[4]}} do
      local a=G.transform(corner,inverse)
      assert(a[1]>=q[1]-1e-10 and a[1]<=q[3]+1e-10 and a[2]>=q[2]-1e-10 and a[2]<=q[4]+1e-10,
        "spectre-view-outside-query")
    end
  end
  local function world_control(p)
    local a=xy(p,192)
    return {origin[1]+step*a[1],origin[2]+step*a[2]}
  end
  local points,edges,ops={},{},{}
  local tiling=x.structures.tiling
  for _,a in ipairs(tiling.vertices) do points[a.id]=a.point end
  local function expand(box,p)
    local a=G.transform(p,m)
    box[1],box[2]=math.min(box[1],a[1]),math.min(box[2],a[2])
    box[3],box[4]=math.max(box[3],a[1]),math.max(box[4],a[2])
  end
  local function empty_box() return {math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge} end
  for _,e in ipairs(tiling.edges) do
    local a,b=points[e.from],points[e.to]
    local q={a=a,b=b,box=empty_box()}
    expand(q.box,a);expand(q.box,b)
    if e.curve then
      q.c1,q.c2=world_control(e.curve.control1),world_control(e.curve.control2)
      expand(q.box,q.c1);expand(q.box,q.c2)
    end
    edges[e.id]=q
  end
  local function append(commands,e,reversed)
    local b=reversed and e.a or e.b
    if e.c1 then
      local p,q=e.c1,e.c2
      if reversed then p,q=q,p end
      commands[#commands+1]={"C",p[1],p[2],q[1],q[2],b[1],b[2]}
    else commands[#commands+1]={"L",b[1],b[2]} end
  end
  for _,c in ipairs(tiling.cells) do
    local b=empty_box()
    for _,use in ipairs(c.boundary) do
      local e=edges[use.edge].box
      b[1],b[2]=math.min(b[1],e[1]),math.min(b[2],e[2])
      b[3],b[4]=math.max(b[3],e[3]),math.max(b[4],e[4])
    end
    if meet(b,crop,0) then
      local use=c.boundary[1]
      local edge=edges[use.edge]
      local a=use.reversed and edge.b or edge.a
      local commands={{"M",a[1],a[2]}}
      for _,u in ipairs(c.boundary) do append(commands,edges[u.edge],u.reversed) end
      commands[#commands+1]={"Z"}
      ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=c.id,commands=commands,transform=m,
        paint={fill=display=="lineage" and palette[c.lineage_label] or {.67,.74,.78}}}
    end
  end
  local pad=width*math.sqrt(m[1]^2+m[2]^2+m[3]^2+m[4]^2)
  for _,e in ipairs(tiling.edges) do
    local q=edges[e.id]
    if meet(q.box,crop,pad) then
      local commands={{"M",q.a[1],q.a[2]}}
      append(commands,q,false)
      ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=e.id,commands=commands,transform=m,
        paint={stroke={.08,.15,.21},stroke_width=width}}
    end
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
    clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)},operations=ops,resources=P.array()}
end

function M.register(registry)
  local d=M.definition()
  local r=provider()
  registry:register(d,{generate=function(s,c)
    local p=s.parameters
    local request={depth=p.depth,root=p.root or "Gamma",step_cm=p.edge_length,boundary=p.boundary or "spectre-s",
      whole_root=p.whole_root or false,halo=p.halo or 4,frame=P.plain(c.frame),world_query=P.plain(s.document.bounds)}
    local result=r.construct("hierarchical_substitution",request,c)
    return {id=result.prefix.."/query/"..H.value("spectre/finite-view-selection",request),
      definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={tiling=result.tiling},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={spectre={route="hierarchical_substitution",request=request,certificate=result.certificate,
        capabilities=P.plain(r.capabilities())}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end
return M

-- Immutable cache files. Lock directory and temporary bytes share destination volume.
-- Host adapters must provide atomic mkdir and same-volume rename; no unsafe fallback.
local H,P=require("pattern_hash"),require("pattern")
local M={}
function M.new(directory,host)
  assert(type(directory)=="string" and #directory>0,"cache directory required")
  if not host then local lfs=require("lfs");host={mkdir=lfs.mkdir,rmdir=lfs.rmdir,rename=os.rename,remove=os.remove,open=io.open} end
  for _,k in ipairs({"mkdir","rmdir","rename","remove","open"}) do assert(type(host[k])=="function","atomic store host lacks "..k) end
  local function filename(key) assert(H.is_digest(key),"cache key must be SHA-256");return directory.."/"..key..".json" end
  local store={}
  function store:get(key)
    local file,err,errno=host.open(filename(key),"rb");if not file then return nil,errno==2 and "missing" or "unreadable cache entry: "..tostring(err) end
    local bytes=file:read(2*1024*1024+1);file:close()
    if #bytes>2*1024*1024 then return nil,"oversized cache entry" end
    local ok,entry=pcall(require("pattern_parse").decode,bytes)
    if not ok or type(entry)~="table" or entry.kind~="cache_entry" or entry.schema_version~=1 or entry.key~=key or type(entry.payload)~="string" or not H.is_digest(entry.sha256) or H.sha256(entry.payload)~=entry.sha256 then
      return nil,"invalid or incomplete cache entry"
    end
    return entry.payload
  end
  function store:put(key,payload)
    assert(type(payload)=="string" and #payload<=1024*1024,"cache payload must be UTF-8 data within 1 MiB")
    local final=filename(key);local lock=final..".lock";local temp=lock.."/payload.tmp"
    local acquired,why=host.mkdir(lock);if not acquired then return nil,"cache writer busy or stale lock: "..tostring(why) end
    local ok,result=pcall(function()
      local existing,reason=self:get(key)
      if existing then assert(existing==payload,"cache key collision or nondeterministic output");return true end
      assert(reason=="missing","existing cache entry is corrupt; explicit quarantine required")
      local entry=P.serialize({kind="cache_entry",schema_version=1,key=key,sha256=H.sha256(payload),payload=payload})
      assert(#entry<=2*1024*1024,"escaped cache entry exceeds 2 MiB")
      local f=assert(host.open(temp,"wb"));local wrote,err=f:write(entry);local flushed,fe=f:flush();local closed,ce=f:close()
      assert(wrote and flushed and closed,err or fe or ce or "cache write failed")
      local check=assert(host.open(temp,"rb"));local actual=check:read("*a");check:close();assert(actual==entry,"cache write verification failed")
      assert(host.rename(temp,final));return true
    end)
    host.remove(temp);local removed,cleanup=host.rmdir(lock)
    if not ok then return nil,tostring(result) end
    if not removed then return nil,"cache published but lock cleanup failed: "..tostring(cleanup) end
    return result
  end
  return store
end
return M

local P,H=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash")
local F,X=require("pattern_stroke_field"),require("pattern_stroke_examples")
local M={VERSION="bounded-stroke-textures-v1"}
local min,max,sqrt=math.min,math.max,math.sqrt
local ink={.12,.19,.26}

local function site_grid(f,spacing,padding)
  local x0,y0,x1,y1=table.unpack(f.bounds)
  local nx,ny=math.floor((x1-x0)/spacing),math.floor((y1-y0)/spacing)
  assert(nx*ny<=2500,"stroke-seed-grid-budget")
  local sites={}
  for j=1,ny do
    for i=1,nx do
      local p={x0+(i-.5)*(x1-x0)/nx,y0+(j-.5)*(y1-y0)/ny}
      if F.admissible(f,p,p,padding) then sites[#sites+1]=p end
    end
  end
  local cx,cy=(x0+x1)/2,(y0+y1)/2
  table.sort(sites,function(a,b)
    local da,db=(a[1]-cx)^2+(a[2]-cy)^2,(b[1]-cx)^2+(b[2]-cy)^2
    if da==db then
      if a[2]==b[2] then return a[1]<b[1] end
      return a[2]<b[2]
    end
    return da<db
  end)
  return sites
end

local function hatching(f,a,c)
  local strokes,stops,segments=P.array(),P.array(),{}
  local function separated(p,q,own)
    for _,s in ipairs(segments) do
      c:consume("operations",1)
      if F.segment_gap2(p,q,s[1],s[2])<(a.spacing+a.width)^2 then return false end
    end
    for j=1,#own-3 do
      c:consume("operations",1)
      if F.segment_gap2(p,q,own[j],own[j+1])<(a.step*.8)^2 then return false end
    end
    return true
  end
  for _,seed in ipairs(site_grid(f,a.spacing,a.width/2)) do
    if #strokes>=a.count then break end
    local forward=F.integrate(f,seed,a.step,a.steps,a.width/2,{segment=separated})
    local backward=F.integrate(f,seed,a.step,a.steps,a.width/2,{reverse=true,segment=function(p,q,own)
      if not separated(p,q,own) then return false end
      for j=3,#forward.points-1 do
        c:consume("operations",1)
        if F.segment_gap2(p,q,forward.points[j],forward.points[j+1])<(a.step*.8)^2 then return false end
      end
      return true
    end})
    stops[#stops+1]={seed=seed,forward=forward.stop,backward=backward.stop}
    local points={}
    for j=#backward.points,2,-1 do points[#points+1]=backward.points[j] end
    for _,p in ipairs(forward.points) do points[#points+1]=p end
    if #points>=3 then
      strokes[#strokes+1]={points=points,width=a.width,color=ink,role="stroke",site=#stops}
      for j=1,#points-1 do segments[#segments+1]={points[j],points[j+1]} end
    end
  end
  return strokes,{stops=stops}
end

local function stippling(f,a,c)
  local rng=c:stream("stippling","density")
  local out=P.array()
  local l,b,r,t=table.unpack(f.bounds)
  local attempted=0
  local rejection={density=0,domain=0,spacing=0}
  for i=1,a.attempts do
    attempted=i
    local p={l+(r-l)*rng.u(),b+(t-b)*rng.u()}
    if rng.u()>F.density(f,p) then rejection.density=rejection.density+1
    elseif not F.admissible(f,p,p,a.width/2) then rejection.domain=rejection.domain+1
    else
      local fits=true
      for _,s in ipairs(out) do
        c:consume("operations",1)
        if F.distance2(p,s.points[1],s.points[1])<(a.spacing+a.width)^2 then fits=false;break end
      end
      if fits then
        out[#out+1]={points={p},width=a.width,color=ink,role="dot",site=i}
        if #out==a.count then break end
      else rejection.spacing=rejection.spacing+1 end
    end
  end
  return out,{attempted=attempted,rejections=rejection,status=#out==a.count and "complete" or "attempt_budget"}
end

local function shifted_grid(f,a,rng,data,c)
  local g=site_grid(f,a.spacing,.01)
  local sites={}
  for i,p in ipairs(g) do
    local q={p[1]+(rng.u()-.5)*a.spacing*.55,p[2]+(rng.u()-.5)*a.spacing*.55}
    sites[i]=F.admissible(f,q,q,.01) and q or p
    if i>=a.count then break end
  end
  local trace=P.array()
  if a.profile=="group" and #sites>=2 then
    local function ratio(distances)
      local sum,square=0,0
      for _,v in ipairs(distances) do sum,square=sum+v,square+v*v end
      local mean=sum/#distances
      return sqrt(max(0,square/#distances-mean*mean))/mean
    end
    local observed={}
    for i,p in ipairs(data.relations) do observed[i]=p.proximity end
    local target=ratio(observed)
    local grid=site_grid(f,max(a.spacing/3,.10),.01)
    for k=0,a.relax do
      local distances={}
      for i,p in ipairs(sites) do
        local best=math.huge
        for j,q in ipairs(sites) do
          if i~=j then best=min(best,F.distance2(p,q,q)) end
        end
        distances[i]=sqrt(best)
      end
      local variance=ratio(distances)
      trace[#trace+1]={iteration=k,relative_deviation=variance,target=target}
      if variance<=target or k==a.relax then break end
      local acc={}
      for i=1,#sites do acc[i]={0,0,0} end
      for _,p in ipairs(grid) do
        local winner,d=1,math.huge
        for j,q in ipairs(sites) do
          local ds=F.distance2(p,q,q)
          if ds<d then winner,d=j,ds end
        end
        local x=acc[winner]
        x[1],x[2],x[3]=x[1]+p[1],x[2]+p[2],x[3]+1
      end
      c:consume("operations",#grid*#sites)
      for i,x in ipairs(acc) do
        if x[3]>0 then
          local p={x[1]/x[3],x[2]/x[3]}
          if F.admissible(f,sites[i],p,.01) then sites[i]=p end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return sites,trace
end

local function synthesis(f,a,raw,c)
  local data=X.analyze(raw,a.cluster)
  local rng=c:stream("example","stroke-groups")
  local sites,relaxation=shifted_grid(f,a,rng,data,c)
  local previous={}
  local function allowed(strokes,element)
    local candidates={}
    for _,s in ipairs(strokes) do
      for j=1,max(1,#s.points-1) do
        local p,q=s.points[j],s.points[j+1] or s.points[j]
        if not F.admissible(f,p,q,s.width/2) then return false end
        for _,v in ipairs(previous) do
          c:consume("operations",1)
          if F.segment_gap2(p,q,v[1],v[2])<(a.clearance+(s.width+v[3])/2)^2 then return false end
        end
        candidates[#candidates+1]={p,q,s.width}
      end
    end
    for _,v in ipairs(candidates) do previous[#previous+1]=v end
    return true
  end
  local elements,strokes,decisions=X.synthesize(data,sites,a,rng,allowed)
  return P.array(strokes),{analysis=data,decisions=P.array(decisions),elements=P.array(elements),relaxation=relaxation}
end

local function controls(p)
  return {mode=p.mode,count=p.count,spacing=p.spacing,width=p.width or .028,step=p.step or .055,
    steps=p.steps or 32,attempts=p.attempts or 3000,profile=p.profile or "causal",behavior=p.behavior or "cloning",
    cluster=p.cluster or .10,scale=p.scale or 1,radius=p.radius or .9,threshold=p.threshold or .7,
    correction=p.correction or .45,relax=p.relax or 4,clearance=p.clearance or .018}
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="stroke/fields-and-examples",version="1",family="stroke-field-texture",
    units="cm",capabilities={"field"},parameters={
      mode={type="string",enum={"hatching","stippling","example"},required=true},
      count={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=300,required=true},
      spacing={type="number",minimum=.05,maximum=2,required=true},
      width={type="number",minimum=.008,maximum=.2},step={type="number",minimum=.015,maximum=.2},
      steps={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=75},attempts={type="integer",minimum=1,maximum=15000},
      profile={type="string",enum={"causal","group","independent"}},
      behavior={type="string",enum={"sampling","copying","cloning"}},
      cluster={type="number",minimum=.01,maximum=.5},scale={type="number",minimum=.4,maximum=2.5},
      radius={type="number",minimum=.2,maximum=3},threshold={type="number",minimum=.05,maximum=3},
      correction={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=1},relax={type="integer",minimum=0,maximum=12},
      clearance={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=.2}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Centimeter analytic direction and density fields with circular holes",
      "Bounded midpoint streamlines, separated stipples and independently analyzed stroke examples",
      "Greedy example elements, causal neighbor matching, and nearest-pair group behaviors"}})
end

local function field(s)
  assert(next(P.plain(s.constraints))==nil,"stroke-unsupported-constraints")
  for k in pairs(s.inputs) do assert(k=="field" or k=="holes" or k=="example","stroke-input:"..k) end
  assert((s.parameters.mode=="example")== (s.inputs.example~=nil),"stroke-example-mode")
  local f=F.new(s.document.bounds,s.inputs.holes,s.inputs.field)
  assert(f.bounds[3]-f.bounds[1]<=12 and f.bounds[4]-f.bounds[2]<=12,"stroke-field-size")
  return f
end

local function samples(strokes,f)
  local out=P.array()
  for i,s in ipairs(strokes) do
    local p=s.points[1]
    local v=F.direction(f,p) or {0,0}
    out[i]={id="stroke/mark/"..i,point=p,vector=v,density=F.density(f,p)}
  end
  return {representation="samples",domain={bounds=f.bounds},samples=out}
end

local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.stroke
  assert(P.serialize(samples(e.strokes,e.field))==P.serialize(x.structures.field),"stroke-field-reconstruction")
  for _,s in ipairs(e.strokes) do
    assert(#s.points>=1 and s.width>0,"stroke-empty-mark")
    for j=1,max(1,#s.points-1) do
      assert(F.admissible(e.field,s.points[j],s.points[j+1] or s.points[j],s.width/2),"stroke-outside-domain")
    end
  end
  return {ok=true,checks={"Stroke segments and ink radius remain admissible","Field samples reconstructed from stroke geometry"}}
end

local function circle(p,r)
  local x,y=p[1],p[2]
  local k=.5522847498307936*r
  return {{"M",x+r,y},{"C",x+r,y+k,x+k,y+r,x,y+r},{"C",x-k,y+r,x-r,y+k,x-r,y},
    {"C",x-r,y-k,x-k,y-r,x,y-r},{"C",x+k,y-r,x+r,y-k,x+r,y},{"Z"}}
end

local function lower(x,v,style)
  assert(next(P.plain(style))==nil,"stroke-unsupported-style")
  local ops=P.array()
  for i,s in ipairs(x.extensions.stroke.strokes) do
    local path,paint
    if s.role=="dot" then path,paint=circle(s.points[1],s.width/2),{fill=s.color}
    else
      path={}
      for j,p in ipairs(s.points) do path[j]={j==1 and "M" or "L",p[1],p[2]} end
      paint={stroke=s.color,stroke_width=s.width,cap="round",join="round"}
    end
    ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref="stroke/mark/"..i,commands=path,transform=P.plain(v.transform),paint=paint}
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,operations=ops,
    resources=P.array(),clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)}}
end

function M.register(reg)
  local d=M.definition()
  reg:register(d,{validate_inputs=function(s) field(s);return true end,generate=function(s,c)
    local f,a=field(s),controls(s.parameters)
    local strokes,trace
    if a.mode=="hatching" then strokes,trace=hatching(f,a,c)
    elseif a.mode=="stippling" then strokes,trace=stippling(f,a,c)
    else strokes,trace=synthesis(f,a,s.inputs.example,c) end
    return {id="stroke/"..H.value("stroke/instance",{field=f,controls=a,seed=s.seed,example=P.plain(s.inputs.example),method=M.VERSION}),
      definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={field=samples(strokes,f)},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={stroke={field=f,controls=a,strokes=strokes,trace=trace}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end

return M

local F=require("pattern_stroke_field")
local M={VERSION="perceptual-stroke-groups-v1"}
local abs,sqrt,min,max,pi=math.abs,math.sqrt,math.min,math.max,math.pi

-- Rank near-equal measurements in fixed bins before breaking ties by declaration order.
local function rank(x)
  return math.floor(x*1e9+.5)
end

local function gap(a,b)
  return sqrt((a[1]-b[1])^2+(a[2]-b[2])^2)
end

local function fit(strokes,indices)
  local cx,cy,n,ink=0,0,0,0
  local dots=true
  for _,i in ipairs(indices) do
    local s=strokes[i]
    ink=max(ink,s.width)
    dots=dots and #s.points==1
    for _,p in ipairs(s.points) do cx,cy,n=cx+p[1],cy+p[2],n+1 end
  end
  cx,cy=cx/n,cy/n
  local a,b,c=0,0,0
  for _,i in ipairs(indices) do
    for _,p in ipairs(strokes[i].points) do
      local x,y=p[1]-cx,p[2]-cy
      a,b,c=a+x*x,b+x*y,c+y*y
    end
  end
  local angle=.5*math.atan(2*b,a-c)
  local u,v=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
  local l,d,r,t=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
  for _,i in ipairs(indices) do
    for _,p in ipairs(strokes[i].points) do
      local x,y=p[1]*u+p[2]*v,p[2]*u-p[1]*v
      l,d,r,t=min(l,x),min(d,y),max(r,x),max(t,y)
    end
  end
  local x,y=(l+r)/2,(d+t)/2
  local color=strokes[indices[1]].color
  return {center={x*u-y*v,x*v+y*u},angle=angle,length=r-l+ink,width=t-d+ink,
    color=color,kind=dots and "point" or "line",members=indices,group=strokes[indices[1]].group}
end

local function angle_gap(a,b)
  return abs((a-b+pi/2)%pi-pi/2)
end

local function relation(a,b)
  local dx,dy=b.center[1]-a.center[1],b.center[2]-a.center[2]
  local turn=(b.angle-a.angle+pi/2)%pi-pi/2
  local angle=a.angle+turn/2
  local u,v=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
  local along,across=dx*u+dy*v,dy*u-dx*v
  local projected=(a.length+b.length)*math.cos(turn/2)
  local r={proximity=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy),offset={dx,dy},along=along,across=across}
  if a.kind=="line" and b.kind=="line" then
    r.parallelism,r.overlap,r.separation=2*abs(turn)/pi,2*abs(along)/projected,abs(across)
  end
  return r
end

local function nearest(elements,i,group)
  local best,other=math.huge
  for j,v in ipairs(elements) do
    if j~=i and (not group or v.group==elements[i].group) then
      local d=gap(v.center,elements[i].center)
      if rank(d)<rank(best) then best,other=d,j end
    end
  end
  return other,best
end

local function element_gap(strokes,a,b)
  local best=math.huge
  for _,i in ipairs(a.members) do
    local p=strokes[i].points
    for _,j in ipairs(b.members) do
      local q=strokes[j].points
      for k=1,max(1,#p-1) do
        for l=1,max(1,#q-1) do
          best=min(best,F.segment_gap2(p[k],p[k+1] or p[k],q[l],q[l+1] or q[l]))
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return sqrt(best)
end

function M.analyze(input,threshold)
  assert(type(input)=="table" and #input>=4 and #input<=96,"stroke-example-count")
  local strokes,queue={},{}
  local points=0
  for i,s in ipairs(input) do
    assert(type(s)=="table" and type(s.group)=="string" and s.group:match("^[%w_-]+$"),"stroke-example-group")
    assert(type(s.points)=="table" and #s.points>=1 and #s.points<=24,"stroke-example-point-count")
    assert(F.finite(s.width) and s.width>=.005 and s.width<=.2,"stroke-example-width")
    assert(type(s.color)=="table" and #s.color==3,"stroke-example-paint")
    for _,v in ipairs(s.color) do assert(F.finite(v) and v>=0 and v<=1,"stroke-example-paint") end
    local vertices={}
    for k,p in ipairs(s.points) do
      vertices[k]=F.point(p)
      assert(k==1 or gap(vertices[k-1],vertices[k])>1e-7,"stroke-example-repeated-vertex")
    end
    points=points+#vertices
    assert(points<=600,"stroke-example-analysis-horizon")
    strokes[i]={points=vertices,width=s.width,group=s.group,color={table.unpack(s.color)}}
    queue[i]=fit(strokes,{i})
  end
  local elements,merges={},{}
  while #queue>0 do
    local a=table.remove(queue,1)
    local merged=false
    local j=1
    while j<=#queue do
      local b=queue[j]
      local mode
      if a.group==b.group then
        local r=relation(a,b)
        local distance=element_gap(strokes,a,b)
        if distance<threshold*.5 then mode="proximity"
        elseif distance<threshold and angle_gap(a.angle,b.angle)<.20 and r.separation and r.separation<threshold*.5 then mode="continuation" end
      end
      if mode then
        merges[#merges+1]={left={table.unpack(a.members)},right={table.unpack(b.members)},rule=mode}
        local indices={table.unpack(a.members)}
        for _,k in ipairs(b.members) do indices[#indices+1]=k end
        a=fit(strokes,indices)
        table.remove(queue,j)
        merged=true
      else j=j+1 end
    end
    local out=merged and queue or elements
    out[#out+1]=a
  end
  assert(#elements>=3,"stroke-example-too-few-elements")
  local relations,groups={},{}
  for i,a in ipairs(elements) do
    local g=groups[a.group] or {indices={},pairs={}}
    groups[a.group]=g
    g.indices[#g.indices+1]=i
    local j=nearest(elements,i,true)
    if j then
      local r=relation(a,elements[j])
      r.from,r.to=i,j
      relations[#relations+1]=r
      g.pairs[#g.pairs+1]=#relations
    end
  end
  for _,g in pairs(groups) do assert(#g.indices>=2,"stroke-example-singleton-group") end
  return {elements=elements,strokes=strokes,merges=merges,relations=relations,groups=groups}
end

local function neighborhood(elements,i,scale,radius)
  local origin=elements[i].center
  local out={}
  for j,a in ipairs(elements) do
    if i~=j then
      local x,y=(a.center[1]-origin[1])*scale,(a.center[2]-origin[2])*scale
      local distance=sqrt(x*x+y*y)
      if distance<=radius then out[#out+1]={x=x,y=y,distance=distance,index=j,element=a} end
    end
  end
  table.sort(out,function(a,b)
    if rank(a.distance)==rank(b.distance) then return a.index<b.index end
    return rank(a.distance)<rank(b.distance)
  end)
  while #out>6 do out[#out]=nil end
  return out
end

local function offset_nearest(a,list)
  local best,result=math.huge
  for _,b in ipairs(list) do
    local d=(a.x-b.x)^2+(a.y-b.y)^2
    if rank(d)<rank(best) then best,result=d,b end
  end
  return result,sqrt(best)
end

local function match(reference,target,scale,radius)
  local score,matched=0,0
  for _,a in ipairs(target) do
    local b,d=offset_nearest(a,reference)
    if b and offset_nearest(b,target)==a then
      local u,v=a.element,b.element
      local angle=angle_gap(u.angle,v.angle)
      local length=abs(math.log(u.length/(v.length*scale)))
      local width=abs(u.width-v.width*scale)/radius
      local shape=abs(u.length-u.width-(v.length-v.width)*scale)/radius
      local color=sqrt((u.color[1]-v.color[1])^2+(u.color[2]-v.color[2])^2+(u.color[3]-v.color[3])^2)
      score=score+d/radius+angle/pi+length+width+shape+color+(u.group==v.group and 0 or 1)
      matched=matched+1
    end
  end
  if matched==0 then return 3+#target,0 end
  return score/matched+(#target-matched)/#target,matched
end

local function property(data,indices,key,mode,rng,source)
  if mode=="cloning" then return source[key] end
  if mode=="copying" then return data.elements[indices[rng.int(1,#indices)]][key] end
  local lo,hi,sum,squares=math.huge,-math.huge,0,0
  for _,i in ipairs(indices) do
    local value=data.elements[i][key]
    lo,hi,sum,squares=min(lo,value),max(hi,value),sum+value,squares+value*value
  end
  local mean=sum/#indices
  local deviation=sqrt(max(0,squares/#indices-mean*mean))
  for _=1,8 do
    local value=mean+deviation*sqrt(-2*math.log(max(1e-12,rng.u())))*math.cos(2*pi*rng.u())
    if value>=lo and value<=hi then return value end
  end
  return mean
end

local function copied_strokes(data,source,element)
  local angle=element.angle-source.angle
  local cu,su=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
  local c,s=math.cos(source.angle),math.sin(source.angle)
  local su_scale=element.length/source.length
  local sv_scale=element.width/source.width
  local out={}
  for _,i in ipairs(source.members) do
    local stroke=data.strokes[i]
    local points={}
    for j,p in ipairs(stroke.points) do
      local x,y=p[1]-source.center[1],p[2]-source.center[2]
      local u,v=(x*c+y*s)*su_scale,(y*c-x*s)*sv_scale
      x,y=u*c-v*s,u*s+v*c
      points[j]={element.center[1]+x*cu-y*su,element.center[2]+x*su+y*cu}
    end
    out[#out+1]={points=points,width=stroke.width*min(su_scale,sv_scale),color=element.color,
      role=#points==1 and "dot" or "stroke"}
  end
  return out
end

function M.synthesize(data,sites,controls,rng,allowed)
  local scale,radius=controls.scale,controls.radius
  local references={}
  for i=1,#data.elements do references[i]=neighborhood(data.elements,i,scale,radius) end
  local placed,output,decisions={},{},{}
  for index,site in ipairs(sites) do
    local seed=rng.int(1,#data.elements)
    local target={table.unpack(placed)}
    target[#target+1]={center=site}
    local local_neighbors=neighborhood(target,#target,1,radius)
    local selected,quality,nmatch=seed,0,0
    if controls.profile=="causal" and #local_neighbors>0 then
      local candidates={}
      for j,ref in ipairs(references) do
        local score,count=match(ref,local_neighbors,scale,radius)
        candidates[#candidates+1]={index=j,score=score,count=count}
      end
      table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
        if rank(a.score)==rank(b.score) then return a.index<b.index end
        return rank(a.score)<rank(b.score)
      end)
      quality,nmatch=candidates[1].score,candidates[1].count
      if quality<=controls.threshold then selected=candidates[1].index end
    end
    local source=data.elements[selected]
    local group=data.groups[source.group]
    local element={center=site,group=source.group,color=source.color,kind=source.kind,
      length=scale*property(data,group.indices,"length",controls.behavior,rng,source),
      width=scale*property(data,group.indices,"width",controls.behavior,rng,source),
      angle=property(data,group.indices,"angle",controls.behavior,rng,source)}
    local pair_id,correction
    if controls.profile=="group" and #local_neighbors>0 and #group.pairs>0 then
      local neighbor=local_neighbors[1].element
      local current=relation(neighbor,element)
      local best=math.huge
      for _,i in ipairs(group.pairs) do
        local delta=abs(data.relations[i].proximity*scale-current.proximity)
        if rank(delta)<rank(best) then best,pair_id=delta,i end
      end
      local pair=data.relations[pair_id]
      local amount=controls.correction
      local corrected_angle=element.angle
      local u,v=math.cos(neighbor.angle),math.sin(neighbor.angle)
      local along,across
      if pair.parallelism and current.parallelism then
        local desired_angle=neighbor.angle+(element.angle>=neighbor.angle and 1 or -1)*pair.parallelism*pi/2
        corrected_angle=element.angle+amount*((desired_angle-element.angle+pi/2)%pi-pi/2)
        local turn=(corrected_angle-neighbor.angle+pi/2)%pi-pi/2
        local bisector=neighbor.angle+turn/2
        u,v=math.cos(bisector),math.sin(bisector)
        along=(current.along>=0 and 1 or -1)*pair.overlap*(neighbor.length+element.length)*math.cos(turn/2)/2
        across=(current.across>=0 and 1 or -1)*pair.separation*scale
      else
        local factor=pair.proximity*scale/max(1e-12,current.proximity)
        local dx,dy=current.offset[1],current.offset[2]
        along,across=(dx*u+dy*v)*factor,(dy*u-dx*v)*factor
      end
      correction={neighbor.center[1]+along*u-across*v,neighbor.center[2]+along*v+across*u}
      element.center={site[1]+amount*(correction[1]-site[1]),site[2]+amount*(correction[2]-site[2])}
      element.angle=corrected_angle
    end
    local strokes=copied_strokes(data,source,element)
    local kept=allowed(strokes,element,placed)
    if kept then
      element.site=index
      placed[#placed+1]=element
      for _,stroke in ipairs(strokes) do stroke.site=index;output[#output+1]=stroke end
    end
    decisions[index]={source=selected,group=source.group,score=quality,matched=nmatch,pair=pair_id,kept=kept,
      fallback=controls.profile=="causal" and #local_neighbors>0 and quality>controls.threshold or false}
  end
  return placed,output,decisions
end

return M

-- Bounded centimeter-space fields and straight-segment domain predicates.
local M={VERSION="stroke-field-v1"}
local abs,sqrt,min,max=math.abs,math.sqrt,math.min,math.max
local function finite(v)
  return type(v)=="number" and v==v and abs(v)<1000
end
M.finite=finite

function M.point(p)
  assert(type(p)=="table" and #p==2 and finite(p[1]) and finite(p[2]),"stroke-field-point")
  return {p[1],p[2]}
end

function M.new(bounds,holes,field)
  assert(type(bounds)=="table" and #bounds==4,"stroke-domain-bounds")
  for _,v in ipairs(bounds) do assert(finite(v),"stroke-domain-bounds") end
  assert(bounds[1]<bounds[3] and bounds[2]<bounds[4],"stroke-domain-bounds")
  holes=holes or {}
  assert(type(holes)=="table" and #holes<=16,"stroke-domain-holes")
  local clean={}
  for i,h in ipairs(holes) do
    assert(type(h)=="table" and finite(h.radius) and h.radius>0,"stroke-domain-hole")
    clean[i]={center=M.point(h.center),radius=h.radius}
  end
  assert(type(field)=="table","stroke-field")
  local dir=field.direction
  assert(dir=="uniform" or dir=="vortex" or dir=="radial","stroke-field-direction")
  local origin=M.point(field.origin or {(bounds[1]+bounds[3])/2,(bounds[2]+bounds[4])/2})
  local vector=M.point(field.vector or {1,0})
  assert(dir~="uniform" or vector[1]^2+vector[2]^2>1e-12,"stroke-field-zero-vector")
  local density=field.density or {1,1}
  density=M.point(density)
  assert(min(table.unpack(density))>=0 and max(table.unpack(density))<=1,"stroke-field-density")
  return {bounds={table.unpack(bounds)},holes=clean,direction=dir,origin=origin,vector=vector,density=density}
end

function M.direction(f,p)
  local dx,dy
  if f.direction=="uniform" then dx,dy=table.unpack(f.vector)
  else
    dx,dy=p[1]-f.origin[1],p[2]-f.origin[2]
    if f.direction=="vortex" then dx,dy=-dy,dx end
  end
  local n=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
  if n<=1e-8 then return nil,"singularity" end
  return {dx/n,dy/n}
end

function M.density(f,p)
  local t=max(0,min(1,(p[1]-f.bounds[1])/(f.bounds[3]-f.bounds[1])))
  return (1-t)*f.density[1]+t*f.density[2]
end

function M.distance2(p,a,b)
  local x,y=b[1]-a[1],b[2]-a[2]
  local d=x*x+y*y
  local t=d>0 and max(0,min(1,((p[1]-a[1])*x+(p[2]-a[2])*y)/d)) or 0
  return (p[1]-a[1]-t*x)^2+(p[2]-a[2]-t*y)^2
end

function M.admissible(f,a,b,padding)
  local l,d,r,t=table.unpack(f.bounds)
  for _,p in ipairs{a,b} do
    if p[1]<l+padding or p[1]>r-padding or p[2]<d+padding or p[2]>t-padding then
      return false,"boundary"
    end
  end
  for _,h in ipairs(f.holes) do
    if M.distance2(h.center,a,b)<=(h.radius+padding)^2 then return false,"hole" end
  end
  return true
end

local function side(a,b,p)
  return (b[1]-a[1])*(p[2]-a[2])-(b[2]-a[2])*(p[1]-a[1])
end

function M.segment_gap2(a,b,c,d)
  local x,y=side(a,b,c),side(a,b,d)
  local z,w=side(c,d,a),side(c,d,b)
  if x*y<0 and z*w<0 then return 0 end
  return min(M.distance2(a,c,d),M.distance2(b,c,d),M.distance2(c,a,b),M.distance2(d,a,b))
end

function M.integrate(f,seed,h,limit,padding,accept)
  assert(finite(h) and h>0 and type(limit)=="number" and limit%1==0 and limit>=0 and limit<=4096,
    "stroke-field-integration-budget")
  local good,reason=M.admissible(f,seed,seed,padding)
  if not good then return {points={seed},stop=reason} end
  local points={seed}
  local sign=h
  local start=M.direction(f,seed)
  if not start then return {points=points,stop="singularity"} end
  if accept and accept.reverse then sign=-h end
  for _=1,limit do
    local p=points[#points]
    local v=M.direction(f,p)
    if not v then return {points=points,stop="singularity"} end
    local mid={p[1]+sign*v[1]/2,p[2]+sign*v[2]/2}
    local w=M.direction(f,mid)
    if not w then return {points=points,stop="singularity"} end
    local q={p[1]+sign*w[1],p[2]+sign*w[2]}
    if f.direction~="uniform" and M.distance2(f.origin,p,q)<=1e-16 then return {points=points,stop="singularity"} end
    good,reason=M.admissible(f,p,q,padding)
    if not good then return {points=points,stop=reason} end
    if accept and accept.segment and not accept.segment(p,q,points) then
      return {points=points,stop="separation"}
    end
    points[#points+1]=q
  end
  return {points=points,stop="step_budget"}
end

return M

-- Engine-neutral document adapter: cached semantic instances and physical views.
local P,Q,R,H,V,G,D=require('pattern'),require('pattern_recipe'),require('pattern_registry'),
  require('pattern_hash'),require('pattern_render'),require('pattern_geometry'),require('pattern_document')
local Random=require('pattern_random')
local M={VERSION='pattern-tex-v1'}
local function need(ok,why)assert(ok,'pattern-tex: '..why)end
local function finite(n)return type(n)=='number' and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge end
local function box(b)
  need(type(b)=='table' and #b==4,'four physical bounds required')
  for _,n in ipairs(b)do need(finite(n),'nonfinite physical bounds')end
  need(b[3]>b[1] and b[4]>b[2],'selected region has no positive area');return b
end
local function intersection(a,b)
  local c={math.max(a[1],b[1]),math.max(a[2],b[2]),math.min(a[3],b[3]),math.min(a[4],b[4])}
  if c[1]<c[3] and c[2]<c[4]then return c end
end
local function mapped(b,m)return {b[1]*m[1]+m[5],b[2]*m[4]+m[6],b[3]*m[1]+m[5],b[4]*m[4]+m[6]}end
local function print_requirements(asset)
  local options=asset.recipe.view.extensions and asset.recipe.view.extensions.document_planning.options or {}
  return {minimum_stroke=options.minimum_stroke,minimum_text_size=options.minimum_text_size}
end
local function expanded(b,p)return {b[1]-p,b[2]-p,b[3]+p,b[4]+p}end
local function available(crop,masks)
  local pieces={crop}
  for _,mask in ipairs(masks)do
    local nexts={}
    for _,b in ipairs(pieces)do
      local hit=intersection(b,mask.bounds)
      if not hit then nexts[#nexts+1]=b else
        for _,r in ipairs({{b[1],b[2],hit[1],b[4]},{hit[3],b[2],b[3],b[4]},
            {hit[1],b[2],hit[3],hit[2]},{hit[1],hit[4],hit[3],b[4]}})do
          if r[1]<r[3] and r[2]<r[4]then nexts[#nexts+1]=r end
        end

    end

  end
  local area=0;for _,b in ipairs(pieces)do area=area+(b[3]-b[1])*(b[4]-b[2])end
  need(area>1e-12,'selected pattern view is fully protected; choose another region or explicitly disable text protection')

end
local function page_data(page,id,origin,masks)
  local w,h=page.size[1],page.size[2];local b=box(page.content)
  need(b[1]>=0 and b[2]>=0 and b[3]<=w and b[4]<=h,'actual text rectangle leaves the physical media')

  for i,r in ipairs(masks)do reservations[i]={id='mask/'..i,bounds=P.plain(r.bounds),space='page',role='protected_content'}end
  return {id=id,number=page.index,size={w,h},origin=origin,margins={b[1],b[2],w-b[3],h-b[4]},
    protected_regions=reservations,anchors=P.plain(page.anchors or P.array())}

function M.new(host)

  local source_hashes={};for name,bytes in pairs(host.source)do source_hashes[name]=H.sha256(bytes)end
  local source={revision='source/'..H.value('tex/source',source_hashes),
    files={construction=host.source,style={},view={},renderer={}}}

  function self:declare(name,bytes,inputs)
    need(type(name)=='string' and name:match('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$') and #name<=64,'asset name must use letters, digits, underscore or hyphen')
    need(not self.assets[name],'asset already declared: '..name)

    local environment=Q.environment(source,{lua=_VERSION,host=host.runtime},{id=V.VERSION,version='1'},inputs or {})
    local key=H.value('tex/generation',{recipe=H.sha256(canonical),source=environment.source.digest,
      runtime=P.plain(environment.runtime),renderer=P.plain(environment.renderer),inputs=P.plain(environment.inputs)})
    local a=self.generated[key]

      local registry,d=require('pattern_cli_core').registry(q.definition.id)
      local result=Q.execute(q,registry,environment)
      need(result.record.status=='complete',table.concat(P.plain(result.record.diagnostics),'; '))
      a={recipe=q,definition=d,registry=registry,result=result,environment=environment,inputs=inputs or {},key=key,
        recipe_bytes=canonical,instance_sha256=H.sha256(result.bytes.instance)}

  function self:inline(name,width)
    need(finite(width) and width>=0,'inline width must be finite and nonnegative')

    local natural=plan.bounds[3]-plan.bounds[1]
    local scale=width>0 and width/natural or 1
    local requirements=print_requirements(asset)
    -- Compare in source units using the existing affine rounding guard. Positive
    -- uniform inclusion scales both physical minima and their error bounds.
    local source_units={}
    for key,value in pairs(requirements)do source_units[key]=value/scale end
    local valid,report=pcall(require('pattern_planner').check_render_requirements,plan,source_units)
    need(valid,type(report)=='table' and report.message or tostring(report))
    report=P.plain(report)
    for key,value in pairs(report)do if type(value)=='number'then report[key]=value*scale end end
    return plan,asset,{width=natural*scale,height=(plan.bounds[4]-plan.bounds[2])*scale,
      scale=scale,print_requirements=report}
  end

    local known={region=true,spread=true,protect_text=true,padding=true}
    for k in pairs(options)do need(known[k],'unknown view option '..tostring(k))end
    local region=options.region or 'outer';local spread=options.spread or 'none'
    need(spread=='none' or spread=='left' or spread=='right','unsupported spread side')
    local protect=options.protect_text;if protect==nil then protect=true end
    need(type(protect)=='boolean','protect_text must be boolean')
    local pad=options.padding or .3;need(finite(pad) and pad>=0 and pad<=2,'padding must be 0..2 cm')
    need(finite(page.index) and page.index>=1 and page.index%1==0,'actual positive shipped-page index required')
    local w,h=page.size[1],page.size[2];box({0,0,w,h});local body=box(page.content)
    local right=not page.twoside or page.logical_number%2==1
    local slots={page={pad,pad,w-pad,h-pad},content=body,
      left={pad,body[2],body[1]-pad,body[4]},right={body[3]+pad,body[2],w-pad,body[4]},
      header={body[1],page.header_top+pad,body[3],h-pad},
      footer={body[1],pad,body[3],page.footer_bottom-pad}}
    slots.outer=right and slots.right or slots.left;slots.inner=right and slots.left or slots.right
    need(region=='page' or region=='content' or region=='outer' or region=='inner' or region=='header' or region=='footer','unsupported region '..tostring(region))
    local slot=box(slots[region]);local b=a.recipe.view.crop

      need(region=='page' and pad==0,'spread requires region=page and padding=0')
      slot={0,0,2*w,h}

        need(page.index%2==0 and not self.spread,'left spread must begin on an actual even shipped page with no open pair')
      else
        need(self.spread and self.spread.name==name and page.index==self.spread.index+1,'right spread must immediately follow its declared left page')
        need(self.spread.width==w and self.spread.height==h and self.spread.asset==a.key,'spread media/instance changed')

    local masks=P.array()

      reserve(expanded(body,pad))

    end
    for _,r in ipairs(page.reservations or {})do reserve(r)end
    for _,r in ipairs(a.recipe.view.protected_regions)do reserve(mapped(r.bounds,fit))end

    local document=D.new({id='tex/page/'..page.index,unit='cm',frame={id='tex/physical-document',origin={0,0}},twoside=not not page.twoside,
      pages={page_data(page,'page/'..page.index,{0,0},masks)},spreads=P.array()})
    local requirements=print_requirements(a)
    local settings={id=a.result.instance.id..'/tex/'..H.value('tex/view',{transform=fit,crop=crop,masks=masks,
        source_view=H.sha256(P.serialize(a.recipe.view)),
        document=H.sha256(P.serialize(document)),label=page.label,logical_number=page.logical_number}),
      instance_ref=a.result.instance.id,unit='cm',transform=G.compose(fit,a.recipe.view.transform),crop=crop,
      protected_regions=masks,derived=a.recipe.view.derived,validity=a.recipe.view.validity,
      projection=a.recipe.view.projection and P.plain(a.recipe.view.projection) or nil,
      extensions={tex_document={schema_version=1,document=P.plain(document),physical_index=page.index,
        logical_number=page.logical_number,printed_label=page.label,geometry=P.plain(page),spread=spread,
        source_recipe_view=H.sha256(P.serialize(a.recipe.view)),available_crop_area=visible_area,
        print_requirements=P.plain(requirements)}}}
    local view=P.view(settings,a.result.instance,a.definition)
    local context=R.context({seed=a.recipe.design.seed,source=a.environment.source,versions={lua=_VERSION,host=host.runtime},
      frame=P.plain(a.result.instance.frame),limits=a.recipe.design.budget,
      stream_provider=Random.provider(a.recipe.design.seed,a.definition.id..'@'..a.definition.version),
      input_provider=function(key)return assert(a.inputs[key],'missing declared dependency')end})
    -- Retain the original planner's selection and internal clips. Re-running a
    -- bare family lower here could reveal tiles excluded by a full-tile view.
    local data=P.plain(a.result.scene)
    data.id=view.id..'/scene';data.view_ref=view.id
    data.clip={bounds=P.plain(crop),protected_regions=P.plain(masks)}
    for _,operation in ipairs(data.operations)do
      if operation.op~='pop_clip'then
        operation.transform=G.compose(fit,operation.transform or {1,0,0,1,0,0})
      end
    end
    local scene=P.scene(data,a.result.instance,view,a.definition)
    context:consume('operations',#scene.operations);context:consume('bytes',#P.serialize(scene))
    local plan=V.plan(scene,a.result.instance,view,a.definition)
    local valid,print_report=pcall(require('pattern_planner').check_render_requirements,plan,requirements)
    need(valid,type(print_report)=='table' and print_report.message or tostring(print_report))
    local vb,sb=P.serialize(view),P.serialize(scene);local pdf=V.pdf(plan)
    local record={status='complete',source=P.plain(a.environment.source),runtime={name=_VERSION,version=host.runtime},
      seed=a.recipe.design.seed,inputs={{kind='recipe',sha256=H.sha256(a.recipe_bytes)},
        {kind='validated_source_scene',sha256=H.sha256(a.result.bytes.scene)},
        {kind='stored_instance',sha256=a.instance_sha256},{kind='physical_document',sha256=H.sha256(P.serialize(document))}},
      dependencies={renderer=V.VERSION,source_recipe_view=H.sha256(P.serialize(a.recipe.view))},
      lineage={{role='physical-document-view',parent_ref=a.result.record.id,instance_sha256=a.instance_sha256}},
      validation={status='passed',print_requirements=P.plain(print_report),checks={'Previously generated and structurally validated semantic instance',
        'Typed physical document, source-preserving positive uniform view, scene and protected clips',
        'Source-declared physical print minima checked after fitting','No generator invocation at shipout'}},
      outputs={{kind='view',sha256=H.sha256(vb)},{kind='scene',sha256=H.sha256(sb)},{kind='pdf',sha256=H.sha256(pdf)}},
      diagnostics=P.array(),budgets=context:receipt()}
    record.id='build/'..H.value('tex/view-record',record);record=P.build_record(record)
    self.views=self.views+1
    local spread_document
    if spread=='left'then self.spread={name=name,index=page.index,width=w,height=h,asset=a.key,page=P.plain(page),masks=P.plain(masks)}
    elseif spread=='right'then
      local left=self.spread
      spread_document=D.new({id='tex/spread/'..left.index,unit='cm',frame={id='tex/physical-document',origin={0,0}},twoside=true,
        pages={page_data(left.page,'left',{0,0},left.masks),page_data(page,'right',{w,0},masks)},
        spreads={{id='pair',left='left',right='right',gutter=0}}})
      self.spread=nil
    end
    return {view=view,scene=scene,plan=plan,pdf=pdf,record=record,asset=a,
      spread_document=spread_document,key=H.value('tex/output',{source=a.environment.source.digest,record=record.id}),
      bytes={view=vb,scene=sb,record=P.serialize(record)},crop=crop}
  end
  function self:finish()need(not self.spread,'spread left page has no matching right page')end
  return self
end
return M
