-- Connectivity and geometric integrity are read from semantic objects, not paths.
local P,G,E,N=require("pattern"),require("pattern_geometry"),require("pattern_exact"),require("pattern_predicates")
local T={VERSION="semantic-topology-v1"}
local function sorted_keys(map) local out=P.array();for k in pairs(map) do out[#out+1]=k end;table.sort(out,P.byte_less);return out end
local function pair_key(a,b) if P.byte_less(b,a) then a,b=b,a end;return P.serialize({a,b}) end
function T.inspect(instance,definition,policy,options)
  options=options or {};local report={ok=false,errors=P.array(),observations=P.array(),checks=P.array(),adjacency={},components={},cells={},owners=P.array(),pair_checks=0}
  local function error_message(message) report.errors[#report.errors+1]=message end
  local ok,problem=pcall(function()
    local allowed={allow_crossings=true,allow_multiedges=true,allow_coincident_vertices=true,max_pair_checks=true}
    for k,v in pairs(options) do assert(allowed[k],"unknown topology option "..tostring(k));if k~="max_pair_checks" then assert(type(v)=="boolean","topology policy flags must be boolean") end end
    local x=P.instance(P.plain(instance),definition);G.tolerance(policy)
    report.checks[#report.checks+1]="schema integrity for declared capabilities"
    assert(x.frame.unit==policy.unit,"topology check unit mismatch")
    local limit=options.max_pair_checks or 100000
    assert(type(limit)=="number" and limit%1==0 and limit>=0,"invalid topology pair budget")
    local function charge() report.pair_checks=report.pair_checks+1;assert(report.pair_checks<=limit,"topology pair-check budget exhausted") end
    local function inspect_complex(s,tiling)
      assert(x.frame.dimension==2,"planar geometry checks require a 2D instance; 3D connectivity remains separate")
      local vertices,edges={},{};local coordinate_mode
      for _,v in ipairs(s.vertices) do
        vertices[v.id]=v;report.adjacency[v.id]=P.array()
        local mode=v.exact and "exact" or "binary64";coordinate_mode=coordinate_mode or mode
        assert(mode==coordinate_mode,"mixed construction coordinates require an explicit validated conversion")
      end
      local function same_vertex(a,b)
        if a.exact then return E.compare(a.exact.components[1],b.exact.components[1])==0 and E.compare(a.exact.components[2],b.exact.components[2])==0 end
        return a.point[1]==b.point[1] and a.point[2]==b.point[2]
      end
      for i,a in ipairs(s.vertices) do for j=i+1,#s.vertices do
        charge();local b=s.vertices[j]
        if same_vertex(a,b) then
          local message="coincident distinct vertex identities: "..a.id..", "..b.id
          if options.allow_coincident_vertices and not tiling then report.observations[#report.observations+1]=message else error_message(message) end
        end
      end end
      local pairs_seen={}
      for _,e in ipairs(s.edges) do
        edges[e.id]=e;report.adjacency[e.from][#report.adjacency[e.from]+1]=e.id;report.adjacency[e.to][#report.adjacency[e.to]+1]=e.id
        local key=pair_key(e.from,e.to)
        if pairs_seen[key] then
          local message="duplicate endpoint-pair edges: "..pairs_seen[key]..", "..e.id
          if options.allow_multiedges and not tiling then report.observations[#report.observations+1]=message else error_message(message) end
        else pairs_seen[key]=e.id end
      end
      for _,neighbors in pairs(report.adjacency) do table.sort(neighbors,P.byte_less) end
      for i,a in ipairs(s.edges) do for j=i+1,#s.edges do
        charge();local b=s.edges[j];local hit
        if coordinate_mode=="exact" then hit=G.intersect_exact_segments(vertices[a.from].exact,vertices[a.to].exact,vertices[b.from].exact,vertices[b.to].exact)
        else hit=G.segment_intersection(vertices[a.from].point,vertices[a.to].point,vertices[b.from].point,vertices[b.to].point,policy) end
        local shared=a.from==b.from or a.from==b.to or a.to==b.from or a.to==b.to
        local expected=hit.kind=="none" or hit.kind=="point" and hit.classification=="endpoint" and shared
        if not expected then
          local message="edge geometry "..hit.kind..": "..a.id..", "..b.id
          local allowed=not tiling and ((options.allow_crossings and hit.kind=="point") or (options.allow_multiedges and hit.kind=="overlap" and pair_key(a.from,a.to)==pair_key(b.from,b.to)))
          if allowed then report.observations[#report.observations+1]=message else error_message(message) end
        end
      end end
      -- Components are deterministic even when a geometric check failed.
      local seen,components={},P.array()
      for _,id in ipairs(sorted_keys(vertices)) do if not seen[id] then
        local stack={id};local component=P.array();seen[id]=true
        while #stack>0 do local v=table.remove(stack);component[#component+1]=v
          for _,eid in ipairs(report.adjacency[v]) do local e=edges[eid];local other=e.from==v and e.to or e.from;if not seen[other] then seen[other]=true;stack[#stack+1]=other end end
        end
        table.sort(component,P.byte_less);components[#components+1]=component
      end end
      report.components[tiling and "tiling" or "graph"]=components
      report.checks[#report.checks+1]=(tiling and "tiling" or "graph").." connectivity, duplicate geometry and planar edge intersections"
      if tiling then
        local incidence={};local neighbors={}
        for _,cell in ipairs(s.cells) do
          neighbors[cell.id]={};local ordered=P.array();local previous,first
          for _,use in ipairs(cell.boundary) do
            local e=edges[use.edge];local from,to=e.from,e.to;if use.reversed then from,to=to,from end
            if previous and previous~=from then error_message("cell boundary is not a connected walk: "..cell.id) end
            first=first or from;previous=to;ordered[#ordered+1]=from
            incidence[e.id]=incidence[e.id] or {};incidence[e.id][#incidence[e.id]+1]=cell.id
          end
          if previous~=first or #ordered<3 then error_message("cell boundary is not a closed polygon: "..cell.id) end
          local area,rounding=0,0
          if #ordered>=3 then
            if coordinate_mode=="exact" then
              local sum=E.new(0)
              for i,id in ipairs(ordered) do local a,b=vertices[id].exact.components,vertices[ordered[i%#ordered+1]].exact.components;sum=E.add(sum,E.sub(E.mul(a[1],b[2]),E.mul(a[2],b[1]))) end
              report.cells[cell.id]={vertices=ordered,signed_double_area_exact=sum}
              if E.compare(sum,E.new(0))<=0 then error_message("cell has zero/negative exact area: "..cell.id) end
            else
              local origin=vertices[ordered[1]].point;local magnitude=0
              for i=2,#ordered-1 do local value,err=N.determinant_value(origin,vertices[ordered[i]].point,vertices[ordered[i+1]].point);area=area+value;magnitude=magnitude+math.abs(value);rounding=rounding+err end
              rounding=rounding+16*2^-52*magnitude
              report.cells[cell.id]={vertices=ordered,signed_double_area=area,area_rounding_bound=rounding}
              if area<=rounding then error_message("cell area is zero, negative or unresolved within rounding: "..cell.id) end
            end
          end
        end
        for _,e in ipairs(s.edges) do
          local uses=incidence[e.id] or {};report.owners[#report.owners+1]={edge=e.id,owner=e.owner,role=e.role,incident_cells=uses}
          if #uses==2 then neighbors[uses[1]][uses[2]]=true;neighbors[uses[2]][uses[1]]=true end
        end
        report.cell_adjacency={};for id,map in pairs(neighbors) do report.cell_adjacency[id]=sorted_keys(map) end
      end
    end
    if x.structures.graph then inspect_complex(x.structures.graph,false) end
    if x.structures.tiling then inspect_complex(x.structures.tiling,true) end
    if x.structures.strands then report.strands={components=#x.structures.strands.components,crossings=#x.structures.strands.crossings,ports=#x.structures.strands.ports} end
    if x.structures.curve3d then report.curves3d={vertices=#x.structures.curve3d.vertices,curves=#x.structures.curve3d.curves,validation="connectivity_only_no_3d_intersection_claim"} end
  end)
  if not ok then error_message(tostring(problem)) end
  report.ok=#report.errors==0;return P.snapshot(report)
end
function T.strand(instance,id)
  local s=assert(instance.structures.strands,"instance has no strand semantics")
  for _,v in ipairs(s.components) do if v.id==id then return P.snapshot({id=id,closed=v.closed,alternating=v.alternating,endpoints=P.plain(v.endpoints),encounters=P.plain(v.encounters)}) end end
  error("unknown strand component "..tostring(id),0)
end
function T.ancestors(instance,id)
  local parents,known={},{}
  local growth=instance.structures.growth
  if growth then for _,v in ipairs(growth.nodes) do known[v.id]=true;parents[v.id]=v.parent end end
  local tiling=instance.structures.tiling
  if tiling then
    for _,v in ipairs(tiling.cells) do known[v.id]=true end
    for _,v in ipairs(tiling.hierarchy or {}) do known[v.id]=true;for _,child in ipairs(v.children) do assert(not parents[child],"multiple construction parents");parents[child]=v.id end end
  end
  assert(known[id],"unknown construction identity");local out=P.array();local seen={[id]=true};local p=parents[id]
  while p do assert(not seen[p],"cyclic construction ancestry");seen[p]=true;out[#out+1]=p;p=parents[p] end
  return P.snapshot(out)
end
return T

-- Havemann and Fellner, VAST 2004, §§2.2–2.5. Construction stays
-- analytic until lowering to the shared cubic drawing vocabulary.
local P,H,G=require("pattern"),require("pattern_hash"),require("pattern_geometry")
local M={VERSION="gothic-tracery-2d-v1"}
local pi,tau=math.pi,2*math.pi
local EPS=2e-11
local function point(x,y) return {x,y} end
local function polar(c,r,a) return {c[1]+r*math.cos(a),c[2]+r*math.sin(a)} end
local function distance(a,b) return math.sqrt((a[1]-b[1])^2+(a[2]-b[2])^2) end
local function angle(c,p) return math.atan(p[2]-c[2],p[1]-c[1]) end
local function finite(v) return type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)<math.huge end

local function network()
  local vertices,edges,by_id,arcs,details=P.array(),P.array(),{},P.array(),{}
  local b={vertices=vertices,edges=edges,details=details}
  function b.vertex(id,p)
    local prior=by_id[id]
    if prior then assert(distance(prior,p)<EPS,"tracery-inconsistent-junction");return id end
    by_id[id]=p
    vertices[#vertices+1]={id=id,point=p}
    return id
  end
  function b.line(id,a,z)
    assert(distance(by_id[a],by_id[z])>EPS,"tracery-collapsed-jamb")
    edges[#edges+1]={id=id,from=a,to=z}
    details[id]={kind="line"}
  end
  function b.arc(id,a,z,c,r,start,sweep,role)
    assert(r>EPS and math.abs(sweep)>EPS and math.abs(sweep)<tau,"tracery-arc-domain")
    assert(distance(by_id[a],polar(c,r,start))<EPS and distance(by_id[z],polar(c,r,start+sweep))<EPS,
      "tracery-arc-endpoint")
    local arc={id=id,from=a,to=z,center=c,radius=r,start=start,sweep=sweep,role=role,breaks={}}
    arcs[#arcs+1]=arc
    return arc
  end
  function b.split(arc,id)
    local p=assert(by_id[id])
    local direction=arc.sweep>0 and 1 or -1
    local travel=(direction*(angle(arc.center,p)-arc.start))%tau
    assert(travel>EPS and travel<math.abs(arc.sweep)-EPS,"tracery-contact-outside-active-arc")
    assert(math.abs(distance(p,arc.center)-arc.radius)<EPS,"tracery-contact-off-circle")
    arc.breaks[#arc.breaks+1]={t=travel,id=id}
  end
  function b.finish()
    for _,arc in ipairs(arcs) do
      local direction=arc.sweep>0 and 1 or -1
      table.sort(arc.breaks,function(a,z)return a.t<z.t end)
      local start,from=0,arc.from
      arc.breaks[#arc.breaks+1]={t=math.abs(arc.sweep),id=arc.to}
      for i,s in ipairs(arc.breaks) do
        assert(s.t-start>EPS,"tracery-coincident-arc-splits")
        local id=arc.id.."/"..i
        edges[#edges+1]={id=id,from=from,to=s.id}
        details[id]={kind="arc",center=arc.center,radius=arc.radius,
          start=arc.start+direction*start,sweep=direction*(s.t-start),role=arc.role,source=arc.id}
        start,from=s.t,s.id
      end
    end
    return {vertices=vertices,edges=edges},details
  end
  function b.point(id) return assert(by_id[id]) end
  return b
end

local function arch(b,id,left,right,base,spring,excess,ends)
  local width=right-left
  local radius=width*excess
  local center=(right+left)/2
  local c=(excess-.5)*width
  local rise=math.sqrt(radius^2-c^2)
  local lc,rc={center+c,spring},{center-c,spring}
  local alpha=math.atan(rise,c)
  local apex=b.vertex(id.."/apex",{center,spring+rise})
  local first=b.arc(id.."/left",ends[1],apex,lc,radius,pi,-alpha,"arch")
  local second=b.arc(id.."/right",apex,ends[2],rc,radius,alpha,-alpha,"arch")
  return {id=id,left=left,right=right,base=base,spring=spring,excess=excess,
    radius=radius,axis=center,center_offset=c,apex=b.point(apex),centers={lc,rc},
    semantic=first.id.."/1"},first,second
end
local function ring(b,id,c,r,ports,meta)
  local ordered={}
  for i,p in ipairs(ports) do ordered[i]={id=p,a=angle(c,b.point(p))%tau} end
  table.sort(ordered,function(a,z)return a.a<z.a end)
  assert(#ordered>=3,"tracery-circle-ports")
  for i,p in ipairs(ordered) do
    local q=ordered[i%#ordered+1]
    local sweep=(q.a-p.a)%tau
    b.arc(id.."/arc/"..i,p.id,q.id,c,r,p.a,sweep,"circle")
  end
  meta.rings[#meta.rings+1]={id=id,center=c,radius=r,semantic=id.."/arc/1/1",ports=ports}
end
local function foils(b,id,c,r,n,theta,depth,meta,shared_tip,parent)
  local a=pi/n
  local s=math.sin(a)
  local radius=r*s/(1+s)
  local d=r-radius
  assert(radius>=.055,"tracery-foil-radius-limit")
  local feet,tips=P.array(),P.array()
  local record={id=id,parent=parent,center=c,container_radius=r,foil_radius=radius,
    count=n,angle=theta,depth=depth,petals=P.array()}
  meta.foils[#meta.foils+1]=record
  for i=1,n do
    local t=theta+(i-1)*2*a
    feet[i]=b.vertex(id.."/foot/"..i,polar(c,d*math.cos(a),t+a))
    tips[i]=b.vertex(i==1 and shared_tip or id.."/tip/"..i,polar(c,r,t))
  end
  for i=1,n do
    local t=theta+(i-1)*2*a
    local center=polar(c,d,t)
    local name=id.."/petal/"..i
    local arc=b.arc(name,feet[(i-2)%n+1],feet[i],center,radius,t-pi/2-a,pi+2*a,"foil")
    b.split(arc,tips[i])
    local child=depth>0 and name.."/child" or nil
    record.petals[i]={id=name,center=center,tip=tips[i],from=feet[(i-2)%n+1],to=feet[i],child=child}
    if child then foils(b,child,center,radius,3,t,depth-1,meta,tips[i],name) end
  end
  return tips
end

local function rosette_center(outer,inner)
  local r,s=outer.radius,inner.radius
  local a,b=outer.centers[2],inner.centers[2]
  local axis=outer.axis
  local lo,hi=math.max(outer.spring,inner.apex[2]),outer.apex[2]
  local function value(y)
    local p={axis,y}
    return distance(p,a)+distance(p,b)-r-s
  end
  assert(lo<hi and value(lo)<-EPS and value(hi)>EPS,"tracery-rosette-unbracketed")
  for _=1,60 do
    local y=(lo+hi)/2
    if value(y)<0 then lo=y else hi=y end
  end
  local c={axis,(lo+hi)/2}
  local radius=r-distance(c,a)
  assert(radius>.09 and math.abs(value(c[2]))<EPS,"tracery-rosette-residual")
  return c,radius
end
local function tangency(c,m,r)
  local d=distance(c,m)
  assert(d>EPS,"tracery-tangency-center")
  return {m[1]+r*(c[1]-m[1])/d,m[2]+r*(c[2]-m[2])/d}
end
local function construct(request,context)
  local frame,p=request.frame,request.parameters
  assert(frame.unit=="cm" and frame.dimension==2 and frame.handedness=="right","tracery-frame")
  local x,y=table.unpack(frame.origin)
  local b=network()
  local meta={profile=p.profile,arches=P.array(),rings=P.array(),foils=P.array(),contacts=P.array()}
  if p.profile=="rose" then
    assert(p.jamb==nil and p.excess==nil and p.drop==nil,"tracery-arch-parameters-on-rose")
    local radius=p.width/2
    local c={x+radius,y+radius}
    local ports=foils(b,"rose/foils",c,radius,p.foils or 6,pi/2,p.recursion or 0,meta)
    ring(b,"rose/border",c,radius,ports,meta)
  else
    assert(p.jamb and p.excess,"tracery-arch-parameters-required")
    assert(p.profile=="rosette" or (p.foils==nil and p.recursion==nil),"tracery-foils-require-rosette")
    local w,h,e,drop=p.width,p.jamb,p.excess,p.drop or 0
    assert(drop<h-.2,"tracery-collapsed-subwindow")
    local left,axis,right=x,x+w/2,x+w
    local spring,lower=y+h,y+h-drop
    local bl,bm,br=b.vertex("bottom/left",{left,y}),b.vertex("bottom/mid",{axis,y}),b.vertex("bottom/right",{right,y})
    local ll,rr=b.vertex("outer/left-spring",{left,spring}),b.vertex("outer/right-spring",{right,spring})
    local sl,sr=ll,rr
    if drop>EPS then
      sl=b.vertex("sub/left-spring",{left,lower})
      sr=b.vertex("sub/right-spring",{right,lower})
      b.line("jamb/left-upper",sl,ll)
      b.line("jamb/right-upper",sr,rr)
    else
      assert(drop==0,"tracery-near-zero-drop")
    end
    local sm=b.vertex("sub/mid-spring",{axis,lower})
    b.line("jamb/left",bl,sl);b.line("jamb/right",br,sr);b.line("jamb/mullion",bm,sm)
    b.line("sill/left",bl,bm);b.line("sill/right",bm,br)
    local outer,ol,orr=arch(b,"outer",left,right,y,spring,e,{ll,rr})
    local inner_a,_,il=arch(b,"sub/left",left,axis,y,lower,e,{sl,sm})
    local inner_b,ir=arch(b,"sub/right",axis,right,y,lower,e,{sm,sr})
    meta.arches={outer,inner_a,inner_b}
    if p.profile=="rosette" then
      local c,r=rosette_center(outer,inner_a)
      local ports=foils(b,"crown/foils",c,r,p.foils or 4,pi/2,p.recursion or 0,meta)
      for i,arc in ipairs{ol,orr,il,ir} do
        local q=tangency(c,arc.center,arc.radius)
        assert(math.abs(distance(c,q)-r)<EPS,"tracery-rosette-contact-residual")
        local id=b.vertex("crown/contact/"..i,q)
        b.split(arc,id)
        for _,port in ipairs(ports) do
          assert(distance(q,b.point(port))>EPS,"tracery-crown-contact-coincides-with-foil-tip")
        end
        ports[#ports+1]=id
        meta.contacts[i]={id=id,arc=arc.id,kind=i<=2 and "internal" or "external",center=c,radius=r}
      end
      ring(b,"crown/border",c,r,ports,meta)
    end
  end
  local graph,curves=b.finish()
  if context then context:consume("objects",#graph.vertices+#graph.edges);context:consume("operations",#graph.edges*8) end
  return graph,curves,meta
end

function M.definition()
  return P.definition({id="ornament/gothic-tracery",version="1",family="analytic-tracery-grammar",
    units="cm",capabilities={"graph"},parameters={
      profile={type="string",enum={"prototype","rosette","rose"},required=true},
      width={type="number",minimum=2,maximum=16,required=true},
      jamb={type="number",minimum=.5,maximum=18},excess={type="number",minimum=.55,maximum=1.8},
      drop={type="number",minimum=0,maximum=8},
      foils={type="integer",minimum=3,maximum=9},recursion={type="integer",minimum=0,maximum=2}},
    transforms={metric_constrained=true,reflection=false,uniform_scale=true},
    assumptions={"Two-centered pointed arch, dependent paired bays and tangent circular rosette",
      "Rounded foil arcs and bounded recursive circular subdivisions",
      "Analytic 2D structure and separately evaluated ornamental profiles"}})
end
local function validate(x)
  local e=x.extensions.tracery
  assert(P.serialize(e.request.frame)==P.serialize(x.frame),"tracery-frame-provenance")
  local graph,curves,meta=construct(P.plain(e.request))
  assert(P.serialize(graph)==P.serialize(x.structures.graph) and P.serialize(curves)==P.serialize(e.curves)
    and P.serialize(meta)==P.serialize(e.grammar),"tracery-dependency-reconstruction")
  local neighbors={}
  for _,edge in ipairs(graph.edges) do
    neighbors[edge.from]=neighbors[edge.from] or {}
    neighbors[edge.to]=neighbors[edge.to] or {}
    neighbors[edge.from][#neighbors[edge.from]+1]=edge.to
    neighbors[edge.to][#neighbors[edge.to]+1]=edge.from
  end
  local first=graph.vertices[1].id
  local queue,seen={first},{[first]=true}
  local i=1
  while queue[i] do
    for _,id in ipairs(neighbors[queue[i]] or {}) do
      if not seen[id] then seen[id]=true;queue[#queue+1]=id end
    end
    i=i+1
  end
  assert(#queue==#graph.vertices,"tracery-disconnected-arc-network")
  return {ok=true,checks={"positive source radii and reconstructed arch/foil grammar",
    "admitted arc branches and connected exact junction identities",
    "rosette contact residuals within 2e-11cm",
    "bounded recursion and retained construction dependencies"}}
end
function M.validate(x) return validate(P.instance(P.plain(x),M.definition())) end

local function append_arc(out,c,r,start,sweep,last)
  local n=math.ceil(math.abs(sweep)/(pi/4))
  local step=sweep/n
  for i=1,n do
    local a,z=start+(i-1)*step,start+i*step
    local p,q=polar(c,r,a),polar(c,r,z)
    if i==n and last then q=last end
    local k=4/3*math.tan(step/4)*r
    out[#out+1]={"C",p[1]-k*math.sin(a),p[2]+k*math.cos(a),
      q[1]+k*math.sin(z),q[2]-k*math.cos(z),q[1],q[2]}
  end
end
local function arch_contour(out,a,offset)
  local r=a.radius-offset
  local base=a.base+offset
  assert(r>a.center_offset+EPS and base<a.spring-EPS,"tracery-profile-collapsed-arch")
  local left,right=a.left+offset,a.right-offset
  assert(left<right,"tracery-profile-collapsed-width")
  local rise=math.sqrt(r^2-a.center_offset^2)
  local alpha=math.atan(rise,a.center_offset)
  out[#out+1]={"M",left,base}
  out[#out+1]={"L",left,a.spring}
  append_arc(out,a.centers[1],r,pi,-alpha,{a.axis,a.spring+rise})
  append_arc(out,a.centers[2],r,alpha,-alpha,{right,a.spring})
  out[#out+1]={"L",right,base}
  out[#out+1]={"Z"}
end
local function circle_contour(out,c,r)
  assert(r>EPS,"tracery-profile-collapsed-ring")
  local p={c[1]+r,c[2]}
  out[#out+1]={"M",p[1],p[2]}
  append_arc(out,c,r,0,tau,p)
  out[#out+1]={"Z"}
end
local palettes={stone={.24,.38,.45},ink={.14,.23,.37},diagnostic={.19,.38,.52}}
local function lower(x,v,style)
  for k in pairs(style) do assert(k=="profile" or k=="band_cm","tracery-style:"..k) end
  local profile=style.profile or "stone"
  local color=assert(palettes[profile],"tracery-profile")
  local width=style.band_cm or .115
  assert(finite(width) and width>=.015 and width<=.6,"tracery-profile-width")
  local e=x.extensions.tracery
  local ops=P.array()
  local transform=P.plain(v.transform)
  local function emit(id,commands,paint)
    ops[#ops+1]={op="path",semantic_ref=id,commands=commands,transform=transform,paint=paint}
  end
  local detail=profile=="diagnostic"
  if not detail then
    for _,a in ipairs(e.grammar.arches) do
      local commands={}
      arch_contour(commands,a,-width/2)
      arch_contour(commands,a,width/2)
      emit(a.semantic,commands,{fill=color,fill_rule="evenodd"})
    end
    for _,r in ipairs(e.grammar.rings) do
      local commands={}
      circle_contour(commands,r.center,r.radius+width/2)
      circle_contour(commands,r.center,r.radius-width/2)
      emit(r.semantic,commands,{fill=color,fill_rule="evenodd"})
    end
  end
  local points={}
  for _,p in ipairs(x.structures.graph.vertices) do points[p.id]=p.point end
  for _,edge in ipairs(x.structures.graph.edges) do
    local curve=e.curves[edge.id]
    if detail or curve.role=="foil" then
      local a,z=points[edge.from],points[edge.to]
      local commands={{"M",a[1],a[2]}}
      if curve.kind=="arc" then
        assert(detail or width*.6<curve.radius*.45,"tracery-profile-collapsed-foil")
        append_arc(commands,curve.center,curve.radius,curve.start,curve.sweep,z)
      else commands[2]={"L",z[1],z[2]} end
      emit(edge.id,commands,{stroke=color,stroke_width=detail and .025 or width*.6,cap="round",join="round"})
    end
  end
  if detail then
    for _,t in ipairs(e.grammar.contacts) do
      local p=points[t.id]
      local commands={}
      circle_contour(commands,p,.061)
      emit(t.id,commands,{fill={.70,.26,.20}})
    end
  end
  return {id=x.id.."/scene",instance_ref=x.id,view_ref=v.id,unit="cm",validity=v.validity,
    clip={bounds=P.plain(v.crop),protected_regions=P.plain(v.protected_regions)},operations=ops,resources=P.array()}
end
function M.register(registry)
  local d=M.definition()
  registry:register(d,{generate=function(s,c)
    local request={frame=P.plain(c.frame),parameters=P.plain(s.parameters)}
    local graph,curves,meta=construct(request,c)
    return {id="tracery/"..H.value("tracery/construction",request),definition_ref={id=d.id,version=d.version},
      frame=P.plain(c.frame),structures={graph=graph},
      provenance={generator=d.id,generator_version=d.version,seed=s.seed,construction=M.VERSION},
      extensions={tracery={request=request,curves=curves,grammar=meta}}}
  end,validate=validate,lower=lower})
  return d
end
return M

-- Exact lattice isometries for an explicitly limited set of wallpaper groups.
-- The hexagonal chart uses a 60-degree basis, not the IUCr 120-degree chart.
local P=require("pattern")
local M={VERSION="wallpaper-affine-v1"}
local I={1,0,0,1};local R4={0,-1,1,0};local R6={0,-1,1,1}
local S4={1,0,0,-1};local S6={1,1,0,-1};local half={-1,0,0,-1}
local owned=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function product(a,b)
  return {a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[3],a[1]*b[2]+a[2]*b[4],a[3]*b[1]+a[4]*b[3],a[3]*b[2]+a[4]*b[4]}
end
local function vector(m,p)return{m[1]*p[1]+m[2]*p[2],m[3]*p[1]+m[4]*p[2]}end
local function key(m)return table.concat(m,",")end
local function finite(n)return type(n)=="number"and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge end
local function address(t)
  assert(type(t)=="table"and #t==2,"two lattice translation integers required")
  for k,x in pairs(t)do assert((k==1 or k==2)and finite(x)and x%1==0 and math.abs(x)<=1048576,"lattice translation outside exact profile")end
  return {math.tointeger(t[1]),math.tointeger(t[2])}
end
local cases={
  p1={1,I},p2={2,half},p3={3,product(R6,R6),nil,"hexagonal"},
  p4={4,R4,nil,"square"},p4m={4,R4,S4,"square","p4mm"},
  p6={6,R6,nil,"hexagonal"},p6m={6,R6,S6,"hexagonal","p6mm"},
}
function M.names()return{"p1","p2","p3","p4","p4m","p6","p6m"}end
function M.group(name,lattice)
  name=({p4mm="p4m",p6mm="p6m"})[name]or name
  local c=assert(cases[name],"unsupported wallpaper group "..tostring(name))
  assert(lattice=="square"or lattice=="hexagonal","explicit admitted lattice metric required")
  assert(not c[4]or c[4]==lattice,"wallpaper operation does not preserve this lattice metric")
  local ops,map,keys={},{},{};local r=I
  local function add(id,m,det,turn)
    assert(not keys[key(m)],"duplicate group operation")
    ops[#ops+1]={id=id,matrix=m,orientation=det,rotation_degrees=turn};map[id]=ops[#ops];keys[key(m)]=id
  end
  for k=0,c[1]-1 do
    add("r"..k,r,1,360*k/c[1])
    if c[3]then add("m"..k,product(r,c[3]),-1,360*k/c[1])end
    r=product(r,c[2])
  end
  assert(key(r)==key(I),"generator order mismatch")
  local function metric(p)return p[1]^2+p[2]^2+(lattice=="hexagonal"and p[1]*p[2]or 0)end
  for _,a in ipairs(ops)do
    for _,p in ipairs({{1,0},{0,1},{1,1}})do assert(metric(vector(a.matrix,p))==metric(p),"group changes exact Gram metric")end
    assert(a.matrix[1]*a.matrix[4]-a.matrix[2]*a.matrix[3]==a.orientation,"wrong group orientation")
    for _,b in ipairs(ops)do assert(keys[key(product(a.matrix,b.matrix))],"group lacks closure")end
  end
  local descriptor=P.snapshot({id=name,international_symbol=c[5]or name,lattice=lattice,operations=ops,
    translations="all integer pairs in the admitted lattice chart",profile=M.VERSION,
    translation_domain={{0,0},{1,0},{1,1},{0,1}},
    asymmetric_unit=name=="p4m"and{{0,0},{0.5,0.5},{0,0.5}}or name=="p6m"and{{0,0},{0.5,0},{1/3,1/3}}or nil})
  owned[descriptor]={map=map,keys=keys};return descriptor
end
local function operation(group,id)
  local data=assert(owned[group],"validated wallpaper descriptor required")
  return assert(data.map[id],"unknown wallpaper operation "..tostring(id)),data
end
function M.element(group,id,translation)
  operation(group,id);return P.snapshot({operation=id,translation=address(translation or{0,0})})
end
function M.apply(group,element,point)
  local o=operation(group,element.operation);local t=address(element.translation)
  assert(type(point)=="table"and #point==2 and finite(point[1])and finite(point[2])and math.abs(point[1])<=1048576 and math.abs(point[2])<=1048576,"lattice point outside bounded profile")
  local p=vector(o.matrix,point);return {p[1]+t[1],p[2]+t[2]},o.orientation
end
function M.compose(group,left,right)
  local a,data=operation(group,left.operation);local b=operation(group,right.operation)
  local l,r=address(left.translation),address(right.translation);local t=vector(a.matrix,r)
  return M.element(group,assert(data.keys[key(product(a.matrix,b.matrix))]),{t[1]+l[1],t[2]+l[2]})
end
function M.inverse(group,e)
  local a,data=operation(group,e.operation);local m=a.matrix
  local inv={m[4]*a.orientation,-m[2]*a.orientation,-m[3]*a.orientation,m[1]*a.orientation}
  local t=vector(inv,address(e.translation))
  return M.element(group,assert(data.keys[key(inv)]),{-t[1],-t[2]})
end
return M

-- External XeLaTeX host. Semantic construction and view planning stay in pattern_tex.
local P,H,V,B=require('pattern'),require('pattern_hash'),require('pattern_render'),require('pattern_bytes')
local M={VERSION='pattern-xetex-records-v1'}
local CM=2.54/(72.27*65536)
local function need(ok,why)assert(ok,'florilegium patterns: '..why)end
function M.replace(path,bytes)
  local f=io.open(path,'rb');local old
  if f then old=f:read('*a');f:close();if old==bytes then return end end
  f=assert(io.open(path..'.tmp','wb'));assert(f:write(bytes));assert(f:close())
  local ok,reason=os.rename(path..'.tmp',path)
  if ok then return end
  -- Windows rename cannot replace an existing file. Retain the previous
  -- generated metadata under its content hash before publishing the new one.
  need(old~=nil,'cannot publish generated metadata: '..tostring(reason))
  local backup=path..'.previous-'..H.sha256(old)
  local saved=io.open(backup,'rb')
  if saved then
    local bytes_saved=saved:read('*a');saved:close();need(bytes_saved==old,'previous metadata backup has different bytes')
    assert(os.remove(path))
  else assert(os.rename(path,backup))end
  ok,reason=os.rename(path..'.tmp',path)
  if not ok then os.rename(backup,path);error('cannot publish generated metadata: '..tostring(reason),0)end
end
function M.records()
  local r={declarations={},inputs={},inline={},pages={},marks={},order=0}
  local env={
    PHEADER=function(t)need(not r.header,'duplicate external header');r.header=t end,
    PINPUT=function(t)r.order=r.order+1;t.order=r.order;r.inputs[#r.inputs+1]=t end,
    PDECLARE=function(t)r.order=r.order+1;t.order=r.order;r.declarations[#r.declarations+1]=t end,
    PINLINE=function(t)need(not r.inline[t.id],'duplicate inline id');r.inline[t.id]=t end,
    PPAGE=function(t)need(not r.pages[t.n],'duplicate physical page');r.pages[t.n]=t end,
    PMARK=function(t)local a=r.marks[t.n] or {};r.marks[t.n]=a;a[#a+1]=t end,
    PEND=function(t)need(not r.finish,'duplicate external finish');r.finish=t end,
  }
  return r,env
end
function M.render(base,r,root)
  local legacy=not r.header and not r.finish and #r.inputs==0 and #r.declarations==0 and #r.inline==0 and next(r.pages)==nil and next(r.marks)==nil
  need(legacy or r.header and r.header.schema_version==1 and r.header.adapter==require('pattern_tex').VERSION,
    'unsupported or missing external pattern record version')
  need(legacy or r.header.engine=='XeTeX' and r.finish,'incomplete external pattern records')
  if not legacy then
    need(type(r.finish.active)=='boolean' and type(r.finish.pending)=='boolean','external pass flags must be booleans')
    for key,maximum in pairs({shipped=10000,inline_count=100000})do
      local n=r.finish[key];need(type(n)=='number' and n>=0 and n<=maximum and n%1==0,'invalid external '..key..' count')
    end
    for id in pairs(r.inline)do need(type(id)=='number' and id%1==0 and id>=1 and id<=r.finish.inline_count,'inline id leaves declared record range')end
    for index in pairs(r.pages)do need(type(index)=='number' and index%1==0 and index>=1 and index<=r.finish.shipped,'physical page leaves declared record range')end
    for index in pairs(r.marks)do need(type(index)=='number' and index%1==0 and index>=1 and index<=r.finish.shipped,'mark has no actual shipped page')end
  end
  local lfs=require('lfs');local dependencies,outputs={},{}
  local function absolute(path)
    if path:match('^[/\\]') or path:match('^%a:[/\\]')then return path end
    return lfs.currentdir()..'/'..path
  end
  local function read(path,limit)
    local f=assert(io.open(path,'rb'),'florilegium patterns: input not found '..path)
    local bytes=f:read((limit or 2*1024*1024)+1);f:close()
    need(bytes and #bytes<=(limit or 2*1024*1024),'input exceeds byte limit: '..path)
    dependencies[absolute(path)]=H.sha256(bytes);return bytes
  end
  local function resolve(path)
    need(type(path)=='string' and #path>0 and not path:find('%z'),'invalid input filename')
    local f=io.open(path,'rb');if f then f:close();return path end
    local found=kpse.find_file(path);need(found,'input not found '..path);return found
  end
  local source={}
  for name in lfs.dir(root)do
    if name:match('%.lua$') or name:match('^florilegium.*%.sty$') or name:match('^florilegium.*%.def$')then
      source[name]=read(root..'/'..name,16*1024*1024)
    end
  end
  local source_hashes={};for name,bytes in pairs(source)do source_hashes[name]=H.sha256(bytes)end
  if legacy or not r.finish.active then
    need(#r.declarations==0 and #r.inputs==0 and #r.inline==0 and next(r.pages)==nil,'inactive external records contain patterns')
    return {dependencies=dependencies,outputs=outputs,source_files=source_hashes,active=false}
  end
  local runtime='XeTeX/'..tostring(r.header.version)..'/'..tostring(r.header.revision)..'/external/'.._VERSION
  local core=require('pattern_tex').new({source=source,runtime=runtime})
  local bindings,binding_order,declarations,inline,pages={},{},P.array(),P.array(),P.array()
  local function write_new(path,bytes)
    local f=io.open(path,'rb')
    if f then local old=f:read('*a');f:close();need(old==bytes,'existing generated filename has different bytes: '..path)
    else f=assert(io.open(path,'wb'));assert(f:write(bytes));assert(f:close())end
    outputs[path]=H.sha256(bytes)
  end
  local function persist(key,files)
    local prefix='florilegium-pattern-'..key;local hashes={}
    for suffix,bytes in pairs(files)do
      write_new(prefix..'.'..suffix,bytes);hashes[suffix]=H.sha256(bytes)
    end
    return prefix,hashes
  end
  for _,item in ipairs(r.inputs)do
    need(type(item.name)=='string' and #item.name>0 and not bindings[item.name],'duplicate or empty dependency name')
    bindings[item.name]=read(resolve(item.path))
    binding_order[item.name]=item.order
  end
  for _,item in ipairs(r.declarations)do
    local bytes=read(resolve(item.path));local q=require('pattern_recipe').decode(bytes);local inputs={}
    for _,group in pairs(q.dependencies)do for key in pairs(group)do
      inputs[key]=assert(bindings[key],'florilegium patterns: bind dependency '..key..' before declaring this recipe')
      need(binding_order[key]<item.order,'bind dependency '..key..' before declaring this recipe')
    end end
    local asset=core:declare(item.name,bytes,inputs)
    local files={recipe=asset.recipe_bytes,record=P.serialize(asset.result.record),view=P.serialize(asset.result.view),scene=asset.result.bytes.scene}
    if asset.result.instance.extensions.legacy then
      local manifest,blocks=require('pattern_botanical_legacy').encode_bundle(asset.result.instance);files.instance=manifest
      for hash,data in pairs(blocks)do files['block-'..hash..'.json']=data end
    else files.instance=asset.result.bytes.instance end
    local prefix,hashes=persist(asset.key,files)
    declarations[#declarations+1]={name=item.name,family=asset.definition.id,prefix=prefix,hashes=hashes,
      instance_sha256=asset.instance_sha256,generation_record=asset.result.record.id}
  end
  local metadata={}
  local function macro(name,value)
    metadata[#metadata+1]='\\expandafter\\gdef\\csname '..name..'\\endcsname{'..value..'}\n'
  end
  for id=1,r.finish.inline_count do
    local item=r.inline[id];need(item and item.id==id,'inline ids are not contiguous')
    local plan,asset,physical=core:inline(item.name,item.width*CM)
    local pdf=V.pdf(plan);local key=H.value('tex/inline',{source=asset.environment.source.digest,pdf=H.sha256(pdf)})
    local prefix,hashes=persist(key,{pdf=pdf})
    inline[id]={name=item.name,prefix=prefix,hashes=hashes,width_sp=item.width,instance_sha256=asset.instance_sha256,
      width=physical.width,height=physical.height,print_requirements=physical.print_requirements}
    macro('flo@pinline@'..id,prefix)
  end
  local F=require('florilegium');local original={dimen=F.dimen,page=F.page,twoside=F.twoside}
  for index=1,r.finish.shipped do
    local d=r.pages[index];need(d and d.n==index,'missing actual shipped-page record')
    F.dimen=function(name)return assert(d[name],'missing page dimension '..name)end
    F.page=function()return d.page end;F.twoside=d.twoside
    local g=F.geometry(nil,'left');local dimensions={}
    for name in ('paperwidth paperheight oddsidemargin evensidemargin hoffset voffset topmargin headheight headsep textwidth textheight footskip'):gmatch('%S+')do dimensions[name]=d[name]end
    local page={index=index,size={g.pw,g.ph},content={g.actual_left,g.ybot,g.actual_right,g.ytop},
      logical_number=d.page,label=d.label,twoside=d.twoside,dimensions_sp=dimensions,
      header_top=g.ytop+(d.headsep+d.headheight)*CM,footer_bottom=g.footy-.5,
      running_regions={{g.actual_left,g.ytop+d.headsep*CM,g.actual_right,g.ytop+(d.headsep+d.headheight)*CM},
        {g.actual_left,g.footy-.5,g.actual_right,g.footy+.5}},
      markers=P.array(),inline_positions=P.array(),reservations=P.array(),anchors=P.array()}
    local requests={}
    for _,mark in ipairs(r.marks[index] or {})do
      local x,y=mark.x*CM,mark.y*CM;local a=mark.arg
      if mark.kind=='reserve_page'then
        page.reservations[#page.reservations+1]={(a.x-a.pad)*CM,(a.y-a.pad)*CM,(a.x+a.w+a.pad)*CM,(a.y+a.h+a.pad)*CM}
      elseif mark.kind=='reserve_box'then
        page.reservations[#page.reservations+1]={x-a.pad*CM,y-(a.d+a.pad)*CM,x+(a.w+a.pad)*CM,y+(a.h+a.pad)*CM}
      elseif mark.kind=='pattern_view'then
        need(a.protect=='true' or a.protect=='false','protect-text must be true or false')
        requests[#requests+1]={name=a.name,options={region=a.region,spread=a.spread,protect_text=a.protect=='true',padding=a.padding*CM}}
      else
        local argument=a
        if mark.kind=='pattern_inline'then
          local asset=inline[a.id];need(asset and asset.name==a.name,'inline position refers to a different asset')
          argument={inline_ref=a.id,name=asset.name,prefix=asset.prefix,width=asset.width,height=asset.height}
          local position=P.plain(argument);position.x,position.y=x,y;page.inline_positions[#page.inline_positions+1]=position
        end
        page.anchors[#page.anchors+1]={id='mark/'..(#page.anchors+1),role=mark.kind,point={x,y},space='page'}
        page.markers[#page.markers+1]={kind=mark.kind,arg=P.plain(argument),x=x,y=y}
      end
    end

    for _,request in ipairs(requests)do
      local valid,result=pcall(core.place,core,request.name,page,request.options)
      need(valid,type(result)=='table' and result.message or tostring(result))
      local prefix,hashes=persist(result.key,{pdf=result.pdf,view=result.bytes.view,scene=result.bytes.scene,record=result.bytes.record})
      results[#results+1]={name=request.name,prefix=prefix,hashes=hashes,instance_sha256=result.asset.instance_sha256,
        record=result.record.id,view_ref=result.view.id,crop=P.plain(result.crop),transform=P.plain(result.view.transform),
        spread_document=result.spread_document and P.plain(result.spread_document) or nil}
      commands[#commands+1]=string.format('\\put(%scm,%scm){\\makebox(0,0)[lb]{\\includegraphics{%s.pdf}}}',
        B.pdf_number(result.crop[1]-d.hoffset*CM),B.pdf_number(result.crop[2]-page.size[2]+d.voffset*CM),prefix)
    end

  end

    source_files=core.source_hashes,declarations=declarations,pages=pages,inline=inline,
    unique_generations=core.generations,physical_views=core.views,actual_shipped_pages=r.finish.shipped,
    input_pass_pending=r.finish.pending,
    construction_policy='Same semantic core and shared renderer; external construction between no-shell-escape TeX passes'}
  local function replace(path,bytes)
    M.replace(path,bytes);outputs[path]=H.sha256(bytes)
  end
  replace(base..'-patterns.json',P.serialize(trace));replace(base..'-patterns.tex',table.concat(metadata))

    local f=assert(io.open(path,'rb'));local now=f:read('*a');f:close();need(H.sha256(now)==digest,'source or recipe changed while rendering: '..path)
  end
  return {dependencies=dependencies,outputs=outputs,source_files=source_hashes,active=true,protocol=M.VERSION,
    input_pass_pending=r.finish.pending}
end
return M

-- Small vector-PDF backend, adapted from wilsybubs/florilegium 6f1d846 (MIT).
-- Geometry stays in ink.lua; this module only owns resources and PDF objects.
local M = {}
function M.encode(objs,catalog)
  local buf,offs={"%PDF-1.5\n%\xE2\xE3\xCF\xD3\n"},{}
  local pos=#buf[1]
  for i,o in ipairs(objs) do
    offs[i]=pos
    local s=string.format("%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n",i,o)
    buf[#buf+1]=s;pos=pos+#s
  end
  buf[#buf+1]=string.format("xref\n0 %d\n0000000000 65535 f \n",#objs+1)
  for i=1,#objs do buf[#buf+1]=string.format("%010d 00000 n \n",offs[i]) end
  buf[#buf+1]=string.format("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n",#objs+1,catalog,pos)
  return table.concat(buf)
end
function M.new()
  local self = { pages={}, resources={}, streams={}, has_text=false }
  self.backend = {
    literal=function(s) self.streams[#self.streams+1]=s end,
    extgs=function(name,dict) self.resources[name]=dict end,
  }
  function self:begin() self.streams={} end
  function self:text(label,x,y)
    assert(label:match("^[0-9ivxlcdmIVXLCDM]+$"), "unsupported PDF search label")
    self.has_text=true
    self.streams[#self.streams+1]=string.format(
      "q BT /FloSearch 9 Tf 3 Tr 1 0 0 1 %.4f %.4f Tm (%s) Tj ET Q",x,y,label)
  end
  function self:finish(w,h)
    self.pages[#self.pages+1]={data=table.concat(self.streams,"\n"),w=w,h=h}
  end
  function self:write(path)
    assert(#self.pages>0,"cannot write a PDF without pages")
    local objs={}
    local function obj(s) objs[#objs+1]=s;return #objs end
    local catalog,pages=obj(false),obj(false)
    local names,dict={},{}
    for name in pairs(self.resources) do names[#names+1]=name end
    table.sort(names)
    for _,name in ipairs(names) do dict[#dict+1]="/"..name.." "..self.resources[name] end
    local gs=obj("<< "..table.concat(dict," ").." >>")
    local font=self.has_text and obj("<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")
    local refs={}
    for _,p in ipairs(self.pages) do
      assert(p.w>0 and p.h>0,"invalid PDF page dimensions")
      local z=zlib.compress(p.data)
      local stream=obj(string.format("<< /Length %d /Filter /FlateDecode >>\nstream\n%s\nendstream",#z,z))
      local pg=obj(string.format("<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %.5f %.5f] /Contents %d 0 R /Resources << /ExtGState %d 0 R %s >> >>",
        pages,p.w,p.h,stream,gs,font and string.format("/Font << /FloSearch %d 0 R >>",font) or ""))
      refs[#refs+1]=pg.." 0 R"
    end
    objs[catalog]=string.format("<< /Type /Catalog /Pages %d 0 R >>",pages)
    objs[pages]=string.format("<< /Type /Pages /Kids [%s] /Count %d >>",table.concat(refs," "),#refs)
    local bytes=M.encode(objs,catalog)
    local f=assert(io.open(path..".tmp","wb"));assert(f:write(bytes));assert(f:close())
    assert(os.rename(path..".tmp",path))
  end
  return self
end
return M

-- Deterministic obstacle clearance and visibility-graph routing, in page cm.
local M = {}
local sqrt, min, max, ceil = math.sqrt, math.min, math.max, math.ceil
function M.clearance(rects, x, y)
  local best = math.huge
  for _, r in ipairs(rects) do
    local dx, dy = max(r[1]-x, 0, x-r[3]), max(r[2]-y, 0, y-r[4])
    local d = sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
    if dx == 0 and dy == 0 then d = -min(x-r[1],r[3]-x,y-r[2],r[4]-y) end
    best = min(best,d)
  end
  return best
end
local function crosses(a,b,r,pad)
  local lo, hi = 0, 1
  for axis=1,2 do
    local d=b[axis]-a[axis]
    local mn,mx=r[axis]-pad,r[axis+2]+pad
    if math.abs(d)<1e-12 then if a[axis]<mn or a[axis]>mx then return false end
    else
      local u,v=(mn-a[axis])/d,(mx-a[axis])/d
      if u>v then u,v=v,u end
      lo,hi=max(lo,u),min(hi,v)
      if lo>hi then return false end
    end
  end
  return true
end
function M.path_clear(pts, exclusions, pad)
  for i=2,#pts do for _,r in ipairs(exclusions) do
    if crosses(pts[i-1],pts[i],r,pad or 0) then return false end
  end end
  return true
end
local function detour(pts, regions, exclusions, pad)
  pad=pad or 0.25
  if #exclusions==0 or M.path_clear(pts,exclusions,pad) then return pts,true end
  local nodes={pts[1],pts[#pts]}
  for _,r in ipairs(exclusions) do
    local p=pad+0.03
    for _,v in ipairs({{r[1]-p,r[2]-p},{r[1]-p,r[4]+p},{r[3]+p,r[2]-p},{r[3]+p,r[4]+p}}) do nodes[#nodes+1]=v end
  end
  local function within(p)
    for _,r in ipairs(regions) do if p[1]>=r[1] and p[1]<=r[3] and p[2]>=r[2] and p[2]<=r[4] then return true end end
    return false
  end
  local function edge(a,b)
    if not M.path_clear({a,b},exclusions,pad) then return nil end
    local length=sqrt((b[1]-a[1])^2+(b[2]-a[2])^2)
    local n=max(1,ceil(length/0.15))
    for k=0,n do local t=k/n if not within({a[1]+t*(b[1]-a[1]),a[2]+t*(b[2]-a[2])}) then return nil end end
    return length
  end
  local costs,previous,seen={[1]=0},{},{}
  for _=1,#nodes do
    local best,u=math.huge,nil
    for k=1,#nodes do if not seen[k] and (costs[k] or math.huge)<best then best,u=costs[k],k end end
    if not u then break end
    if u==2 then
      local order={2};while order[1]~=1 do table.insert(order,1,previous[order[1]]) end
      local out={};for _,k in ipairs(order) do out[#out+1]=nodes[k] end
      return out,true
    end
    seen[u]=true
    for v=1,#nodes do if not seen[v] then
      local d=edge(nodes[u],nodes[v])
      if d and best+d<(costs[v] or math.huge) then costs[v],previous[v]=best+d,u end
    end end
  end
  -- A box may block the entire column. The final PDF clip still protects it.
  return pts,false
end
function M.route(pts,regions,exclusions,pad)
  pad=pad or 0.5
  if #exclusions==0 or M.path_clear(pts,exclusions,pad) then return pts,true end
  local out={pts[1]};local i=1
  while i<#pts do
    if M.path_clear({pts[i],pts[i+1]},exclusions,pad) then out[#out+1]=pts[i+1];i=i+1
    else
      local j=i+1
      while j<#pts and M.clearance(exclusions,pts[j][1],pts[j][2])<=pad do j=j+1 end
      local segment,ok=detour({pts[i],pts[j]},regions,exclusions,pad)
      if not ok then return pts,false end
      for k=2,#segment do out[#out+1]=segment[k] end
      i=j
    end
  end
  local rounded={out[1]}
  local function line_to(b)
    local a=rounded[#rounded];local n=max(1,ceil(sqrt((b[1]-a[1])^2+(b[2]-a[2])^2)/0.15))
    for j=1,n do local t=j/n rounded[#rounded+1]={a[1]+t*(b[1]-a[1]),a[2]+t*(b[2]-a[2])} end
  end
  for k=2,#out-1 do
    local a,b,c=out[k-1],out[k],out[k+1]
    local u,v=sqrt((a[1]-b[1])^2+(a[2]-b[2])^2),sqrt((c[1]-b[1])^2+(c[2]-b[2])^2)
    if u>1e-9 and v>1e-9 then
      local r=min(0.6,u*0.4,v*0.4)
      local entry={b[1]+r*(a[1]-b[1])/u,b[2]+r*(a[2]-b[2])/u}
      local exit={b[1]+r*(c[1]-b[1])/v,b[2]+r*(c[2]-b[2])/v}
      line_to(entry)
      for j=1,8 do local t=j/8;rounded[#rounded+1]={(1-t)^2*entry[1]+2*t*(1-t)*b[1]+t*t*exit[1],(1-t)^2*entry[2]+2*t*(1-t)*b[2]+t*t*exit[2]} end
    end
  end
  line_to(out[#out])
  if M.path_clear(rounded,exclusions,0.20) then return rounded,true end
  return out,true
end
return M
